Chapter 1251: The Holy Emperor Steps Across Du’E

Under the dual enhancement of the Flowing Light Armor and the Seven-Colored Jade Void Glimmering Light, his speed had reached an unbelievable level.

Even though he flew so ostentatiously, radiating seven-colored brilliance all over his body, his speed was simply too fast. Not a single cultivator in the entire Nine Mountain Prefecture could detect him.

Not even the Dao Integration guardian of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

At first Ou Shangtian was still somewhat cautious, but after confirming that no one could sense him, he gradually relaxed.

He even felt a thrill of being able to do whatever he wanted.

“Refreshing! Truly refreshing!”

In the vast Nine Mountain Prefecture, he had flown back and forth several times in the time it takes to breathe. The feeling of riding the wind and lightning left Ou Shangtian somewhat intoxicated.

At the same time, he could not help feeling puzzled: “Just by flying around like this nonstop, can I really lure that Stone Tablet out?”

“Is it really that mysterious? With my speed, could it be that he cannot even find me?”

“Should I slow down a bit and try?”

Just as Ou Shangtian’s thoughts began to wander, an inexplicable sense of crisis suddenly rose in his heart.

A scene suddenly surged into his mind.

The sky and earth suddenly darkened.

As if bound by some invisible force, no matter how he flew, he could not escape the range of the darkness.

In despair, his body could only slowly slide toward the center of the darkness.

“!”

Ou Shangtian’s heart shook violently.

He knew this was the spontaneous warning from his other companion strange object besides the Kun-Qian Bone Hand: the Book of Ten Thousand Deaths.

“What the hell is this thing? The Stone Tablet?”

The foreseen scene made Ou Shangtian’s hair stand on end. Without hesitation, he detonated one of the formation crowns he had prepared long ago.

In an instant, countless formations were deployed, protecting Ou Shangtian at the center.

Only then did the illusory scene from the Book of Ten Thousand Deaths slowly dissipate.

But the sense of crisis in Ou Shangtian’s heart did not fade. As the one who had set up the formations, he could clearly feel that the hundreds of thousands of formations he had personally arranged around him were disappearing at an unbelievable speed.

Yet from beginning to end, he had not seen the person breaking the formations. It was as if something was silently devouring them.

The horror in his heart grew even stronger. While the protective formations were still effective, Ou Shangtian threw several more formation crowns around him.

Layers of formations spread out one after another, and a blurry figure slowly revealed its form.

Ou Shangtian did not dare to look any longer.

“Earth veins!”

With a silent shout in his heart, Ou Shangtian plunged straight from the sky into the ground.

He vanished in an instant.

Yet the countless formations he left behind were strangely compressed into solid book-page-like entities and all slowly floated toward the suddenly appearing figure.

The figure gradually revealed its true appearance: a scholar-like figure with a very conspicuous stone tablet on his back.

Every time he received a book page and finished reading it, the page disappeared from his hand with a flash of fluorescent light, as if it had been imprinted onto the stone tablet.

The scholar was not in a hurry to chase the fleeing Ou Shangtian. Instead, he unhurriedly read through all the book pages in his hand.

His originally calm face gradually showed a frown.

“When did formations in the Xuanhuang Realm develop to such a level?”

“That light of the world…”

“Could it be an outsider?”

All the pages in his hand vanished. The scholar glanced toward the position where he sensed Ou Shangtian was located.

“What fast speed. He even has the Earth Vein Ancient Tree as a helper.”

The scholar reviewed the Stone Tablet’s recent records.

He found no related entries.

“More and more external prefectures are appearing. Even the Stone Tablet that claims to know everything is gradually failing to live up to its name.”

“Carefree, you were right. Nothing is truly eternal. Not even immortals, and not even the power we Longevity Immortal beings take pride in.”

Although the matter clearly carried the scent of a conspiracy, as if deliberately trying to lure him over, the Stone Tablet felt no fear in his heart.

Instead, he felt even more curiosity.

With one step, he arrived at the previous location of Ou Shangtian.

However, Ou Shangtian seemed to have prepared in advance and had already slipped into the earth veins one step ahead.

The earth veins surged and roared. Even the Stone Tablet found it difficult to locate a single ant within them.

Yet the Stone Tablet was not anxious. He knew the other party would inevitably appear again, so he simply waited in place.

“Interesting. It seems the person behind this understands me somewhat.”

There was no anger at being toyed with. Instead, a faint smile appeared on the Stone Tablet’s face.

In this manner, the Stone Tablet was gradually drawn to a quiet mountain Daoist temple.

Ou Shangtian no longer fled. Instead, he stood respectfully behind a majestic figure.

The Stone Tablet’s gaze shifted from Ou Shangtian to this figure.

After observing for a moment, the smile at the corner of the stone tablet’s mouth finally disappeared.

In its place appeared a trace of puzzlement and solemnity.

The person before him gave him a feeling that was both somewhat familiar and carried a faint sense of danger.

“I cannot sense the aura of body and Dao united. Is he not in the Longevity Immortal realm? Or, like me, does he practice the ancient method of Longevity?” The stone tablet pondered silently.

“Standing like this, aren’t you tired? Come in and sit for a while.” After a brief standoff, Li Ping spoke first.

With just one sentence, he broke the tense, sword-drawn atmosphere.

It did not feel like enemies meeting, but rather like old friends reuniting and greeting each other familiarly.

A strange feeling arose in the Stone Tablet’s heart.

Still, he replied softly: “Alright.”

He followed Li Ping into the Daoist temple below.

Passing through the temple, Li Ping did not stop but continued walking to the edge of a small pond behind it.

“How long has Fellow Daoist been carrying that Stone Tablet on your back?” Li Ping asked.

The Stone Tablet was slightly startled, but he did not hide it and answered: “Thirty-six thousand nine hundred and forty-two years.”

“Thirty-six thousand nine hundred and forty-two years.” Li Ping repeated the number.

“It sounds like a very long time. Yet it is only a little over thirty thousand years. Compared to the lifespan of the Xuanhuang Realm, it is insignificant. Not to mention the Star Sea beyond the Xuanhuang Realm.” Li Ping said with some emotion.

The Stone Tablet agreed: “Yes, thirty thousand years pass in the blink of an eye. For heaven and earth itself, it may be nothing. But for an ordinary person like me, it has truly been quite long.”

“Ordinary person…” Ou Shangtian could not help muttering softly at this moment.

Li Ping smiled: “Shangtian, do not be rude. This senior is right. He is indeed just an ordinary person.”

Ou Shangtian dared not disobey the Holy Emperor and quickly bowed to the Stone Tablet in apology.

The Stone Tablet did not take offense at all. Instead, he stared straight at Li Ping: “You… seem to know me quite well?”

Li Ping did not admit it: “It is only that I feel some empathy.”

“I am also just an ordinary person, bearing a destined mission.”

Upon hearing these words, Ou Shangtian lowered his head even further, afraid of showing even the slightest abnormality.

The Stone Tablet, however, fell into thought and continued to examine Li Ping carefully.

That tall and sturdy figure was different from ordinary cultivators.

The several strands of aura entwined around him were all extremely profound, making the Stone Tablet dare not underestimate him.

“Fellow Daoist lured me here. What is your purpose? Could it be simply to chat for a few words?” In the end, the Stone Tablet asked directly, ending the exchange of veiled words between them.

“I am here to help Fellow Daoist achieve liberation.” Li Ping said in a deep voice.

These straightforward words caused Ou Shangtian to raise his head, a flash of excitement in his eyes.

The Stone Tablet narrowed his eyes and grew wary.

“It seems Fellow Daoist has misunderstood me. I truly wish to help you achieve liberation.” A trace of disappointment appeared in Li Ping’s tone.

The Faceless Holy Emperor pointed around him.

“Could it be that Fellow Daoist has not noticed anything unusual here?”

Upon hearing this, the stone tablet finally shifted his attention from the Faceless Holy Emperor to the surroundings.

After looking around, his gaze finally settled on the calm little pond.

Although the pond appeared ordinary with no obvious mysteries, instinct told the Stone Tablet that some secret must be hidden here.

The Stone Tablet walked slowly to the edge of the pond. The clear pool water reflected the appearance of a scholar, causing him to pause slightly.

He then shook his head, and in an instant his appearance changed completely.

“I am somewhat curious what you originally looked like.” The Faceless Holy Emperor Li Ping said from behind him.

“Heh, even I can barely remember anymore.” The Stone Tablet smiled self-mockingly.

He then began to observe the pond seriously.

The pool water was not deep. A single glance revealed everything.

“Hmm?”

The Stone Tablet observed for a long time but could not find the pond’s secret. He could not help doubting his own judgment.

He turned his head to look at Li Ping.

Li Ping did not explain. Instead, he suddenly asked with deeper meaning: “Before the great calamity of the Xuanhuang Realm, many immortal treasures existed in the world. Now, more than ten thousand years have passed, and these treasures have long since vanished without trace. The existence of immortal artifacts has become legend, and even casual conversations among cultivators rarely mention them.”

“Does Fellow Daoist know anything about the whereabouts of these immortal treasures?”

The Stone Tablet’s expression remained unchanged: “Immortal artifacts? I have never cared about…”

Halfway through his sentence, he seemed to realize something and suddenly looked at the Fishing Pond again.

After pondering for a moment, his appearance changed once more.

An old fisherman wearing a straw raincoat and carrying a fish basket instantly appeared before Li Ping.

Green light flashed in his hand. The fisherman-form Stone Tablet cast out his fishing rod.

In the next moment, his body stiffened violently.

Without reeling in the line, the Stone Tablet stood motionless in place, as if frozen in ice.

Only after a long time did he take a step back and break free from the illusion before his eyes.

“What was that?” The Stone Tablet stared straight at Li Ping.

“What do you mean ‘what was that’?” The Holy Emperor asked knowingly.

“The fish pond? The starry sky?” The Stone Tablet pressed further.

Li Ping shook his head slightly: “That is the Bait.”

“Bait?” The Stone Tablet was momentarily stunned.

“The angler may also be angled.” Li Ping’s tone turned cold.

“Even if Fellow Daoist remains unmoved upon seeing treasures from the entire starry sky, what if it involves the path to your liberation? Could you still stay so calm?” Li Ping’s voice was faint.

The Stone Tablet had lived in the Xuanhuang Realm for far too long and had witnessed too many things.

After hearing Li Ping’s words and pondering for a moment, he quickly understood the meaning.

“With the immortal path severed, the star sea outside the Xuanhuang Realm should have long become ruins. Unless…” A flash of realization appeared in the Stone Tablet’s eyes.

“Why, do you also wish to go out and take a look?” Li Ping asked.

The Stone Tablet denied it: “Matters of the world are largely the same. Even in another world, what difference would it make? I only wish to remove the heavy stone on my back and sleep soundly for once.”

He returned the topic to the Fishing Pond: “I do not know when this thing arrived in the Xuanhuang Realm. But it can be confirmed that it was after the great calamity.”

“More precisely, after the Immortal Ancestor reappeared and established the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.”

The Holy Emperor spoke even more clearly: “In other words, this Fishing Pond was most likely implanted into the Xuanhuang Realm together with fragments from other immortal cultivation realms.”

“That should be the case… However, treasures of the immortal path have already transcended our understanding. One cannot be certain.” The Stone Tablet left some room in his words.

“The path of liberation you mentioned, is it to make me bite this bait?” The Stone Tablet looked at the Holy Emperor with a somewhat strange expression.

Li Ping replied frankly: “Exactly. Does Fellow Daoist not feel endless suffering? You are fused with the Genesis Stone Tablet. Across the entire world, I believe only immortal path treasures that surpass the power limit of the immortal cultivation realm can separate you from the stone tablet.”

“As for what fate awaits after being hooked away by the power behind the Fishing Pond, that is something I cannot guarantee.”

The Stone Tablet very much wanted to say: I have no grudge against you, so why harm me?

But the words reached his lips and stopped.

It was obvious that this Faceless Venerable harbored no malice. Otherwise, he would not have revealed the entire plan openly.

On the contrary, the Stone Tablet felt that the person before him was quite sincere.

Moreover, a certain familiar aura emanating from the other party’s body gave him an inexplicable sense of reassurance.

“I am simply tired of living and wish to shed this burden. It is not that I do not want to live.” The Stone Tablet politely declined the Holy Emperor’s kindness.

“If Fellow Daoist is merely troubled by the endless stream of information constantly emerging from the Genesis Stone Tablet, then the matter is actually easy to handle.” Only now did Li Ping reveal his true intention.

“Oh?” The Stone Tablet’s eyes clearly carried doubt.

“Does Fellow Daoist recognize this object?” Li Ping stretched out his hand. A brilliant blue crystal floated quietly in his palm.

“The Dao Deviation Stone. Of course I know it. You mean to…” The Stone Tablet shook his head.

“To be honest, in order to relieve the pain, I have tried various methods. I have also attempted the Dao Transformation Divine Art from the Taiyan Sect. However, the Genesis Stone Tablet is the embodiment of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao’s authority. The Heavenly Dao stands high above and looks down on all things. After fusing with me, it can no longer accommodate anything else.”

“That was in the past. Times have changed.” Li Ping directly interrupted the Stone Tablet.

The Stone Tablet was slightly stunned.

“Moreover, I can help you.”

As these words were spoken, the aura around the Faceless Holy Emperor changed.

Above the Daoist temple, wind and clouds gathered. A strange rhythm appeared out of nowhere and resonated with the Holy Emperor.

The familiar and intimate feeling in the Stone Tablet’s heart grew even stronger.

“You are…?!”

Even though he had lived for tens of thousands of years, he could not help but cry out in shock at this moment.

“The Great Celestial Venerable of Xuanhuang?!”

But he quickly denied it himself: “No, that is impossible. Moreover…”

The Stone Tablet raised his head and gazed at the sky. His expression shifted from shock to solemnity.

The authority controlled by the Great Celestial Venerable of Xuanhuang was independent from the Genesis Stone Tablet yet stood above it.

Although the Stone Tablet still recorded his deeds, only a few vague lines remained, giving merely the roughest outline.

But at this moment, sensing the aura on the Faceless Holy Emperor, it was clearly different from the records of the Great Celestial Venerable of Xuanhuang.

“The Great Celestial Venerable of Xuanhuang controls the Nine Heavens Dao. Although he has countless connections with the Heavenly Dao, he is more like a separate individual. With certain blessings, he can command the laws of the Heavenly Dao as easily as moving his own arm. But this person before me.”

An idea suddenly arose in the Stone Tablet’s mind.

“Heavenly Dao incarnation?”

Although it seemed somewhat unbelievable, this was the most reasonable explanation.

Li Ping seemed to sense what the Stone Tablet was thinking and no longer displayed his connection with the Heavenly Dao.

He also did not explain directly.

Instead, he returned to the previous topic: “With the Dao Deviation Stone to help you share and organize the events occurring in the Xuanhuang Realm, it should ease your burden somewhat.”

“But relying on the Dao Deviation Stone alone is not enough.”

The Stone Tablet’s gaze sharpened slightly as he waited for the other party’s next words.

“The Du'e Sect. Fellow Daoist should not be unfamiliar with it.” Li Ping asked.

Upon hearing these three words, the Stone Tablet’s expression turned slightly unpleasant.

“The World-Observing Divine Eye of the Du'e Sect shares the same effect as the Genesis Stone Tablet. Combined with the endless paper figures, that Du'e Book can similarly record everything it monitors.”

“The Du'e Book together with the Dao Deviation Stone should be able to roughly offset the side effects of the Genesis Stone Tablet. As for the rest, with the resilient will you have cultivated over tens of thousands of years, handling it should not be a big problem.” The Faceless Holy Emperor said slowly.

The Stone Tablet fell silent, inwardly considering the feasibility of the other party’s suggestion.

“First, the quality of this Dao Deviation Stone in your hand is somewhat insufficient…” After a moment, the Stone Tablet spoke.

“No problem. I can find a better one.” The Holy Emperor stated directly.

The Stone Tablet paused, then continued: “Second, the Du'e Sect once angered the Immortal Ancestor. The entire sect was sealed and has vanished into seclusion. Because of the cultivation method they practice, Eternal Aeon of Tribulation, they can even interfere with the perception of heaven and earth. Moreover, since it was the Immortal Ancestor who acted.”

“I know where they are hiding.” The Holy Emperor said calmly.

The Stone Tablet was stunned.

“It seems this person is even stronger than I imagined.”

Since the other party had spoken to this extent, the Stone Tablet naturally would not remain hesitant.

“Please lend me your assistance.” He said sincerely.

Li Ping had been waiting for exactly these words.

“Follow me.”

His figure flickered and in an instant appeared at the edge of the sky.

The Stone Tablet followed in one step.

Leaving behind a bewildered Ou Shangtian.

He had not heard the conversation between the Holy Emperor and the Stone Tablet.

Ever since Li Ping pointed toward the Fishing Pond, Ou Shangtian had lost all perception of these two powerhouses.

Only now, as they left one after the other.

“Master was supposed to deal with that Stone Tablet, right? Why didn’t they fight?”

“Could it be that, just like the Earth Vein Ancient Tree, he will also join our Holy Dynasty?”

Ou Shangtian suddenly had a bad premonition in his heart.

At this moment, Li Ping and the Stone Tablet had already arrived outside the Du'e Sect, at the seal left by the Inni Ancestor.

Watching Li Ping skillfully dispel the Immortal Ancestor's seal, more and more doubts arose in the Stone Tablet's heart.

“This is a seal left by the Immortal Ancestor. Even a Heavenly Dao incarnation should not be able to crack it so easily, right?”

“Or has the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, after so many years, recovered to the point where it can contend with the Immortal Ancestor?”

Chapter 1252: The Background Of The Immortal Ancestor

Li Ping paid no attention to what the Stone Tablet was thinking and led him straight into the Du'e Sect.

Ascending the mountain, descending the mountain, endlessly repeating courtyards...

All flashed rapidly before them, until finally the main hall of the Du'e Sect appeared before the two.

“Go in.”

The Stone Tablet followed inside and confirmed that this was indeed the former site of the Du'e Sect.

He could sense that countless paper figures, seemingly alive yet dead, were hidden in this dim hall.

“They were one of the Ten Great Immortal Sects of the Xuanhuang Realm, enjoying the immortal cultivation resources produced by the Xuanhuang Realm. Yet at the moment of calamity, they chose to hide from the world and escape disaster. They truly deserve to be called parasites of the Xuanhuang Realm, just like those so-called World-Observing Divine Eyes.” Li Ping’s words were ice-cold as he criticized mercilessly.

“Eternal Aeon of Tribulation, cultivating by exploiting the world’s calamities. This is inherently a technique that brings harm to heaven and earth. If heaven and earth were thriving without calamities, these people would probably create calamities themselves. Such a sect should have been eradicated long ago.” Li Ping continued.

It seemed as though they heard the Holy Emperor’s words; a cold wind suddenly blew through the eerie hall without cause.

“Thinking that by turning into paper figures they could escape everything...”

A golden chain emerged from the Holy Emperor’s body.

Silently, it shot fiercely into the depths of the hall’s darkness.

Just like fog being stirred, the blackness within the Du'e Sect hall rippled like water waves.

Stone Tablet examined the golden chain, a trace of surprise flashing in his eyes.

Then, within Li Ping’s body, a golden vortex phantom slowly took shape.

Countless chains whistled out, following the direction of the vortex’s rotation.

Bang, bang...

As they flew into the darkness, they continuously emitted muffled sounds as if colliding with something.

The Holy Emperor’s aura was too overwhelming; even the Stone Tablet had to step back temporarily.

The Stone Tablet secretly felt alarmed: “This one’s strength is quite a bit stronger than an ordinary Longevity Immortal Realm cultivator.”

“And...”

“It seems to be more than just the power of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.”

Creaking sounds rose and fell throughout the hall.

As the golden vortex nebula within the Holy Emperor’s body reversed, the golden chains contracted.

Something in the darkness seemed to be bound by the chains and was forcibly dragged out.

If ordinary cultivators saw this scene, they would undoubtedly feel their hair stand on end.

Yet the stone tablet felt a rare surge of excitement in his heart.

When a paper figure with a somewhat terrified face emerged from the darkness, the Stone Tablet’s eyebrows rose slightly.

It was these guys!

The paper figure bared its teeth and claws, still trying to struggle.

The end of the chain binding it burst with dazzling light, and the paper figure instantly wilted as if struck by lightning.

Fear, accompanied by listlessness; several different expressions could actually appear on the hollow paper face, which was truly somewhat wondrous.

Li Ping reached out and gripped the paper figure tightly in his palm.

Around the Holy Emperor, countless golden chains danced continuously, dragging more and more paper figures out from the darkness.

The hall began to shake unsteadily; even the entire Du'e Mountain seemed on the verge of collapse.

“Hmph!”

Li Ping stomped fiercely. Golden light rings spread outward from beneath his feet.

The space that was about to shatter froze as if encased in ice.

Li Ping lowered his head and fixed his faceless gaze on the paper figure in his hand.

He applied slight force, and a wail suddenly issued from the paper figure in his hand.

“Fellow Daoist, ease up, ease up...”

“We have no grudge or enmity; why resort to such ruthless measures!”

The paper figure stopped playing dead and hastily spoke.

“Fellow Daoist? You think you deserve that?!” Li Ping’s tone was full of disdain as he applied a bit more force.

At the same time, the countless golden chains around him synchronously emitted brilliant light.

In the hall, the pained voices of the paper figures rose and fell one after another.

“Venerable One, spare us! Venerable One, spare us!”

The situation was stronger than the man; the paper figures finally stopped being stubborn and begged for mercy repeatedly.

Li Ping did not stop immediately.

The vortex nebula continued to rotate as he retracted the chains.

He gathered all the Du'e Sect paper figures into one place before ceasing the torment.

“Is this the renowned Du'e Sect of ancient times?”

Li Ping looked at the pile of paper figures stacked together before him and said in a deep voice.

“We dare not claim such renown, we dare not...”

“We only sought survival, that is all.”

Amid the paper figures’ wails, one voice stood out as rather unique.

The Holy Emperor’s golden chain moved slightly, and one of the paper figures was pulled before Li Ping.

It was somewhat different from the others. This paper figure showed little fear on its face. Instead, it looked listless and lethargic.

Its thick eyebrows slanted upward, giving it a rather comical appearance.

“Seeking survival?”

“If the skin is gone, where can the hair attach? If the Xuanhuang Realm is destroyed, where can you all survive!” the Holy Emperor said coldly.

The thick-browed paper figure smiled bitterly: “Our Du'e Sect has only mediocre strength. If the Xuanhuang Realm is truly destroyed, there is nothing we can do, is there? We can only accept it.”

“Could it be that Venerable One would blame the mortals of this world for not stepping forward to save the Xuanhuang Realm? One can only do as much as one’s ability allows…”

Li Ping did not argue with the Du'e Sect paper figure. The golden chain tightened slightly once more: “Sharp-tongued even at death’s door, still unrepentant.”

The golden light slowly condensed, changing from chain-thick to thread-thin. It wrapped around the thick-browed paper figure layer by layer.

The other captured paper figures all cried out in extreme terror. Only the thick-browed paper figure sat upright as if in solemn meditation, its expression turning grave.

It chanted softly: “Time turns to emptiness, calamities endure eternally. A hundred lifetimes and a thousand tribulations, melt my golden body…”

The golden source power that the Holy Emperor had always wielded with unstoppable success lost its effect for the first time.

Li Ping only felt that the power exerted on the thick-browed paper figure was ingeniously neutralized by an invisible force.

It was even absorbed by the other party and became part of its foundation.

The golden threads slowly dissolved. The thick-browed paper figure remained unmoved, but the color of the paper figure changed from its old yellowish-white to a brilliant gold close to that of source power essence.

Stone Tablet, who had been watching from the side, instantly grew serious: “Fellow Daoist, be careful. This is precisely the Du'e Sect’s supreme technique Eternal Aeon of Tribulation, which can transform all the calamitous forces of the world into nourishment for one’s own cultivation.”

Li Ping sneered coldly: “Nothing but a cowardly turtle hiding its head. You want to borrow my power to cultivate? Then I shall oblige you!”

Dazzling golden radiance like blazing flames erupted from the Holy Emperor’s body.

The flames of light blazed fiercely, illuminating the entire Du'e Sect space in golden yellow.

The golden flames, as if condensed into solid form, were poured entirely into the paper figure’s golden body along the remaining chains.

The paper figures that were not the Holy Emperor’s main targets but merely caught in the aftermath all let out earth-shaking wails as if being roasted by fierce flames. One could imagine the intense pressure the golden-bodied paper figure endured. It appeared twisted, as if about to melt.

Yet the thick-browed paper figure remained steadfast and unmoved, its expression calm.

This scene caused the Stone Tablet to feel secretly alarmed.

Although they had transformed into paper figures and their original appearances could not be recognized, those who could remain composed and unharmed under the Holy Emperor’s overwhelming might were rare even in the Du'e Sect at its peak.

The Stone Tablet was speculating about the identity of the thick-browed paper figure.

At the same time, the Faceless Holy Emperor did not lessen the torment on the Du'e Sect paper figures.

The golden flames burned even more vigorously. Although they did not completely incinerate the paper figures, they slowly plated them with an indelible layer of gold.

Especially the thick-browed paper figure, wrapped in raging flames, its body’s golden light grew even more striking.

“You wish to hide from the world and avoid calamity, but I will not allow it!”

“The prosperity and peril of Xuanhuang concern all of you!”

The Holy Emperor’s voice thundered like lightning as source power essence erupted fiercely.

It shone into every corner of the space. The brilliance was so intense that even the Stone Tablet could not help but close his eyes to avoid it.

Once the light receded, the darkness in the Du'e Sect’s main hall completely vanished. The extremely discomforting gloomy aura was nowhere to be seen.

The paper figures, now free from the chain restraints, fell to the ground in a chaotic heap.

Compared with before, they seemed to possess a bit more vitality.

The leading thick-browed paper figure had directly transformed into a “little golden man.”

The golden figure still wore that listless, dejected look. He sighed: “Venerable One has wasted so much source power essence on useless trash like us. It is truly a reckless squandering of heavenly resources!”

“It is simply not worth it!”

Li Ping said in a deep voice: “If all matters in the world were decided by pure reason, the Xuanhuang Realm would have perished long ago! How could you still be here making noise!”

Before he finished speaking, a large “X” suddenly appeared on the golden paper figure’s face, sealing its mouth.

The rest of the paper figures followed suit.

The Du'e Sect’s main hall, which had been as noisy as a marketplace, fell silent in an instant.

“Fellow Daoist Yi Jue?” Only then did the Stone Tablet look toward the golden paper figure and ask tentatively.

The golden paper figure could not speak but merely blinked at the Stone Tablet.

It was unclear whether it was admitting or denying.

The two had no time to catch up. After losing the support of the source power essence, the space gradually became unstable.

“Let us leave first.”

Li Ping brought the Stone Tablet, along with the group of paper figures who had lost their sense of self, and flashed outside the Du'e Sect.

This ancient immortal sect, which had been suppressed by the Immortal Ancestor’s seal, finally revealed its true appearance at this moment.

A book unfolded in the air.

There were no words inside the book, only embossed mountains and empty architectural scenes.

As the book turned its pages naturally, the scenes within it kept changing. Yet everything appeared as silhouettes, looking both comical and eerie.

Li Ping’s giant hand grasped the Book of Du'e. In an instant, the mountains and grand vistas inside were dyed with a layer of gold.

“Collect!”

The Holy Emperor gave a low shout. Countless paper figures stacked together, including the thick-browed little golden figure, flew uncontrollably into the Book of Du'e.

Bang!

Li Ping pressed his right hand down, closing the book.

All anomalies vanished in an instant.

“This place is not suitable for lingering. Although my method of cracking the Immortal Ancestor’s restriction was extremely clever and restored the restriction while breaking it, there is still no guarantee that the anomalies here will not be discovered by the Immortal Ancestor.”

“Follow me.”

Li Ping spoke in a deep voice. His figure had already disappeared from the sealed space.

Stone Tablet followed the Holy Emperor all the way, passing through the Xuanhuang Realm’s spatial channel and arriving in an endless void.

Even at their speed, they flew through the void for quite some time before sensing the aura of a world ahead.

“That is…”

The Stone Tablet was slightly stunned.

“The Five Elements Cave-Heaven of the First Origin Sect? It is actually here. Does this not mean that the Longevity Immortal realm cultivator who once transported the Cave-Heaven back then…”

While the Stone Tablet was still pondering, Daoist Hundred Flowers had already come forward to greet them.

After her gaze lingered on the Stone Tablet for a moment, she transmitted something to Li Ping.

Li Ping nodded slightly.

Daoist Hundred Flowers then nodded toward the Stone Tablet before flying back into the Five Elements Cave-Heaven.

“This place is where I rest and recuperate. What does Fellow Daoist think of it compared to the Xuanhuang Realm itself?” Li Ping brought the Stone Tablet into the Great Qi small world.

With a sweep of divine sense, the general scene of the small world appeared in Stone Tablet’s mind.

Although some areas were obscured by mysterious power and he could not perceive everything, what was revealed on the surface was enough to shock Stone Tablet greatly.

Although the reputation of the Genesis Stone Tablet for recording all things under heaven had become somewhat undeserved, it had once known every event that occurred in the prefectures and regions of the original Xuanhuang Realm with perfect clarity.

Yet when compared with this Great Qi small world…

It felt like lagging behind by several centuries, an entire era.

Many things within it were even beyond the Stone Tablet’s own comprehension.

Moreover, he sensed the auras of old acquaintances here.

Such as the Earth Vein Ancient Tree, and that member of the Beast Taming Sect.

By the time they reached the Holy Emperor’s hall, the Stone Tablet’s shocked emotions had gradually calmed down somewhat.

“I have carried this Stone Tablet for so many years, thinking that all affairs under heaven were contained within my mind. Only after seeing and hearing what I have today do I realize that the matters of the world have long surpassed my expectations…” Stone Tablet said with a sense of loss.

“Fellow Daoist need not be discouraged. Constant renewal and change is the true path. If the world remained stagnant for thousands of years…”

“Would that not make us appear incompetent?” Li Ping smiled faintly.

Stone Tablet not know how to respond for a moment and remained silent.

Ever since coming into contact with this “Heavenly Dao incarnation,” the shocks he had received had been far too great.

Compared with the scenes he was witnessing now, the Xuanhuang Realm in his mind seemed like nothing more than a stage play, a false image purely performed for his benefit!

This left the Stone Tablet feeling somewhat dazed and absent-minded.

“I have long known that the Five Elders Association, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, and the other supreme experts in the Xuanhuang Realm who knew of the existence of this stone tablet behind me would do everything possible to avoid its records. But I never expected that the truth of the world had already developed to this extent…”

Li Ping vaguely sensed the Stone Tablet’s inner thoughts and said slowly: “The Xuanhuang Realm is the final surviving ground of the Darkest Star Sea. The Xuanhuang Realm itself, fragments of other worlds, Star Sea survivors, and forces beyond the High Walls.”

“All converge here. The complexity of its form is such that not even you, Fellow Daoist, nor the Immortal Ancestor or the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao itself, can claim full understanding of this place.”

“Yes…” The Stone Tablet sighed and nodded.

He also thought of the Fishing Pond he had seen earlier. How many such hidden treasures were still concealed within the Xuanhuang Realm?

As an ancient remnant of the Xuanhuang Realm, he finally experienced a faint sense of being out of step with the times.

“Things remain, but people have changed. The story is no longer the same.”

Scenes from the earliest days of the Xuanhuang Realm long ago surfaced in the Stone Tablet’s mind, leaving him momentarily dazed.

The Holy Emperor’s voice interrupted him.

“The fusion of the realms has become inevitable. A battle between me and the Immortal Ancestor is certain. However, no matter who wins or loses, it will not change the fact that the Xuanhuang Realm will be reborn from ruin.”

Li Ping did not mention helping the Stone Tablet resolve its mental overload. Instead, he suddenly spoke in this manner.

Stone Tablet’s thoughts gathered. He focused and looked at Li Ping.

“The key to the problem lies in who will become the new orthodoxy of the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“Does Fellow Daoist know the background of the Immortal Ancestor?”

Li Ping’s divine sense locked onto Stone Tablet as he asked in a deep voice.

Stone Tablet pondered for a moment before replying: “When the Immortal Ancestor first appeared back then, our Ten Great Immortal Sects investigated him. This person was indeed a native cultivator of the Xuanhuang Realm. His life trajectory from childhood to adulthood was completely clean and fully documented.”

“The Immortal Ancestor’s is named Xuanyuan, given name Tuo. He grew up in a rural village, and because he was frail and often ill as a child, his parents gave him the nickname ‘Goudan.’ (Dog Egg).”

“Before the age of fifty, his life trajectory was no different from that of an ordinary farmer. It was only after he turned fifty-one that he suddenly attained enlightenment and rose in a single morning.”

“Precisely because of this, the Ten Immortal Sects’ initial investigation could not uncover his origins. He had truly achieved enlightenment suddenly.”

Stone Tablet recounted slowly.

Scenes from those years also appeared within the Holy Emperor’s hall.

...

“Xuanyuan Tuo.” Li Ping watched the somewhat silly and foolish youth on the screen gradually turn into a silent and reserved middle-aged farmer, then slowly transform into a white-haired elderly man.

“It is possible for a mortal to attain enlightenment in a single morning, but it usually happens in youth. The Immortal Ancestor’s transformation occurred almost at the point when his lifespan was nearing its limit.”

“It is truly puzzling and suspicious.” Li Ping commented.

Stone Tablet nodded: “The Ten Sects had the same suspicion back then. However, we used secret techniques and received confirmation from the Heavenly Dao that no possession or impersonation by an external person had occurred on his body.”

“Yet the Immortal Ancestor remains extremely mysterious. It is as if he was a congenital knower. Back then, several Longevity Immortal realm experts from the Ten Sects launched a surprise attack on him, yet he somehow resolved it by unknown means. From then on, he completely slipped beyond our control. Perhaps if the Ten Sects had struck with full force at the beginning, the outcome might have been different…” Stone Tablet said with some regret.

The hall suddenly fell silent.

After a long time.

Li Ping suddenly asked: “Heavenly Dao confirmation… What if the opponent’s method of stealing identity transcends the Heavenly Dao itself?”

Stone Tablet froze in astonishment.

At first glance, these words seemed unreasonable.

But upon careful reflection, Stone Tablet realized that it was precisely because the Ten Sects had placed too much faith in their own methods back then that they had held this unshakable conclusion for thousands of years.

“At this point, what use is there in pursuing the Immortal Ancestor’s background?”

After a brief moment of loss, this thought rose in the Stone Tablet’s mind. With lingering doubt, he looked toward the Holy Emperor once more.

The Holy Emperor’s voice thundered and echoed within the hall: “Just as I said earlier, the key to the newborn Xuanhuang Realm lies in the word ‘orthodoxy.’”

“It is like assembling a brand-new body from severed limbs. Who becomes the brain is very important.”

“Right now, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao still considers itself the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao. But before long, that may no longer be the case.”

Li Ping’s tone was profound.

Stone Tablet knew that the other party was a Heavenly Dao incarnation and would not speak without reason. His expression changed: “Please explain in detail, Fellow Daoist.”

“The things you observe through the Stone Tablet can all be viewed from an outsider’s perspective, detached from the events. However, when realms merge, the memories feel as though experienced personally, blurring the line between truth and illusion. Over time, one can no longer distinguish the false from the real, or the self from the external.”

“Especially…”

Li Ping’s gaze turned toward the Xuanhuang Realm proper, countless miles away.

“The Heavenly Dao today is already weak, and its power to resist is minimal.”

“If one day the remnant wills of the Heavenly Daos from the various realms surge in like a collapsing flood.”

“I fear the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao would be unable to withstand it in the first instant and would go mad, losing its sense of self.”

Li Ping’s tone carried a hint of self-mockery.

“After that, if someone uses a relatively intact Heavenly Dao will to guide and erode it, they could steal the heavens and replace the sun, changing the orthodoxy of the Xuanhuang Realm. At that time, although it would still be called the Xuanhuang Realm, from the inside out, it would no longer be the original Xuanhuang.”

Upon hearing this, Stone Tablet fell into deep thought.

The objective Li Ping referred to in his words was clearly the Immortal Ancestor.

Chapter 1253: Clear World-Observing Divine Eye

“As the saying goes, when the nest is overturned, how can there be any intact eggs? When the Xuanhuang Realm is no longer the Xuanhuang Realm, existences like you, Fellow Daoist, who rely on the Xuanhuang Realm today will likely face retribution as well.”

“Even Longevity is not a true escape..” The Faceless Holy Emperor delivered his conclusion.

The moment Li Ping finished speaking, a sense of crisis naturally arose in the heart of Stone Tablet. It was as if his spiritual intuition was echoing Li Ping’s conclusion.

“I had never considered this point before. I wonder what the other Longevity Immortal ones think. We have had no contact for many years.”

After pondering for a long time, Stone Tablet replied in this manner.

Li Ping gave a cold laugh: “Those few still plan to sit on the mountain and watch the tigers fight.”

“But it does not matter. Staying neutral is fine as well. They were never within the scope of my plans anyway.”

Stone Tablet skipped over the topic: “So, Fellow Daoist, you say the key point is that Xuanhuang is the orthodoxy.”

“How can this be achieved? Moreover, if it is truly as you say, if we make any unusual moves, the Immortal Ancestor will surely detect and stop us.”

Li Ping remained silent for a long while without responding.

Instead, he suddenly said: “Let me first help Fellow Daoist resolve the trouble brought by the Stone Tablet on your back.”

Stone Tablet knew very well that in the eyes of the Holy Emperor before him, he was not yet someone to whom all plans could be fully disclosed. Thus, he did not press the matter and simply cupped his hands: “In that case, I shall thank Fellow Daoist in advance. If it does not succeed, it is also fine.”

“Since I have taken action, there is no reason for failure.”

The Holy Emperor’s single sentence left the Stone Tablet speechless.

Snap!

The Book of Du'e was thrown by Li Ping onto the floor of the great hall.

The book pages flipped rapidly without any wind.

Gilded paper figures surged out from the book one after another, lining up neatly like soldiers in formation.

Leading them was naturally the thick-browed little golden figure from before.

No one knew what method the Holy Emperor had used, but after being suppressed for less than half a day, the paper figures seemed to have undergone an earth-shaking change compared to when they had just left the Du'e Sect.

The Stone Tablet’s gaze focused on the Du'e Sect paper figures.

Li Ping, however, sensed an unusual movement from Cat Treasure inside the Holy Dynasty’s treasury.

As if it had discovered something of great interest, it flashed to Li Ping’s side. Standing on Li Ping’s shoulder, it affectionately rubbed against his head, yet its eyes stared fixedly at the paper figures below.

An inexplicable atmosphere instantly enveloped the Holy Emperor’s hall.

The paper figures, which had been shaking their heads and making occasional small movements, suddenly froze like ice sculptures.

They did not dare move at all.

The leading little golden figure even began circulating the [Eternal Aeon of Tribulation] technique.

However, the golden light on its body flickered like a candle in the wind, appearing extremely precarious.

Even when they had just faced the Holy Emperor’s threat to refine the entire Du'e Sect, the whole sect had not been this terrified.

Yet at this moment, they acted as if they had encountered their true natural enemy.

Stone Tablet, who had been continuously watching the Du'e Sect paper figures, naturally noticed the abnormality in the hall. he looked toward the Faceless Holy Emperor seated high above with some uncertainty.

From the Stone Tablet’s expression, Li Ping judged that the other party had not discovered Cat Treasure on his shoulder.

With an almost imperceptible glance at the restless Cat Treasure, countless thoughts flashed through the Holy Emperor’s mind.

“It is not that it saw [food] and wanted to hunt, but pure curiosity.”

“The entire Du'e Sect, although also unable to see Cat Treasure, instinctively sensed a fatal calamity crisis due to their cultivation technique. To be frightened to this extent is interesting.”

“Cat Treasure… and what lies beyond the High Wall…”

Li Ping separated a strand of golden source power to calm the restless Cat Treasure.

After observing the paper figures below for a round, Cat Treasure seemed to suddenly lose interest. It only licked some source power from Li Ping before flashing back to the Holy Dynasty’s treasury below to rest.

The eerie atmosphere in the hall gradually returned to normal.

No one brought up the strangeness that had just occurred in the hall. The Du'e Sect members simply transformed from scattered rural soldiers into a battle-hardened army, moving according to the Holy Emperor’s will.

With Li Ping’s permission, the thick-browed little golden figure glanced at the stone slab and explained: “The Genesis Stone Tablet connects to the foundational laws of the Xuanhuang World. It is like the growth rings of a tree, automatically recording everything that happens in the Xuanhuang Realm at every moment.”

“With the scale of a world, it is nothing even if it contains all major and minor events over tens of thousands, or even hundreds of thousands or millions of years. However, when all of this must be borne by a human…”

“It naturally becomes extremely painful.”

The little golden figure cupped his hands toward Li Ping: “In fact, if Venerable One wishes to resolve this matter, it is actually quite simple. One way is to increase this person’s carrying capacity. The second is to create a buffer.”

The leader of the Du'e Sect acted as if he did not recognize the Stone Tablet at all. He beckoned toward the Book of Du'e not far away.

As the pages flipped, countless scenes recorded by the [Clear World-Observing Divine Eye] flashed across them.

“Our Du'e Sect has also supervised the Xuanhuang Realm to a certain extent over the years, much like the Genesis Stone Tablet. The difference is that none of us directly contacted this vast amount of information. Instead, we first recorded and stored it, then divided the labor to review it. One person’s power is naturally insufficient to handle it, but the power of an entire sect makes it effortless.”

The little golden figure looked at the Stone Tablet again: “If you are alone and wish to alleviate or even get rid of the burden of the Stone Tablet, you will need to rely on external objects. In the past, being rejected by the Heavenly Dao made it somewhat difficult. But now, with Venerable’s assistance, it should not be a big problem.”

From the little golden figure’s tone and expression, the Stone Tablet became even more certain that the other party was the former acting sect master of the Du'e Sect, the Daoist Yi Jue. However, since the other party refused to acknowledge it, he could only pretend not to recognize him.

Li Ping waited until Yi Jue finished speaking before addressing Stone Tablet: “Fellow Daoist, please wait for me a moment.”

With that, the Holy Emperor’s figure disappeared from the Holy Emperor’s hall.

Even the entire Great Qi small world could no longer sense his presence.

In the hall, only a group of Du'e Sect paper figures and the standing Stone Tablet remained.

The Stone Tablet looked at Yi Jue and opened his mouth to speak, but hesitated.

“Since we have already pledged ourselves to the Venerable One, everything from the past is like clouds and smoke, not to be mentioned again.” Yi Jue stared straight ahead and said so.

“Of course, if you become like us and we serve as colleagues, it would not hurt to grow closer.”

This way of handling matters greatly resembled Yi Jue’s attitude from back then.

The Stone Tablet nodded slightly, indicating that he understood the meaning behind the other party’s words.

“In the Immortal Ancestor’s sealing space, even when facing the golden flame refinement, our Du'e Sect actually did not feel much fear. Because we did not sense any true, unavoidable calamity.”

“But just now, inside this hall…”

“An unprecedented terrifying disaster. Be careful. That person is not simple…”

A faint voice from Yi Jue reached the Stone Tablet’s ears. The Stone Tablet’s heart tightened.

He wanted to chat a bit more with the other party, but the little golden man refused to respond any further.

Meanwhile, the Faceless Holy Emperor Li Ping returned to the hall shortly after.

“This Dao Deviation Stone should be of sufficient quality.”

He threw a blue crystal toward the stone slab.

“Venerable One is wise. A high-grade Dao Deviation Stone is more than adequate for use as a recording buffer.” Before Stone Tablet could reply, Du'e Sect’s Yi Jue spoke up first.

“Actually, a medium-grade one would already be enough. high-grade is somewhat wasteful.” The little golden man’s tone even carried a hint of flattery.

Seeing this, Stone Tablet shook his head slightly and directly reached out to grasp the Dao Deviation Stone in front of him.

After testing it, although the repulsion from the Heavenly Dao laws had weakened somewhat compared to before, it still did not allow foreign objects to enter.

Stone Tablet looked toward Li Ping.

“It is merely a high-grade Dao Deviation Stone. If Fellow Daoist does not mind, that is fine.” The Holy Emperor spoke very graciously.

“Follow me.”

At Li Ping’s instruction, the Stone Tablet and all the paper figures of the Du'e Sect followed him to the sky above the Great Qi small world.

At the intersection point where the unknown formation power enveloping the entire small world converged, golden threads could occasionally be seen spiraling and circling, forming a hollow.

Above the hollow, the color of the sky was no longer azure but pitch black.

It seemed to connect to some unknown existence.

Upon arriving here, an inexplicable sense of crisis rose once more in the Stone Tablet’s heart.

“What formation is this again?”

Stone Tablet had already grown somewhat numb, but out of instinct he still observed the traces of the formation here.

The paper figures of the Du'e Sect, however, all maintained calm expressions, as if they did not realize the danger of this place.

Li Ping stepped forward, arrived at the center of the hollow, and sat cross-legged in the void.

An inexplicable aura surged from the Holy Emperor. Soon after, a straight beam of golden light shot out from the top of his head and flew into the unknown blackness.

It was as if a certain passage had been opened. The black was stirred, and its color gradually shifted toward the normal sky around it.

Stone Tablet raised his head and sensed from the end of the hollow a very familiar aura belonging to the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

“Fellow Daoist, come here.” Li Ping spoke at this moment.

Stone Tablet’s figure floated over and sat in the air opposite the Holy Emperor.

The Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao aura poured down from the crown of his head like a waterfall. Stone Tablet felt a long-lost comfort.

The pain from being tormented by countless scenes was also eased at this moment.

At the same time, infused by this Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao aura, Stone Tablet keenly sensed subtle changes occurring within his body.

“This is…”

“The thousand-year change of Xuanhuang?”

After comprehending for a while, Stone Tablet fell into thought.

The Stone Tablet he carried only recorded events that had occurred in the Xuanhuang Realm itself over the years. Changes caused by fusion with fragments of other immortal worlds outside the original Xuanhuang Realm were originally imperceptible to him.

But now, with the infusion of Heavenly Dao aura, he was able to personally experience the dramatic changes of the world.

Stone Tablet vaguely felt that not only was the repulsion of the Xuanhuang laws within his body toward external forces weakening, but even the stone tablet itself was undergoing inexplicable changes.

Some blurry scenes from the implanted prefectures also began to appear on the Stone Tablet’s records.

However, because the fusion was not yet complete, the writing that appeared on the stone tablet was very blurry.

It seemed as though it could be casually wiped away with a light rub.

“If the Xuanhuang Realm were given tens of millions of years to slowly devour other worlds on its own, it might still preserve the so-called Xuanhuang orthodoxy. The stone tablet on my back would also record everything that happened in the absorbed prefectures. But unfortunately, reality will not give it that much time…”

While Stone Tablet was pondering, the voice of the Faceless Holy Emperor suddenly sounded in his ear.

“Dao Transformation Divine Unity.”

Stone Tablet immediately came back to his senses and pressed the high-grade Dao Deviation Stone against the center of his brows.

He attempted to integrate it into his body.

Sure enough, it was completely different from before.

The repulsive force of the Heavenly Dao within his body had weakened tremendously. Moreover, with the continuous injection of Heavenly Dao aura from above, the repulsion was becoming increasingly faint.

“Touch with the divine, fuse with calculation.”

“Merge object and self, Dao Transformation Divine Unity…”

Stone Tablet silently recited the secret technique of the Taiyan Sect in his heart. The blue crystal melted like ice into water and was gradually pushed into his sea of consciousness.

The entire process went very smoothly.

Just when only the final tip of the Dao Deviation Stone remained exposed, an anomaly in the hollow above caught Stone Tablet’s attention.

“What is that…”

Streams of withered yellow light flew out from the end of the pitch-black passage.

At first only dozens flew together, but gradually the yellow light in the passage increased more and more.

Thousands upon thousands, dense like a swarm of flying bees.

The yellow light also carried an aura that made Stone Tablet feel no real threat yet extremely uncomfortable.

The sky full of yellow light continuously flew toward the Holy Emperor.

Li Ping reached out and caught them one by one.

Only then did Stone Tablet realize that these lights were actually sheets of paper figures with eerie expressions.

Unlike the vivid and lifelike ones from the Du'e Sect, these were pure paper figures.

They emanated a decaying aura. Even without facing them directly, the paper figures seemed to stare fixedly at the stone slab, causing irritation.

“World-Observing Divine Eye?” After a moment of daze, Stone Tablet suddenly understood.

“These things are harmful and useless to the world, so they naturally need to be recovered.” Li Ping said indifferently.

“Didn’t the Du'e Sect say that once implanted, they cannot be recovered? Back then we…”

Stone Tablet seemed to recall something and looked toward Daoist Yi Jue in astonishment.

Daoist Yi Jue acted as if he had not seen the Stone Tablet ’s gaze at all and only spoke respectfully to the Holy Emperor: “Although the World-Observing Divine Eyes are somewhat damaged, after re-refining them, they can still be reused.”

“The raw materials for these items came from beyond the heavens. Our Du'e Sect does not have much left. Such precious and rare objects, we originally planned to recover after surviving the calamity. Now we are simply doing it ahead of schedule.”

...

Looking at Yi Jue’s calm and composed expression, Stone Tablet forcefully suppressed the urge to teach him a lesson.

“Occasionally using them to scout enemy intelligence is not bad. But having them all over the world is unnecessary.”

Feeling the greatly increased affinity toward Xuanhuang after the removal of the World-Observing Divine Eyes, Li Ping said calmly.

“The Venerable One’s teaching is correct.” Du'e Sect’s Daoist Yi Jue responded with a smile.

Stone Tablet simply stopped looking at the two of them and focused on fusing with the Dao Deviation Stone.

When the Dao Deviation Stone completely disappeared from view, a brilliant crystal appeared in his sea of consciousness.

The countless suppressed scenes seemed to freeze for a moment.

Then they surged madly into the Dao Deviation Stone. At the same time, Daoist Yi Jue’s voice continued to echo.

It was the Du'e Sect’s exclusive method for storing and recording information about heaven and earth.

Chapter 1254: Mysterious Force Hidden Within The Rift

Listening to Yi Jue’s recitation, Stone Tablet understood tacitly.

Within the Dao Deviation Stone in his sea of consciousness, miniature versions of the Stone Tablet’s figures instantly differentiated.

The recorded images of the Genesis Stone Tablets, arriving like falling snowflakes, were diverted into these different child bodies.

The effect was so immediate that the Stone Tablet instantly felt a sense of relaxation he had not experienced for a long time.

“This is merely a buffer. To completely resolve my hidden worries, storage is still required.”

Stone Tablet seemed to gain some insight.

As his thoughts shifted, those thousands of miniature child bodies continuously expanded and directly merged into the Dao Deviation Stone.

The originally azure crystal, under the tempering of the Stone Tablet’s method, became a miniature version of itself.

Through the eyes of the Dao Deviation Stone Tablet, one could see countless different Stone Tablets arranged horizontally and vertically in a crisscross pattern. It was like facing mirrors with no end.

“I have already pushed the computational power of this Dao Deviation Stone to its limit. It truly deserves to be called a heavenly oddity. Just one high-grade piece can bear the information of the Genesis Stone Tablets without any burden…” Stone Tablet could not help but secretly admire in his heart.

“Moreover, these recorded data are still under my control. After being sorted and analyzed by the countless child bodies of the Dao Deviation Stone, they can actually be found even faster than before.”

With the hidden danger eliminated, he did not get up immediately. Instead, he fully enjoyed the peace he had never experienced in tens of thousands of years.

No longer would countless images and noises constantly fill his sea of consciousness. It was empty and vast, almost bringing Stone Tablet to the verge of tears.

Only after a long time did Stone Tablet stand up.

He solemnly bowed to the Holy Emperor ahead: “Many thanks, fellow Daoist, for your grace of rebirth!”

“It was merely a small effort!” Although the Holy Emperor said this, he accepted it calmly.

Leaving the center of the formation, the Holy Emperor waved his hand, and the void above was concealed by a profound aura.

Returning to the Holy Emperor’s seat, Li Ping spoke frankly: “Although I have helped fellow Daoist resolve the worry of the Stone Tablet’s chaotic information, I will not use this as leverage to demand anything from you.”

“Whether you are willing or not is entirely up to your own heart.”

Stone Tablet could tell that the Holy Emperor before him spoke with genuine sincerity and could not help feeling deeply moved.

He spoke directly: “I have always shared prosperity and decline with the Xuanhuang Realm. In the past, I was tormented by endless pain, so I had little interest in the mortal world. But now that I have escaped it, I naturally will not stand idly by anymore.”

Li Ping merely nodded slightly at the Stone Tablet’s assurance.

Yet he did not bring up the previous [Xuanhuang Orthodox] plan again.

Instead, he inquired about another matter.

“What do the two of you think of the Heavenly Capital Grand Mage?”

“If I clash with the Immortal Ancestor, will he intervene?”

As soon as this question was asked, both the Stone Tablet and Yi Jue’s expressions became slightly strange.

Seeing that Yi Jue had no intention of speaking, Stone Tablet took the initiative to answer: “As far as I know, the Grand Mage has been resting and recuperating above Daoyuan Prefecture these years. Matters of the outside world…”

“...would probably find it hard to draw his attention.”

Stone Tablet glanced at his friend Yi Jue: “Back when the Ten Great Immortal Sects were driven to desperation by the great calamity, they sought help from the Grand Mage more than once. Yet they could not even enter his door.”

“After leaving Heavenly Capital back then, they never had the chance to return.”

Stone Tablet’s tone carried a slight sigh.

“The character of Xuantian King was truly exemplary. You Ten Sects, for your own selfish desires, colluded with the outsider Grand Mage to destroy the Xuantian Sect. You were truly aiding a tiger in its wickedness.” The Holy Emperor commented calmly.

Stone Tablet smiled bitterly and offered no defense.

Daoist Yi Jue’s expression remained unchanged: “The Holy Emperor sees clearly. The events of that year were indeed somewhat improper on the part of the Ten Sects. But everything is like passing clouds and smoke, scattered by the wind. The original instigators from back then are all long gone. As for Xuantian King…”

“He and the Grand Mage were destined for a battle. Even without our Ten Sects, it would still be so. Moreover, according to those who personally experienced it back then, Xuantian King’s disappearance was quite suspicious and not entirely the doing of the Grand Mage.”

“Once Xuantian King disappeared, the Xuantian Sect became a pile of loose sand. It was only natural for the Ten Sects to inherit power. During the Xuantian Sect era, the oppression of cultivators throughout the world was too severe. After the Ten Sects took power, they mostly adopted a policy of recuperation, and the various large and small sects enjoyed a rare period of peaceful years.”

Yi Jue said slowly. He was not making excuses for the Ten Sects but simply stating plain facts.

Stone Tablet also cooperated by projecting the images from that year into the Holy Emperor’s hall.

Watching the scenes flash by rapidly, Li Ping nodded slightly.

After a moment of silence, Li Ping said: “The Grand Mage has faintly transcended this realm. Although the possibility of him intervening is very low, we cannot ignore it.”

Stone Tablet and Yi Jue were both slightly stunned, not expecting Li Ping to remain unchanged in his plans.

“However, I have my own methods. You two need not worry.”

“How much do the two of you understand about the current Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance?” Li Ping changed the subject once more.

Stone Tablet pondered for a moment, then shook his head slightly: “The headquarters of the Immortal Alliance is located within the Xuantian Treasure Mirror space. It forms its own realm and shields the perception of the Genesis Stone Tablet. Although I have records of scenes from various prefectures and regions of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance over the years, I actually know very little about the core secrets of the Immortal Alliance.”

“However, the highest level of the Immortal Alliance, the Dharma-Transmitters, were all surviving cultivators from the Xuanhuang Realm back then. I have their information here. But it is limited to before they hid inside the Xuantian Treasure Mirror.”

“Since the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance was reestablished, they have gathered resources from the Xuanhuang Realm to enrich their own exclusive worlds. Moreover, with the enhancement from the Immortal Ancestor's secret treasure, their strength compared to back then is certainly worlds apart. The information I provide can only serve as reference.” Stone Tablet said solemnly.

A blue light point, condensing a large amount of light and shadow information, slowly flew before the Holy Emperor.

Absorbing it, countless scenes instantly appeared in Li Ping’s mind.

“With this, it is enough.” He said in a deep voice.

“Our Du'e Sect does have some clues.”

“Hmm?” This time even Stone Tablet was somewhat surprised.

“That cannot be right, Yi Jue. Back when your entire sect was suppressed by the Dharma-Transmitters, the current Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance did not even exist yet, right?”

Sensing Stone Tablet’s doubtful gaze, the golden figure of Yi Jue smiled faintly.

“This matter was also a coincidence. When the Immortal Alliance headquarters was being constructed back then, a space containing a World-Observing Divine Eye happened to be excavated by them and implanted into the Immortal Alliance headquarters space.”

“Although it was not a core or critical location, over these many years we have still seen some things. It is not to the point of knowing nothing.”

As Yi Jue spoke, like offering a treasure, the Book of Du'e flipped continuously. The changing light and shadow slowly coalesced into a book page.

It slowly floated before Li Ping.

Li Ping absorbed this page and quickly browsed the recorded images within it.

After a long time.

“Are there still such World-Observing Divine Eyes in the Xuanhuang Realm that I cannot sense?”

The Holy Emperor spoke again, not offering praise but asking this instead.

Daoist Yi Jue hurriedly stated: “Aside from the special reason of being isolated by the Xuantian Treasure Mirror, all other divine eyes have already been recovered by the Holy Emperor.”

“However…” Yi Jue hesitated slightly.

“Speak freely.”

“Although the divine eyes originally placed in those positions have now been retrieved, because the divine eyes were stationed there for too long, the space itself has become imbued with some of the divine eye’s characteristics.”

Upon hearing this, Daoist’s expression turned somewhat serious.

Yi Jue continued: “That is to say, our Du'e Sect can still perceive events occurring near those points. However, the effect is not as good as direct observation by the divine eye.”

To verify his words, Yi Jue flipped the Book of Du'e and projected all the countless light and shadow records from those different points simultaneously.

The range was a bit smaller than what the World-Observing Divine Eye could control, and the images were also quite blurry.

But just as Yi Jue said, it was only a decline in performance; the most critical monitoring function was indeed still intact.

“Yi Jue, what exactly is the origin of this World-Observing Divine Eye?”

Stone Tablet pondered for a moment, somewhat shocked, and asked the question that was also in Li Ping’s mind.

After all, the fact that the divine eye could alter the very nature of the space it occupied was not as simple as it appeared.

If one were to be precise, this could already be considered a kind of reversing the principles of heaven and earth in a certain sense.

Yi Jue Daoist did not conceal anything: “Back when the Heavenly Sword Sect forged the World-Rifting Divine Weapon, split the realm, and shook the Xuanhuang Realm, I once went to visit the ruins of the Heavenly Sword Sect.”

“That World-Rifting fissure had shattered space, leading to unknown places. If ordinary cultivators rashly entered, only death and dao dissipation awaited. But our Du'e Sect’s Eternal Tribulation World could temporarily preserve itself inside.”

The expression in Stone Tablet’s eyes became colorful.

“However, I took the risk of nine deaths and one life to enter the World-Rifting fissure. Following the aura of the World-Rifting Divine Weapon, I delved deeper, wanting to confirm whether the Heavenly Sword Sect had truly succeeded…”

“Unfortunately, the fissure recovered even faster than I imagined. A power I had never seen before, not belonging to the Xuanhuang Realm, was actively repairing the wound. Having lost track of the World-Rifting Divine Weapon, I had also reached my limit of endurance, so I had no choice but to return helplessly…”

“This World-Observing Divine Eye was refined using that power I collected from within the World-Rifting fissure.”

Daoist Yi Jue’s words came to an abrupt stop.

But the scenes described in his words caused the other two in the hall to think deeply.

Stone Tablet suddenly understood: “So this World-Observing Divine Eye was not deliberately refined into this form by you. Rather, it is the manifestation of its power’s essence?”

Yi Jue nodded.

“Otherwise, how could our Du'e Sect suddenly possess a method that even the Immortal Ancestor could not handle?”

The Holy Emperor’s hall suddenly fell silent.

In Li Ping’s perception, this golden figure from the Du'e Sect was not lying.

Then the meaning behind his words was somewhat terrifying upon careful thought.

Did this mean that there were still even higher-level powers, like the World-Observing Divine Eye, currently monitoring the Xuanhuang Realm?

And what kind of existence was behind it?

Was it something outside the High Wall, or...

Stone Tablet suddenly recalled something, and his expression changed.

But the words reached its lips and stopped.

Li Ping naturally noticed Stone Tablet’s abnormality, but only locked onto it slightly with his divine sense without speaking first. Stone Tablet understood Li Ping’s concern and waved its hand: “Fellow Daoist has misunderstood.”

“I simply recalled a rumor about the origin of the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“It was information I unintentionally came across in the bottom layer of the Genesis Stone Tablet. It dates back at least several tens of thousands of years.”

These words immediately drew the attention of Li Ping and all the paper figures of the Du'e Sect.

Stone Tablet frowned and spoke while recalling: “In the era before the catastrophe descended, when the immortal path was flourishing, within the endless starry sky, our Xuanhuang Realm appeared somewhat unique.”

“In addition to more frequent exchanges with the upper realm and the presence of numerous immortal artifacts, our Xuanhuang Realm also had the existence known as the Great Celestial Venerable.”

“After all, once cultivators ascend, they basically sever all contact with the lower realm. But this Great Celestial Venerable could not only connect with the upper realm but also draw items from the immortal realm to the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“Moreover, the Great Celestial Venerable held authority in the Xuanhuang Realm that ordinary cultivators could hardly attain…”

At this point, Stone Tablet looked at Li Ping.

Li Ping shook his head slightly: “There is no memory of this.”

Stone Tablet did not mind and continued: “But the Great Celestial Venerable of that time was different from the one we recognize today. Their cultivation and strength were not necessarily very high; they were more like a...”

“Official position.”

Stone Tablet pondered for a moment and uttered these two words.

“It was like an official post conferred by the upper realm. As long as one received recognition from the upper realm, even a mortal with no strength to tie a chicken could hold the position of Great Celestial Venerable.”

“Now it is completely different. Without absolute strength, one cannot gain recognition from the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao and certainly cannot achieve the position of Great Celestial Venerable.”

“I do not know when the difference between these two arose. But what I want to say is...”

“The power that manifested the World-Observing Divine Eye within the World-Rifting fissure may not necessarily come from outside the Star Sea. It could be a characteristic inherent to the Xuanhuang Realm itself.” Stone Tablet glanced at Li Ping again.

This viewpoint caused even Yi Jue of the Du'e Sect to lower his head in contemplation.

“The earliest Great Celestial Venerable could control the world with a mortal body. What they relied on was likely a power similar to the World-Observing Divine Eye, deeply hidden within the Xuanhuang Realm. But at some unknown time, the connection between this power and the Xuanhuang Realm was mysteriously severed.”

Stone Tablet’s words echoed in the Holy Emperor’s hall.

The ancient secrets involved in these words were something even Li Ping had no prior knowledge of.

“Before the immortal path was severed, changes that ordinary cultivators could not detect must have occurred in the Xuanhuang Realm.” Li Ping said in a deep voice.

“It is merely my speculation. My original intention was that there is no need to worry excessively about powers outside the Star Sea. Even if there truly is external interference, since the Xuanhuang Realm has existed for so many years and they have not appeared...”

“They are probably beyond reach here as well.”

Stone Tablet said softly.

“I think so too.” Yi Jue Daoist concurred, his expression returning to its previous calm state.

“What we must face first now is still the threat of the Immortal Ancestor. As for these...” Li Ping also concluded.

“Although we should not pay too much attention, we must still guard against them.”

The Holy Emperor’s wording was the same as when he mentioned the Heavenly Capital Great Mage, leaving Yi Jue and Stone Tablet astonished.

“I have my own methods. You two need not worry.”
