Chapter 1262: Star Sea’S Primordial Will

Matters related to the Dark Realm were top secret of the Immortal Alliance. This Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance envoy knew very little about any further information.

To avoid alerting the enemy, Li Ping did not make any further moves on him.

By the time the Immortal Alliance envoy named Jia Su gradually woke up, he remained completely unaware that the secrets in his mind had been seen through clearly by the person before him.

He continued to praise: “Sect Master, this divine technique of yours is truly extraordinary. Even when I read it, I unknowingly fell into a state of self-forgetfulness.”

Li Ping chuckled: “If it can be of use to the Immortal Alliance, that would be excellent. However, could we perhaps discuss lowering the proportion of source power to be submitted each year?”

Before he could finish speaking, the Immortal Alliance envoy’s expression changed slightly. He spoke earnestly: “Sect Master, most things can be negotiated. But the Immortal Alliance’s duties cannot be treated lightly.”

The envoy hesitated for a moment, then lowered his voice: “To tell you the truth, the higher-ups originally planned to collect even more this time...”

Seeing Li Ping’s extremely ugly expression, as if he might erupt at any moment, the envoy hurriedly reassured him: “But since Sect Master has rendered meritorious service now, I will try to put in a word. We should be able to reduce it somewhat...”

Without waiting for Li Ping to lose his temper, the Immortal Alliance envoy quickly took his leave.

The anger on the Holy Emperor’s face slowly faded, replaced by complete calm.

He left the puppet behind to continue watching over the Lingyuan Sect members, while Li Ping returned to the Holy Dynasty.

The profound technique he had left for the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance was indeed a superior method capable of better developing source power within cultivators’ bodies, and he had left no hidden moves in it.

After all, the matter involved the Dark Sea. The Immortal Alliance would never treat it lightly or fail to verify it repeatedly.

The reason Li Ping had passed this technique to the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance was simply that, as its creator, he could roughly sense the corresponding locations of the cultivators who practiced it. He could even perceive the source power they cultivated under the enhancement of this technique.

The Dark Sea was endlessly black and swallowed everything. Even the You Clan only moved within the areas they were familiar with.

To locate the “Piercing Spear” that the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had driven into the Dark Sea naturally required some special means.

However, it would still take some time for this technique to be widely promoted.

Li Ping first continued with his previous unfinished plan of using the puppet body to comprehend the Dao outside the Xuanhuang Realm. After the final refinements over these days, the puppet body now fully met the Holy Emperor’s requirements.

Every time his consciousness descended upon it, the instinctive urge to switch bodies grew stronger and stronger.

Because of this, Li Ping reduced the frequency of testing this puppet body.

The large quantity of Voidbright Flow Crystals he had collected in the Hongze Realm was also sufficient for him to break free from the pull of the Immortal Ruins and successfully fly out of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Without informing anyone, under the cover of formations and the aura of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, a rainbow light flew silently toward the sky.

In an instant, he reached the edge of the world.

After losing the protection of the Xuanhuang Realm, the enormous suction force from the Immortal Ruins caused Li Ping’s expression to change slightly.

Knowing of the existence of True Immortal power and personally experiencing it were two entirely different matters.

Only when truly facing this vast, mountain-and-sea-like divine might of a True Immortal would one understand one’s own insignificance.

Even as the Holy Emperor, currently one of the strongest existences in the Xuanhuang Realm, it was the same.

“The path is blocked and long.”

The Holy Emperor sighed softly in his heart and released rainbow lights one after another to counteract the suction of the Immortal Ruins.

Meanwhile, the puppet body rapidly flew in the opposite direction.

The light of the Xuanhuang Realm gradually dimmed. All around, only darkness remained. Unlike the blackness of the Dark Sea, the Star Sea was one of utter deathly silence.

And...even though it seemed as if nothing existed ahead, the Holy Emperor instinctively sensed that danger was waiting for him there.

He decisively changed direction and detoured around that area.

On the subsequent journey, whenever any rampaging remnant True Immortal force in the Darkest Sea posed a threat to him, he could foresee it in advance and avoid it ahead of time.

It was as if he were not traversing this Star Sea for the first time.

The Holy Emperor’s puppet body narrowed its eyes and followed the vague direction in the darkness, continuing deeper into the Darkest Sea.

He had already sensed the fact that the upper limit of laws in the Star Sea was higher than in the Xuanhuang Realm.

But his destination was not the foot of the High Wall mentioned in the sword light’s message.

Instead, it was the place in this Darkest Star Sea where new upper-limit laws were being gestated. There, the efficiency of comprehending the Dao would be the highest.

The rainbow light shuttled rapidly, as if the concept of time had vanished. The Holy Emperor gradually stopped following the guidance of his premonitions. Instead, he followed the mysteriously surging profound rhythms in the dead-silent Star Sea and changed his direction of advance.

It was like truly being in a great ocean and finding the fierce undercurrents beneath the calm surface.

His speed suddenly surged, covering millions upon millions of miles in an instant. Immense forces tore at him from all sides. Even the protective rainbow light began to shatter and break apart under the pull of this unknown mighty power.

Li Ping remained focused, treating the crisis of possible body destruction as nothing. He calmly comprehended the profound and wondrous changes around him that he had never encountered in the Xuanhuang Realm.

“Destruction and rebirth.”

“People of the Xuanhuang Realm view this dead-silent starry sky as the Darkest Star Sea. Yet unbeknownst to anyone, vitality is slowly recovering within it.”

“However, it is currently still in the most primordial stage. Moreover, the entire process is far too slow. From the perspective of [humans], it is destined to be extremely difficult to detect.”

“This has nothing to do with comprehension. It is purely the difference that inevitably arises between different life forms at different scales...”

“But...”

A peculiar rhythm slowly awakened on the Holy Emperor’s puppet body. It carried the unique aura of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao!

Indeed, this time the Holy Emperor had secretly sent the puppet body out of the Xuanhuang Realm to comprehend the Dao without letting anyone in the Holy Dynasty know.

Yet how could he possibly hide it from the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao?

At its insistent request, and with the resolute determination that there might be no return, a strand of consciousness was separated and attached to the puppet body.

It left the Xuanhuang Realm together and arrived deep within the Star Sea.

Unlike its purpose from several years ago. This time, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao had also come to “learn the Dao”!

Before its destruction, the upper limit of laws in the Darkest Star Sea had already surpassed that of the Xuanhuang Realm. Although the Xuanhuang Realm had managed to survive until now, its own strength had not undergone sublimation over the long years.

Even after devouring many fragments of immortal cultivation worlds and being occupied by cultivators, it had only grown slightly overall compared to before. Yet the new laws being gestated in the Darkest Star Sea were naturally one level higher than those of the Xuanhuang Realm.

For the Xuanhuang Realm, observing these newborn entities in the Darkest Star Sea was likewise a great opportunity. Previously, there had been no trustworthy cultivator candidate to possess, and no method to escape the pull of the Immortal Ruins.

Therefore, even though the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao had such intentions, it could not carry them out.

But this time, with the existence of the Heavenly Mandate Holy Emperor, everything became different.

Li Ping completely handed over control of the puppet body to the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao. He himself acted only as an observer, feeling and comprehending alongside it.

Merely this simple point was something almost impossible for any other cultivator in the Xuanhuang Realm to achieve. Like a young child who had not gone outside for a long time and suddenly saw a breathtakingly beautiful scene.

From the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, Li Ping felt cheerfulness, excitement, and throbbing anticipation...as well as the gradually brightening Darkest Star Sea.

To call it bright might be a slight exaggeration. It was merely occasional specks of light appearing here and there.

Yet in this originally pitch-black and deathly silent Star Sea, they stood out so clearly.

The puppet body seemed to disappear as the perspective suddenly zoomed out countless times.

The very center of the entire Darkest Star Sea, not in the spatial sense, but in the sense of life, appeared before Li Ping. It resembled a faintly beating heart. Though weak, it undoubtedly represented life, hope, and the future.

The Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao and Li Ping had arrived at the foot of this heart. They greedily seized and absorbed the reviving power of the Star Sea that radiated outward with each beat.

In an instant, countless images flooded into their minds. There were worlds being destroyed and the Star Sea rising and falling. There were living beings flourishing and receiving heaven’s favor. There were also terrifying beast-like shadows, like black mist, secretly watching and ready to pounce at any moment.

...

Amid these countless changes and constants, after destruction the Darkest Star Sea still remained stable and persistent, once again attempting to burst forth with vitality.

This was undoubtedly the primordial will of this Star Sea, yet it was also a stubborn determination that could bring tears to one’s eyes.

Unable to withstand such vast and pure primordial Dao intent from the Star Sea, the puppet body began to disintegrate inch by inch. Yet at this moment, the consciousness of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao and Holy Emperor Li Ping felt neither worry nor fear in their hearts.

“Compared with the entire Darkest Star Sea, what are the tribulations suffered by the Xuanhuang Realm?”

“Since the Star Sea can revive from destruction, the Xuanhuang Realm will surely be able to do the same.”

The two took advantage of the final moments to engrave as many insights as possible into their minds. Li Ping also knew that the primordial Dao intent of the Darkest Star Sea was not something he could fully glimpse at his current level.

The so-called insights he gained now were more like a blind man touching an elephant. Everything he saw and comprehended was merely the tiny portion he could perceive and wished to see.

Even so, this insignificant fraction of the entire Star Sea held profound significance for them.

Just as the puppet body was about to completely collapse and vanish. The primordial reviving consciousness of the Star Sea seemed to notice the existence of Li Ping and the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

It cast down a strand of attention.

But clearly, the fragile puppet body could no longer bear this immense and unmatched power.

It was annihilated within the vast force.

However, before consciousness disappeared.

Li Ping, with the help of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, caught a fleeting, blurry image. It appeared and vanished so quickly that Li Ping could not even be sure whether it was an illusion.

The Immortal Path collapsed, the Star Sea was destroyed, and calamities spread. A figure whose face and details could not be seen grew fainter and fainter.

It completely disappeared.

Only his light laughter continued to echo for a long time in this Star Sea where calamity was about to spread.

“What does it have to do with me...”

“What does it have to do with me...”

“Hahaha...”

Boom!

The Holy Emperor suddenly returned to reality.

He let out a muffled groan and spat out a mouthful of golden blood.

The sleeping Cat Treasure abruptly raised its head and flew at light speed to the side of the still-floating blood. It directly swallowed the blood into its stomach.

“Meow! Meow meow!”

Then, as if afraid Li Ping would scold it, Cat Treasure called out a few times in a flattering manner.

Li Ping circulated golden source power to slowly repair the injuries in his body and did not bother arguing with Cat Treasure. All his thoughts were concentrated on the scene he had just witnessed.

“That figure...”

The Holy Emperor’s heart was filled with solemnity.

Anyone capable of making this Star Sea remember them even in the midst of revival from destruction was definitely no ordinary person.

The mere existence of that figure lingering in his mind for a short while had already caused a faint sense of crisis to emerge in the Holy Emperor’s heart. He immediately felt a chill and slowly forced himself to stop thinking about it.

But soon the Holy Emperor realized he had worried too much. Because even if he did not deliberately try to forget, the memory of that figure was already fading uncontrollably.

“This situation...”

“It has not yet reached the legendary realm of the [Nameless True Immortal], yet it seems only one step away.”

The Holy Emperor carefully savored the meaning that the newborn Star Sea had tried to convey in that instant.

“If I am not mistaken, the true culprit behind the many calamities ravaging the Star Sea is very likely this person...”

The Holy Emperor frowned slightly as he tried hard to capture the memory that was about to disappear from his mind.

In the end, most of the details slowly faded away.

What remained were only the four large words: “What does it have to do with me.”

“He Ganxian.” The Holy Emperor’s expression was inscrutable.

Inside the Holy Emperor’s hall, Li Ping sat for a long time in silence. Cat Treasure also seemed to sense something. It lowered its body, scanned its surroundings with its head, and assumed a hunting posture.

It appeared to be searching for the existence that made Li Ping so wary. Yet it ultimately found nothing. Cat Treasure became lazy again and fell asleep on Li Ping’s shoulder.

The Holy Emperor began to digest the gains from this journey deep into the Star Sea.

Not only him.

Even the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, because of this long journey, had begun changes that had not occurred for a very long time. Like the newborn Darkest Star Sea, the changes were silent and moistening, still unknown to others.

But they were indeed happening. In the entire world, only a handful of people could detect them.

In Great Qi.

Shi Ban, who was chatting with others in a teahouse in the Holy Capital, showed a slight change in expression and looked into the distance.

In the Lifespan Refining Space, Ruomu, who was trimming his withered branches, stared blankly at the new buds sprouting from the yellowed tips, stunned with astonishment.

Deep underground for ten thousand miles, the Earth Vein Ancient Tree suddenly felt the surging power from the Xuanhuang Realm become inexplicably more vigorous, as if something was brewing. It left him both expectant and fearful.

...

“Beside a sunken ship, a thousand sails pass;

before a withered tree, ten thousand trees burst into spring.”

In the Derivation Law Jade space, these two lines of poetry suddenly surged into Li Fan’s mind.

“So, only by using the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao to comprehend the Dao in the Star Sea can one obtain the greatest harvest.”

“Because the perspective of humans and the perspective of Heaven and Earth are different.”

“Just like back then, when I used the Canghai Pearl to comprehend the [Formless Killing Intent].”

“Creating the Holy Emperor clone in this life and helping the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao was truly a fortunate coincidence.”

Li Fan felt immense joy in his heart.

Although the connection between him and the Holy Emperor had already become very weak.

Because the impact from the Star Sea’s primordial Dao intent had been too great, he had still gained some understanding of the insights obtained by the Holy Emperor and the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

Most importantly, he had grasped the method. As long as he had the method, in the next life he could recreate it once again.

Chapter 1263: Establishing Xuanhuang Orthodoxy

“Star Sea’s Primordial Dao intent...”

Li Fan savored repeatedly the faint insights transmitted from the Holy Emperor. At the same time he vaguely sensed the current state of the Xuanhuang Realm reviving from within outward.

“If there were no new-law cultivators devouring heaven and earth from inside and no Immortal Ruins from outside, perhaps the Xuanhuang Realm could truly regain new life.”

“Unfortunately... it is destined to treat the symptoms but not the root cause.”

While shaking his head slightly, a thread of doubt also surfaced in his mind. Logically the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao could not be unaware of this. Instead of accumulating this reviving power for a future decisive battle, it was impatiently spreading it out.

What was the purpose?

“Hmph. Let me wait and see.”

The perspective returned once more to the Holy Dynasty of Great Qi.

The moment Stone Tablet detected the disturbance in the Xuanhuang Realm, he immediately arrived inside the Holy Emperor’s hall. Upon seeing the Holy Emperor, who was also emanating profound auras, Stone Tablet was startled.

“You already know what is happening in the Xuanhuang Realm?”

“There is no need for alarm. It brings benefit without harm.” The Holy Emperor replied.

Stone Tablet’s expression eased slightly: “I thought the Xuanhuang Realm was facing great calamity and showing a final burst of vitality...”

“What you said is not entirely wrong. This reviving power, triggered by a momentary comprehension of the Dao, is destined not to last. But for us, it may be a once-in-a-thousand-years opportunity.” After a brief silence, the Holy Emperor spoke slowly.

“You mean the Xuanhuang Orthodoxy plan?” Stone Tablet was slightly stunned, then quickly understood.

“Correct.”

The Holy Emperor nodded. A miniaturized image of the Xuanhuang Realm appeared before the two.

The original core portions of the Xuanhuang Realm glowed with yellow light.

The Cave-Heavens and worlds captured by the Xuanhuang Realm’s native forces, the Xuantian Sect, and the Ten Great Immortal Sects using the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation since the collapse of the immortal path appeared in an eerie green.

The remnants of other immortal cultivation realms forcibly stitched in by outsiders after the great calamity spread and the Star Sea was destroyed appeared in dead-silent black. This was information transmitted by the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

It could be seen that the yellow occupied only about one-thirtieth of the entire miniaturized landscape of the Xuanhuang Realm.

The green occupied one-tenth.

The rest consisted of vast stretches of pitch black.

At first glance, the yellow of Xuanhuang appeared to be the anomaly.

Yet unlike the green and black, the glowing color representing the Xuanhuang Realm seemed to possess its own living consciousness. It flickered and continuously overflowed and spread toward the surrounding alien-colored regions.

From a direct visual perspective, the green and black regions were not pure. They were mixed with specks of dim yellow.

Over several thousand years, however, this erosion in a certain sense had grown increasingly slow. There were even signs of it being pushed back.

But...with the recent sudden revival of vitality in the Xuanhuang Realm, the overflow of the Xuanhuang yellow suddenly accelerated.

“Xuanhuang Orthodoxy...”

Stone Tablet fell into thought: “The regions that originally belonged to the Xuanhuang Realm naturally require no further mention. Everything that occurs there is recorded in detail by the Genesis Stone Tablet. As for those green regions...”

Stone Tablet examined them carefully: “Some fall within the stone tablet’s recorded scope, while others do not.”

“As for the black regions, they are complete blind spots.”

Holy Emperor Li Ping said: “If we do nothing, the Xuanhuang Realm’s final fate will be to be swallowed by the black that holds an absolute numerical advantage. In the future, these black areas will likely transform into something else.”

“Therefore we must act first and deeply implant the Xuanhuang Orthodoxy into these external remnant domains.” The Holy Emperor’s voice was low, yet the resolve in his words was unmistakable.

“How shall we proceed?” Stone Tablet grew interested.

“Observe the Dao of heaven and carry out the actions of heaven...”

The Holy Emperor spoke slowly. Stone Tablet listened attentively and nodded from time to time.

After explaining the method in detail, the Holy Emperor’s tone grew somewhat grave: “When carrying this out, we must be cautious to avoid detection by the original perpetrator.”

Although the Holy Emperor did not name anyone, Stone Tablet understood his meaning.

Stone Tablet rarely showed a playful smile: “It is said that gentle rain moistens things silently. This method is so covert, and with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao actively cooperating to conceal it, even if that person possesses unmatched cultivation, I doubt he could detect it.”

The Holy Emperor said seriously: “We cannot be careless. Even if he is not in the Xuanhuang Realm, we must guard against the various contingencies he left behind.”

Stone Tablet nodded to show understanding.

“The fewer participants in this matter, the better. Ideally it would be handled by Ruomu for maximum efficiency. After all, as an innate tree spirit, it has a closer connection to the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“It is not that I distrust him, but every move Ruomu makes draws the attention of other powerhouses in this realm. As the acting party, it would be too conspicuous. On the contrary, everyone believes you are constantly oppressed by the Genesis Stone Tablet and remain under its weight at all times. They will subconsciously overlook you.” Perhaps because the matter concerned the future of Xuanhuang, the Holy Emperor spoke a few unusually lengthy sentences.

It seemed directed at the Stone Tablet, yet it also appeared to be spoken to Ruomu.

“This is what is called hiding in plain sight.” Stone Tablet nodded in agreement. “Now that I have shed the weight of the Stone Tablet, I shall make further changes. I guarantee that no one in the Xuanhuang Realm will associate me with my former image.”

“Then we shall wait a few days until the reviving power released by the Xuanhuang Realm this time reaches its peak before taking action. That way we can achieve twice the result with half the effort.”

Stone Tablet agreed at once.

He did not leave. He simply stood quietly inside the Holy Emperor’s hall, watching the miniaturized scene of the Xuanhuang Realm created by the Holy Emperor. The light at the center of Xuanhuang flickered continuously. Like a beating heart, it transported strands of Xuanhuang yellow to every corner of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Including those green and black regions.

Even within them, a trend of gradual assimilation had begun. Yet under the powerful reviving force being continuously transmitted at present, they could still temporarily maintain their original colors. Slowly but surely, even the pitch-black zones at the outermost edge of the Xuanhuang Realm became tinged with a faint, almost imperceptible trace of Xuanhuang yellow.

“It is time to act.” The Faceless Holy Emperor said in a deep voice.

Stone Tablet smiled faintly. Its figure flickered, instantly splitting into two identical bodies inside the Holy Emperor’s hall. Then two became four, four became eight, and eight became sixteen. In the blink of an eye, countless identical Stone Tablet figures densely filled the hall.

“Change! Change! Change!”

Stone Tablets spoke in unison.

In an instant, the Stone Tablet clones transformed into various real, existing people of the Xuanhuang Realm.

There were carefree white-robed scholars, hunched woodcutters, women of unparalleled beauty, and irreverent old men...Each figure looked vividly alive, showing no sign that they originated from the same source.

“I will go now.”

They each bowed to the Holy Emperor with smiles on their faces before their figures vanished from the Holy Emperor’s hall.

At the same time, throughout every prefecture and region of the Xuanhuang Realm, unnoticed by anyone.

Certain special existences appeared.

When gathered together inside the Holy Emperor’s hall they had seemed rather crowded. Yet once dispersed across the Xuanhuang Realm, they raised not the slightest ripple.

“Observe the Dao of heaven and carry out the actions of heaven.”

“Heaven and man unite in action; the foundation of all changes is set...”

They chanted softly while heading toward the mortal cities and towns where ordinary people congregated in each prefecture.

The Holy Emperor’s plan was simple in description. It was in essence using human will to establish the heavenly foundation. Leveraging Stone Tablet’s ability to disguise itself as any form, he split into countless clones that infiltrated the mortal populace.

They would subtly and imperceptibly preach the existence of the “Xuanhuang Realm” to all mortal beings in the Xuanhuang Realm. Today’s mortals knew only the small corner of land where they lived. They had no particular awareness of the Xuanhuang Realm as a whole.

The very concept of the Xuanhuang Realm did not exist in their minds. The first step in establishing Xuanhuang Orthodoxy was to familiarize them with the fact that the world they inhabited was the Xuanhuang Realm.

Of course, this could not be accomplished in a single day. It would require years, even more than a decade, of dissemination. Moreover, to avoid arousing suspicion, they had to labor tirelessly and integrate personally into mortal society, spreading the message through word of mouth.

Yet with the Stone Tablet’s power, even splitting into thousands upon thousands of clones made the task far from difficult.

A single mortal, or even hundreds or thousands, might be as insignificant as an ant. But when all the mortals of the entire Xuanhuang Realm united in consensus, they became a force that could not be ignored.

Once the mortal populace of the Xuanhuang Realm reached consensus, the second step of the plan could begin.

Using the will of [All Spirits Of Heaven And Earth] to launch a synchronized counterattack, encircle, and devour the remnant consciousnesses of those external immortal world remnants.

This step would require the assistance of Yin Shangren. As an existence akin to a world’s ghost specter, he possessed profound knowledge of how to devour world consciousnesses.

After cooperating with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao to complete the encirclement and suppression of the immortal realm remnants, the final step would be to help those remnants fully merge into the Xuanhuang Realm.

In fact, the vast majority of the Xuanhuang Realm’s regions had already achieved surface-level fusion. Only a very few prefectures still experienced frequent, bizarre anomalies due to improper integration.

Such “ulcerated sores” required thorough surgical cleansing: destruction followed by reconstruction. If the first and second steps could still be carried out undetected.

Then the third step would inevitably alert the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, and even the Immortal Ancestor beyond the Star Sea.

At that time, open conflict would be unavoidable.

Yet according to the Holy Emperor, as long as the second step was completed, even if the final outcome failed.

The general trend would already be set, and no one would be able to turn the tide. Unless they brought in even more immortal realm remnants and spent nearly ten thousand years performing yet another round of dismemberment and reassembly.

For this plan of the Holy Emperor, Stone Tablet, who had not grown excited over any matter for a very long time, actually felt his blood boil with enthusiasm.

Aside from the chance to save the Xuanhuang Realm, the benefits of success were self-evident. He would gain control over far more heavenly authority and become an existence even stronger than Longevity Immortal.

For whatever reason, Stone Tablet would not refuse this plan. A dozen or so years meant nothing more than the blink of an eye to it.

...

Inside the Holy Emperor’s Hall.

Li Ping summoned Ruomu.

A true wise man does not place all his eggs in one basket. Naturally he would not entrust the vital task of establishing Xuanhuang Orthodoxy to Stone Tablet alone. Even though the Stone Tablet was trustworthy and the plan carried low risk.

He spoke words identical in meaning to those given to the Stone Tablet, though phrased differently.

The main agent carrying out the goal became Ruomu. And the [All Spirits of Heaven And Earth] used to implant the concept of the Xuanhuang Realm became the ordinary grasses, trees, birds, and beasts of the Xuanhuang Realm.

“You are the ancestor of all living beings under heaven. Influencing them subtly and imperceptibly should also be within your power.”

“Establish the will of the [Xuanhuang Realm].”

To Ruomu, this was a trivial matter. Moreover, the recent fact that its withered branches had sprouted new buds had reignited its spirit. It rarely showed such motivation and readily agreed.

“Ruomu, Stone Tablet.”

“Even with both of them, it is still not enough.”

“This matter ultimately requires my personal involvement.”

“Only with three layers of insurance can it be considered foolproof.”

The Holy Emperor’s thoughts flowed slowly.

“Clashing spears with the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance is the open battlefield.”

“While establishing Xuanhuang Orthodoxy is the hidden war.”

“By comparison, this hidden war is even more important. There is only one chance. Losing it means total defeat.”

As the Holy Emperor pondered, a bulge slowly formed on his forehead. Flesh swelled, and a fleshy tumor continued to grow larger. Li Ping seemed completely unaware and remained motionless.

Only after half a day did the flesh burst open, releasing a cluster of Xuanhuang qi. Xuanhuang qi swirled around it, the internal image hazy. It bore some resemblance to Mr. Bai, and also to Li Ping himself.

“Cat Treasure.”

The Faceless Holy Emperor woke the drowsy Cat Treasure. He pinched the back of its neck, finally compelling the reluctant creature to activate its replication function.

Another cluster of Xuanhuang qi, identical in every way, appeared inside the Holy Emperor’s hall.

“Go!”

With a light command from the Holy Emperor, the two clusters of Xuanhuang qi tore through the void, left the Holy Dynasty’s small world, and flew toward different prefectures of the Xuanhuang Realm. They did not merge directly into the Heavenly Dao but lurked in concealment.

The Holy Emperor coughed lightly. Even with his power, he felt a brief moment of weakness. The Xuanhuang qi separated from his body could, in a certain sense, be viewed as the Xuanhuang evil thought he had swallowed in the past.

After being refined by him personally and blended with the Holy Dynasty’s fortune from the [Heavenly Emperor Qi Canon], it had become something akin to a materialized Xuanhuang fortune.

Had he not delved deep into the Star Sea and witnessed the Star Sea’s Primordial True Intent, condensing this materialized fortune would have been rather difficult.

“Each cluster of materialized fortune can merge with and govern roughly three prefectures.”

“Setting aside the Five Elders Association for now, covering the entire Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, with Cat Treasure’s assistance, will not take long.”

After a few breaths, the Holy Emperor’s aura returned to its peak of strength. Yet Li Ping knew this was due to the support of the Holy Dynasty’s fortune reserves and the feedback from his own Dao comprehension.

If he condensed it too frequently, recovery would not be this swift.

“Infusing Xuanhuang fortune into heaven and earth is equivalent to reasserting sovereignty.”

“Even if Ruomu and Stone Tablet fail, Xuanhuang Orthodoxy will still remain firmly under control.”

“Of course, if they succeed, that would be even better.”

In Li Ping’s deductions, the battle against the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance would ideally occur only after establishing Xuanhuang Orthodoxy.

By then, dealing with these “heretics” of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance would be like fighting on home ground. With a single thought he could ignore spatial distance, mobilize the power of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, and bring down endless heavenly punishments. Victory could be achieved without losing a single soldier.

Chapter 1264: Boundless Mirror Peers Into The World Rift

After all, the immortal cultivation world revered strength above all else. The key would still be the final battle against the Immortal Ancestor.

As one who knows himself is wise, the Holy Emperor understood very clearly that his current strength still lagged noticeably behind the Immortal Ancestor.

After all, the other party had dominated the Xuanhuang Realm for thousands of years and had also comprehended the Dao deep within the Star Sea.

He was truly unfathomable. Although the Holy Emperor had already reached the limit of the Xuanhuang Realm and possessed the fortuitous encounter of the Star Sea’s Primordial Dao intent, he had not yet fully converted that encounter into actual power.

“I need more time.”

A deep sense of urgency inevitably settled over the Holy Emperor’s heart.

“Time waits for no one.”

Before departing for the Star Sea he had not felt this way. Yet ever since returning from the Star Sea, an indistinct premonition told him that the time left to him might not be much.

...

Sun family.

Sun Luyuan circulated his spiritual energy to ward off the bone-piercing chill around him and walked slowly into the room. Looking at Sun Tianci sitting cross-legged on the bed, neither crying nor making noise but simply staring blankly into space, a feeling of helplessness surged in his heart.

Every family has its own difficulties.

Outsiders only knew that Sun Tianci had been born at the Dao Integration realm with extraordinary dominance, yet they did not know that this child had perhaps become extremely cold toward outsiders because he had witnessed his own mother’s death from the moment of his birth.

He naturally released an extreme cold aura around his body that made it difficult for outsiders to approach.

If he had not been born with Dao Integration cultivation, he would likely have starved to death within days from lack of care.

Yet no matter how extraordinary he was, he was still a newborn infant who needed looking after. The Sun family’s several Dao Integration cultivators could only take turns.

“Tianci...” Sun Luyuan showed a kindly smile and took out the top-grade spiritual liquid he had prepared.

“Would you like to eat something?”

Sun Tianci merely shook his head slightly and refused.

Sun Luyuan felt another wave of helplessness.

Then he suddenly thought of something and spoke softly once more: “This time when I visited your father, he learned of your birth and personally created a cultivation method for you. Take a look...”

As he spoke, Sun Luyuan transmitted the “Uplifted Righteous Dharma” that Li Fan had created into Sun Tianci’s mind.

Upon hearing that it was a method created by his yet-unseen father for his sake, the icy aura around Sun Tianci loosened slightly. He slowly read through the text of “Uplifted Righteous Dharma” one by one. He seemed to gain some insight and closed his eyes.

Sensing that the surrounding environment was returning to normal, Sun Luyuan was overjoyed. More importantly, the innate sorrow that seemed to cling to Sun Tianci was also slowly fading.

“What an excellent ‘Uplifted Righteous Dharma’!”

“Lu'er truly is resourceful!”

Knowing that the child was now in a state of comprehension, Sun Luyuan did not dare disturb him. He simply placed the spiritual liquid gently to one side and quietly withdrew. He then sealed the room with restrictions to prevent outsiders from interrupting before he finally felt somewhat relieved.

“Such a temperament in Tianci is actually good. If he stays indoors and disappears from public view, within a few years the world will forget his existence.”

“At this time of great upheaval, our Sun family should focus on lying low and preserving our strength.”

Thinking of this, Sun Luyuan could not help recalling the mission the Holy Dynasty had assigned him this time. Ever since joining the Holy Dynasty, he had lived quite idly. The Holy Dynasty’s never issued any compulsory tasks.

The previous plan to lure the Fairy Kongyou to the Holy Dynasty to become a Dao companion for the Holy Emperor’s disciples had been interrupted by Xu Yuanyuan’s sudden request, and now contact with the other party had been lost. It could only be set aside for the time being.

This left Sun Luyuan, who had always wanted to render meritorious service and increase his own capital, somewhat frustrated. This time he had finally received a task from the Holy Dynasty, yet it was truly troublesome and he had yet to find an opportunity to act.

“Nether Prison...”

“Isn’t that just a place for imprisoning heavy offenders? What does the Holy Dynasty intend by meddling in it?”

Sun Luyuan muttered to himself. Entering the Nether Prison was not difficult. But infiltrating the Nether Prison while still maintaining constant contact with the outside world was truly challenging.

“The Nether Prison forms its own independent system within the Immortal Alliance and is alternately supervised by the Dharma-Transmitters. To intervene...”

Although the mission issued by the Holy Dynasty this time had not specified any consequences for failure, Sun Luyuan knew it was definitely a test from the Holy Dynasty. Faces flashed through Sun Luyuan’s mind as he began considering the list of people who could help him with this matte𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢

After a long time, he still had no gains.

He habitually went to the underground secret chamber. His younger brother Sun Luyao, the Boundless Mirror Spirit, saw his expression and could not help asking about the reason.

“Brother, I found some information that might be useful.”

Sun Luyuan looked at the message his brother had sent. His tightly furrowed brows gradually relaxed.

“It might work.”

“I will give it a try.”

Just as he was about to leave in a hurry, Sun Luyuan suddenly heard Sun Luyao ask: “By the way, Brother, you promised before to take me out for some fresh air. When can we set off?”

Sun Luyuan’s footsteps paused. He replied somewhat evasively: “Let us wait a little longer. The Sun family is still being watched closely by those people. If I take you out now, there is no guarantee something similar to the last time we went looking for fragments and were surrounded by the Chen family from the Medicine Hall will not happen again.”

“Wait until the situation calms down.”

With that, he left in a rush without waiting for Sun Luyao to speak.

“Understood. I know, Brother...”

Before he departed, he heard his younger brother say these words.

The tone sounded a bit strange.

But Sun Luyuan did not think much of it. According to the information Sun Luyao had spied from the Tianxuan Mirror, a heavy criminal from the Immortal Alliance was about to be thrown into the Nether Prison.

However, this person’s identity was special. He was a direct descendant of Dharma-Transmitter [Sun]. Normally, with such a background, he should not have been sent to a place like the Nether Prison.

But the crime he had committed openly this time was truly too great. It was well known that the Immortal Alliance was organizing the second Escaping-the-World Rainbow Light to fly deep into the Star Sea.

Voidbright Flow Crystals were the key material required to achieve this goal.

After the previous open-and-secret compromise that agreed to divide the slots for this Rainbow Light equally among the Dao Integration cultivators of the Immortal Alliance regardless of background, the Immortal Alliance seized the opportunity to once again emphasize the scarcity of Voidbright Flow Crystals under the banner of righteousness.

They began using all means, including but not limited to entrapment, to recover the Flow Crystals privately hoarded by the various major families.

This direct descendant of Dharma-Transmitter Sun, named Sun Wanyun, had been caught red-handed while secretly purchasing large quantities of Voidbright Flow Crystals.

The cultivators responsible for the arrest naturally knew Sun Wanyun’s identity well. But with so many eyes watching, they had to put on a show. They could only steel themselves and arrest him. They had planned to quietly release him afterward, but someone unknown had stirred things up behind the scenes.

In less than half a day, news of Sun Wanyun’s arrest by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance in an impartial and unsentimental manner had quietly spread everywhere. Everyone praised Dharma-Transmitter Sun for upholding the Immortal Alliance’s laws and sacrificing family for the greater good.

At this point, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance could not possibly slap its own face by reversing the decision. Moreover, Voidbright Flow Crystals were indeed too important. Thus Sun Wanyun was law-abidingly thrown into the Nether Prison.

Yet since he was a direct descendant of a Dharma-Transmitter, no one knew when he might be released. Naturally he enjoyed certain privileges inside the Nether Prison.

“This person should be a suitable breakthrough point.”

“As long as I visit under the guise of paying respects and hand him the item bestowed by the Holy Emperor...”

Thinking this, Sun Luyuan arrived at the temporary holding area in the Immortal Alliance headquarters where Sun Wanyun was detained.

One look left him somewhat stunned.

It turned out there were quite a few “clever people” who understood the value of offering help in times of need.

The entrance was crowded with cultivators coming to visit. It was extremely lively. There was no sign at all that this was the treatment for a heavy criminal of the Immortal Alliance about to be thrown into the Nether Prison. The scene appeared truly ironic.

Although they shared the surname Sun, Sun Luyuan had no blood relation with Dharma-Transmitter Sun or this Sun Wanyun. He had merely met the man a few times.

Even as the family head of the Sun clan, which possessed five Dao Integration cultivators and appeared overwhelmingly powerful to outsiders, Sun Luyuan could only obediently line up at the entrance.

Meanwhile, in the Sun family’s underground secret chamber. Li Fan’s clone was mercilessly mocking Sun Luyao.

“I told you long ago that your brother would never let you out. What now?”

“The last time he took you out was only because you kept going mad and constantly risked losing control of the mirror, which could lead to your death.”

“Now, with my help in regulating you, the source of the Boundless Mirror’s outbursts, that wind obliterating calamity, is slowly being removed. Your condition has grown increasingly stable.”

“You are now an immortal artifact and represent the hope of the Sun family’s rise. How could your brother possibly let you out so easily? If something goes wrong and you are captured by someone, what then?”

Sun Luyao listened to Li Fan’s taunts without saying a word. Only the figure inside the mirror twisted from time to time, revealing the unrest in his heart.

“Senior...”

After a long silence, he wisely spoke up to ask Li Fan for help. Sun Luyao knew that this mysterious existence before him would not have said so much merely to mock him a few times.

“Heh heh. You have grown smarter, kid.”

Li Fan let out a sinister laugh. As he spoke, he manifested a pair of giant hands that reached toward the crown of Sun Luyao’s head.

Sun Luyao’s heart jolted, but he forced himself to stay still and not dodge.

The dark giant hands enveloped him. The interior of the Boundless Mirror shook violently.

A faint shadow was pulled out from Sun Luyao’s body by Li Fan. With a light wave, Li Fan sent the shadow floating out of the Boundless Mirror. It began merging with a pile of materials that had appeared out of thin air in the secret chamber.

Before long, another “Boundless Mirror” that looked exactly the same appeared before Sun Luyao.

As the spirit of the Boundless Mirror, Sun Luyao was naturally more familiar with this immortal artifact than anyone.

Yet even he could not tell the difference between the object before him and the immortal artifact he inhabited! His heart filled with uncertainty, Sun Luyao flew into the fake. Upon discovering it was merely an empty shell inside, he returned full of excitement.

“Senior’s methods are truly unfathomable! You can even replicate an immortal artifact so convincingly!” Sun Luyao flattered.

“Hmph. It is only an empty shell on the surface.”

Li Fan said coldly: “Separate another strand of your divine sense and hide it inside this mirror. With my craftsmanship as the foundation and your enhancement, it will be more than enough to fool your brother.”

Seeing freedom within reach, Sun Luyao did not hesitate at all. Enduring the sharp pain of having his divine soul cut, he split off a strand of divine sense. Once Sun Luyao’s divine sense entered the fake Boundless Mirror, the counterfeit artifact no longer had any flaws.

In a certain sense, it could now be considered a clone of the true Boundless Mirror. Though it was only an empty shell, as long as the real Boundless Mirror existed, it could synchronize any information the main body probed at any time.

“Senior, can we sneak out now?”

Looking at the fake Boundless Mirror floating quietly in the air as a replacement, Sun Luyao asked impatiently.

“Fool! What do you mean by sneak out?”

“This is called: the sea is wide for fish to leap, the sky is high for birds to fly!”

Li Fan’s clone laughed sinisterly. Wrapping the Boundless Mirror in his power, he turned into a black streak that ignored the numerous restrictions and protections personally set by Sun Luyuan. In an instant they left the Sun family.

Seeing the blue sky overhead once more, Sun Luyao felt exhilarated.

“Senior, where are we going?”

“Are we looking for the lost immortal artifacts of the Xuanhuang Realm as previously discussed?”

Even without a physical body, Sun Luyao took a deep breath of the free air. Then he asked Li Fan cautiously.

“Immortal artifacts... there is no rush.” Li Fan simply replied.

Seeing that the other party did not explain, Sun Luyao did not dare press further. He could only let himself be carried along as they sped rapidly southward through the Xuanhuang Realm.

Seven days later, sensing the surging energy fluctuations ahead, Sun Luyao suddenly became alert.

“That is...”

Endless ocean. Turbulent currents converged toward a single point at the center. Fierce winds howled and crackled. Violent storms even tore open space, stirring up bolts of lightning.

Beside the massive vortex that seemed to gather all the waters of the world lay an extremely conspicuous chain of islands shaped like long dragons.

This highly distinctive sight instantly told Sun Luyao where they were.

“The World-Rending Grand Vortex!”

He blurted out.

Although he had already learned of this wonder of nature from the countless materials spied through the Tianxuan Mirror, experiencing it in person was truly worlds apart.

“Such raging and turbulent currents, such frenzied and violent winds...”

“How could mere images and light from information possibly capture even a fraction of it?”

Trapped since his youth inside a small, dark mirror, he had never again been able to witness the magnificent sights of the world. The grand scene before him stirred Sun Luyao’s emotions deeply. He felt as if he had become the hot-blooded youth he once was.

“Making such a fuss. You really have no experience.”

Li Fan’s disapproving click of the tongue pulled Sun Luyao out of his repeated exclamations.

“Once you have finished marveling, get to work.”

With a light point toward the Boundless Mirror, Sun Luyao’s shadow was instantly sucked inside. Moments later, the mirror’s surface uncontrollably released a beam of dark light. It aimed straight at the World-Rending Grand Vortex not far away.

The Boundless Mirror’s body trembled lightly. Countless images flashed across it like a cascading waterfall.

Li Fan merely narrowed his eyes and waited quietly for the changes within.

“Boundless, Primal Chaos Reveals In Form.”

“With this grand formation as the core, the Boundless Mirror should in principle be able to analyze all hidden secrets in the world.”

“Although it is now damaged, using it to probe the secrets of this [World Rift] should not be difficult.”

“After all, the power of the World Rift back then was truly too immense. So much time has passed, yet the wound it left on the Xuanhuang Realm has still not healed.”

...

While Li Fan pondered, the Boundless Mirror seemed to have reached its limit.

Cracks began to appear on the mirror’s surface.

Chapter 1265: The Theory Of The Xuanhuang Islands

The Holy Emperor's words were no empty promise.

Neither the Heavenly Capital Grand Mage nor the entities secretly monitoring the Xuanhuang Realm could possibly transcend the immortal realm.

Although Li Ping was currently only at the Longevity Immortal realm in the Xuanhuang Realm.

On this land where too many eerie events had occurred, as the incarnation of the Heavenly Dao he possessed means capable of mutual destruction and effective restraint.

Li Ping needed some time to sort through the gains obtained from Stone Tablet and the Du'e Sect.

He stored the Book of Du'e in the treasury for suppression. He granted Stone Tablet a rare period of leisure and relaxation, allowing him to disguise himself as a mortal and travel freely through the Xuanhuang Realm.

Li Ping himself first arrived in the Xuanhuang Realm.

Fuguang Prefecture, Great Rift Valley.

Deep underground.

Ignoring the shallow protective formations around him, Li Ping reached the depths of the ruined remains.

Here he sensed two extremely terrifying residual powers that even made him feel faintly uneasy.

One came from the two statues, or rather the two remnant bones, within the ruins.

The other came from the ruins of the [First Origin Sect] itself.

“All the hidden concerns that worry me can find their solutions here.”

Li Ping gazed at the desolate ruins, which appeared as if they had only recently been destroyed, and pondered inwardly.

Instead of employing the power of the golden source power essence, he silently recited in his heart: “Cat Treasure.”

At this moment Cat Treasure was inside the treasury beneath the Holy Emperor’s hall, toying with the trembling Book of Du'e using its paw. Upon sensing Li Ping’s summons, its figure pressing down on the book did not vanish, yet another small cat body simultaneously appeared on Li Ping’s shoulder.

“Meow~”

Cat Treasure called out in response.

“Take everything here away.” Li Ping patted its head.

Cat Treasure glanced at the [First Origin Sect] ruins with a trace of disdain in its eyes. Nevertheless it did not disobey Li Ping’s command.

Its form instantly turned illusory like data blue light. Cat Treasure opened its mouth slightly.

Blue star points expanded and enveloped the entire underground ruins.

After Cat Treasure returned to its original form, the original location of the [First Origin Sect] ruins, including its buildings, formations, space, and everything within it, had completely vanished.

Only pure nothingness remained.

Cat Treasure yawned and appeared somewhat listless.

The First Origin Sect ruins had not been destroyed outright but had been taken intact into Cat Treasure’s “belly.” With a single thought Li Ping could release them again.

In truth, merely cutting and transferring space was something Li Ping could achieve with his current strength alone.

The reason he had Cat Treasure act was first to avoid disturbing the residual obliterating wind calamity in the ruins with his own source power essence.

Second, it was to test the nature of Cat Treasure’s power.

“Not only did the remains of the Heavenly Capital Grand Mage remain unmoved. Even the obliterating wind, which is extremely sensitive to immortal power, showed no reaction at all.”

“Although Cat Treasure is not an immortal artifact, it seems to follow an entirely different path.”

The scenes of his disciple Sun Erlang’s experiences in the Land of Truth flashed before Li Ping’s eyes once more.

...

While the Holy Dynasty of Great Qi grew ever stronger under the operations of the great Faceless Holy Emperor.

On the far side of the Star Sea, Holy Embryo Li Fan also reaped a massive harvest.

On this day, the echoing star power from the invisible High Wall erupted once again.

Hidden within the Remnant World Great Wall, Holy Embryo Li Fan could faintly sense the slight tremors of the surrounding worlds.

The tremors from different fragments merged and harmonized, condensing into a peculiar force that resisted the vast immortal power capable of easily destroying the Star Sea.

Influenced by the echoing star power, Holy Embryo Li Fan’s body was involuntarily drawn toward the High Wall. Yet there was no longer the astonishment or panic he had felt the first time.

Instead there was the joy of deep immersion and enlightenment.

“Echoing star power is the remnant of True Immortal power.”

“And the Remnant World Great Wall is the corpse of the mortal immortal cultivation world. Although the immortal cultivation world was utterly fragile before immortal power while alive, after death it can unite to jointly resist it.”

Holy Embryo Li Fan’s eyes grew brighter: “This is the Dao of the entire Darkest Star Sea evolving spontaneously.”

“It is no longer the so-called lower realm that existed while the immortal realm was still present, but a new Dao lineage reborn from destruction.”

“The destruction of the immortal realm, no matter the reason, shows that the immortal realm had already contradicted the most fundamental Dao of the world. Yet the surviving Darkest Star Sea is instinctively and slowly evolving toward this most fundamental Dao.”

“As one rises the other falls. This is also why the Remnant World Great Wall can contend against the power of True Immortal Seal Script. The Darkest Star Sea is still far from completing this sublimation, but if given enough time...”

“Perhaps the Darkest Star Sea within this High Wall could develop into an existence comparable to the immortal realm of old.”

Holy Embryo Li Fan gained sudden insight. In his perception the overall rhythm of the Remnant World Great Wall became increasingly clear and bright, like a resounding song.

The speed at which he drifted toward the invisible High Wall gradually slowed.

“Enlightening here for one day equals a hundred years in the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“In this sense, calling this place the [Immortal Realm] would not be wrong.”

Holy Embryo Li Fan’s body finally came to a complete stop, floating among the world fragments.

A streak of sword light slashed behind him, propelling him in the opposite direction.

What was somewhat eerie was that the sword light he released changed direction after flying straight for a distance.

It flew toward the nearest world fragment.

Once the target was locked, it accelerated. Like a silver-white spider silk it embedded itself fiercely into the fragment.

Holy Embryo Li Fan continued moving away from the High Wall, stepping out of the Remnant World Great Wall bit by bit.

What he left behind were countless sword-light threads slowly fading into the darkness.

“With the Remnant World Great Wall as an anchor, I no longer need to worry about being drawn in by the High Wall. I can also traverse the Star Sea at even greater speed.”

Holy Embryo Li Fan transformed into an invisible ray of light and sped back toward the Xuan Immortal Ark.

The strand of divine sense he had left behind earlier was no longer sufficient to handle the increasingly complex situation. It was time for him to appear in person.

...

Both the clone and the Holy Embryo had accumulated greatly and were ready to release their potential.

Meanwhile, the backup plan Li Fan had left in the Sun family also reached the moment of hatching.

Sun Luyuan looked at Wu Ninglu with a grave expression and repeatedly instructed her on all the matters requiring attention during the Dao Integration process.

Wu Ninglu merely nodded absentmindedly. Most of her attention remained fixed on the tightly bound Spirit of Heaven and Earth not far away.

Spirit of Heaven and Earth: White Silk.

It resembled light smoke or flowing radiance. It had no physical form, yet it was incomparably magnificent, emitting a bewitching glow that intensely captivated a cultivator’s mind.

“This is one of the foundations of our Sun family. I went through great hardships to obtain it originally as compensation for Sun Ang. Who would have thought he would later achieve Dao Integration through his own opportunity...”

“Since Lu'er has taken up duty in the Guardian Hall, this Spirit of Heaven and Earth shall belong to you as compensation.”

“If you achieve Dao Integration, it will bring enormous benefits to the fetus in your womb as well.” Although Sun Luchang spoke these words, the expression on his face betrayed him.

Only after Sun Luyuan gave a cold snort did he reluctantly restrain himself.

In the Sun family, Sun Luyuan still held the final say.

“Lu’er, you may begin. We will guard you.” Sun Luyuan said solemnly.

Wu Ninglu glanced at the three Dao Integration cultivators of the Sun family. Her excitement was plain to see.

After lurking in the Sun family for so long, the time of harvest had finally arrived.

Although this harvest deviated somewhat from her original purpose...

“If I become a Dao Integration cultivator, why would I still need to watch their expressions? The world is vast; where could I not go? Moreover, formally joining the Sun family is a wise choice.”

“Counting both my husband and me, our family would have five Dao Integration cultivators. Even within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, we would rank among the top powerful clans.”

Wu Ninglu’s mind surged with excitement. In a moment of carelessness she nearly fell victim to White Silk’s bewitching illusory light.

“Lu’er, focus!”

Fortunately the three Sun family Dao Integration cultivators acted in time and neutralized the attack.

Wu Ninglu dared not slack off any longer. She collected her thoughts and seriously confronted the Spirit of Heaven and Earth before her.

Although White Silk’s offensive power was not particularly strong, its bewitching illusory light was truly troublesome.

It could harm the physical body and erode the mind of any struck cultivator.

Even if one avoided every illusory light attack, prolonged entanglement within the white light would inevitably lead to falling into successive illusions.

Yet the three Sun family Dao Integration cultivators had prepared for a long time. They lit an incense stick that dispelled all the illusions before Wu Ninglu’s eyes.

They also employed a special treasure specifically designed to counter White Silk’s illusory light.

Despite the vast difference in strength between Wu Ninglu and the Spirit, it was still gradually worn down until it perished.

Seeing the Spirit of Heaven and Earth on the verge of death and her own path to Dao Integration within reach, Wu Ninglu felt wild joy in her heart.

“So this is how so many young Dao Integration cultivators in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance came to be! With such treatment, even a pig could achieve Dao Integration!”

“I actually thought they were peerless geniuses before...”

Such thoughts crossed Wu Ninglu’s mind as the sharp blade in her hand finally pierced the body of the Spirit of Heaven and Earth White Silk.

Boom!

A fierce radiance erupted from the soul. Wu Ninglu felt an overwhelmingly powerful force pouring into her body without end.

“Is this the taste of Dao Integration?”

Wu Ninglu’s eyes were filled with obsession, unable to break free.

While she was immersed in this unprecedented power, she did not even notice that the fetus in her womb was sharing in that force.

Li Fan’s divine sense, attached to the fetus, was not satisfied with the quality of the Spirit of Heaven and Earth White Silk.

“It is still a bit weak. Not to mention compared with Ink Death, it is even inferior to Crimson Flame.”

“Perhaps I can lend a hand.”

Li Fan’s divine sense watched the Spirit of Heaven and Earth power continuously pouring into the fetus and split off a portion of itself to join it.

This strand of divine sense had originally been a tiny fragment, negligible in strength.

But that was relative to Li Fan.

To the unborn fetus, it was a great tonic. Moreover, Li Fan’s strand of divine sense contained countless insights into the principles of the Xuanhuang Heaven and Earth.

Mixed within the origin of the Spirit of Heaven and Earth White Silk, it was devoured by the fetus.

The most immediate change was that the suddenly strengthened fetus began competing with its mother for resources.

“Hmm?” Wu Ninglu was no fool and finally noticed the anomaly within her body.

Although she was about to become a mother, when it concerned the fruit of Dao Integration, how could she yield it willingly?!

Thus Wu Ninglu instinctively began contending with the fetus for ownership of the Spirit of Heaven and Earth origin.

However...

Wu Ninglu soon discovered to her horror that she could not outcompete this wretched spawn!

“This is bad. If this continues...” Wu Ninglu’s expression changed. After only a brief hesitation, she made her decision.

Just as she prepared to strike ruthlessly and end the life of the fetus in her womb.

“What are you doing!” Sun Luyuan’s furious shout interrupted her actions.

Wu Ninglu then discovered in shock that her body had instantly lost all control.

After all, she had not yet achieved Dao Integration. How could she possibly oppose three Dao Integration cultivators of the Sun family?!

Wu Ninglu could not speak. She could only plead for help with her eyes toward Sun Luyuan.

Yet Sun Luyuan, Sun Luchang, and Sun Lujiu paid no attention to her life or death.

Their burning gazes were fixed solely on the fetus in her womb.

The three ignored Wu Ninglu completely and discussed among themselves.

“Big Brother, have you ever heard of such a phenomenon?”

“Seizing the creation of Heaven and Earth with an innate body. This child’s future achievements will be limitless!”

“If possible, he might even be born as a Dao Integration cultivator?”

“It is worth a try. Even if it fails, being born at Soul Transformation is guaranteed.”

“Good, good, good. Our Sun family has gained another qilin child.”

The three members of the Sun family glowed with excitement.

Listening to their conversation, Wu Ninglu’s heart turned ice-cold.

Yet matters had reached this point. She had no room left for regret.

Feeling her strength continuously drain away while concentrating in her abdomen.

In this utterly contradictory situation, Wu Ninglu’s consciousness gradually faded.

...

The Spirit of Heaven and Earth, White Silk, had fallen.

The mother Wu Ninglu had perished, her Dao extinguished.

In the field only a single fetus remained, born from the mother’s body.

It did not cry or make noise. One hand pointed to the heavens, the other to the earth.

It quietly regarded the three Dao Integration cultivators of the Sun family.

Sun Luyuan and the others were overjoyed.

“This little child doesn’t seem to have a name yet?”

“Hmm. I originally planned to ask Lu'er the next time we visit him.”

“No need to ask him! Although he is indeed his son, he is even more so a descendant of our Sun family. As his elders, can we not decide?”

“I suggest we call him Sun Wei. Born as a Dao Integration cultivator, he will surely spread the might of our Sun family.”

“Too vulgar! Too vulgar! I think it should be called...”

The three showed not the slightest regret over Wu Ninglu’s passing.

They simply gathered around the Sun family’s qilin child, filled with delight.

Yet the infant, newly born, looked at his mother’s corpse with a flash of sorrow in his eyes.

...

In a space of utter darkness.

“I...”

“Am I dead?”

“Where is this place?”

A consciousness, after an endlessly long slumber, finally awakened once more
