Chapter 1266: Stealing The Power Of The Darkness

At first there was only confusion. Then all the memories of her previous life rapidly surfaced in her mind.

An overwhelming resentment surged forth.

“Sun family!”

“And that damned bastard!”

“Kill kill kill kill kill kill kill...”

No other content could remain in her mind. Only the intent for revenge.

“Do you wish to take revenge on them?”

At that moment a voice suddenly sounded beside Wu Ninglu’s ear.

“Who?”

Wu Ninglu instantly snapped awake. She glared around with extreme venom.

Wu Ninglu was surrounded only by darkness. She could not locate the source of the voice.

Yet that voice kept laughing strangely, constantly provoking her.

“Get out here!” Wu Ninglu roared madly.

The other party ignored her. Instead, one scene after another lit up the blackness.

Wu Ninglu looked over, and the resentment in her heart surged even higher.

It was the grand scene of the Sun family’s Qilin child, Sun Tianci, who had been born already at the Dao Integration realm. The news shook the world, and every major family in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had sent representatives to offer congratulations.

Among them was even her own family, the Chen family of the Medicine Hall! Despite having already fallen out with the Sun family, they still dispatched envoys to extend their felicitations. After all, one does not strike a smiling face. On account of the newborn Sun Tianci, they openly accepted the congratulatory gifts.

As for Wu Ninglu herself, the inexplicably missing birth mother of Sun Tianci, no one cared at all.

...

“All this glory and praise should have belonged to me!”

The stark contrast in circumstances between mother and son drove Wu Ninglu in the darkness to grow even more deranged.

She wailed and screamed like a ghost howling and a wolf wailing.

At that moment, the voice finally spoke again.

“You...”

“Do you want to take revenge on them?”

Instinct urged Wu Ninglu to curse loudly, but the little reason she still possessed slowly calmed her down.

She answered without hesitation: “I want to! Senior, save me!”

“Hahahaha!”

Mad laughter rang out from the darkness: “Your body and divine soul have already vanished from this world, leaving only a few remnants of divine sense. Even if you could be reborn, what makes you think you could oppose the Sun family’s five Dao Integration cultivators?”

Wu Ninglu’s mind went blank upon hearing this.

Indeed. Not to mention her current state. Even if she successfully devoured the Spirit of Heaven and Earth and reached Dao Integration, how could one person contend with the Sun family, this rising new power?

Wu Ninglu felt utter despair, but suddenly she realized that this senior who had rescued her right in front of three Dao Integration cultivators would not simply toy with her for amusement.

The reason he spoke this way...

Wu Ninglu instantly understood.

“I beg Senior to teach me! Whether it succeeds or fails, Ninglu is willing to toil like an ox or horse, to serve as slave or maid, and attend to Senior day and night!”

Wu Ninglu gritted her teeth as she spoke.

“Hmph. You are merely a wisp of lingering divine sense struggling to survive. Do I need your consent to control you?”

A powerful oppressive force enveloped Wu Ninglu. In the terrifying suffocation, she felt her fragile will could shatter completely at any moment.

Her thoughts grew weaker and weaker. Wu Ninglu’s heart filled with despair.

Just then, the crushing pressure around her suddenly vanished for no apparent reason.

“Good thing you are not completely stupid.”

The voice sounded like heavenly music as it rang beside her ear once more.

At the same time, an extremely profound text appeared in her mind.

The Three Disasters and Hundred Tribulations Divine Clarity Method.

One Thought gives birth to Ten Thousand Ghosts. This was a supreme divine art capable of bridging the gap in numbers between cultivators.

Wu Ninglu read every word with ravenous hunger.

“Sun family... Sun family...”

Supported by the terrifying obsession of revenge that burned in her mind, the first thought demon god, radiating murderous aura, slowly took form.

Hidden in the darkness, Li Fan’s clone watched the entire process and nodded slightly.

Although the Sun family’s sage had been cultivated by him personally, that did not stop him from creating a natural nemesis for them.

As for when, or even whether, this future peerless demonic god driven solely by vengeance would be released, that remained unknown.

It was merely one of the contingency plans he had casually left behind.

“All preparations in this life are now complete. Next, we simply wait quietly for the good show to begin.”

“Judging by the Holy Emperor’s temperament and the current balance of power between both sides, their first clash will not be long in coming.”

...

Three months later, the first clash between the Holy Dynasty and the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance unfolded in a way no one had anticipated.

The conflict arose because of a sword light that came from beyond the heavens.

That day, golden light shone like a rainbow, illuminating the vault of heaven.

Beyond the Star Sea, beneath the High Wall, lies the Xuan Shang Immortal Ark, which can float across calamities.

Within the seven-colored rainbow light visible across the entire Xuanhuang Realm, sixteen characters glowed brilliantly.

It seemed to be a peculiar method of transmitting information. Even when people from the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance tried to erase it, they achieved no effect.

They could only let the rainbow light drift quietly in the sky for seven days before it slowly faded.

Yet the shock caused by these sixteen characters was far from subsiding.

Instead, it grew increasingly intense.

In the Chizha Abyss, at Broken Palm Immortal City.

Shang Shaoyun recalled the sixteen characters and stared blankly into space.

“I knew he was not dead. Beyond the Star Sea, beneath the High Wall...”

“Has he already gone so far?”

The carefree and unrestrained bearing of Holy Embryo Li Fan appeared once more in Shang Shaoyun’s mind, stirring faint nostalgia and a touch of melancholy in his heart.

“Outside the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“If I had cast aside everything back then and gone with him, what would things be like now?”

After staring blankly for a long while, Shang Shaoyun finally came to his senses and began attending to proper business.

He started sending messages to Diyi Jinglun, Ji Hongdao, and the others.

“Have you seen the rainbow light in the sky these past few days? That is precisely the white-robed sword immortal I told you about earlier. You used to say I exaggerated. What do you think now?”

After satisfactorily showing off, Shang Shaoyun checked the quantity of Voidbright Flow Crystals in his private treasury.

Although the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had long classified it as a prohibited item, the major families within the alliance had secretly hoarded varying amounts.

They had almost forgotten about it before, but with the appearance of the seven-day rainbow light, Voidbright Flow Crystals had returned to public view.

The world did not know exactly how Holy Embryo Li Fan had left the Xuanhuang Realm.

Thus, by instinct, they guessed that the method used was the same as that employed by the sixteen Dao Integration cultivators who had previously departed from the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

The sixteen Dao Integration cultivators had gone deep into the Star Sea for unknown reasons, but the rainbow light made the information clear.

Beyond the Star Sea, at a place called the High Wall, there stands the Xuan Shang Immortal Ark.

This Xuan Shang Immortal Ark possesses a supreme technique that allows it to float across countless calamities!

These mere sixteen characters caused countless cultivators’ hearts to tremble with wild imagination.

The brilliance of Holy Embryo Li Fan’s message lay in its deliberate vagueness.

It fully mobilized the subjective initiative of Xuanhuang cultivators, making the Xuan Shang Immortal Ark in their fantasies even more mysterious.

Some cultivators even searched ancient texts and found records of the Xuan Shang Immortal Ark from antiquity.

“It can travel freely between realms for trade. So many years have passed, so it must be far more advanced than our calamity-ridden Xuanhuang Realm!”

“Do you think the rainbow light earlier was...”

“Fellow Daoist, speak carefully!”

Regardless of the truth, Voidbright Flow Crystals had once again become the hottest commodity in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Although the alliance reissued its prohibition, it could not stop the major families from secretly collecting the crystals.

After all, far too many cultivators were doing so this time.

It had truly reached the point where the law could not punish the masses. Thus, they could only make examples of low-level, rootless cultivators to exert some deterrence.

In fact, even the alliance’s upper echelons held differing opinions.

Sun family.

Sun Luyuan returned to the Boundless Mirror secret chamber, filled with worry.

“Brother, are you troubled by the recent uproar over the rainbow light message?” the Boundless Mirror spirit Sun Luyao asked.

“Sigh, it is not only that. The key issue is that this matter involves too much. Mirror Holder Fu, who had been punished by the Immortal Ancestor and confined in closed-door cultivation, emerged early because of it. He even specifically inquired about Tianci. That old thing...” Sun Luyuan said with hatred.

“His meaning was that although Dharma-Transmitter Jiang is suppressing the matter this time, the commotion is simply too great. Every cultivator in the entire Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance now wants to know what lies outside the Xuanhuang Realm and beyond the Star Sea. Without an explanation, it may destabilize the alliance’s foundation. Yet the Immortal Ancestor has lost contact since his last message.”

“To stabilize the situation, the alliance plans to soon announce to the world that they will recreate the Voidbright rainbow light and fly out of the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“Piloting the rainbow light requires Dao Integration realm cultivators. Our Sun family has become far too prominent lately. A single family with five Dao Integration cultivators is known to everyone in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance. I fear that if they truly seek suitable cultivators to journey into the stars, our Sun family will not be able to escape involvement.”

“Truly, fortune and misfortune are unpredictable. If I had known, we should not have publicized Tianci being born at Dao Integration so widely. We miscalculated and let success go to our heads.” Sun Luyuan sighed.

Upon hearing this, the Boundless Mirror spirit Sun Luyao also frowned, finding the situation difficult.

“From the scattered clues I previously gathered inside the Tianxuan Mirror, the region beyond the stars is likely fraught with danger. Even with the precedent of the Voidbright rainbow light, this journey is still one of uncertain life and death. If our Sun family’s Dao Integration cultivators are truly assigned to go, we must prepare for sacrifice.” After a long while, he spoke gravely.

“We brothers have already discussed it. This matter can hardly be avoided. If the decree truly comes down, let Luchang go. What we fear...”

Sun Luyuan paused, then his voice dropped heavily: “What I fear is that more than one from our Sun family will be assigned.”

The underground secret chamber fell quiet for a moment.

“Brother, I actually have a clever plan.”

At that moment, Sun Luyao suddenly suggested.

“Hmm?”

Sun Luyuan listened attentively, his eyes brightening.

Not long afterward, rumors began circulating in various places throughout the alliance.

The upper echelons of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had approved the plan to recreate Voidbright Flow Crystals. This time, the number of cultivators who could leave the Xuanhuang Realm and enter the stars might be even greater than before.

However, the specific quotas had likely already been divided among the upper levels and decided internally. Some powerful families might even receive more than one spot.

Such explosive news spread like wildfire.

Upon hearing it, cultivators were filled with righteous indignation and fury.

The opportunities and fortunes beyond the stars were enormous!

And they were simply being divided up just like that?

It showed no consideration at all for the feelings of the grassroots Dao Integration cultivators who had labored to suppress the various prefectures.

Although the alliance quickly issued a denial, as long as the list remained undecided, the turmoil was bound to continue.

Even many Dao Integration cultivators who guarded the various prefectures and had not returned to alliance headquarters for years made an unprecedented return, all for one answer.

As for the alliance’s repeated emphasis that venturing into the Star Sea carried fatal danger and that the chance of safely returning was almost negligible, the enraged cultivators dismissed it all as an excuse.

They had their own rebuttals.

As the saying goes, one may hear the Dao in the morning and die content in the evening. What is there to fear from mere danger?

Who among those who reached Dao Integration had not walked a path of hardships?

Trapped in the Xuanhuang Realm for a lifetime, dying in the Star Sea would leave no regrets.

The Dao Integration guardians of the various prefectures were the cornerstone of the alliance’s rule.

Now that these people had united, even the Dharma-Transmitters felt some headache.

After serious discussion, they finally gave a response.

The alliance would carefully consider the personnel list and strive to make it fair, just, and convincing to the world.

With the Dharma-Transmitters personally guaranteeing it, the group of guarding Dao Integration cultivators finally left alliance headquarters.

At the same time, this confirmed the earlier rumor that the alliance would recreate the Voidbright rainbow light.

For a time, alliance cultivators privately discussed the matter fervently.

With a first time, there would be a second. The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s exploration of the stars would certainly not end here.

Although they had not yet reached Dao Integration, who could say what the future held?

And even if they had no hope of reaching Dao Integration in this life, they could at least obtain some Voidbright Flow Crystals, right?

If they could not eat the meat, could they not at least drink the soup?

In the underground market, the price of Voidbright Flow Crystals skyrocketed once more. As soon as any appeared, no matter how high the price, they were immediately snapped up.

Some clever individuals had already begun traveling to various secret realms and small worlds, digging three feet into the ground in search of traces of these crystals.

Holy Dynasty of Great Qi.

Inside the Holy Emperor’s hall, Li Ping’s disciples were assembled.

They were all aware of the unrest in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Yet all matters in the Holy Dynasty were decided by a single word from the Holy Emperor.

Since Li Ping had not spoken, they could only pretend the matter had never occurred.

“Master, about those Voidbright Flow Crystals, should we get involved?”

“Breaking out of the Xuanhuang Realm to explore the unknown Star Sea just thinking about it is exciting.” As always, Ou Shangtian was the boldest and asked with a smile.

“Since the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance wishes to court death, let them do so. The more of their Dao Integration cultivators that leave, the better it is for us.” With one calm sentence from the Holy Emperor, the direction of the matter was decided.

Ou Shangtian showed a trace of regret.

The others, however, pondered the meaning behind the Holy Emperor’s words.

“From now on, you must remain strictly vigilant and be ready for battle at any time.”

The Holy Emperor’s next words made their spirits rise.

Sun Erlang nodded: “Those Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators are now acting like madmen, searching everywhere in the various small worlds for those Voidbright Flow Crystals. Our Holy Dynasty is fine since they will certainly not encounter us. The main concern is the many affiliated small worlds we have already conquered...”

Li Ping said: “Do not initiate direct conflict for the time being, but there is no need to deliberately avoid it either.”

“When you act, be decisive and do not leak any information related to the Holy Dynasty.”

The Holy Emperor’s words made the disciples eager to try.

“Sun Erlang.”

“This disciple is here.”

“Yi Shu has stayed with us long enough. You will go with him and return once more to the Taiyan Sect.” The Holy Emperor said calmly.

Chapter 1267: Encountering The True Immortal Character Again

The Holy Emperor’s intention was clear.

War between the Holy Dynasty and the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance was imminent. It was time for the Taiyan Sect to make its final choice of allegiance.

When Sun Erlang found Yi Shu in the Holy Capital, the latter had already prepared everything and was waiting with a smile.

“Young Master Sun, let us depart.”

Sun Erlang did not hesitate. He cupped his hands in greeting, and the two set off directly for the Taiyan Sect.

“Senior, did you gain any special insights during your time in our Holy Dynasty?” Sun Erlang asked tentatively on the return journey.

Yi Shu smiled: “The sights of the Holy Dynasty differ from those of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and are entirely unlike anything the Xuanhuang Realm has seen in hundreds of thousands of years. We have benefited greatly. The sect has now reached a unanimous decision and has also obtained the Stone Mother’s approval. You will understand when the time comes.”

“By the way, you may have the chance to meet the Stone Mother this time.”

Yi Shu’s words stirred something in Sun Erlang’s heart.

He wanted to probe for more inside information, but Yi Shu changed the subject and began chatting about his recent experiences in Great Qi.

“The people of the Holy Dynasty enjoy abundant food and clothing, so they pursue higher spiritual needs. Although their cultivation realms and strength are ordinary, certain ideas of theirs are truly intriguing. I recently befriended a scholar who wrote a supernatural novel. It describes what would happen in the Xuanhuang Realm if the Immortal Ancestor Heavenly Sovereign had never appeared…”

Sun Erlang was slightly stunned. Yi Shu continued: “Unlike the simulated worlds you experienced, even though the Immortal Ancestor does not appear in that novel, disasters and calamity still descend and throw the Xuanhuang Realm into chaos.”

“Three venerables rise from humble beginnings and grow into forces that sweep across the world, standing as equals in opposition. One uses education to nurture the people and becomes the [Teacher of Heaven and Earth].

“One uses the pure and noble character of a sage to win heartfelt submission from those around him and forms an unshakable alliance. This one is the [Supreme Sage of the Mortal Realm].

“One uses boundless might to establish an immortal dynasty on earth. Wherever his soldiers point, all things submit. This one is the [Taixuan Immortal Emperor]…”

At this point, Sun Erlang’s expression grew rather subtle.

“The three venerables fight like dragons and tigers for several hundred years without a clear victor. The details are derived through personal effort, so they are somewhat crude and cannot withstand close scrutiny. Yet they are quite interesting and offer a fresh perspective…”

Sun Erlang could not help asking: “In the end, who wins?”

“This book, ‘Romance of the Xuanhuang Tripartition,’ is not yet finished. The scholar’s doorstep has been blocked by crowds of people. Everyone claims he has shown great disrespect to the Holy Emperor and wants to teach him a lesson. Although the Holy Dynasty’s officials have not intervened, once the Taixuan Immortal Emperor makes some mistakes in the ‘Romance,’ the uproar grows even larger and nearly results in loss of life.”

“That scholar dares not continue writing. The plot has stalled, so I do not know who ultimately wins.” Yi Shu smiled enigmatically.

Sun Erlang gave a light cough: “Once I return, I will disperse those people and let him write in peace. It is only a supernatural novel. How could Master possibly mind such things?”

Yi Shu spoke with deeper meaning: “The Holy Emperor indeed would not care, but the people of the Holy Dynasty may not think the same.”

Sun Erlang wanted to argue further, but they had already arrived within the territory of the Taiyan Sect.

Inside the floating city within the crystal wall in the sky, Sun Erlang stepped in once more. Unlike the previous visit, every cultivator he encountered on the way smiled and greeted him warmly.

They all seemed extremely familiar with him.

Sun Erlang knew that the Taiyan Sect shared all information as a single collective entity. Still, the feeling of everyone knowing him while he knew nothing about them left him somewhat uncomfortable.

Fortunately the journey was short, and Sun Erlang soon reached the central area of the Taiyan Sect and met Chen Tianhai.

Chen Tianhai was holding a scroll and reading it attentively.

Yi Shu did not enter.

“Greetings, Senior.”

Sun Erlang bowed, but Chen Tianhai remained motionless as if he had not heard.

After a long silence, Chen Tianhai finally spoke and went straight to the point: “Regarding the war between the Holy Dynasty and the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, our Taiyan Sect has decided…”

“To remain neutral and help neither side.”

This answer caught Sun Erlang completely off guard, leaving him stunned on the spot.

Would they not at least pretend to offer some support? Playing the fence-sitter and watching the tigers fight from the mountain might preserve peace for a time, but once the dust settled later, they would surely face the harshest reckoning.

Logically, the Taiyan Sect should not make such an unwise move.

Sun Erlang looked at Chen Tianhai with full of puzzlement.

“Besides the fact that the Stone Mother’s tens of thousands of derivations have all yielded nearly equal chances of victory for either side as the reason for our decision…”

“The greater reason is that we have chosen to leave the Xuanhuang Realm for the time being.” Chen Tianhai’s words landed like a thunderclap.

“Hmm?!” Sun Erlang froze in shock.

“Is it because of the recently sensational Voidbright Rainbow Light?” Sun Erlang asked.

“Yes and no. In truth, our Taiyan Sect has long harbored the intention of crossing the stars. However, the dangers of the Star Sea have always caused the plan to be postponed indefinitely. Yet the sword message that crossed the Star Sea previously has made us change our minds.” Chen Tianhai smiled faintly.

“The sword message illuminated the Xuanhuang sky for seven days. During that time we conducted a detailed analysis and gained some small insights. Since the sword message could cross the Star Sea to reach us, our Taiyan Sect can trace it back to its origin and follow the path it took to locate the place from which it was sent.” Chen Tianhai spoke with full confidence.

“The far side of the Star Sea, beneath the High Wall, is truly something to yearn for.” Chen Tianhai sighed.

Sun Erlang felt the unified will of the entire Taiyan Sect.

Knowing the matter could no longer be stopped, Sun Erlang’s thoughts raced. He wanted to return as quickly as possible and report this to his master.

“Young Master Sun, there is no need to hurry. After this parting, who knows when we shall meet again. Why not meet the Stone Mother?” Chen Tianhai suggested as he looked at Sun Erlang.

Sun Erlang hesitated for a moment, then finally nodded.

The instant he agreed, the surrounding room scenery vanished. He felt as though he stood within the Star Sea, surrounded by pitch blackness.

Only a brilliant blue light came from the depths of the darkness, turning into a thin line that sped through the Star Sea.

The moment he saw this blue line, understanding dawned in Sun Erlang’s heart.

This was the Dao Deviation Stone Mother.

The original Dao Deviation Stone.

“I was never a thing of the Xuanhuang Realm. By coincidence, while traversing the Star Sea, I arrived in this realm.”

A voice emerged in Sun Erlang’s mind.

It was not through the five senses or divine sense communication, but directly through the resonance between the Dao Deviation Stone crystals in Sun Erlang’s sea of consciousness.

Sun Erlang’s expression turned solemn to show his respect.

The Stone Mother continued on her own: “Where I came from is no longer traceable. Yet where I am going has an answer.”

These words from the Dao Deviation Stone Mother shook Sun Erlang’s mind violently.

“Where are you going? Stone Mother, what do you mean by that?”

“The other end of the Star Sea is not truly the other end. It is merely a corner of the world. If not for the High Wall blocking the way, I should have fled far away ten thousand years ago. Moreover, having been cut and divided previously, I also lost the ability to cross the star ocean. Helpless, I had to let it be, and in the blink of an eye so many years have passed.”

The scene before Sun Erlang suddenly changed.

The blue thread that had been flying straight through the Star Sea suddenly changed direction for some unknown reason and plunged toward the Xuanhuang Realm.

It was discovered by cultivators in the Xuanhuang Realm, and with its help the Taiyan Sect rose to become a renowned sect under the heavens in one leap.

What had been cut apart could no longer be restored.

Unexpectedly, a great change occurred in the Xuanhuang Realm’s heavens and earth, bringing disaster. To resist the calamity that forbade joint cultivation of techniques, the Taiyan Sect cultivators voluntarily decided to merge as one with the Dao Deviation Stone.

Information is indestructible; the Dao Deviation reappears.

After experiencing tens of thousands of years of separation and reunion, the Dao Deviation Stone had once again become the same as when it first arrived in the Xuanhuang Realm.

...

Scene after scene changed rapidly, shaking Sun Erlang’s heart and mind.

He could not help asking: “Senior has stayed in the Xuanhuang Realm for so long and is nearly omniscient. As long as you remain in Xuanhuang, being impervious to ten thousand tribulations would not be empty words. Why insist on leaving? Beyond the Star Sea, there are too many variables and unknowns. Even for Senior, there is probably no absolute guarantee of survival, right?”

“Why must I go? The answer to this question is the same as why you cultivators must cultivate.”

The words from the Stone Mother left Sun Erlang speechless.

“The High Wall blocks the Star Sea. But there are some things it cannot stop.” The Dao Deviation Stone Mother’s tone was enigmatic. Some confusion, yet also some inexplicable confidence.

“Little fellow, do not think too much. I am simply going to take a look first. If I truly cannot cross the High Wall, we may very well return. As for the reason for meeting you this time...”

The illusory blue thread before Sun Erlang suddenly became solid and shot fiercely toward his head.

Before he could react, Sun Erlang was struck by the blue ray.

Sun Erlang checked his entire body but felt no abnormality. Only the Dao Deviation Stone crystal in his sea of consciousness seemed somewhat different.

“Little fellow, do not be nervous. It is merely a mark left behind. So that when I plan to return in the future, I will not lose my way back.”

“Of course, we will not treat you unfairly. Concentrate your mind...”

The Stone Mother’s words were accompanied by the synchronized flickering of the Dao Deviation Stone. In Sun Erlang’s perception, countless images surged toward him like a tidal wave, nearly flooding his sea of consciousness completely.

He hurriedly focused and slowed the reception of the images.

These numerous scenes included some where the Holy Dynasty fell into bitter battles with heavy casualties, and others where the Holy Dynasty achieved continuous victories and the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance could only linger on in the central four prefectures. Without exception, all were events that had not yet occurred in the real world.

“These are all products of my deductions, given to you as reference.”

Sun Erlang felt relieved and quickly expressed his thanks to the Stone Mother.

“However, I must warn you: do not place too much faith in these deductions, little fellow.”

“This Xuanhuang Realm is like a bottomless pond. If the waters are calm, every ripple on the surface can be deduced. But if the ferocious creatures at the bottom all emerge and stir up unrest...”

“The deduction of ripples will inevitably differ greatly from reality. Your master certainly understands this principle.”

“So in truth, whether our Taiyan Sect is present or not will not change things too much.”

The Dao Deviation Stone Mother’s voice still echoed in his ears. When Sun Erlang came back to his senses, he had already appeared outside the Taiyan Sect.

The crystal wall that had not been very noticeable before was now shrouded in a mysterious blue glow.

The entire Taiyan Sect became even more transparent, as if it could disappear from this world at any moment.

“Young Master, you must survive well.”

“Otherwise, our Taiyan Sect will not be able to find the way home.” Yi Shu’s half-smiling words came through.

It felt like an illusion.

In his daze, the floating heavenly city before his eyes had completely vanished from Sun Erlang’s perception.

“They left just like that, too quickly.”

Sun Erlang grumbled inwardly, yet felt a sense of loss in his heart.

He stood there dazed for a long time before returning and reporting the entire matter in detail to his master.

Looking at the Faceless Holy Emperor sitting silently above, Sun Erlang could not help feeling somewhat nervous.

Yet the Holy Emperor’s next words left him somewhat stunned.

“What mark? It was merely the Stone Mother’s teasing. The Dao Deviation Divine Stone is an unparalleled wonder. Even I could not comprehend that Rainbow Light Sword Message for a time, yet it cracked it in a short period...”

“If it can trace origins and cross the star ocean, how could it possibly lose its way?”

“Master, then what exactly...” Sun Erlang was puzzled. “The profound sensation brought when the blue thread collided with the Dao Deviation Stone in my sea of consciousness was indeed real.”

The Holy Emperor smiled, which was extremely rare.

“It is your good fortune, young one.”

“Strictly speaking, all Dao Deviation Stones in the world are merely fragments separated from the Stone Mother. Although cultivators can claim them as their own through the Dao Transformation Divine Unity Method, fragments are ultimately fragments. Even the finest Dao Deviation Stone cannot compare to the Stone Mother. However, the blue ray the Stone Mother cast upon you is like turning stone into gold...”

The Holy Emperor’s tone was somewhat peculiar: “Although its quality is currently only high grade, it has been enlightened and possesses unlimited potential in the future.”

“In time, it may even become a second Stone Mother.”

“This...” Sun Erlang was stunned. He had not expected that after departing, the other party had left behind such a great fortune for him.

“No need to overthink it. Everyone has their own fortune. Perhaps the Stone Mother simply took a liking to you.” The Holy Emperor said indifferently.

“Yes...” Although Sun Erlang responded this way, from his expression it was clear he had not yet adapted.

“By the way, Master, those tens of thousands of deduction results from the Stone Mother...”

“Once you have calmed down, analyze them and report back.”

“I shall obey Master’s command.”

Somewhat dazed, Sun Erlang left the Holy Emperor’s hall.

Unknowingly, he arrived at the residence of the scholar whom Yi Shu had mentioned earlier, the one who had written “The Romance of the Xuanhuang Tripartition.”

At the doorway of the house, a large crowd still gathered.

Although they had not done anything excessive, they stared fixedly at the exit with hostile glares.

It was as if the scholar inside had an irreconcilable enmity with them.

Upon seeing Sun Erlang, their faces lit up with joy and they eagerly approached, wanting to recount the scholar’s misdeeds.

But Sun Erlang interrupted them with a slight frown.

The crowd sensibly dispersed.

Sun Erlang strode into the house.

The scholar was heavily drunk. Sun Erlang picked up the manuscript on the table and began to read.

Chapter 1268: Nullified Immortal Power

The handwriting was extremely sloppy, with large sections crossed out and deleted.

Nevertheless, Sun Erlang could still make out the general content.

The Immortal Dynasty ruled by the Taixuan Immortal Emperor grew stronger day by day, with talented individuals and extraordinary figures emerging in great numbers. It repeatedly achieved victories in its conflicts with the other two nations.

The Teacher of Heaven and Earth and the Supreme Sage of the Mortal Realm had no choice but to join forces to resist the might of Taixuan...

This plot was clearly not what the scholar truly wished to write.

Not only was the literary style and wording much weaker than before, but even the attitude toward writing had become perfunctory. Perhaps he could no longer bear it; the scholar had stopped writing before reaching the ending. He spent his days drunk, living in a daze.

Sun Erlang was not surprised by this outcome.

In the Holy Dynasty of Great Qi, the symbols of the Taixuan Immortal Emperor and the Faceless Holy Emperor were too similar. If the character suffered even the slightest setback in the plot, the scholar would face criticism from countless people. Under such real-world pressure, the Taixuan Immortal Emperor could only enjoy unbroken success in the story. Over time, his strength naturally surpassed the other two sages by a wide margin.

Still, Sun Erlang was somewhat curious about the original plot direction the scholar had in mind.

With a thought, Sun Erlang split off a strand of divine sense and entered the scholar’s sea of consciousness.

Before long, amid the chaotic thoughts, he found the content related to “Romance of the Xuanhuang Tripartition.”

It had to be said that the scholar was, after all, a native of the Holy Dynasty of Great Qi. After years of basking in the Holy Emperor’s grace, the deep reverence for the Holy Emperor in his subconscious led the ending he originally envisioned to still have the Taixuan Immortal Emperor overcoming all difficulties, suppressing the other two sages in succession, and unifying the Xuanhuang Realm.

Yet in that version there were failures, setbacks, and even moments when the situation turned desperate and his life hung by a thread.

Sun Erlang had to admit that, compared with the revised version he had seen in reality, the scholar’s original plot arrangement was far more dramatic and gripping.

“So it is said that literature should be like mountains, never flat. By comparison, the version outside tastes like chewing wax.”

Although Sun Erlang thought this, the book’s content involved his own master after all, so he did not dare decide on his own.

He flashed back into the Holy Emperor’s hall and reported the matter to Li Ping.

It was merely a small matter, yet for some unknown reason it caused the Holy Emperor to remain silent for a long time.

“The Taixuan Immortal Emperor is me, the Supreme Sage of the Mortal Realm is me, and the Teacher of Heaven and Earth is also me.”

In the end, the Holy Emperor slowly spoke these words, which echoed within the cold Holy Emperor’s hall.

Sun Erlang was first stunned, then suddenly enlightened.

He left with a joyful expression.

However, Li Ping’s usually unshakable state of mind was stirred by this incident into ripples that could not be calmed.

He perhaps understood a little why, after founding the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, the Immortal Ancestor had never again involved himself in worldly affairs or appeared before the public eye.

...

Hongze Realm.

Zhang Ming, the Golden Core cultivator stationed in this realm by the Holy Dynasty of Great Qi, suddenly received a report from his subordinates.

It seemed that some uninvited guests from the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had intruded into this small world.

“Three Nascent Soul cultivators and seven Golden Core cultivators.”

Zhang Ming’s brows furrowed tightly.

Although he had immediately sent a request for reinforcements to the Holy Dynasty, the thought of the large Voidbright Flow Crystal vein they had just discovered filled his heart with unrelenting unease.

“This Hongze Realm is not large, and the aura carried by the Voidbright Flow Crystal is quite distinctive. Even with the formation talismans I used for slight concealment, I fear it will be difficult to escape their detection.”

“It seems this battle cannot be avoided.”

Zhang Ming quickly calculated the forces he could currently command.

Including himself, he had at most five Golden Core cultivators.

The disparity in strength was obvious, and defeat was all but certain.

If he chose to retreat, the Holy Dynasty would not impose any severe punishment.

Yet as a proud soldier of Great Qi, Zhang Ming was destined to possess the courage to fight at least once before withdrawing.

He acted decisively and immediately deployed the sole Concealing Heaven Talisman.

As the name implied, the Concealing Heaven Talisman could obscure the secrets of heaven.

It was well known that when a cultivator of the Xuanhuang Realm perished, strange phenomena would appear in the sky. The deceased cultivator’s life story and even the exact manner of death would be displayed in vivid detail upon the celestial curtain.

Under normal circumstances this was manageable, but in a life-and-death battle like today, any casualties on either side would instantly spread far and wide, greatly increasing the difficulty of combat.

With the Concealing Heaven Talisman, however, the situation could be reversed and even turned into an advantage for their side.

The talisman could not only conceal the phenomena of a cultivator’s fall but could also precisely identify friend and foe and treat them differently.

When their side killed an enemy cultivator, no phenomenon would appear. Yet if one of their own was killed, the phenomenon would still descend as a warning.

Although the exact principle by which the talisman worked was unknown, there was no doubt that this single Concealing Heaven Talisman could shift the balance of victory by a fraction.

“Relying on this one talisman alone is still not enough.”

Zhang Ming then looked at the small white jade arrow in his bosom.

“Unfortunately, given our team’s qualifications, we can apply for at most one Army-Destroying Arrow each time we go out.”

“If we could obtain a few more, let alone these Nascent Soul cultivators, I would not fear even a Soul Transformation cultivator.”

The Army-Destroying Arrow was a weakened version of the Holy Dynasty’s Sky-Patrolling Arrow.

Though weakened, it could still deliver a devastating blow to Nascent Soul realm cultivators and those below.

It also came with tracking and aura-locking functions; once targeted, there was no escape.

“With only this one, it must be used to maximum effect.”

Zhang Ming soon had a plan in mind.

“Fu Ge!”

“Present!” A Golden Core mid-stage cultivator in earth-yellow robes under Zhang Ming’s command responded at once.

“Use the Rushing Current Talisman to transport these Voidbright Flow Crystals to this location underground.” Zhang Ming marked the exact spot on the map.

Fu Ge showed no hesitation and accepted the storage ring Zhang Ming handed over.

Yellow light flashed across his body, and he vanished into the ground.

The storage ring contained all the Voidbright Flow Crystals they had mined so far, merely a small portion of the giant vein.

Yet if detonated and guided in a special manner, the dispersed aura would be sufficient to draw the attention of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators on the surface.

“Bing San!”

“Lay down formation barriers along the route. Remember, do not make it too easy for them, but do not activate any of the lethal killing formations either.”

A middle-aged man with a sallow complexion acknowledged and departed.

...

Zhang Ming completed the deployment of his forces in an orderly and rapid manner.

Yet even though each of them possessed unique skills, they were still stretched thin before the absolute disparity in power.

An accident occurred right at the first step of the plan.

The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators were no ordinary foes. The one responsible for luring them to the ambush site was named Qiu Di.

Within the team, he excelled particularly in escape techniques.

Unexpectedly, the moment they met, before he could even display his escape art, he was trapped by a Cave-Heaven domain cast by a white-robed man among the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance group.

This Cave-Heaven domain was rather peculiar; it did not manifest any specific scene. It simply projected white rings of light that suppressed Qiu Di.

After trying every method and seeing no hope of escape, Qiu Di resolutely chose to self-detonate and end his own life.

Sensing the disappearance of his subordinate’s life aura, Zhang Ming’s heart tightened and his fists clenched.

The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators clearly had not expected the other side to be so resolute, committing suicide at the slightest disagreement.

The atmosphere instantly turned strange.

“Wait, Brother Lin Bai, something is wrong!”

After a moment, one of them reacted.

“Why is there no phenomenon of death?”

“Is it a faked death?”

“Doesn’t seem so; his soul and spirit have truly been extinguished.”

Lin Bai’s expression turned solemn as he looked up at the sky.

Before long his face grew ugly: “Be careful. Someone has concealed the secrets of heaven.”

Although he issued the warning, the others did not grow afraid; instead they became extremely excited.

“Concealing the secrets of heaven? In such an ordinary small world they are already using such methods. It seems there is a secret here!”

“We have run to several places in vain; finally we are about to reap some gains.”

“Even if it is not Voidbright Flow Crystal, unearthing the secret of this place may still make the trip worthwhile.”

...

While they were still discussing, they suddenly felt the ground tremble slightly.

At the same time, a familiar aura rose from underground.

“This is...”

The group froze for a moment.

Then their faces filled with disbelief: “It really is Voidbright Flow Crystal?”

In their perception, besides the spreading aura of the flow crystals, several figures seemed to be rapidly flying away from the site of the underground tremor.

“They saw they could no longer hide and are trying to flee?”

The thought crossed their minds instinctively.

Although they very much wanted to descend and investigate, they still exercised some caution. Instead of acting rashly, they all turned to look at Lin Bai.

Lin Bai pondered briefly and soon made a decision.

“Split into two groups. Brother Qian, take three people and pursue the fleeing cultivators. The rest will follow me.”

Without wasting words, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance group quickly divided. Four of them chased toward the horizon.

Lin Bai led the rest toward the source of the Voidbright Flow Crystal aura underground.

Along the way, some formations blocked their path.

Yet they broke through them with ease.

“These formations were set up by at least a Nascent Soul formation master.”

“Moreover, many of the array patterns are ones I have never seen before. Interesting...”

The group grew even more excited.

They soon reached their destination.

A giant cavity left by an explosion still showed many fragments of Voidbright Flow Crystal.

“Damn! So ruthless, they actually destroyed it outright!”

“What a waste! A fist-sized flow crystal now costs fifty thousand contribution points, and even then there is no supply!”

“There are still quite a few fragments; hurry and collect them, do not waste any!”

...

The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance group had originally maintained some order.

Yet upon seeing the ground covered in Voidbright Flow Crystal fragments, their greed was aroused and they could no longer restrain themselves.

They swarmed chaotically toward the interior of the cavity.

Although Lin Bai felt some envy in his heart, he habitually scanned the surroundings first.

Only after detecting no danger did he fly inside as well.

“Strange. This does not look like the original underground vein of the flow crystals. Could it be a storage warehouse they collected and kept...”

Lin Bai picked up a small piece of Voidbright Flow crystal, this thought rising in his mind.

At that moment his expression changed abruptly.

A small white jade arrow, appearing from nowhere, shot silently and swiftly from the dark underground toward the several people inside the cavity.

“Careful!” Lin Bai shouted instinctively.

He fully unleashed his Cave-Heaven domain and deployed hundreds of command flags to protect himself.

Yet the white jade arrow was even faster than expected.

A dazzling sphere of light erupted underground.

In an instant it engulfed all the cultivators inside the cavity.

Even their Cave-Heavens were completely annihilated.

Not far away, Zhang Ming watched the deaths of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators with no fluctuation in his heart.

“Brother Qiu Di, rest in peace.”

Without delay, Zhang Ming hurried toward the location of his other subordinates who were acting as bait.

Compared with his side, their situation was truly miserable.

Without a powerful weapon like the Army-Destroying Arrow, they could only rely on minor tricks to stall. They were quickly overtaken by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators.

A bitter battle ensued.

By the time Zhang Ming arrived with reinforcements, only two remained desperately holding on.

The Qian-named cultivator from the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance was still trying to persuade them: “Fellow Daoists, why persist? These are merely external objects; how can they compare with your own lives? We have no intention of taking your lives...”

Despite his words, the attacks in his hands did not weaken in the slightest.

Red light burst from the armor on Zhang Ming’s body.

He transformed into a red streak and charged straight toward the Qian-named cultivator.

“Brother Qian, watch out!”

After all, the gap in strength was too great. Even with the protective battle armor, it was not enough to bridge the difference between Golden Core and Nascent Soul.

He was still evaded.

The sneak attack failed, and instead he suffered heavy wounds.

The armor’s glow dimmed sharply.

“Huh? What kind of protective treasure is this? It endured my full-powered strike without a single crack?”

The Qian-named cultivator’s tone carried surprise mixed with greed.

“It seems we are destined to die here.”

Such was the thought in Zhang Ming’s heart.

Yet he felt no regret.

He had bought this much time; reinforcements from the Holy Dynasty should arrive soon.

Before the giant Voidbright Flow Crystal vein could be discovered by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, the Holy Dynasty would reclaim this place.

“After I die, my family will be proud of me.”

“Perhaps I will even receive personal commendation from the Holy Emperor.”

Zhang Ming’s heart was calm. Looking at the opposing Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators, he spoke in an icy tone: “Burn the soul!”

The few surviving subordinates heard him and showed no hesitation.

“Are you mad?!” the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators screamed in utter incomprehension.

They saw no need to clash head-on with these doomed men.

Even with overwhelming strength, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators focused on avoiding injury and dodging.

The cultivation boost from soul-burning gradually faded.

Zhang Ming and the others finally reached the end of their lives.

Just before his consciousness dissipated, Zhang Ming seemed to see a familiar figure.

“General Sun?”

Zhang Ming felt at peace.

Boundless golden light enveloped him.

Zhang Ming seemed to see the great Faceless Holy Emperor upon a swirling galaxy of stars.

...

Sun Erlang gathered the lingering wills of Zhang Ming and the others, then turned his gaze toward the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators.

Infinite killing intent instantly enveloped them.

Moments later, the few from the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance joined the brave warriors of the Holy Dynasty in death.

Sun Erlang looked toward the quiet sky, his mind stirring. He pointed toward the heavens.

The phenomenon of death slowly emerged. Yet the information it displayed was completely fabricated and contrary to the facts.

Chapter 1269: The Immortal Folding Formation

On the heavenly curtain of the Hongze Realm, the anomalous phenomenon of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance party perishing appeared in an instant.

“Nascent Soul cultivator Lin Bai, who had cultivated for one hundred and sixty-five years…”

“He perished in the Hongze Realm while contending for Voidbright Flow Crystals and was besieged by Qian Sheng, Qian Ming, and Qian Su, suffering fatal injuries.”

“His body died and his Dao dissipated, returning to the heavens!”

...

Clearly the advance team from the Holy Dynasty had killed them, yet the cause of death displayed on the heavenly curtain now showed a conflict with the Qian family.

This was Sun Erlang’s first use of the Heaven-Usurping Talisman, and the effect appeared quite good.

Sun Erlang carefully recorded the scene in the sky with a projection stone, a cold glint flashing in his eyes. He then followed the final message from Zhang Ming and located the Voidbright Flow Crystal vein in this place.

He cautiously uprooted the entire vein, deliberately scattered the small fragments that had broken off from the main vein across various parts of the Hongze Realm, and finally erased all traces of the battle.

Only after completing these steps did Sun Erlang quietly depart.

A long time later, the obscured and altered heavenly secrets of the Hongze Realm slowly returned to normal.

Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, Yueyang Prefecture, Qian family.

The Qian family head, Qian Wanling, who was at the peak of Soul Transformation, wore a gloomy expression. Below him stood Qian Sheng, Qian Ming, Qian Su, and the others, who still looked somewhat confused.

“Tell me what fine deeds you have done.”

“What fine deeds?” Qian Sheng froze on the spot.

“Big Brother, you suddenly summoned us here with this kind of face. What exactly happened?” Qian Su asked, also puzzled.

Qian Wanling slammed the table hard. “You are still hiding it! The Lin family has already come knocking! Lin Bai was the successor the Lin family placed high hopes on. Now that you have killed him, how can they let it go? Voidbright Flow Crystals may be good, but you need to be alive to enjoy them!”

“Greed has clouded your judgment! Utterly foolish!”

The Qian family head glared at his brothers, flames nearly leaping from his eyes. If not for blood being thicker than water, he would have wanted to slap them all dead on the spot.

“Wait!” Qian Ming suddenly realized something. His expression changed as he asked in panic, “What Lin Bai? What Voidbright Flow Crystals? Big Brother, you must have made a mistake, right? We killed Lin Bai? What kind of joke is that?”

Seeing that they still refused to admit it, Qian Wanling felt disappointment reach its peak. “You are even hiding it from me for the sake of Voidbright Flow Crystals? Fine, fine, fine!”

In his rage, Qian Wanling immediately took out a recording stone and played the heavenly phenomenon of the fall in the Hongze Realm.

Watching the heavenly anomaly before them, the three Qian brothers were instantly dumbfounded.

“This is wrong, Big Brother! We really did not do this!”

“Someone is framing us! Big Brother, you must believe us!”

After a brief daze, the three brothers cried out together, protesting their innocence.

Qian Wanling stared at them fixedly but could not detect any flaw of pretense in their expressions.

“These three fools’ acting skills are not that good. Could it be…”

Even Qian Wanling now felt some hesitation.

“Then where were you three during the past few days?”

Upon hearing this, Qian Sheng and the others hesitated. But under their elder brother’s murderous gaze, they had no choice but to reveal the truth.

“That day we were cultivating by absorbing Sun qi at the small building beside Yueyang Lake when we suddenly sensed an anomaly in the earth veins not far away, as if some treasure was about to emerge. So we went to investigate. Unexpectedly, right after we arrived, the earth-vein power suddenly went berserk. We were swept into the earth veins, lost control, and could not free ourselves…”

“We only escaped recently.” Qian Sheng recounted everything in detail.

Seeing his elder brother Qian Wanling’s increasingly gloomy gaze, he hurriedly added, “It is true. If you do not believe me, look. Because we were immersed in the earth veins for so long, the spiritual energy in our bodies has unavoidably been tainted with a thick earth-vein aura.”

Qian Wanling swept his senses through the three and indeed found clear traces of earth-vein power contamination.

He then fell silent.

The three Qian brothers thought their elder brother still did not believe them and wanted to continue explaining.

Instead, Qian Wanling let out a long sigh. “Even if I believe you, will the Lin family believe you? Will the world believe you?”

“The image recorded in this projection stone has been verified and is not fabricated.”

“Moreover, it involves the treasure known as Voidbright Flow Crystals…”

“Our Qian family is in trouble.”

Qian Sheng gradually came to his senses, his eyes nearly splitting with rage. “Who is so scheming as to frame us like this!”

Qian Ming’s eyes turned red. “Big Brother, rest assured. We will not drag the family down with us.”

With that, he turned to leave.

“You fools! If you go out now, are you seeking death?!”

Reprimanded by Qian Wanling, they stopped.

Looking at his three brothers’ aggrieved and furious expressions, Qian Wanling sighed again.

In the end, he made the decisive call as family head. “At this point, being misunderstood is unavoidable.”

“The only option is to report this matter to Lord Fan Li first…”

Fan Li was the Dao Integration cultivator stationed in Yueyang Prefecture. He usually disliked staying in Yueyang Sky City and had built a small building by Yueyang Lake for his residence.

“I will go personally. You three must stay home and not go out.”

Qian Wanling gave serious instructions, then altered his appearance and left through a secret passage in the house.

He left behind the three panicked and helpless Qian brothers.

Not long after, Fan Li, who was resting in the Yueyang small building, frowned upon hearing Qian Wanling’s account.

At that moment, the Lin family head, Lin Yufei, also arrived.

“Lord Fan, you must uphold justice for our Lin family!”

The Lin family’s spies stationed outside the Yueyang small building had seen Qian Wanling appear and immediately notified Lin Yufei.

Lin Yufei hurried over. He looked at Qian Wanling, who sat upright in the building, and did not conceal the killing intent in his eyes.

“Your Qian family has gone too far! You simply treat the Immortal Alliance’s laws as nothing!”

“Brother Lin, calm down. Someone is framing us.” Qian Wanling gave a bitter smile and apologized.

“Framing?! Is the heavenly phenomenon false? Is the image recorded in the projection stone false?!”

Saying nothing would have been better. Qian Wanling’s words sounded to Lin Yufei like excuses and evasion, and he flew into a rage.

However, due to the inherent workings of the Immortal Alliance system, such matters had not yet drawn the attention of the alliance’s true upper echelons.

Great Qi.

In any corner of Great Qi, one could see the divine hall’s brilliant radiance like the great sun in the sky.

Although they lost their physical bodies, they could exist eternally in the state of heroic spirits.

The golden-light-filled phantoms of Zhang Ming and the others flying out from the floating divine hall confirmed the Holy Emperor’s words.

The people of Great Qi cheered the Holy Emperor’s divine grace. Their fear of death gradually transformed into fanaticism to enter the floating divine hall and become immortal heroic spirits.

Sun Erlang knew that these so-called heroic spirits were likely remnants of consciousness preserved by Master using divine power and given form.

Although there was still a great gap from true immortality and eternity. But it was still a way to salvage something after death.

Rather than the soul scattering and completely annihilating, leaving the last trace in the world was good.

But for Sun Erlang, minimizing the sacrifices of soldiers was the proper path.

He arrived at the secret location where the Holy Dynasty forged its instruments of conquest. The Army-Destroying Arrows and Heaven-Usurping Talismans all came from here.

“I greet Senior Qiao Gong.”

Sun Erlang said to the busy Qiao Gong.

Qiao Gong did not respond, focusing intently on the black puppets continuously flashing rapidly in the space ahead.

Sun Erlang did not mind and also looked toward the puppets.

The black puppets kept teleporting, their figures floating, even evading Sun Erlang’s divine sense lock.

Qiao Gong said with full regret.

“Sun boy, go up and spar with it.”

Qiao Gong suddenly said.

Sun Erlang nodded and instantly arrived in the testing area.

The black puppet stopped its rapid movement and instead launched a full-force assault on Sun Erlang.

The main attack methods were two: one was black death rays sprayed out with annihilating aura.

The other was detonating formation modules to trap and injure enemies with standard formations.

It could almost fight an ordinary peak Nascent Soul cultivator, but clearly it could not injure Sun Erlang at all. While easily dodging the black puppet’s attacks, Sun Erlang flicked his fingers to shoot out several blue light spheres.

The light spheres traced different curves, accurately locking onto and striking the black puppet.

A faint glow flashed across the puppet’s body, and it unexpectedly absorbed Sun Erlang’s moves.

“Boy, you didn’t see this last time, did you?”

“This move is called returning the favor with the same method.”

As Qiao Gong said this, faint blue light lit up on the black puppet’s body.

Those blue light spheres were actually reflected back.

“This is only one puppet. The advantage of the mass-produced type lies in numbers.”

With Qiao Gong’s words, dozens more puppets appeared in the testing space in the blink of an eye.

In the fight against them, Sun Erlang discovered that these puppets seemed to act as one whole.

Not only did they coordinate perfectly, they vaguely formed a formation.

Moreover, any one of the puppets could concentrate and reflect back the attacks absorbed by the whole.

Even with Sun Erlang’s considerable strength, without using killing moves, facing over thirty puppets left him somewhat overwhelmed.

He called a stop to the test and returned to Qiao Gong’s side.

“Senior Qiao Gong, how many of these mass-produced puppets can be deployed at once?”

Qiao Gong shrugged: “Boy, this is a Holy Dynasty secret. Even though you are the Holy Emperor’s direct disciple, I cannot tell you too much.”

Sun Erlang could not help but be speechless.

Qiao Gong laughed heartily: “Just kidding with you.”

“[Holy Army Puppet], fifty per group. They require control by special cultivators to display maximum combat power.”

“Surrounding and killing a Soul Transformation cultivator should not be a problem.”

“Upper limit?” Qiao Gong was slightly stunned, then understood.

“You want to try?”

Sun Erlang nodded.

Qiao Gong pondered for a moment and handed over a black jade disk.

“Do not force it.”

Sun Erlang took the disk. In his sea of consciousness, the scene of over a thousand black puppets standing neatly and straight instantly appeared.

His thoughts seemed like threads connecting all the puppets.

Each puppet seemed to have its own consciousness.

After connecting, Sun Erlang’s own divine soul felt as if weighted down by something heavy and became somewhat burdened.

However, this also allowed him to control the puppets as easily as moving his own arms.

Sun Erlang got used to the puppet’s body. With a thought, one of the puppets flew into the testing area.

It began flying and attack experiments.

After a period of adaptation, Sun Erlang felt the burden on his divine soul had become negligible. He then began connecting additional puppets.

Next came the third, the tenth, the fiftieth…

Under Qiao Gong’s gradually shocked gaze, the total number of puppets controlled by Sun Erlang had clearly exceeded one hundred.

And from his expression, he still seemed completely at ease.

“You kid…”

“You can do it!”

Qiao Gong suddenly had a whimsical thought: “If you controlled the Holy Army Puppets alone, would the effect be even better?”

Inside the Holy Dynasty’s treasury.

The Holy Emperor, having avoided Qiao Gong, began modifying the puppet body. His purpose in traveling to the Star Sea this time was to comprehend the Dao.

He still had requirements regarding the aptitude of the body he would possess. What Qiao Gong could not achieve...did not mean the Holy Emperor could not.

His large hand rested on the crown of the flesh puppet’s head as the Xuanhuang Heavenly Favor slowly infused into it.

Suddenly...a sense of déjà vu arose in the Holy Emperor’s heart. His hand movements paused slightly.

After pondering for a moment, he suppressed this unusual feeling. The originally somewhat stiff shell gradually became lifelike.

As one heavenly material after another in the Holy Dynasty’s treasury was refined into liquid by source power essence and merged into the puppet body, the body grew increasingly crystalline and translucent, emitting a rich fragrance.

Even the slumbering Cat Treasure was drawn by it. It woke with a start and looked around. Upon discovering that the source of the fragrance was the body refined by Li Ping, a trace of disappointment flashed in its eyes.

Just as it was about to sleep again, it received the Holy Emperor’s instruction.

Cat Treasure shook its head somewhat unwillingly. In the end, unable to resist the promised temptation of source power essence, it let out a lazy meow.

Then it leaped forward and transformed into the shape of a blue, transparent glass cover.

It enveloped the body Li Ping had refined.

Strands of blue light released from the container. After drifting for a moment, they all drilled into the interior of the puppet body.

At this moment Li Ping had a strand of consciousness attached to the puppet body, so he could personally and vividly feel the specific changes occurring as it bathed in the blue light.

“Reorganization of flesh and blood, sublimation of life form.”

“Even without cultivation, the strength of this body already surpasses that of ordinary Nascent Soul cultivators in the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“And...”

The Holy Emperor carefully sensed the differences between this body and his original one.

He could not yet understand all the consequences caused by these differences. But he could almost confirm that these variations had been created to deal with some special circumstance.

While the blue light cover continued its modifications, a flash of insight appeared in Li Ping’s mind. He could even use Cat Treasure’s function to infuse the special abilities of the living beings Cat Treasure had previously absorbed and imitated into this body, turning them into innate divine powers.

However, since this was an artificially created body, doing so might cause unpredictable changes.

The divine powers Cat Treasure currently possessed were all optional for Li Ping. With departure for the Star Sea imminent, he did not pursue it further.

He could experiment slowly in the future.

The blue light cover grew dimmer and dimmer until its glow completely faded.

Cat Treasure looked as if it had fought a great battle for three days and three nights. Its face was haggard, and even its once-glossy fur appeared somewhat yellowish.

Li Ping fed it a large mouthful of golden source power essence. Only then did Cat Treasure sink contentedly back into deep sleep.

“Item replication and living being imitation. This is Cat Treasure’s third function.”

“Changing tendons and cleansing marrow.”

“Truly remarkable!” Li Ping exclaimed in admiration.

The puppet body had awakened from its sublimation. Li Ping sensed that this body was even more suitable for his divine soul than his original one.

“Why not simply switch bodies?”

An irresistible thought surged from the depths of his mind, but the Holy Emperor forcibly suppressed it in an instant.

Cat Treasure’s tendon-changing and marrow-cleansing function was not a one-time use.

The effect on the puppet body was already so excellent; applying it to the main body would naturally be no worse.

There was still plenty of time. There would be plenty of opportunities. Li Ping focused his will on the puppet body and began adapting to and attempting to control it.

...

Half a month later.

Before the puppet body could fly out of the Xuanhuang Realm, it first received a transmission reminder from Qiao Gong.

The Immortal Alliance envoy was about to arrive at the Lingyuan Sect in Nine Mountain Prefecture.

Golden light flashed across Li Ping’s body, instantly transforming him into the appearance of Master Qiao Gong.

He appeared noiselessly inside the Lingyuan Sect headquarters.

He waited for the Immortal Alliance envoy’s arrival.

The puppet body left behind by Qiao Gong had already prepared a large quantity of collected source power.

Li Ping naturally looked down on this low-quality energy.

Not to mention compared with source power essence, it fell far short even when compared with the source power produced by the people of the Holy Dynasty of Great Qi through cultivating the Vital Essence Technique of All Living Beings.

However, after inspecting it, the Immortal Alliance envoy was overjoyed.

“The quality of this batch submitted seems to have improved quite a bit?”

“The sect master has put in real effort.” The Immortal Alliance envoy praised as he carefully stored away the light sphere containing the source power.

Li Ping, imitating Qiao Gong’s tone, smiled and replied: “Recently I acquired a profound technique that can invisibly eliminate the distracting thoughts of the sect members, allowing them to devote more time to cultivating the method.”

The Immortal Alliance envoy’s eyes brightened: “There is such a divine technique?”

“Why? Is the envoy interested?” Li Ping asked.

The Immortal Alliance envoy looked somewhat embarrassed: “The Immortal Alliance’s deficit has grown larger again recently. If the sect master finds it convenient...”

Li Ping waved his hand: “It is no trouble. It is merely a minor path. If the envoy is interested, I shall recite it for you.”

“Keep the mind free of distractions and reside in one’s own spirit. Ten thousand laws cannot invade; touch upon the profound and mysterious...”

As Li Ping spoke, he chanted the words of the technique aloud.

The Immortal Alliance envoy was delighted and concentrated on listening attentively.

He did not notice that his own mind was slowly sinking under the other party’s gentle chanting.

When the Immortal Alliance envoy’s eyes turned completely vacant and he fell into a state of total stupor, Li Ping smiled faintly and flicked a speck of gold from his finger. It flew into the other party’s sea of consciousness.

As expected, there was protection from the Immortal Alliance’s restrictions.

Yet under the silent infiltration of source power essence, the defenses were like paper and were pierced without sound.

Soon Li Ping found the information he wanted inside the envoy’s mind.

“Power of ten thousand cultivators, condensed into a Piercing Spear.”

“Striking deep into the Xuanhuang Realm, toward the endless Dark Sea...”

“Just as expected.”

Previously Li Ping had always been curious about how the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had located and maintained the entrance to the Dark Sea.

According to the You Clan’s accounts, the channel the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had dug in the Dark Sea differed markedly from the channels opened by traditional You Clan methods.

Perhaps they did not fully trust the You Clan, or perhaps the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance wanted to keep firm control of the Dark Sea channel in their own hands.

In any case, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had devised a method of using highly condensed source power to directly open a passage between the Xuanhuang Realm proper and the Dark Sea.

“It is precisely because the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance has been eyeing the Nether Realm like a tiger watching its prey, that the power of the Dark Sea has continued to diminish.”

“It seems it is time to cut off some of their reaching tentacles first.”
