Chapter 1276: Capturing Of Mo Rubin

At first, the Derivation Law Jade was somewhat cautious. But after she truly took a bite, her expression instantly became extremely vivid. Then she began to gulp it down in large mouthfuls.

“Mmm… so tasty…”

In just a few bites, she finished an entire plate of fried rice. Afterward, still somewhat unsatisfied, she rubbed her slightly swollen belly, her face full of astonishment. “Your fried rice tastes just like the real thing. How did you do it?”

As she spoke, she let out another burp.

Li Fan smiled and said, “When the false is treated as real, it becomes real; when the real is treated as false, it becomes false. Truth and illusion are never so easy to distinguish. As long as you have sufficient understanding of the essence of things, you too can create something that is indistinguishable from reality.”

The Derivation Law Jade plopped down onto the ground. “I have only ever eaten fried rice, never made it myself. The same goes for other delicacies. Looks like there is no hope of being self sufficient. But…”

She glanced at Li Fan. “You were not a chef in the past, were you?”

Li Fan’s face twitched slightly. He avoided answering and changed the subject. “Are you full? Have you remembered that immortal character?”

Derivation Law Jade quickly shook her head. “One dish is not enough. Can I have more?”

Li Fan let out a cold snort, but still waved his hand lightly. A stove, cooking utensils, and ingredients appeared one after another.

As the cooking fire flickered, dish after dish of fragrant delicacies was presented.

Derivation Law Jade drooled as she watched, accepting everything and stuffing it all into her mouth.

“Burp…”

After enjoying a satisfying feast, the little girl’s belly was round like a ball. She lay flat on the ground in an ungraceful manner.

“I have to say, although you do not look very handsome, your cooking skills are truly excellent,” she praised.

Li Fan replied calmly, “It is merely a skill I used for small business when I was a mortal. Not worth mentioning.”

Derivation Law Jade squinted happily, savoring the lingering taste. Then she said, “I feel sleepy. I am going to take a nap. You can do as you wish.”

As she spoke, she was already snoring loudly, fast asleep. Within the sphere of character light, strokes intertwined and moved, forming a massive character that filled the entire sky.

The profound sound of the Great Dao that had once been heard in the illusion faintly echoed again.

However, it came and went intermittently, as if it were only an illusion.

Li Fan raised his head and gazed at the character without moving. Only after it slowly dissipated did he reveal a thoughtful expression.

“It is indeed a True Immortal character script. However, due to the Derivation Law Jade’s incomplete memory, its meaning cannot be fully understood. Even the character she presents already deviates somewhat from the true script.

“However…”

Li Fan used his hand as a brush and attempted to write in the air.

Yet he repeatedly paused at critical points and shook his head slightly.

“The structure of the strokes, the style of their turns, and the details of the brushwork are all very similar to the Hunger and Chaos characters I saw before, yet they are more beautiful and more naturally formed.”

“The gap between the original and an imitation is actually so vast.”

Previously, the True Immortal character scripts Li Fan encountered already seemed perfect to him, flawless in every aspect and filled with vast divine power.

But comparison reveals the difference.

Compared to this authentic inscription remembered by the Derivation Law Jade, those that brought disaster to the Darkest Star Sea appeared crude, like childish scribbles.

However, Li Fan discovered that this gap only appeared when both were compared simultaneously. If he reproduced a single character like Hunger or Chaos alone, he would still instinctively feel it was flawless.

It was a very contradictory and wondrous experience.

After repeated attempts, Li Fan reached a conclusion. To him, True Immortal script was like a vast ocean. By himself, he could only be submerged within it, unable to perceive its entirety. But with an authentic inscription as a reference, it was like an anchor or a vantage point, allowing him to break free and see clearly.

By imitating the authentic inscription, Li Fan reorganized the Hunger and Chaos scripts he had mastered.

The results were excellent. Though they appeared almost the same at first glance, Li Fan was certain their power had increased by at least one third.

“It is a pity that this authentic inscription is also incomplete, and after passing through memory, it is still somewhat distorted.”

After a long while, Li Fan emerged from his enlightenment and exhaled deeply.

“From the clues so far, True Immortal character script can be divided into three categories. The first is like the Chaos type, which brings disasters and destruction. The second is the Return type, which represents decrees from the Immortal Realm. The last is this…”

“The rain that falls when the character manifests can be called Immortal Melody Jade Dew. It is accompanied by the profound sound of the Great Dao, attracting True Immortals to compete for it. It likely corresponds to the legendary Inscription Dao.”

Li Fan’s thoughts surged as he once again tried to repair the incomplete character.

The result was naturally futile.

“With the destruction of the Immortal Realm, where could such authentic inscriptions exist now?”

…

At the same time, while Li Fan’s true body was gaining insight, Li Ping, the Faceless Holy Emperor, had completed the final sealing of the Faceless Immortal statue and the ruins of the First Origin Sect.

According to his perception, Mo Rubin, who had been fleeing rapidly, had stopped moving for quite some time.

“Where is this place?”

Li Ping pondered and did not pursue immediately. Instead, he summoned Master Qiao Gong.

“That place… it is said to be formed from the heart of a giant beast after death, the convergence of earth energy in Nine Mountains Prefecture. I have been there once, but found nothing special,” Qiao Gong replied.

“It is merely that the spiritual qi is slightly denser than elsewhere.”

Li Ping then asked about the Heavenly Beast.

Qiao Gong shrugged. “If not for local cultivators, I would not even know Nine Mountains came from a giant beast corpse.”

He then mentioned a Nascent Soul cultivator named Shen Yurou, whose family specialized in excavations.

Li Ping summoned Shen Yurou and asked for details.

Shen Yurou said cautiously, “After my ancestor entered that place, he developed strange illnesses. He would dream of that underground structure repeatedly. Since then, all members of our family have had reversed yin and yang traits.”

Li Ping examined him and found no abnormalities.

“Is the location recorded?”

“No, but there is a painting.”

Shen Yurou created an image.

At the four corners stood headless statues, seemingly praying.

At the center stood a smooth pillar.

Its shadow, however, resembled a ferocious beast.

Li Ping stared at the statues.

Though headless, they resembled the style of the Faceless True Immortal statues beneath Mount Taixu.

“They borrowed the image, yet severed the head.”

“And this pillar…”

The smooth cylindrical pillar was, without a doubt, the core of this strange structure. However, nothing could be discerned from the image alone.

After dismissing Shen Yurou, Li Ping quietly arrived at the great marsh of Nine Mountains Prefecture.

In a region where nine mountain ranges stretched continuously, the presence of such a vast swamp was, in theory, extremely unreasonable. Many cultivators had come here to explore, hoping to uncover some hidden secret, but all had returned empty handed.

Standing at the center of the marsh, Li Ping only sensed a foul, putrid stench. He did not detect anything unusual.

If not for clearly sensing that Mo Rubin was hiding here.

Mo Rubin had likely not noticed Li Ping’s approach. Although he was moving within a small range deep in the swamp, he never left this area.

A gurgling sound.

Suddenly, his figure came to an abrupt halt.

Just moments ago, Li Ping had faintly heard a squirming noise.

With his current cultivation, it could almost certainly not be an illusion. Therefore…

Li Ping looked around.

The sticky, foul smelling swamp mud was rhythmically squeezing and shifting like a living thing.

A strange feeling arose in Li Ping’s heart. It was as if the entire swamp had suddenly come alive.

“A trap?”

This thought flashed through Li Ping’s mind, but he quickly dismissed it.

The swamp’s attention was not on him.

The Holy Emperor continued to conceal his presence. Following the sensation in his heart, which was also the source of the swamp’s life rhythm, he soon discovered the strange structure that Shen Yurou’s ancestor had once encountered.

From an external, macroscopic view, the structure resembled a blank face.

The towering smooth cylinder was positioned at the center of the face’s forehead, like a raised third eye gazing at the sky from beneath the ground.

Such a bizarre sight made Li Ping’s heart tighten.

The structure blocked his perception of its interior. He could only rely on the mark he had previously left on Mo Rubin to confirm that the other party was indeed inside, busy with something.

The Holy Emperor did not enter rashly. Instead, he silently set up a net of source power essence outside.

Combined with layers of formations, he completely sealed the area. He also invoked the power of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao to lock down the surrounding earth veins.

Even after deploying so many measures, for some reason Li Ping still felt little confidence.

After a moment of thought, Li Ping awakened Cat Treasure on his shoulder and took out an item from its belly.

It was a strange treasure obtained from the Fishing Pond, capable of sealing space.

The treasure appeared rather plain, merely a simple ring.

Yet the golden white light flowing across it faintly revealed the terrifying power hidden within.

“Binding Space Ring.”

“It was refined by extinguishing all life within a ring shaped world and merging it into the ring. It carries not only the weight of an entire world, but also the weight of countless living beings. Once bound, even my movements would be greatly affected.”

Although its method of refinement made it an undeniably evil artifact, Li Ping was not rigid in his thinking, so he felt no burden in using it.

With a light toss, the Binding Space Ring flew toward the top of the faceless structure. In an instant, it expanded several times, covering the entire surrounding area.

Watching the golden white ring gradually fade from sight, the Holy Emperor pondered briefly and set up one final measure.

Once everything was prepared, Li Ping flew into the structure.

“You have come.”

“I have been waiting for you for a long time.”

As soon as he entered, Mo Rubin’s voice sounded beside his ear.

Li Ping focused his gaze but could not see his figure.

However, at the base of the smooth cylinder at the center of the structure, a drifting shadow vaguely resembled a human shape.

It faced Li Ping, as if sneering.

“I followed Brother Xuanyuan for so long. Even if I did not step into the half immortal realm, I would not be completely ignorant. Not to mention, you are using a plan that my brother already discarded…”

“The Mortal Dust Immortal Power is strong, but harmful without benefit,” Mo Rubin mocked.

Li Ping knew that the power of Mortal Dust Immortal Power he referred to was the source power essence condensed from the faith of the You race.

A shortcut always comes with a price. But Li Ping’s goal was not ascension, but the Xuanhuang world itself.

Within the limits of what he could pursue, there was nothing wrong with seeking the greatest possible power.

Ignoring Mo Rubin’s words, the Holy Emperor examined the details of the structure.

“A relic of the Xuantian Sect?” he asked.

Mo Rubin seemed to be waiting for something and did not act. He replied, “Heh, rather than the Xuantian Sect, it is better to say this is a backup I left for myself.”

“Brother Xuanyuan is too idealistic. He trusts himself too much.”

“I am different.”

The shadow beneath the pillar seemed stimulated, moving faster and faster.

“I once had the same mentality as him, believing I was the destined protagonist, that as long as I acted, failure was impossible. But later I was struck down hard, my cultivation regressing every day, and I had to face the mockery of those I once looked down upon…”

“I understood!”

Mo Rubin’s shadow surged upward from the ground, floating in midair as it glared viciously at Li Ping.

“I am not some protagonist. I am just an insignificant figure in the long river of history. A small figure must prepare a path for failure. So I built this place behind Brother Xuanyuan’s back!”

Chapter 1277: A True Immortal Hidden In The Dark Sea

A killing intent so dense it seemed tangible swept toward the Holy Emperor, yet it was dissolved into nothingness by the strands of golden light before him.

Only after Mo Rubin’s fury subsided slightly did Li Ping speak calmly, “I can tell that your anger is not genuine.”

“Still acting in front of me? Or have you played the role so long that even you can no longer tell the difference?”

“Take a look. True anger is like this.”

The Holy Emperor suddenly stepped forward. A powerful force erupted from the tip of his foot and swept outward in all directions. The radiance of the white jade banner pole shook violently like a withered willow in the wind.

Yet once this surging energy left the circle of light and entered the Dark Sea, it rapidly weakened.

Ripples spread across the silent Dark Sea, erasing all disturbances, as if soothing the enraged Holy Emperor.

“I do not need you to teach me. I understand this place better than you!”

Mo Rubin’s figure suddenly appeared behind Li Ping. A shadow lurked beneath the white glow of the jade banner pole like a venomous serpent, baring its fangs at Li Ping’s neck.

Cracks instantly spread across the golden armor on the Holy Emperor’s surface. From the hollow at its center, a black line shot out toward Li Ping’s throat.

Just as it was about to strike, Li Ping raised his hand and blocked it.

Looking at the writhing shadow restrained in his palm, Li Ping said coldly, “Another personality? This one resembles you quite a bit.”

After speaking, he did not crush the ambushing shadow but released it back to Mo Rubin. However, Mo Rubin himself had already abandoned even the white jade banner. Taking advantage of the moment, he vanished from where he stood.

Li Ping shook his head slightly. That earlier kick had not been meaningless. Following the lingering trace of perception, he sped through the Dark Sea in pursuit of Mo Rubin.

Mo Rubin’s direction seemed to be the rift where the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance was extracting the power of darkness.

“So you learned some trick and dare to boast in front of me?”

“Do you think I do not know that the Dark Sea contains everything, even a cultivator’s emotions stir ripples and are then swallowed by the darkness?”

“And you claim to see through my heart?”

Dozens of Mo Rubin’s faces floated in the darkness, appearing from time to time, mocking Li Ping.

Their tones differed, but without exception, each dissolved into the Dark Sea after speaking.

Since these demonic faces did not attack, Li Ping ignored them and continued forward at full speed.

The chatter continued.

“What is the real me? I am the number one genius of the Nine Refinements Temple, the one chosen to become an immortal. I am also one of the Twelve Dharma Kings of the Xuantian Sect, assisting Xuanyuan Hong in building the Xuantian Sect and unifying the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“Does that mean I must always show the same face? Must the top genius always be composed? Must a Dharma King always plan before acting?”

“Wrong, wrong, wrong! My laughter and rage are me. My arrogance is me. My unrestrained nature is also me!”

“With an immortal heart commanding demonic faces, I show whatever is needed in the moment.”

“To those acting, I act along. To those in fear, I intimidate. To the wicked, I join them.”

“And for someone like you, a stubborn do-gooder, you deserve to be cursed awake!”

“Who do you think you are? You have not even stepped into the Immortal Realm, yet you dream of saving the world!”

More faces appeared, hurling vicious insults at the Holy Emperor.

Yet his expression did not change at all.

His gaze pierced through layers of darkness. Not far ahead, Mo Rubin’s true face was equally calm.

A surge of the Dark Sea blocked Mo Rubin’s path.

He suddenly stopped and looked up at the sky.

A rift continuously spewed dark power outward in rhythmic bursts, like a heavy heartbeat.

“What a nuisance.”

“With so many parasites dragging things down, how could success ever be achieved?”

Another shadowy face appeared above Li Ping, its tone calm but filled with genuine killing intent.

“I once tried to use the power of the Dark Sea to close that rift, but I was stopped by an eyeball.”

“Does that eyeball belong to the Xuantian King?”

The Holy Emperor stepped beside Mo Rubin and placed a hand on his shoulder, transmitting his voice.

Mo Rubin did not turn around. A face appeared on the back of his head, looking at Li Ping with disdain.

“You think Brother Xuanyuan would do such a thing?”

Li Ping did not react and continued, “Then why can that eyeball control the power of the Dark Sea?”

The face vanished.

“Do you know what the essence of this Dark Sea is?” Mo Rubin asked.

“A formation?” Li Ping answered after a moment of thought.

“How foolish,” Mo Rubin sneered. “The formation is only the surface. What truly creates this gathering of darkness and allows the Xuanhuang Realm to resist the pull from the ruins of the ascension passage is…”

He suddenly paused.

“Do you want to know?” he asked teasingly.

“Yes,” Li Ping replied plainly.

Mo Rubin lost interest and returned to a normal tone.

“Only the power of a True Immortal can oppose a True Immortal.”

“The catastrophe of the Darkest Star Sea was caused by a True Immortal who had attained the Dao. Then the force capable of allowing the Xuanhuang Realm to escape must also come from another True Immortal.”

These words struck like thunder in the Holy Emperor’s mind.

The surrounding darkness seemed to come alive, observing him.

“A True Immortal indeed.”

“But a dead one, correct?” Li Ping calmly asked.

Mo Rubin shrugged. “Talking to smart people is boring.”

“That is right. The entire Dark Sea is formed from the corpse of a True Immortal.”

Li Ping was not surprised.

The Dark Sea could absorb the faith of the You race and convert it into source power essence, yet it did not restrict believers from changing faith.

Once the network of a True Immortal was formed, it existed independently of will. To escape it required power capable of tearing it apart.

The weak You race clearly lacked such strength. The only explanation was that the True Immortal who created it had already died.

“True Immortal,” Li Ping repeated.

“A fallen True Immortal within the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“Remarkable, is it not? A mere lower realm contains the corpse of a True Immortal. Fortunately, it exists, otherwise even Brother Xuanyuan could not have saved the Xuanhuang Realm,” Mo Rubin said with emotion.

Li Ping then explained the existence of the Fallen Immortal Realm.

“Interesting. Someone actually shared the legacy of a True Immortal,” Mo Rubin said, his aura becoming unstable again.

“Hard to imagine someone more foolish than Brother Xuanyuan.”

“He is already dead,” Li Ping added.

Mo Rubin fell silent, then said quietly, “Good. Good that he died…”

Though he said so, there was a trace of sadness.

Li Ping asked, “Is the Xuantian King truly dead?”

Mo Rubin looked at him blankly. “How would I know? Probably not. I am searching for him too.”

He turned away.

“The Dark Sea is built upon the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation, with the corpse of a True Immortal as its bones and the bloodline of the first Celestial Venerable as its binding.”

“It generates power from nothing, enough to resist a True Immortal.”

“But without a core, it has become nourishment for others.”

“So never die. What if you were a True Immortal in life? After death, even ants can bully you."

Mo Rubin looked toward the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s extraction device and sneered.

“Bloodline of the First Great Celestial Venerable?” Li Ping thought of the strange appearance of the You Race and felt a stir in his heart.

“No wonder only these people can communicate with the Dark Sea. However…”

A direct bloodline of a True Immortal, there was no need to think to know how noble it once was. Yet now they had become neither human nor ghost.

Mo Rubin seemed to see through Li Ping’s thoughts and said coldly, “There is no need to pity them. If you had lived in that era and personally experienced how the Great Celestial Venerable bloodline enslaved others…”

“You would probably have been the first to rise in rebellion.”

“If not for Brother Xuanyuan taking action back then and slaughtering all their claws and fangs, these so called superior beings would have continued their tyranny for who knows how long. Becoming what they are now can be considered their karmic retribution.” Mo Rubin sneered coldly.

Li Ping did not continue to argue with him on this matter.

“The Dark Sea is actually formed by relying on the remains of a True Immortal, condensing dark immortal power to resist the Immortal Ruins. Then what exactly is the eye controlled by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance?” he asked softly.

“Immortal Ruins…” Seeming quite dissatisfied with the term, Mo Rubin let out another cold laugh.

However, this time he did not dwell on such details and directly answered Li Ping’s question. “That is merely a magical artifact refined by Brother Xuanyuan back then to control the Dark Sea. After all, he could not watch over this place at all times, and the Dark Sea was too important in the entire escape plan, so he needed us to assist. There were three in total, each entrusted to a different Dharma King.”

“I just do not know whose one the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance currently holds.” A trace of killing intent flashed in Mo Rubin’s words.

Li Ping nodded slightly. “Is there any way to influence that eye artifact’s control over the Dark Sea?”

“If your attainment in formations surpasses even Brother Xuanyuan…”

“Hmm?”

Mo Rubin was about to mock him, but suddenly recalled the level of formation mastery the Holy Emperor had displayed in their previous clash.

The words he was about to say were swallowed back.

“Within the core hub of the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation, it might be possible to try,” Mo Rubin said.

His gaze moved away from the rift opening in the Dark Sea and turned elsewhere.

Following his gaze, Li Ping said with some admiration, “This formation is indeed extremely mysterious. I consider my formation attainments to be quite high, yet within this darkness I cannot perceive even the slightest trace of formation patterns.”

“That is the effect of the True Immortal corpse,” Mo Rubin bluntly pointed out Li Ping’s mistake. “Without the diffused power of the True Immortal remains, you should be able to.”

The Holy Emperor fell silent.

“Follow me.”

Mo Rubin called out, then after roughly determining the direction, his figure turned into a black line and disappeared into the darkness.

Li Ping followed closely behind.

As they drew closer to the so called core of the Dark Sea, for some unknown reason, a sense of unease suddenly arose in Li Ping’s heart.

Some vague images even flashed through his mind.

Among them was the scene of Mo Rubin reduced to a mere shell, lying quietly within the Dark Sea.

“Wait!”

A chill ran through him, and Li Ping called out to stop Mo Rubin.

“Hm?” Though somewhat dissatisfied, Mo Rubin still paused.

“You had better truly have a reason.”

Ignoring his attitude, Li Ping thought for a moment and then asked, “What kind of power could kill you instantly?”

As if he had heard a very amusing joke, one face after another flew out from Mo Rubin’s body, gathering before Li Ping and shouting noisily.

“Kill me instantly? As long as the demonic heart is not extinguished and the immortal body does not perish, as long as even one personality remains, I will not truly die!”

“Even a True Immortal…”

“A True Immortal should be able to.”

Mo Rubin’s main body suddenly spoke, and all the noisy faces instantly fell silent.

“In fact, with Brother Xuanyuan’s strength, if he struck with preparation against an unprepared target, he could also achieve it.”

Mo Rubin’s main body analyzed calmly.

“I feel that the formation hub ahead is somewhat problematic.”

After hearing Mo Rubin’s conclusion, Li Ping directly voiced his concern. Unexpectedly, Mo Rubin did not refute him this time.

Instead, he said something seemingly unrelated. “The entire Dark Sea is built upon the corpse of a True Immortal.”

“In our era, this place was far less vast than it is now. It seems that over the years, the Great Celestial Venerable bloodline has multiplied quite well.”

“Although recently there is a slight decline, it does not affect the overall situation.”

“Spirit Gathering Ascension, Ascension Gathering Spirit. In fact, this place can also be seen as a masterless True Immortal body that has cultivated on its own for nearly ten thousand years. Inside, it is filled entirely with pure True Immortal power.”

“However, this True Immortal power is cultivated based on the remains of a True Immortal. So in theory, only that deceased True Immortal can use it.”

“In theory.” Mo Rubin repeated the words.

“But there are countless mysterious techniques in this world. Who knows, there might be some method that can break this limitation.”

The Faceless Holy Emperor gazed at the boundless Dark Sea. “Such immense energy. If it could be controlled, it might instantly unleash power comparable to a True Immortal.”

“A child lifting a cauldron will only be crushed to death by it.” Mo Rubin shattered Li Ping’s fantasy.

Chapter 1278: The Will To Survive At The End Of The World

“I’m more afraid that the remains of that True Immortal… might come back to life.”

As Mo Rubin spoke these words, Li Ping was not sure if it was just his imagination, but the depths of this Dark Sea seemed to grow even colder.

It was as if some unknown existence had suddenly fixed its gaze upon him, and a chill rose abruptly in his heart.

The Holy Emperor carefully looked around, but he did not discover any hidden watcher.

Turning his gaze once more to the body of Fang Dingge from the Grand Dao Sect, Li Ping asked, “It has already become like this, can it still come back to life?”

Li Ping was naturally not referring to Fang Dingge, but to that True Immortal whose immortal body had transformed into the Dark Sea and whose will had become the Fallen Immortal Realm.

Mo Rubin also examined the corpse not far away and said softly, “Let me tell you a story.”

“Our Nine Refinements Temple once enshrined a statue of our ancestor. It is said that it was personally crafted by the founding ancestor, Master Miaofa, for himself.”

“This stone statue was worshipped for thousands of years. Whenever disciples encountered doubts on the path of cultivation, as long as they prayed sincerely, most would receive a response from the unseen. Thus, for many years, the incense offerings never ceased.”

“Then one day, tribulation clouds suddenly gathered above the Nine Refinements Temple. Divine lightning struck repeatedly, but the target was that ancestor statue. A figure broke out from the statue and shot straight into the heavens. His strength was terrifying. Even the Nine Heavens Divine Lightning, capable of instantly killing Dao Integration cultivators, could not harm him at all. He laughed wildly within the lightning, about to withstand the tribulation and ascend…”

At the crucial point, Mo Rubin paused again.

After waiting for a long time without hearing the Holy Emperor urge him on, he could only continue, “The fragments of the ancestor statue that had scattered all over the ground unexpectedly gathered together again. They approached the one undergoing tribulation. Taking advantage of his unpreparedness, they swallowed him back into the statue.”

“From then on, no matter how he struggled, he could not escape the statue’s confinement. The statue then ascended together with that figure!”

After hearing this rather mysterious story, Li Ping frowned slightly.

Mo Rubin asked, “Guess, among the two who ascended together, which one was the ancestor of our Nine Refinements Temple?”

Li Ping pondered briefly and replied, “The figure inside the statue had to face the ascension tribulation. It should be him. Failing to ascend in life, he used the statue form, received worship for thousands of years, accumulated power, and attempted ascension…”

Mo Rubin smiled faintly. “Wrong.”

“Our ancestor, Master Miaofa, has clear records of ascending to immortality before countless witnesses. However, what only the successive heads of the Nine Refinements Temple know is that in the second year after entering the Immortal Realm, he died for unknown reasons.”

Li Ping was stunned upon hearing this.

Mo Rubin continued with satisfaction, “However, the statue he personally created contained a backup plan he left behind. Even if his soul was destroyed in the upper realm, he could be reborn through that statue.”

Li Ping frowned again. “Then who was the figure inside the statue?”

Mo Rubin chuckled. “He was the third head of our Nine Refinements Temple. He disobeyed the ancestor’s instructions and tried to establish new rules. After internal conflict, he was severely injured and disappeared. Who would have thought he had been hiding inside the ancestor statue all along, even cultivating to the level of ascension in one stroke.”

“In the end, he merely made a wedding garment for another.”

“Master Miaofa had only ascended for a year and had no deep foundation, yet he could still revive through the statue. Let alone that True Immortal.”

“Just look at this Dark Sea. You can imagine how powerful it was in life. In truth, do not use the perspective of cultivators to speculate about the methods of Immortals. The difference is like heaven and earth.”

Perhaps because they had been talking for some time, Mo Rubin’s emotions had stabilized considerably as he spoke.

Li Ping remained silent.

He felt that Mo Rubin’s account of Master Miaofa’s revival through the statue and the involvement of the third head contained some inaccuracies.

However, this was an ancient secret, and they were deep in a dangerous place. It was not the time to investigate further.

“Should we continue deeper? The way Fang Dingge died does not seem like something an ordinary cultivator could accomplish,” Li Ping changed the subject.

“Let us go in and take a look. If the True Immortal has revived, after so many years, it would not still remain in place,” Mo Rubin said as he bypassed Fang Dingge’s remains and continued descending into the darkness.

They passed through three layers of formation barriers, some originally part of the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation and others set up later.

With the combined efforts of Li Ping and Mo Rubin, after considerable effort, they finally reached the control core of the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation.

Along the way, they did not find the remains of the other four fallen Longevity Immortals.

The control core, though located at the deepest part of the Dark Sea, resembled a transparent observation platform.

Through the surrounding formation barriers, which were like panoramic glass, Li Ping and Mo Rubin could clearly see the entirety of the Dark Sea.

Even after being magnified countless times, the Dark Sea still clearly resembled the outline of a human form.

Mo Rubin was clearly not here for the first time. He was not distracted by the magnificent sight and instead walked to the center of the platform.

His expression changed slightly.

“One piece of good news and one piece of bad news. Which do you want to hear first?” Mo Rubin asked.

After a brief silence, Li Ping replied, “The good news first.”

“The good news is that the fallen True Immortal did not revive through its remains,” Mo Rubin said in a low voice.

“And the bad news?”

Mo Rubin let out a cold laugh. “You will know when you see it.”

Li Ping stepped forward and came to Mo Rubin’s side.

The scene before him suddenly changed. The lofty observation platform seemed to be falling rapidly.

The Dark Sea below rushed closer, enlarging quickly. In an instant, it filled his vision and penetrated deep into his soul.

Boom.

The surroundings changed again. It seemed they had left the Dark Sea and arrived at an entirely unknown place.

“Do not move.”

Mo Rubin’s voice sounded within his mind. Li Ping felt slightly reassured and looked around.

He saw the other four fallen Longevity Immortals.

They maintained their final postures from before death. Unlike Fang Dingge, their faces were covered with a gray layer, making their features unrecognizable.

It could only be vaguely seen that they had been desperately trying to resist a terrifying force that devoured them.

Li Ping attempted to find the culprit behind the deaths of these five Longevity Immortals.

From beneath the bodies of the four immortals, gray vine like substances extended, intertwining together, which caught Li Ping’s attention.

From his observation, these gray vines had no life aura at all. They were merely lifeless aggregates of pure energy.

Yet for some reason, when facing them, Li Ping felt as if he were being stared at by a venomous snake.

“What is this?” Li Ping asked without hesitation.

After a long pause, Mo Rubin slowly answered, “This is the will to survive. The will to survive of the True Immortal’s remains.”

“The will to survive?” Li Ping carefully contemplated the meaning of these words.

“True Immortals cannot be judged by ordinary logic. Back when Brother Xuanyuan modified the True Immortal’s remains, he already had such concerns. To prevent it from reviving, he made many additional arrangements. Yet unexpectedly…”

Although Li Ping could not see Mo Rubin’s figure, he could sense that he was staring intently at the gray “will to survive” spread throughout the area.

“Under normal circumstances, a True Immortal’s remains that have already turned into the Dark Sea should not be able to give rise to such a strong will to survive.”

Hearing Mo Rubin’s words, Li Ping also fell into thought. “Unless someone deliberately triggered it.”

“Correct. That person is not simple,” Mo Rubin commented.

“First, being able to break the restrictions left by Brother Xuanyuan is not simple. Second, being able to stir the will of a True Immortal’s remains is not simple. Third, after triggering the will to survive, still being able to retreat unscathed… remarkable.” Mo Rubin praised without any tone of admiration.

“Do not underestimate these things. Even you and I, if we are carelessly targeted by them, would likely find it hard to escape death. We would end up just like these five empty shells.”

Li Ping frowned slightly. He still had some confidence in his own strength.

Mo Rubin did not argue with him and continued explaining in a low voice, “A person who has already died, yet their will to survive is reignited. It is like grasping the final straw, bursting out with power in an instant…”

“Instinctively devouring all nearby life it can touch and converting it into nourishment for its own revival. Only someone at Brother Xuanyuan’s level can barely resist it. Though you and I may appear strong, we are still far behind.”

Li Ping remained silent.

Mo Rubin continued, “Fortunately, the one who triggered it did not destroy Brother Xuanyuan’s arrangements. After this ‘will to survive’ drained those four Longevity cultivators, it could no longer find any target to absorb, and thus fell back into silence.”

“If it were to escape from the Dark Sea…”

“I am afraid the entire Xuanhuang Realm would become its meal.” Li Ping immediately became extremely solemn.

“But then again, Brother Xuanyuan’s methods are not so easily broken. That person who triggered it, the one you called the Immortal Ancestor, did not directly destroy the restrictions of the Dark Sea. He did not even alter them, but instead added his own methods on top.”

“However… possessing a formation control artifact and being thoroughly familiar with the restrictions here, he can move freely.” Mo Rubin seemed to think of something, and the aura he had condensed suddenly became unstable.

“Let us work first.” Just as Li Ping was worried that Mo Rubin might lose control and descend into madness, he instantly calmed down again.

He transmitted a large amount of information into Li Ping’s mind.

“This is… the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation?” Li Ping immediately recognized its essence.

“Strictly speaking, it is a modified version by Brother Xuanyuan. The original Ascension Formation was created by a demonic cultivator. Heh, this one was a true peerless fiend. He was born of humble origins and had poor cultivation aptitude, reaching only the Golden Core stage at most. Yet he forcibly created this vicious formation. Wherever the formation covered, everything within would be refined into the purest energy.”

“He started from mortal small worlds, progressing from weak to strong, exterminating countless worlds’ living beings before finally ascending to the Immortal Realm. After arriving there, the first thing he did was improve the formation, intending to repeat his methods in the Immortal Realm. Hmph, even such a figure died like a fly during the Immortal Realm catastrophe. All his accumulated treasures ended up benefiting Brother Xuanyuan. However, Brother Xuanyuan was quite disdainful of his legacy…” Mo Rubin said with a cold laugh.

““Someone so violently enraged and brutally vicious… can still attain the Dao and become an immortal? Are the Immortal Tribulations in his world different from those of the Xuanhuang Realm?” Li Ping asked with a frown.

Because in Li Ping’s memory, in the Xuanhuang Realm, such vicious individuals would face heavenly tribulations dozens of times stronger than usual, with no chance of success.

“The heavenly tribulation, no matter how strong, has limits in the lower realms. As long as you surpass it, it is enough. Moreover, good and evil are not absolute…”

Li Ping could clearly feel that as Mo Rubin spoke, he once again fell into a confused state.

“What do you need me to do?” Li Ping timely shifted his attention.

“Your attainment in formations should not be much weaker than Brother Xuanyuan’s. The control core of the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation here must not be disturbed. If possible, reinforce it with another layer and push it deeper into the Dark Sea. Then sever the connection between the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s formation control artifact and this grand formation,” Mo Rubin said after regaining composure.

Li Ping nodded, observing the surrounding formation details while comparing them with the formation diagram in his mind.

“As expected of the Xuantian King, truly the most outstanding genius of the Xuanhuang Realm in ten thousand years.”

As a formation master himself, Li Ping could not help but feel a sense of mutual appreciation upon sensing the ingenuity of this formation.

The source power essence from the prayers of the You race was absorbed and transformed by the Dark Sea, that is, the remains of a True Immortal, and then gathered deep within the formation.

It appeared to accumulate without order, yet Li Ping faintly perceived that through certain means, all this power, capable of rivaling a True Immortal, could be unleashed instantly.

To push the Xuanhuang Realm to escape the control of the True Immortals in Immortal Ruins.

“To use a mortal formation to control the power of a True Immortal… remarkable.”

Li Ping did not find traces of the original world formation of the Xuanhuang Realm within this structure. This formation was likely created independently by the Xuantian King. Even the remains of a fallen True Immortal were utilized, demonstrating Xuanyuan Hong’s extraordinary mastery of formations.

“To reinforce the formation, some materials are needed,” Li Ping said after observing for a while.

“I have them,” Mo Rubin replied immediately.

As if prepared in advance, after they returned from the hiding place of the “will to survive” to the formation core, he took out a pile of materials.

Li Ping checked them. They were all exactly what was needed to reinforce the formation.

“Do not look at me like that. I am even borrowing your face.”

“As a Dharma King of the Xuantian Sect, even while fleeing in haste, carrying resources to make a comeback is perfectly normal, right?”

“By the way, why are you also faceless? Could it be related to that True Immortal who saved Brother Xuanyuan back then? I am timid, do not scare me…”

Li Ping ignored Mo Rubin’s ramblings and focused on setting up the formation.

With the Xuantian King’s prior work as a reference, Li Ping only needed to follow the pattern. It was not difficult for him.

As the formation gradually took shape, the “watchtower” where they stood seemed to rise higher.

Mo Rubin nodded in satisfaction. After Li Ping finished, he took out another batch of materials.

“Go deeper. Completely suppress the True Immortal’s ‘Will To Survive’ in the depths of the Dark Sea.”

Li Ping also agreed with this view. Without any complaints, he continued working.

After the materials were exhausted, the scene of the Dark Sea in their field of vision had already shrunk to only half of what it was when they first saw it.

“If that is the case, it should be safe enough. As long as no one deliberately disturbs it.” Mo Rubin stood beside Li Ping, looking at the Dark Sea below, and spoke softly.

“This concerns the safety of the Xuanhuang Realm. It is better to be extra cautious.” This was not asking for Mo Rubin’s opinion, but informing him of a decision already made. “I will set up additional protective formations here.”

Mo Rubin shrugged. “Do as you like. After all these years, no one has come to this cursed place except us. Who are you even guarding against with your formations? If that will to survive truly breaks free from its cage, your little formations will not be worth mentioning.”

Li Ping ignored Mo Rubin’s mockery and, with utmost seriousness, added the strongest sealing formation he could currently deploy.

“Alright, next is to cut off the hand extended by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance,” Mo Rubin urged after Li Ping finished.

“The dark power being extracted right now is limited. But if the Dark Sea shrinks to a certain extent, the Will to Survive might sense the vibrant vitality of the Xuanhuang Realm outside. If that happens, the consequences would be unimaginable.”

While reinforcing the formation here, Li Ping had already noticed that within the formation core, there were two thread like connections extending outward, intermittent and faint.

Their destinations were unknown.

“Both formation controlling artifacts, cut off their connection to the core?” Li Ping looked at Mo Rubin.

“The other one is most likely already dead. Cutting it off is fine.” Mo Rubin fell silent for a moment, then nodded.

Li Ping immediately modified the formation core.

The process went very smoothly. The Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation let out a soft hum, then seemed to restart.

It dimmed briefly, then grew bright again.

Standing at the formation core, Li Ping sensed the opening that the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had cut into the Dark Sea.

Boom. Boom.

Cloud masses churned, stirring up waves of invisible force. They swept up the drifting “clouds” within the Dark Sea, growing larger and larger. By the time they reached the torn wound, they had already turned into a heaven shaking tidal wave.

It slammed fiercely against the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s device.

Dozens of Immortal Alliance cultivators, who had been diligently supervising the extraction of Dark power, were silently swallowed.

They vanished from the world without a trace.

Amid the violent tremors, the rift also began to close.

Facing this sudden change, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance was unwilling to give up. Within the nearly closed rift, the eye type formation controlling artifact appeared once again.

The golden abacus flickered rapidly, attempting to turn the tide.

However, this time it could no longer produce any effect. It could only watch helplessly as the rift of the Dark Sea healed.

Everything settled.

Li Ping and Mo Rubin both watched this scene in silence.

Although it had taken quite some effort, they had finally cut off the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s attempt to extract dark power. At the same time, he had also learned many secrets of the ancient Xuantian Sect.

Li Ping felt a deep calm in his heart. He could sense that his connection with the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm had grown even closer.

However, he was also very clear that being able to so easily mobilize the power of the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation was not only due to his own attainment in formations. A greater part of it was thanks to Mo Rubin’s assistance.

Without the formation diagrams transmitted by him, breaking the restrictions left behind by the Xuantian King would not have been possible in a short time.

More importantly, there was the demonic face that Mo Rubin had split off and attached to Li Ping’s face.

It was precisely because of this face that they could move freely at the deepest part of the Dark Sea. Even when altering the key structure of the formation, they did not suffer any attack or backlash from the grand formation.

In a certain sense, the authority of Mo Rubin’s face was far higher than that of the two eye type formation controlling artifacts.

“Back then, among the Twelve Dharma Kings of the Xuantian Sect, where did your strength rank?” Li Ping suddenly asked.

Mo Rubin was slightly stunned.

Then he sneered. “To be honest, among the twelve, my strength was the weakest. You may barely defeat me, but you would not be able to win against the others.”

Li Ping naturally did not believe him.

Mo Rubin snorted coldly. “In our era, geniuses emerged in great numbers. Peerless talents were as numerous as fish crossing a river. It was an undeniable golden age of cultivation.”

“If the path to immortality had not suddenly been severed, it would not have been impossible for a large number of ascenders to appear within a short time.”

Li Ping fell silent.

According to the records of the Genesis Stone Tablet, all information related to those who ascended to immortality had been erased, so he had no way to judge the truth of Mo Rubin’s words.

However, judging from the performances of the Twelve Dharma Kings before they joined the Xuantian Sect, Mo Rubin’s words might be somewhat exaggerated, but they were not without basis.

“You were all so strong. How did the Ten Great Immortal Sects win back then?”

“Even without the Xuantian King, with the twelve of you joining forces, it should have been difficult for the Ten Great Immortal Sects to defeat you, right?” Li Ping asked the question that had been weighing on his mind for a long time.

“Hmph.” Mo Rubin simply let out a cold snort.

After a long silence, he finally spoke somewhat vaguely. “In any case, a loss is a loss. I will not deny it. Those people from the Ten Great Immortal Sects were not useless either.”

“And moreover…”

Mo Rubin’s tone suddenly turned extremely cold.

“Someone turned a fake act into reality and suddenly defected. Without knowing who the traitor was, none of us dared to trust anyone. On top of that, Brother Xuanyuan disappeared without reason…”

“One by one, we all claimed that our talent was no less than Xuanyuan Hong, saying we only lacked luck and failed to ascend at the right time. But when the real moment came, we realized that without Brother Xuanyuan leading us, we were nothing more than a mob.”

“On the other hand, the Ten Great Immortal Sects truly fought with their lives, because they knew that if they failed, death awaited them.”

“…”

Mo Rubin suddenly laughed. “But now I have come to terms with it. As the saying goes, the Heavenly Dao repays in kind. Did not those Ten Great Immortal Sects also get destroyed by this so called Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance? Hahaha! They deserved to die!”

“Well done, Xuanhuang Realm!”

Mo Rubin patted Li Ping on the shoulder in praise.

“In truth, the core figures of the Ten Great Immortal Sects are probably still alive,” Li Ping suddenly said.

“They have merely withdrawn from the world and remain hidden.”

Mo Rubin’s hand gripping Li Ping’s shoulder suddenly tightened.

“Hmph, hmph…” Upon suddenly hearing this news, not only did Mo Rubin not become enraged, he instead began laughing more and more wildly.

“So they are not dead? Even better.”

“This way, I can take revenge with my own hands. After so many years, they should not be as united as they were back then.”

Mo Rubin flashed away from Li Ping’s side, his figure suddenly dimming considerably.

“It is time to leave.”

“I originally planned to look for Brother Xuanyuan, but by a twist of fate I ended up here first. That is fine. At least I have ruled out one wrong answer.”

Li Ping felt that the demonic mask on his blank face was about to detach.

The surrounding darkness surged in uncontrollably.

Whispers from the depths of his soul echoed, eroding his consciousness.

Knowing this was no place to linger, Li Ping followed Mo Rubin as they returned from the deepest part of this Sea of Darkness.

“By the way, where was your original destination? You even needed to use that immortal artifact command flag?” Li Ping asked.

Mo Rubin remained silent.

As they passed the void shell of Fang Dingge, the Sect Master of the Grand Dao Sect, he suddenly said to Li Ping, “Go search his body. You might find some treasures.”

Li Ping looked at Mo Rubin.

Mo Rubin rolled his eyes. “This man resisted the devouring will to survive and managed to flee all the way here before dying. That alone proves his strength. Experts always carry good things. Brother Xuanyuan taught me that.”

“And if anything on his body managed to survive the erosion of a True Immortal’s will to survive, it must be an extraordinary treasure. Are you really not going to try?” Mo Rubin tempted him.

Li Ping glanced again, but ultimately shook his head slightly.

“The dead are gone. Let him rest here. There are countless treasures in the world. Must we gather them all? Greed clouds the heart and invites disaster.”

“Call you foolish, and you truly are foolish,” Mo Rubin sneered.

However, he also did not loot Fang Dingge’s corpse and simply left it lying there in silence.

After traveling for some time, the two returned to where they had come from.

The white jade flagpole was still planted in place.

However, eroded by the power of darkness, the area covered by its radiance had shrunk noticeably.

“As expected of a refurbished second hand item. Truly useless,” Mo Rubin criticized mercilessly.

“Because of your interference, I now have to go find the other arrangements I left behind back then. Who knows if they still exist after so many years. If not, I will come back to trouble you!” Mo Rubin said coldly as he looked at Li Ping.

Li Ping summoned the You Clansmen and reopened the gateway leading outside.

“I can help you search for Xuantian King.”

“I need his help,” Li Ping said sincerely.

Mo Rubin entered the passage first, laughing loudly. “Do you really think that just because we walked through the Dark Sea together, I will completely trust you?”

“Back then, the other eleven brothers and sisters all went through life and death together.”

“Reality taught me that no one can be fully trusted!”

Mo Rubin’s icy voice gradually faded.

By the time Li Ping returned to Nine Mountains Prefecture, there was no longer any trace of Mo Rubin.

However, the Holy Emperor did not pursue him further.

This Dharma King of the Xuantian Sect was not his enemy.

Chapter 1279: Dao Integration Ants Must Die

Leaving aside the character of Mo Rubin and the others from the Xuantian Sect, they are ultimately cultivators born and raised in the Xuanhuang Realm.

The main contradiction within the Xuanhuang Realm now lies in the struggle for sovereignty between the native cultivators of the Xuanhuang Realm and the cultivators from foreign cultivation worlds who were devoured for various reasons since the great catastrophe of the Immortal Realm.

The key to resolving this contradiction lies in two individuals, the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor.

“As for Mo Rubin, he might even lend a hand at a critical moment. And as for the Xuantian King…”

Based on current clues, the goal of Xuantian King Xuanyuan Hong aligns with that of Li Ping, both aiming to save the Xuanhuang Realm from crisis. If he is truly not dead, Li Ping would not mind returning the position of Xuanhuang Celestial Venerable to him.

This journey with Mo Rubin brought Li Ping significant gains. Aside from unexpectedly mastering an Immortal level formation, the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation, more importantly, he cut off the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s covert attempt to draw power from the Dark Sea.

Without the formation controlling artifact, relying only on the strength currently displayed by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, it is absolutely impossible for them to manipulate the Dark Sea again. Although the purpose behind stealing the power of darkness remains unclear, this action undoubtedly destroyed one of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s hidden trump cards.

As for deepening his connection with the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm, it now seemed to be an optional improvement for Li Ping.

After returning to the Holy Dynasty Great Qi, Li Ping first went to the treasury. He ordered Cat Treasure to once again use the original Binding Space Ring to complete replication, ensuring that every treasure existed in triplicate.

Only then did the Holy Emperor return to his throne and sit in contemplation.

“Although I previously knew that many Dharma Kings of the Xuantian Sect are still slumbering throughout the Xuanhuang Realm, I did not have a precise measure of their strength. Mo Rubin claimed he is the weakest among the twelve…”

“Even if exaggerated, the strength of the Dharma Kings is indeed terrifying. After all, they possess the legacy of the Immortal Realm.”

“The Xuantian Sect inherited the legacy of the Immortal Realm. The Ten Great Immortal Sects inherited the teachings of the Heavenly Capital Grand Mage, and when they destroyed the Xuantian Sect, they must have also seized many treasures. As for the Immortal Ancestor…”

“Even the Taishang Sect’s highest cultivation scripture, the Supreme Primordial True Scripture, was forcibly taken by him. Many treasures of the Ten Great Immortal Sects must now be in his possession. Not to mention the Tianxuan Mirror, a supreme treasure that even the Ten Great Immortal Sects could not find, yet is under his control. His strength surpasses even that of the Xuantian Sect’s Dharma Kings.”

A question arose before the Holy Emperor.

If the Immortal Ancestor is forced out, a battle is inevitable.

Though vast, the Xuanhuang Realm cannot withstand their devastation. Moreover, too many strange and dangerous existences lie hidden within it, such as the True Immortal’ “Will to Survive” in the depths of the Dark Sea.

If their battle were to disturb such existences, then there would be no need to argue about orthodoxy. Whether the Xuanhuang Realm could even survive would become uncertain.

“The decisive battle must take place in the outer void beyond the Xuanhuang Realm,” Li Ping thought.

He believed that in this matter, the Immortal Ancestor would agree. After all, having painstakingly maintained the world for thousands of years, he would not wish to see it destroyed.

Li Ping bore no particular malice toward him. It was simply a difference in position.

“It seems I must personally travel to the outer void to familiarize myself with the battlefield environment.”

However, before that, Li Ping focused his attention on the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation.

This formation shares similarities with the Myriad Realms All-Spirits Refining Formation. After improvements by the Xuantian King, its bloody and violent nature had been greatly reduced, making it acceptable to Li Ping.

The Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation can extract matter and convert it into transcendent immortal power.

The Myriad Realms All-Spirits Refining Formation can fuse consciousness into a force capable of resisting a True Immortal.

If the two are combined…

“It may solve the issue of insufficient source power essence.”

“Although limited by materials, the effectiveness of the Ascension Formation will be reduced, it should not be difficult to condense power equal in level to source power essence.”

The Holy Emperor immediately began deducing.

Formation structures decomposed and recombined within his mind. A new formation was slowly taking shape.

Meanwhile, someone else had already deduced this formation ahead of him.

Beneath the Dark Sea, under constant threat of death, the connection between the Holy Emperor’s clone and Li Fan’s true body grew closer.

Especially after Mo Rubin placed that demonic mask on the Holy Emperor, the images perceived by Li Fan became clearer than ever.

Thus, Li Fan had complete knowledge of their actions.

Within the Derivation Law Jade space, Li Fan looked at the results reported by the simulated personality of the Final Dissociation Disc, a strange light flashing in his eyes.

“The Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation is powerful, but its efficiency in extracting energy is too low. Even refining an entire world into nothing yields only a small amount of immortal power. But if combined with the Myriad Realms All-Spirits Refining Formation…”

“It achieves perfect utilization. Matter converts into energy, and divine sense fuses and ascends. Remarkable.”

Li Fan rapidly deduced in his mind.

“If I had used this formation earlier to sacrifice the beings of multiple small worlds…”

“I could have delayed the Faceless True Immortal three times longer.”

“Moreover, with this formation, I will no longer need to rely so heavily on the You race.”

Regardless of his opinion of Mo Rubin, Li Fan took his warnings seriously.

“Immortal Power of the Mortal Dust brings more harm than benefit,” and “do not become a True Immortal unless absolutely necessary,” remained deeply imprinted in his mind.

As for their grudges, they could be settled in a future life.

Li Fan suppressed the rising thoughts and refocused on the newly formed formation.

The simulated personality of the Final Dissociation Disc was waiting for him to name it.

“All things in the world, whether living beings or spiritual qi, originate from chaotic nothingness.”

“Under this formation, all things return to their primordial state.”

“The formation shall be called [Primordial Spiritual Void Formation].”

As the thought formed, a chaotic yellow light enveloped the Final Dissociation Disc.

This name drew inspiration from the Immortal level formation Primordial Mystic Spirit.

Though similar in name, their power was incomparable.

Yet Li Fan was confident that through continuous reincarnation and refinement, one day this formation would rival it.

“This formation is too extreme. The Holy Emperor’s clone may not think the same way.”

Li Fan continued analyzing.

This journey yielded immense gains.

The Immortal formation personally set by the Xuantian King provided vast data to the Final Dissociation Disc.

The True Immortal “Will to Survive” and the accumulated power of the Dark Sea also tempted Li Fan greatly.

Unlike others who live only once, he had endless time and opportunities for trial and error.

However, the prerequisite was simple.

He must survive.

“Mo Rubin may be detestable, but his words are reasonable.”

With ample time in seclusion, Li Fan continued to digest his gains.

Meanwhile, those capable of deciding the fate of the Xuanhuang Realm had undergone tremendous upheaval in just days.

Yet the countless living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm remained completely unaware.

The same was true within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

The Dark Sea was a highly classified matter, known only to a few Dharma-Transmitters, who were now gathered discussing countermeasures.

Among ordinary cultivators, the most discussed topic was the rainbow light communication from beyond the world.

It had been over three months since dozens of Dao Integration cultivators departed the Xuanhuang Realm within that rainbow light.

People originally believed they would never return or send news again.

Unexpectedly, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance possessed a method of long distance communication and occasionally released messages from the departed group.

Originally, this was impossible.

It was only made possible thanks to a sword light message transmitted from the depths of the star sea.

After analysis, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance successfully reproduced this communication technology and applied it to the Beyond Realm Rainbow Light.

Because of this, members of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance were fortunate enough to witness scenes beyond the Xuanhuang Realm.

“What is all this. Why is it completely pitch black?”

“Could it be that the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance is just fooling people. This looks no different from an ordinary spatial rift.”

“Where is the so-called other side of the star sea. Where is the Xuanshang Immortal Ark?”

“Good thing I did not choose to go at the time. Otherwise, staring at this every day would be unbearably boring.”

“Without reaching Dao Integration, one is not even qualified to board the Beyond Realm Rainbow Light. May I ask what your cultivation level is now, fellow daoist?”

“I have cultivated for less than a hundred years and have already entered the Golden Core Great Dao. Reaching Dao Integration should be easy for me.”

…

Regarding the images released by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance for unknown reasons, the vast majority of cultivators simply treated them as entertainment and casually commented on them.

However, some people were able to perceive certain clues from this fleeting glimpse.

Outside the Chizha Abyss, in the Broken Palm Immortal City.

Shang Shaojun had already watched these scenes of the outer void dozens of times.

Apart from the versions made public by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, he had also obtained some highly confidential versions through special channels.

Cold sweat formed on his forehead. His body staggered slightly as he withdrew from his contemplation.

“How do you feel, Shaojun?”

The one speaking was Diyi Jinglun.

He coughed lightly, looking at Shang Shaojun with an expression as if enjoying a show.

“The outer void is actually this dangerous. I consider myself quite strong, but if I were to encounter those calamities, I would likely not escape death,” Shang Shaojun said with lingering fear.

“It is fine, I am the same,” Diyi Jinglun said with a smile. “That is why I am becoming increasingly curious about the white robed sword immortal you mentioned.”

Diyi Jinglun withdrew his smile. “Not only can he safely traverse the void, he can also transmit such critical information from the other side of the star sea. Such an extraordinary genius, yet I have never heard of him before.”

Shang Shaojun also sighed. “Only after that day did I realize how many capable individuals exist in this world. I no longer dare to underestimate other heroes.”

“No, you have not understood what I mean,” Diyi Jinglun shook his head. “I mean that the appearance of such a person completely defies logic.”

Shang Shaojun was stunned.

Diyi Jinglun suddenly stood up, lightly waving his feather fan as he spoke slowly. “In the current era where techniques cannot be cultivated simultaneously, not only are cultivation methods strictly controlled, but even the resources required for advancement are constantly monitored by us.”

“Those rogue cultivators, even with heaven defying luck, can at most reach the Nascent Soul stage. To go further, they would inevitably fall into the sight of our Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance. Yet the white robed sword immortal you mentioned…”

“It is as if he appeared out of nowhere. No matter how we investigate, there is no trace of him.”

Shang Shaojun frowned slightly, somewhat unconvinced. “There are countless hidden forces in the Xuanhuang Realm. How could the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance possibly know them all?”

Diyi Jinglun lightly waved his fan again, and a projection of light appeared before them.

It showed the scene of Li Fan’s Holy Embryo displaying great power outside the Chizha Abyss, breaking the demonic sound with a single sword strike.

“How do you find this sword technique, Shaojun?” Diyi Jinglun asked.

“Exquisitely profound, as if born from nature,” Shang Shaojun replied without hesitation.

Chapter 1280: Secrets Of The Blue Feather In Heavenly Capital

Guan Xingxiu spoke eloquently within the flying vessel. At first he was somewhat stiff, but the more he spoke, the more confident he became, as if what he had comprehended were the natural laws of the star sea itself.

“The laws of the star sea can almost be regarded as a higher level substitute for the laws of the Xuanhuang Realm. Therefore, the key to our breakthrough is to find, within this silent and desolate star sea, the corresponding Star Sea Dao that matches our own path of cultivation. Since all of you have achieved Dao Integration, your aptitude cannot be weak. As long as you cast aside your inner fear of the star sea and instead approach it with a calm mind, just as you did in the Xuanhuang Realm, and quietly comprehend it, achieving this should not be too difficult.”

Guan Xingxiu went into detail about how he had sensed his own Star Sea Dao. Just as he was speaking with growing enthusiasm, an extremely anxious voice suddenly interrupted him.

It was Zimu among the survivors.

“Old Guan, suppose, I mean suppose, that within the star sea, the Dao corresponding to what I cultivate no longer exists. What should I do?”

Zimu stared tightly at Guan Xingxiu.

“Does that mean the path ahead is cut off and I can no longer advance?”

Guan Xingxiu fell silent.

The other Dao Integration cultivators present also showed different expressions upon hearing this.

Some turned pale, while others felt secretly relieved.

Because they too had discovered that, perhaps due to the various calamities that once destroyed the Immortal Realm, the laws of the star sea were shattered and incomplete.

It was not that their aptitude was insufficient and they could not sense their corresponding Star Sea Dao.

Rather, that Dao had already vanished from the star sea.

“Perhaps you can try sensing other laws. After all, all paths ultimately lead to the same destination.” Seeing despair beginning to spread, Guan Xingxiu thought for a moment and quickly offered a suggestion.

However, he was immediately refuted without mercy.

“That might work for those below Dao Integration or for cultivators from other worlds. But we Xuanhuang Dao Integration cultivators have already devoured the Spirit of Heaven and Earth and merged our bodies with the laws. Hmph, how could it be so easy to switch to another path?”

“In that case, among us, the one most likely to achieve the highest accomplishment is probably Brother Lan Yu,” a Dao Integration cultivator named Qingshuang suddenly remarked.

The flying vessel instantly fell into silence as everyone’s gaze turned toward Lan Yu.

Lan Yu himself did not deny it.

There was no need.

Because among all the Dao Integration cultivators present, and even within the entire Xuanhuang Realm, he was the most special.

He was the only one who had achieved Dao Integration through the ancient method.

He was not bound to the principles of the Xuanhuang world, which meant that within this silent star sea, any law could be used by him for comprehension and breakthrough.

“I say, Brother Lan Yu, the reason you have not broken through yet is not because you have too many choices and cannot decide, right?”

“Congratulations in advance, Fellow Daoist Lan!”

“Sigh, the new method. Sigh, Heavenly Sovereign.”

For a time, everyone reacted differently.

Lan Yu’s expression remained serious as he casually responded, but inwardly he was puzzled.

Because he had not sensed any Star Sea Dao within the void.

“Could it be that my aptitude is truly this poor, or that I am too old and have already lost all spiritual sensitivity?”

Lan Yu was momentarily dazed.

“Oh, I seem to remember now.”

“I, Wu Fuqiu, never really had much aptitude.”

Lan Yu froze slightly as his thoughts seemed to return to his youth.

At that time, the Immortal Dao was flourishing and the Ten Great Immortal Sects stood tall. He was merely one of countless ordinary cultivators under their rule. His talent was mediocre, and he had no remarkable encounters. The Golden Core realm should have been his limit.

But one day, a moment of curiosity completely changed his fate.

“Fellow Daoist, what is happening ahead with such a grand display?” Wu Fuqiu asked curiously as he looked at the sealed air route ahead and the massive flying boats, each as large as a city, passing overhead one after another.

“Shh, keep your voice down. If you disturb the Ten Great Immortal Sects’ Ceremony of Honoring the Master, you might not even know how you die.”

The fear and reverence in others’ eyes only made Wu Fuqiu more curious.

After half a day, the vast procession of the Ten Great Immortal Sects finally passed, and the air route reopened.

Yet Wu Fuqiu continued to gaze in the direction they had gone, unwilling to leave.

After making inquiries, he learned that this Ceremony of Honoring the Master was a grand event held once every hundred years by the Ten Great Immortal Sects to express gratitude to the Grand Mage of Heavenly Capital for imparting the Dao. Important figures from all ten sects would attend.

Wu Fuqiu did not know who the Grand Mage of Heavenly Capital was.

But even as a wandering cultivator from the wilderness, he had long heard of the immense prestige of the Ten Great Immortal Sects.

“If the Ten Great Immortal Sects are already so powerful, just how formidable must the one who imparted the Dao to them be?”

“If I could somehow gain his favor…”

Wu Fuqiu’s mind trembled, and for the first time, an unprecedented ambition arose in his heart.

After repeated deliberation, he ultimately could not rid himself of this obsession.

He set out toward the legendary Heavenly Capital.

After enduring countless hardships to reach its outskirts, his hopes were instantly shattered.

Heavenly Capital itself could not be seen. Only a Source Dao Palace stood among the mountains, faintly visible within the clouds.

At the foot of the mountain were countless young cultivators like him, who had come across great distances seeking opportunities.

Wu Fuqiu was confused.

He knew that Heavenly Capital was the residence of the Grand Mage. But what was this Source Dao Palace?

“You do not even know the Source Dao Palace? Where did this bumpkin come from? The source of all methods, the origin of all paths. Even direct disciples of the Ten Great Immortal Sects must queue obediently here.”

“Think carefully. Who is the Grand Mage? How could someone like him be easily seen by mortals like you? If you want to behold his presence, you must first enter the Source Dao Palace and pray devoutly. If you catch his attention, he will naturally guide you to Heavenly Capital.”

“What, you want to go in as well? Easy. Pay one thousand high grade spirit stones and you can go queue over there.”

Wu Fuqiu was pushed out by the crowd, his mind in disarray.

One thousand high grade spirit stones was enough to purchase a decent Nascent Soul technique. If he had that much wealth, why would he have traveled thousands of miles just to seek an opportunity?

Although he was poor, Wu Fuqiu did not intend to leave.

Because he discovered that there were many others like him who could not afford the fee and thus could not ascend the mountain.

After spending half a month befriending them, he learned an important piece of information.

The so called Source Dao Palace had actually been built later by the Ten Great Immortal Sects and had no real connection to Tiandu.

The true land of the Source Dao referred to this vast region beneath Heavenly Capital. The Ten Great Immortal Sects had simply enclosed a large portion of it and constructed the palace.

However, they had not gone too far and had left a section at the mountain’s base.

“The Grand Mage has not appeared for who knows how many years. They say it is easier to catch his attention on the mountain, but that is just for comfort.”

“Exactly. The Grand Mage stands high above in the heavens. In his eyes, what difference is there between the mountain top and the mountain base?”

Listening to these words, Wu Fuqiu settled down at the foot of the Source Dao Palace.

This stay lasted twenty years.

Some people arrived, others left. Some died with regret. Some, filled with resentment, cursed the Grand Mage and were beaten to death.

Wu Fuqiu also aged from a young man into a middle aged man.

He did not know what had allowed him to persist here all this time.

Perhaps for someone as mediocre as him, it made no difference where he went.

During these years, while he waited, he did not neglect his cultivation. However, without a source of spirit stones, he could only consume his reserves. Although the land of the Source Dao was rich in spiritual qi, it could not sustain so many cultivators drawing from it at once.

Not only did he fail to make progress, he even began to regress.

At this point, Wu Fuqiu had accepted his fate and no longer held unrealistic hopes.

After all, he had been an orphan since childhood, drifting without support. Having stayed at the foot of the Source Dao Palace for over twenty years, he had grown accustomed to the surroundings and vaguely regarded this place as his home.

Whenever young people arrived full of hope, praying for the Grand Mage’s blessing, he would only smile without saying a word.

It was as if he saw his former self.

However, he did not expose the illusions of these young people.

Because anyone who did so would be completely eliminated by the people of the Ten Great Immortal Sects.

Yet the strange and wondrous nature of the world lay precisely in this.

Just when Wu Fuqiu had already cast aside the thought of the Great Mage’s blessing…

On this day, a boundless seven colored radiance suddenly bloomed across the sky.

Beneath the Source Dao Palace, tens of thousands of cultivators were stunned on the spot.

No one knew who shouted first, the Great Mage has manifested.

Then, in overwhelming excitement and fear, a dense crowd of cultivators knelt across the ground.

Only Wu Fuqiu stood there blankly, his mind completely empty.

“How dare you show disrespect to the Great Mage!”

A streak of sword light, accompanied by an angry shout, flew in from afar.

Just as Wu Fuqiu was about to be beheaded, a blue feather slowly drifted down from the sky.

The white sword light struck first, incomparably fast.

The blue feather descended later, swaying gently and moving extremely slowly.

Yet a strange scene occurred. Before everyone’s eyes, the blue feather actually arrived first and landed on Wu Fuqiu.

The sword light arrived a moment later, but did not sever Wu Fuqiu’s head. Instead, it passed through his body and instantly killed the three kneeling cultivators behind him.

As for Wu Fuqiu himself…

Bathed in the blue feather’s glow, he slowly rose into the air, beyond his control.

Amid the cries of the crowd, he ascended continuously.

Passing over the mountain peak and the Source Dao Palace, piercing through the clouds, he arrived in an instant before a purple gold Dao arena.

Wu Fuqiu felt as if he were in a dream. Only after standing there for a long time did he come back to his senses.

His body trembled with excitement, so much so that he even forgot proper etiquette and pushed the door open directly.

Unlike the sacred Heavenly Capital he had imagined, this place was completely empty.

Silent and lifeless.

Only faint chanting could be heard from within.

Following the direction of the sound, Wu Fuqiu cautiously made his way to the deepest part of the Dao arena.

A simple and ancient purple gold wooden building emitted a faint fragrance.

Wu Fuqiu knelt and paid his respects. After waiting a long time without any response, he gathered his courage and pushed the door open.

The scene inside came into view.

A vague figure sat cross legged, murmuring continuously.

Behind him stood a child in a blue and white Dao robe, eyes closed.

The child had red lips and white teeth, with delicate features, making it impossible to tell whether they were male or female.

However, Wu Fuqiu noticed that the child seemed to have fought someone before. The Dao robe was slightly damaged, with faint traces of blood on it.

Wu Fuqiu did not dare act rashly and once again kowtowed.

But neither the figure nor the child gave any response.

“That figure should be the Great Mage of Heavenly Capital.”

After a long while, Wu Fuqiu gathered his courage, stood up, and imitated the figure, sitting cross legged.

He carefully listened to the continuous chanting.

Gradually, it seemed as if he understood something.

The blue feather that had previously vanished into his body suddenly appeared within his dantian.

“Feather Transformation Technique.”

“Across endless epochs of heaven and earth, countless worlds are born and perish, like feathers drifting in the void.

“Transform the body into a feather, resonate with the world, drift through cycles of life and death, cross calamities, and achieve eternal transcendence.”

Wu Fuqiu listened in a trance, at times frowning, at times filled with joy.

This Myriad Calamities Feather Transformation Technique was far too profound for him, a mere Foundation Establishment cultivator.

Yet even glimpsing a fragment of it brought enlightenment, and his cultivation rose continuously.
