Chapter 1281: Reunion In The Star Sea

A large number of Dao Integration corpses drifted chaotically, like kites pulled by invisible strings. The expressions on their faces still retained the joy of having just escaped disaster.

“Damn it…”

Looking at these faces that had been alive just moments ago, now completely frozen, Guan Xingxiu could no longer endure it. The Falling Star Divine Sword transformed into a streak of golden light and slashed straight ahead.

A cyan figure suddenly appeared, blocking the sword light.

Ice crystals bloomed like flowers at his fingertips. The surrounding air seemed to freeze, and the Falling Star Divine Sword was halted midair.

“This is… Qing Shuang?”

Xu Guanhai looked at the familiar yet strange figure and could not help but cry out in shock.

The one who had cast the spell to block the Falling Star Divine Sword was clearly Qing Shuang, a Dao Integration cultivator who had been drained dry and had already perished not long ago.

However…

Guan Xingxiu narrowed his eyes, unable to conceal his shock.

“Old Guan, be careful. This Qing Shuang is not Ji Wantao himself, but a Spirit of Heaven and Earth.” Xu Guanhai immediately saw the clue and warned loudly.

[T/N: 青霜 (Qing Shuang) means Azure Frost]

The five surviving Dao Integration cultivators instantly tensed again.

Upon closer inspection, they discovered that this Spirit of Heaven and Earth Qing Shuang no longer had the originally blurred face. Instead, it closely resembled the appearance of Immortal Sage Qing Shuang Ji Wantao when he was alive.

What frightened them even more was that behind this new Spirit of Heaven and Earth Qing Shuang extended a thin thread, stretching into the void.

The thread was identical to the weapons they had previously seen used by the flying vessel to slaughter Dao Integration cultivators.

As they confronted the flying vessel, numerous thin threads extended from nothingness.

Familiar faces seemed to drift out from the shadows.

They surrounded the five survivors completely.

Sun Luchang’s face turned pale, his body trembling uncontrollably. “How is this possible? Even after death, the Spirits of Heaven and Earth can still be extracted and refined? What kind of evil technique is this…”

Zi Mei, however, seemed thoughtful. “This place is far from the Xuanhuang Realm. The principle of returning Dao to Heaven has lost its effect. If certain special methods are used, it may not be impossible to impersonate the Heavenly Dao and receive these Spirits of Heaven and Earth.”

Xu Guanhai smiled bitterly. “Old Guan, it seems we cannot escape this calamity. One or two Spirits of Heaven and Earth I might not fear. But this many… and that terrifying flying vessel…”

Guan Xingxiu’s eyes flashed with determination. “Then we destroy this monster first.”

“Wait.” Just as the Falling Star Divine Sword was about to pierce the flying vessel’s deck, Lan Yu suddenly shouted.

Lan Yu stepped forward, standing between the Spirits of Heaven and Earth, and said in a deep voice, “Query current mission completion probability.”

All the floating Spirits of Heaven and Earth froze. After a moment, the cold voice of the Wangzun flying vessel sounded.

“Current mission feasibility: extremely high.”

“Current energy reserves: sufficient.”

“Energy replenishment plan terminated.”

…

Voices echoed continuously. The expressionless Spirits of Heaven and Earth were dragged back into the void by the threads.

The seemingly fatal crisis vanished instantly.

Sun Luchang wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and let out a long breath, still in disbelief. “It… it is resolved just like that?”

Lan Yu’s expression did not relax at all. “Only temporarily. It seems that as long as its energy is sufficient, it will not attack us as long as we do not attempt to escape.”

Guan Xingxiu nodded coldly. “But once its energy runs low, it will inevitably hunt and absorb us again. Hmph. We, high officials of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, reduced to rations for a tool in this cold void. Truly ironic…”

Zi Mei remained silent, his expression solemn.

Only Xu Guanhai gave a bitter smile. “I did not expect to live a bit longer. Consider it a gain. Everyone, relax a little. This thing just devoured so many Dao Integration cultivators. Perhaps it can last long enough for us to meet the Heavenly Sovereign.”

“Besides, they were ambushed before. If the five of us cooperate and stay vigilant, we might escape this place.” This sentence was transmitted through divine sense.

“I have the Heavenly Capital Martial Arena. If I deploy the combat domain, it should buy us time,” Lan Yu said.

“This place is not suitable to remain in. Let us recover first, then break through together. What do you think?”

“If we do not leave, we will die anyway. Let us fight.”

…

As they discussed, time passed slowly.

When all of them had recovered to their peak state and took action, things proceeded more smoothly than expected.

No Spirits of Heaven and Earth appeared to stop them. Even the Wangzun flying vessel itself was like paper and was easily torn apart.

“We… got out?” Sun Luchang was stunned.

“Something is wrong.” Guan Xingxiu looked at the surrounding void with a cold expression.

“We are still inside the flying vessel. We are imprisoned.”

The Falling Star Divine Sword erupted with dazzling light, attempting to illuminate the dark space.

But like the true star sea void, this place seemed boundless. The star light was like a firefly, extinguished in an instant.

“Go.” Guan Xingxiu still refused to give up. He summoned the Falling Star Divine Sword and sent it flying rapidly into the darkness.

It never returned, completely swallowed by the void.

The others also realized the problem and used their own methods, but none could escape this void prison.

“That damned thing never intended to let us go. While we were planning to escape, it had already set a trap for us.” Sun Luchang said angrily.

“This place seems to be a kind of formation, somewhat similar to the legendary Two-Extreme Microdust Formation from ancient times,” Xu Guanhai said after observing for a while.

He then sighed regretfully. “Unfortunately, I do not understand formations. Otherwise, I could attempt to break it.”

“I do not either.”

“…”

Everyone fell silent, then all turned their gaze toward Lan Yu.

This veteran Dao Integration cultivator had lived for thousands of years. Surely he understood at least a little about formations.

Under their hopeful gazes, Lan Yu shook his head helplessly. “I do have some knowledge of formations, but the level of this formation…”

“It is far above mine. I cannot comprehend it,” Lan Yu said truthfully.

Instantly, despair filled the group.

A deathly silence enveloped them.

“This formation is an absolute sealed space. I cannot find the exit. However, if that flying vessel attempts to kill us again, it will inevitably open a gap. That will be our opportunity,” Lan Yu said after a while, reigniting hope.

“I will deploy the martial arena. Everyone enter it to avoid another sneak attack.”

As he spoke, a circular structure appeared in the dark void.

With no better option, everyone flew inside.

As the entrance closed, the five looked at each other, and a surge of battle intent rose in their hearts.

“Elder Lan, can you control this treasure? Now is not the time for sparring. If we waste our strength, what will we do when the flying vessel attacks again?”

“What the hell, Old Guan, why are you attacking me?” Xu Guanhai shouted loudly.

Even though the five forcibly suppressed the agitation in their hearts, they still could not control themselves and began attacking one another.

Lan Yu explained somewhat helplessly, “This treasure was personally passed down by the Grand Mage back then. Once you enter it, you will be forced to continuously spar until you leave. This is the innate nature of the treasure and cannot be controlled. The reason I did not take it out earlier was precisely because of this.”

“However, the intensity of the sparring can be adjusted. I have already lowered it to the minimum. Do not suppress your fighting intent. Just make casual moves and maintain a state of combat. With the supplies we carry, there is no need to worry about energy consumption.”

After a period of chaotic exchanges, everyone gradually adapted.

They lightly sparred while calmly communicating with one another.

“This kind of warm up is not bad. At least it ensures we can act at peak condition at any time,” Xu Guanhai joked bitterly.

Sun Luchang sighed repeatedly, “It has been a long time since I fought like this with others. Fellow Daoists, go easy on me…”

Guan Xingxiu returned to the main topic, “In this desperate situation, we only have one chance. Therefore, we must clearly understand each other’s strongest methods.”

His words gained everyone’s agreement.

He then spoke first, “My strongest strike was something I comprehended not long ago within this star sea. It is called, Sword Dividing the Star River. Be careful.”

Guan Xingxiu gave a light shout, and a sword radiance slashed out. In an instant, it seemed as if countless starlights were born from it.

The star splitting sword did not hit the other four. Instead, it struck heavily against the sky of the training field.

The firmament trembled. Cracks appeared one after another, then quickly healed.

Guan Xingxiu praised, “What a fine treasure.”

The other four then each demonstrated their ultimate techniques. While sparring, their coordination grew increasingly tacit.

They even jointly deduced a combined attack method.

Within the void trapping formation, time seemed to lose meaning.

The five Dao Integration cultivators were like sharpening blades, nurturing their essence, qi, and spirit.

They waited only for the right moment to unleash their strongest strike.

After an unknown amount of time…

A tremendous vibration startled them.

It was not the shaking of the training field, but the trembling of the entire dark void outside it.

Or rather, it came from the Wangzun Flying Vessel.

Through their long cooperation in sparring, the five had already achieved a certain level of mutual understanding.

In an instant, they reached a consensus and waited for the moment of weakness to appear.

Without warning, the darkness vanished and light returned.

They seemed to have returned to the interior cabin of the flying vessel.

However, having suffered once before, the five did not hesitate at all.

Their strongest combined attack, which had been prepared for a long time, was unleashed directly.

“Twilight Gazing at the Star Sea!”

“Feather Extinction!”

…

Shouts rang out at the same time. Five streams of light merged into one and struck fiercely against the wall of the flying vessel.

However, a despairing scene appeared.

A black hole suddenly manifested on the wall, swallowing the immense destructive power of their combined attack.

The hole slowly healed, and the wall returned to its original state.

Their painstakingly practiced killing move was like a joke, unable to cause even the slightest damage.

All five turned pale.

Guan Xingxiu’s Dao heart was shaken, and his body wavered as if about to collapse.

“How is this possible?” He muttered in a daze, unable to accept it.

Their strongest strike had failed. The five felt as if their hearts were dead, and it became difficult to muster any will to resist.

But soon, another violent tremor from the Wangzun Flying Vessel awakened them.

“Something is not right. The attack is coming from outside the vessel?”

“A void calamity?”

The five immediately realized, their faces filled with joy.

“We still have a chance!”

They also noticed abnormalities in the vessel.

The heaven and earth souls that had previously been absorbed had not appeared.

The vessel also seemed to have undergone a great battle, with faint cracks visible on the walls.

While they were still uncertain…

The cold voice of the Wangzun Flying Vessel sounded again.

“Third battle against unknown star sea civilization.”

“Energy reserves exhausted.”

“After calculation, the probability of victory in the next battle is zero.”

“Executing contingency plan…”

“Transferring data…”

“Initiating self destruction…”

The voice of the vessel caused the five Dao Integration cultivators to change expression drastically.

“Not good!”

Lan Yu instinctively expanded the training field again, enveloping the five.

The others also used their own methods to protect themselves.

“Initiating… ini… ini…”

However, something even more astonishing occurred.

The voice of the Wangzun Flying Vessel seemed to be interfered with, stuttering and repeating, yet no explosion arrived.

Boom, boom, boom.

From above the vessel came another series of loud explosions.

Amid rolling smoke and dust, a circular breach suddenly appeared. More than thirty unknown beings wearing strange armor poured in through the opening.

They were well trained. Ten of them surrounded Lan Yu and the others.

The rest continued to explore deeper into the vessel.

“Brother Lan Yu, you are well traveled. What do you think is happening?” Xu Guanhai asked through transmission.

Chapter 1282: Hidden Immortal Compendium Of The Hundred Tales

In this life, Li Fan had also attempted to classify the True Immortal seal script characters he had seen.

However, his approach was based on their specific effects, such as destruction, command, enhancement, and so on.

But within the Severed Immortal Tower at the far end of the star sea, they used an entirely different and novel perspective.

That is, whether the Dao depicted by a True Immortal seal script character had already been occupied by a True Immortal, or had once been occupied.

According to the many records within the Severed Immortal Tower, these different types of True Immortal seal script characters varied greatly in difficulty and danger when used to enter the Dao.

If a Dao had already been occupied by a True Immortal, then anyone who attempted to enter the Dao through that character would be reduced to ashes at the very moment of attaining the Dao, vanishing without a trace. No matter how powerful or talented they were, it could not be avoided.

If no True Immortal currently occupied that Dao, then even with certain side effects, ordinary cultivators could still glimpse the grand Dao depicted by the True Immortal seal script.

Li Fan carefully studied the scattered insights left by predecessors that he could access with his current level of contribution.

There was a fundamental difference between this and methods such as copying or attempting to draw the True Immortal script itself. Within the Severed Immortal Tower and the entire Xuan Immortal Ark, rather than directly using the power of the True Immortal seal script, it was more accurate to say they relied on relics of world extinction to draw out residual immortal power.

What they called entering the Dao was not truly stepping onto the path of a True Immortal. It was more like merging one’s body, soul, and consciousness into these relics, gaining certain properties formed through the tempering of time, thereby allowing them to better draw upon the remaining immortal power in the star sea.

There was no doubt that this was a shortcut. If the environment changed and the star sea no longer contained such abundant residual immortal power, then even if one could enter the Dao, the resulting strength would be greatly weakened. In contrast, Li Fan’s method of using the fundamental form of the True Immortal seal script depended only on the caster’s own strength and their level of comprehension of the script, without environmental restrictions.

Of course, this was only Li Fan’s understanding, based on having personally seen the true form of the True Immortal seal script. The people of the Immortal Ark would certainly not agree, unless Li Fan were willing to share the fundamental forms of the scripts. Given the Immortal Ark’s accumulation over thousands of years, if they could truly see the authentic forms, their overall strength would likely experience a qualitative leap in a short time.

However, Li Fan was not foolish enough to do that.

It was far easier and safer to occasionally submit some insights in exchange for contributions. Since his insights were based on genuine True Immortal seal script, no matter how unusual his perspective, they were always correct.

This was the essential difference of having seen the true transmission. They tried every possible way to reconstruct the origin from outward appearances, while Li Fan had already seen the origin itself and worked downward, making everything naturally smooth.

Although Li Fan firmly believed that the Immortal Ark’s methods were merely clever tricks, he had to admit that for beings beneath the True Immortal level, it was entirely worthwhile if they could wield power that originally belonged to True Immortals.

After all, survival was the foremost priority in the Darkest Star Sea.

Without these research achievements on True Immortal seal scripts, the Xuan Immortal Ark would likely have long since become part of the endless ruins drifting in the star sea.

This time, Li Fan guided the Xuan Immortal Ark to capture a Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance flying vessel. Besides accumulating merit for his current body, his primary goal was to use those Dao Integration cultivators to reveal the existence of the Immortal Ancestor.

After infiltrating the Xuan Immortal Ark for so long, Li Fan had finally uncovered the identity of the mysterious cultivator he first encountered in the Sea of Relics.

They had once been a member of the Xuan Immortal Ark, even one of its highest rulers. However, several hundred years ago, they were deceived by an outsider. No one knew what secret agreement had been made, but they allowed this outsider to enter the Immortal Ark’s highest confidential archive, the [Immortal Compendium of Hundred Tales].

The outsider had claimed they only intended to consult the ancient records stored within. Yet after entering, they never came out at the appointed time. When the Immortal Ark investigated, they were horrified to find that many secret archives had vanished.

Along with the outsider, three Dao Integration cultivators responsible for guarding the place also disappeared without a trace.

The Immortal Ark was shaken. The ruling figures were purged, leading to a small scale internal conflict.

In the end, a portion of the group escaped the Ark. However, they refused to give up on it. With nowhere else to go in the vast Darkest Star Sea, they hid within the Sea of Relics, waiting for a chance to counterattack and reclaim the Xuan Immortal Ark.

Meanwhile, the Immortal Ark never ceased its attempts to hunt them down. Yet the star sea was too vast, making capture nearly impossible.

They could only tolerate their continued existence.

The people of the Immortal Ark remained deeply resentful toward the outsider who caused the turmoil, especially over the lost secret archives, which became a permanent wound in their hearts.

However, the outsider’s identity was extremely mysterious. Only those former members who had fled might know the truth.

Since that incident, the outsider had never appeared again.

Although Li Fan was not certain whether this outsider was truly the Immortal Ancestor, that did not prevent him from creating the possibility that they were the same person.

After all, in the present Darkest Star Sea, living beings were scarce.

Near the High Wall, and possessing such mysterious power, who else could it be besides the Immortal Ancestor or the Heavenly Doctor?

Li Fan believed that if the Immortal Ark learned that, far beyond the Sea of Relics, within the even more vast Sea of Remnant Worlds, there existed a powerful figure who might be their ancient enemy, they would certainly attempt to investigate.

After all, no one would tolerate another sleeping beside them.

And through the Xuan Immortal Ark, Li Fan could also take the opportunity to probe the true nature of the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor.

He did not expect any decisive results, but even a small piece of information would be valuable. For Li Fan, this was merely a casual move with no cost.

The final victory might well be built upon these seemingly insignificant pieces of information. The Immortal Ark and the Holy Emperor were both pieces he used for testing.

Li Fan reviewed another document, thinking this to himself.

As for the fate of those Dao Integration cultivators from the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, he did not care at all. In the Xuanhuang Realm, they were also merely expendable resources.

However, something unexpected occurred.

Three days later, the long haired Dao Integration cultivator Wang Hai returned.

He also brought an interrogation record.

“Brother Zhao, take a look. What happened on that flying vessel is truly remarkable.”

Li Fan glanced through it and frowned slightly.

“That flying vessel was so powerful? Dao Integration cultivators were treated like food…”

Wang Hai nodded.

“We fought it three times before finally breaking its defenses. We also consumed quite a few relics.”

“But it was worth it. Each of those Dao Integration cultivators carried immense resources. Not to mention the items stored in the vessel called the Spirit of Heaven and Earth.”

Li Fan raised his head slightly and feigned ignorance.

“What exactly is this Spirit of Heaven and Earth? A manifestation of world laws?”

Wang Hai smiled.

“If that were all, I would not be so excited. This Spirit of Heaven and Earth not only contains the power of the cultivation world’s laws, but also carries a portion of the foundational force that constructs the world itself.”

“If the cultivation world is like a house, then these Spirit of Heaven and Earth are like the beams that support it. And this is precisely what our Xuan Immortal Ark lacks. With this fuel, our ark can operate steadily for another hundred years.”

From Wang Hai’s voice, one could clearly hear the joy in his heart.

He continued chattering on, adding, “Even that flying vessel itself can be dismantled and used to reinforce our Immortal Ark. Brother Zhao’s vague premonition this time has brought gains to the Immortal Ark that are absolutely comparable to dozens of relic artifacts.”

Li Fan, however, kept his head lowered as he flipped through documents. “I only care about what specific rewards there are. By the way, what exactly did the Council of Elders say about that world called Xuanhuang Realm. The fat meat may be a bit far away, but it can still save lives after all.”

Wang Hai shrugged. “You know those people in the Council of Elders well enough. Everything is always justified with the ‘greater situation’ and the ‘future of the Immortal Ark.’ As for something like crossing the star sea for an expedition…”

“I think they would only do that when our Immortal Ark is truly at the end of its road.”

Li Fan nodded thoughtfully upon hearing this. “That is rather a pity. From what I vaguely foresaw, cultivators like those Dao Integration ones on the flying vessel are already the peak combat power of that Xuanhuang Realm. As for those slightly stronger Longevity Immortal Realm cultivators, there are no more than a handful. If our Immortal Ark were to arrive, they would have no ability to resist at all.”

Wang Hai nodded in agreement, full of disdain. “They are nothing more than parasites clinging to a surviving cultivation world. In my opinion, we would not even need the full power of the Immortal Ark. Just three to five Dao Entrants cultivators would be enough to easily suppress the Xuanhuang Realm.”

Wang Hai then sighed, somewhat regretful. “It is just a pity that the Council of Elders does not permit it.”

Li Fan did not respond and instead asked, “What is my reward. Surely after making such a great contribution, the Council of Elders would not give nothing at all.”

Only then did Wang Hai stop being evasive and carefully take out a jade slip.

The moment the jade slip appeared, Li Fan’s gaze sharpened.

He keenly noticed that the half jade hairpin on Wang Hai’s head was trembling incessantly. Meanwhile, the jade slip itself faintly emitted fluctuations of the power of True Immortal seal script.

“This is…”

Li Fan quickly reacted. “The jade slip itself is a world extinction relic artifact?”

Wang Hai said with some pride, “Correct. This is the third World Extinction Jade Slip our Immortal Ark has collected. Each time it is observed, the True Immortal power attached to it is consumed, so it is extremely precious. This time, the Elders Council has truly paid a heavy price.”

“What is recorded in this jade slip?”

“I also want to know, but unfortunately I do not have the qualifications. You will understand once you see it yourself. Hurry up, after you finish reading, I still need to take it back,” Wang Hai said, looking somewhat enviously at the jade slip in Li Fan’s hand as he urged him.

Only then did Li Fan solemnly separate a strand of divine sense and enter it.

The World Extinction Jade Slip was a very special type among world extinction relic artifacts.

Unlike ordinary magic treasures, after being nourished by True Immortal power over a long period of time, the jade slip itself would not be stained with the power of True Immortal seal script. However, the True Immortal power would permeate into the contents recorded within the jade slip.

Causing a kind of transformation.

Or rather, a sublimation.

The sublimated content was as if it had received guidance from a True Immortal, undergoing a qualitative leap.

A mortal technique could become a True Immortal method. Even a simple piece of writing, after being touched by True Immortal power, could become something that allowed one to comprehend the Dao.

In short, the World Extinction Jade Slip was currently one of the rare methods that allowed harmless close contact with a True Immortal.

When his divine sense entered the jade slip, what first flooded in was the original content of the jade slip.

An ordinary method for tempering the will. Judging by its grade, it did not exceed Soul Transformation.

After finishing reading it in an instant, the perception of his divine sense suddenly changed.

The originally plain and unremarkable text seemed to come alive in an instant, twisting and mutating, transforming into entirely new characters.

After rearranging themselves, a brand new immortal method appeared before him.

“Hm?”

Li Fan’s heart trembled slightly as he quickly studied this new method several times in detail.

A familiar yet unfamiliar feeling gradually rose within his heart as his understanding deepened.

“Immortal Heart Mantra?”

“But not Xuanhuang.”

“And in subtle details, there are still differences. After all, it was not truly deduced and personally transmitted by a True Immortal, but rather evolved by the jade slip itself. It can even be said to be a weakened version of the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra,” Li Fan thought to himself with some regret.

However, on the surface, he still showed an expression of excitement and deep immersion.

When the flowing characters in his mind gradually faded and finally disappeared completely, Li Fan reluctantly returned the World Extinction Jade Slip and said, “As expected of an immortal method. With this technique, I can ensure that I will not be troubled by heart demons in the future. Even when comprehending True Immortal seal script, the negative effects I suffer will be greatly reduced.”

“Please also convey my thanks to the elders.”

Hearing this, Wang Hai subconsciously glanced at the World Extinction Jade Slip in his hand, then forcibly suppressed the urge to take a look.

Not to mention that there were restrictions placed on it by the Council of Elders, making it impossible for him to pry into it. Taking it without permission was a great taboo in the Immortal Ark.

Even for him, committing such an act would only lead to becoming living material for the study of Immortal seal script.

“My harvest this time also owes much to Brother Wang for connecting me over the long term. This is my insight, please accept it,” Li Fan said as he noticed the other party’s expression. After slightly closing his eyes and concentrating, he immediately carved another jade slip on the spot and handed it over.

Wang Hai was overjoyed upon seeing this. “Many thanks, Brother Zhao. In the future, I will go through fire and water without hesitation.”

After exchanging a few polite words, he directly accepted the jade slip and began to read it.

Immersed in it, his brows danced with joy.

After a long while, he came back to his senses from the insights and directly crushed the jade slip in front of Li Fan.

This was the rule of knowledge transmission within the Immortal Ark.

Although there was no restriction that different methods could not be cultivated together, techniques, Dao arts, and various insights were still extremely precious resources.

Just like the World Extinction Jade Slip rewarded by the Council of Elders of the Severed Immortal Tower this time, only Li Fan was qualified to study it, and it could not be lent to others.

However, after Li Fan finished viewing it, he could pass on his own insights, and this was not restricted.

But after all, it had passed through another hand, so the effect was certainly far inferior to direct personal experience. Especially when it involved the power of a True Immortal, even if the written description was completely identical, without sensing the transformation of the profound power, whether in cultivation progress or the subtlety of comprehension, it would naturally be much weaker.

Unless one was a heaven-defying genius who could ignore this inherent gap. Otherwise, second-hand and third-hand transmissions would all be weaker than the original.

It was precisely because he strictly followed this rule that after Wang Hai finished reading, he destroyed the jade slip that Li Fan had engraved.

After he left today, he would have the right to spread this method again. However, since it was passed on by him, it was already beyond a third transmission, and its effectiveness would be further reduced.

If someone who cultivated this method wished to go further, they would need to trace the path of its transmission, go upstream, pay a certain price, and seek guidance from the earlier transmitters. As for whether they could obtain the true method, that would depend on the sincerity of their heart.

Li Fan had infiltrated the Xuan Immortal Ark for more than ten years and was already thoroughly familiar with its rules.

Seeing that Wang Hai had acted accordingly and even gifted an additional jade slip of insights, the two finally parted reluctantly.

"By the way, among the five surviving Dao Integration cultivators in the Xuanhuang Realm, one of them is somewhat unusual. So, to be cautious, the elders have not taken action against him yet. If you are interested, you may want to look into it," Wang Hai left behind this ambiguous remark before departing.

Li Fan could not help but fall into thought.

According to the rules of the Immortal Ark, such indirect wording was only used when it involved the upper levels of the ark or the forces behind the other party.

"A survivor…"

"It should be Lan Yu. After all, he is the only one who achieved Dao Integration through the ancient method and holds no value to the ark. But he does not seem particularly unusual…"

"The Grand Mage of Heavenly Capital?"

Li Fan formed a hypothesis, straightened his somewhat disordered clothes, left the room, and headed toward the Counsil of Elders of the Severed Immortal Tower.

The current Immortal Ark was built entirely upon a Void Divine Tree, and after seizing actual control of the ark, the Severed Immortal Tower relocated to the very top of this tree.

Threads of green light, like the tips of branches and leaves, connected the many buildings of the Severed Immortal Tower into one.

Standing in the void, there was no need to fly. With a single thought, one could control the green light to travel between different locations.

Looking down, one could vaguely see places such as the Academy of Dao Attainment, the Star Forging Workshop, and the newly constructed Sin Suppression Valley.

They seemed to float separately in the endless void, connected only by the divine tree.

The giant who had previously been pierced through the body by the divine tree had already been completely drained. In his place was now a massive rabbit.

This rabbit had a white body, black ears, and a human face. Although it was already dead, its expression was one of sorrow for the world, as if it had witnessed something deeply tragic before its fall.

This [Human Emperor Rabbit], like the previous [Dao-Chasing Giant], was part of the hidden collection within the Immortals Compendium Hundred Tales of the Xuan Immortal Ark.

The hidden collection contained various resources, not only from the flourishing cultivation era before the destruction of the star sea, but also many strange objects gathered by the ark over thousands of years of drifting through the Darkest Star Sea.

Li Fan’s gaze briefly swept over the nearly withered body of the Human Emperor Rabbit, but his thoughts had already shifted to the ark’s hidden collection.

If there was anything on this ark worth scheming for, it would likely be this Immortal Compendium of Hundred Tales.

"Perhaps, I should also include the whereabouts of the Shang Immortal Ark."

Li Fan suddenly thought of this.

As parts of the former Xuanshang Immortal Ark, although the Xuan and Shang divisions had long lost contact, they could still occasionally sense each other''s existence.

However, all information regarding the Shang Immortal Ark was a top secret of the Xuan Immortal Ark. Even within the Council of Elders, only the three core elders were qualified to know.

Despite infiltrating for over ten years, Li Fan had only overheard a few fragments during an elders’ gathering.

"I wonder what exactly the situation of the Shang Immortal Ark is, that its secrecy level is even higher than that of True Immortal seal script..."

While Li Fan was thinking to himself, he had already arrived at the top of the Void Divine Tree, where the council of the Severed Immortal Tower elders was located.

The first thing Li Fan did was naturally to visit his "teacher."

Within the Xuan Immortal Ark, lineage and faction were extremely important.

The reason Wang Hai had repeatedly run errands and delivered messages for him was because both he and Li Fan were disciples under the third elder of the Severed Immortal Tower, Ai Tianjue.

And this Ai Tianjue had an even closer relationship with Li Fan. Because Ai Tianjue himself had also come from the Academy of Dao Attainment.

However, in order to study new methods of entering the Dao, after leaving the academy he joined the Severed Immortal Tower and remained hidden from the public for many years.

Only after achieving results, when the Severed Immortal Tower reversed its fortunes and seized control of the ark, did Ai Tianjue reappear in the public eye.

"Greetings, Teacher." Li Fan bowed calmly, then truthfully reported his insights from the World Extinction Jade Slip he had just studied.

Any gains made by a disciple had to be reported and submitted to the teacher.

After listening to Li Fan’s explanation, Ai Tianjue nodded slightly. “I have also read this jade slip before. Your talent is indeed extraordinary. You have already grasped seventy to eighty percent of its essence.”

Li Fan bowed respectfully once more, thanking his teacher for the praise.

“But do not rely on it too much.” Ai Tianjue suddenly changed his tone.

“You must understand that inner demons are both calamity and opportunity. Although one may rely on wondrous methods to sever inner demons, they are endless and will regenerate after being cut away. Using the Immortal Heart Mantra to suppress them is ultimately an inferior approach.”

“It is better to transform them into nourishment for tempering oneself. That instead will greatly benefit cultivation.”

Ai Tianjue spoke slowly and calmly.

While lecturing Li Fan, he was also writing something on a sheet of white paper.

As expected of one of the top experts of the Severed Immortal Tower, even his casual words could inspire the current Li Fan.

Li Fan listened attentively, his gaze never once peeking at what Ai Tianjue was writing.

After finishing his explanation, Ai Tianjue still did not stop writing. Only after half a day did he finally put down his brush.

“Take a look at this piece of calligraphy. How is it?” Ai Tianjue said to Li Fan.

Only then did Li Fan raise his head to look.

On the white paper was a “complete” True Immortal seal script character.

That was Li Fan’s first reaction upon seeing it.

“Fallen…”

Focusing his mind and observing further, a trace of regret arose in Li Fan’s heart. “A pity.”

“It is not a complete True Immortal seal script character. Only about eighty to ninety percent has been restored.”

“However, to comprehend it to this extent from a pile of fragmented remnants is already truly remarkable.”

Li Fan knew that he himself would not be able to achieve such a level.

After pondering for a moment, Li Fan spoke of his understanding of the character [Fallen]:

“This ‘fall’ is not the fall of the mind. It is the fundamental falling of all things. A descent from a higher level to a lower level.”

“A True Immortal becomes a cultivator, a cultivator becomes a mortal, a mortal turns into dust.”

With just this single character, Li Fan spoke for nearly half a day.

And yet it was still far from complete.

After Li Fan finished, Ai Tianjue first pointed out several errors in his explanation, then sighed slightly.

“To comprehend a True Immortal character is like viewing mountains while riding a galloping horse.”

“This character ‘Fallen’ had already been restored to sixty to seventy percent a thousand years ago on the Immortal Ark. After a thousand years, progress has increased by only a small fraction.”

“The closer one gets to the true essence of Immortal seal script, the slower the progress becomes. Even if there is only the slightest difference, compared to a True Immortal seal script character, the power differs vastly.”

“One may see the path ahead, yet cannot tread upon it. The Immortal Dao is truly difficult.”

Hearing Ai Tianjue’s sigh, Li Fan felt somewhat puzzled.

This did not sound like something his research-obsessed teacher would say.

“Teacher, why do you say this?” Li Fan asked directly.

Only then did Ai Tianjue explain the reason.

“That Lan Yu, who has achieved Dao Integration in the Xuanhuang Realm, cultivates a True Immortal technique.”

“Myriad Calamities Feather Transformation Technique.”

“My heart longs for it.”

Ai Tianjue let out another long sigh.

These words immediately shocked Li Fan.

He knew how high his teacher’s standards were. Since he called it a True Immortal technique, it must be a genuine Immortal-level cultivation method, comparable to the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra.

But…

How could that be?

Lan Yu?

Was he not cultivating the Heavenly Capital Feather Transformation Art?

In an instant, Li Fan narrowed his eyes, countless thoughts flashing through his mind.

Yet his verbal response was quick. “Since Lan Yu has fallen into our Immortal Ark’s hands, does that not mean this Immortal technique now belongs to us?”

“Then why does teacher feel regret?”

He pretended not to understand.

Ai Tianjue smiled and shook his head.

“In the Xuanhuang Realm, there exists the rule that techniques cannot be cultivated simultaneously. Although the Immortal Ark is far from the Xuanhuang Realm and not bound by this restriction, the Immortal technique cultivated by Lan Yu has a similar limitation.”

“To cultivate the Myriad Calamities Feather Transformation Technique, one must use the Feather of Myriad Calamities as a catalyst. Without this treasure, no matter how extraordinary one’s talent is, it is impossible to even begin.”

Li Fan was slightly stunned.

“The Feather of Myriad Calamities has already fused with Lan Yu. It cannot be separated by us.”

“So even with the Immortal technique before our eyes, we can only observe it, not cultivate it.”

Ai Tianjue shook his head again. “This situation is similar to the only recorded Immortal technique hidden within our Xuan Immortal Ark.”

Li Fan also revealed a thoughtful expression. “Not only cultivation techniques, but True Immortal seal script as well. Once a True Immortal occupies it, others cannot cultivate it…”

Ai Tianjue waved his hand, putting away the writing on the table, his expression somewhat complex.

“That is why, the other day, I suddenly felt that perhaps failing to fully comprehend this True Immortal seal script might actually be a good thing.”

“Otherwise, within the Immortal Ark, there would inevitably be another storm of bloodshed.”

Li Fan fell silent upon hearing this.

“However, speaking of it, the rule in the Xuanhuang Realm that techniques cannot be cultivated simultaneously is rather interesting,” Ai Tianjue suddenly said.

Li Fan looked at his teacher.

He saw Ai Tianjue muttering to himself:

“This restriction should be unique to the Immortal Realm. It should not be something that the Heavenly Dao of a lower realm could naturally develop…”

Chapter 1283: First Trial Of The Spiritual Void Formation

Li Fan was immediately startled upon hearing this. “How could that be? Could it be that the Xuanhuang Realm is actually connected to the legendary Immortal Realm?”

Ai Tianjue replied in a strange tone, “Heh, impossible to fully grasp, impossible to fully grasp. The history of the Xuanhuang Realm is rather interesting. Once we extract more from that Lan Yu’s mind, perhaps those old fellows will change their stance.”

“It is just unclear whether this will be a blessing or a disaster for our Immortal Ark.”

After speaking, Ai Tianjue fell silent for a moment before formally beginning his instruction to Li Fan.

Li Fan’s repeated address of “teacher” was not empty politeness.

Here, there was no restriction against cultivating multiple methods. What was passed down between master and disciple were truly profound techniques.

Li Fan had studied under Ai Tianjue for five years. Having gained his recognition, he was taught the [Jade Void Inner Vision Weeping Spirit Art].

This profound technique was also Ai Tianjue’s own foundational cultivation method.

“Kàn and Lí reverse Heaven and Earth, the Jade Void technique is wondrous. The azure sea refines true emptiness, weeping spirit transforms into divine ability…”

Ai Tianjue held a glowing scroll and slowly recited the contents of the Jade Void Inner Vision Weeping Spirit Art.

Li Fan followed behind, silently reciting as well.

Though it was only a word by word reading without detailed explanation, as Ai Tianjue’s rhythmic voice, resembling Dao laws, entered his ears, countless insights about the Weeping Spirit Art naturally surfaced in Li Fan’s mind.

This method of teaching was itself a commonly used instructional technique within the Immortal Ark.

Rather than a cultivation method, it was closer to a divine ability called Sentient Beings Enlightenment.

It was said to have been obtained by the Immortal Ark from the remnants of worlds within the star sea, greatly reducing the difficulty of transmitting knowledge. Once introduced, it became widely popular throughout the Immortal Ark.

The teaching effectiveness of Sentient Beings Enlightenment depended closely on the aptitude and comprehension ability of both teacher and student.

Ai Tianjue was one of the top experts in the Severed Immortal Tower, with deep understanding even of True Immortal seal script characters. His ability required no doubt.

As for the body Li Fan currently inhabited, Zhao Xian, its aptitude was by no means poor. Combined with Li Fan’s accumulated experience across many cycles, his progress in cultivating the Weeping Spirit Art advanced rapidly.

The Jade Void Inner Vision Weeping Spirit Art was a supreme divine ability passed down within the Xuan Immortal Ark since ancient times. It was said that during the ancient era when the Immortal Path had not yet been severed, the Xuanshang Immortal Ark exchanged a supreme treasure with a major cultivation world sect in return for this exquisite method.

Members of the Xuanshang Immortal Ark constantly traveled across the star sea, moving between various cultivation worlds. They had no fixed residence and found it difficult to cultivate in deep seclusion.

This Weeping Spirit Art perfectly solved both issues.

At its core, the method involved constructing an inner world within one’s own divine soul.

Within this inner world, one cultivated through “weeping spirit.” The term “weeping” did not literally mean crying, but rather imitating the natural, unrestrained emotional flow that arises when a person cries.

Over time, everything within the inner world would move in accordance with one’s will.

For ordinary techniques, as one’s realm increased, cultivation speed would gradually slow. However, for the Weeping Spirit Art, progress was slow in the early stages, requiring one to establish a genuine emotional connection with the inner world. The further one progressed, the faster the cultivation became.

The Weeping Spirit Art required no secluded cultivation. Even practicing for half a day could deepen the emotional bond with the inner world. Those with lively minds and delicate emotions were especially suited for it.

Although Li Fan could not recall when he had last truly cried, for someone capable of turning illusion into reality, recreating emotional fluctuations was not difficult.

He was unaware of the cultivation speed of Ai Tianjue’s other disciples, but the fact that he was always taught individually was enough to show the importance Ai Tianjue placed on him.

After half a day passed, Ai Tianjue finally finished reciting the technique. He let out a long breath, and the sweat on his forehead instantly evaporated.

Li Fan, however, still had his eyes closed, as if immersed in the teaching.

“Do you have any doubts?” Ai Tianjue asked.

“I have understood everything,” Li Fan replied in a deep voice.

Ai Tianjue nodded slightly, revealing an approving expression. “After you return, you must recite it daily and not neglect it. Your Weeping Spirit Art has reached its most critical stage. Once your inner world takes shape, with thought following intention, you may catch up to me within half a year.”

Li Fan nodded in agreement.

Ai Tianjue added, “Although the mainstream view within the Immortal Ark is that researching True Immortal seal script is fundamental, you must remember that cultivation realm and strength are the foundation of all exploration. If the foundation is unstable, even if you temporarily reach great heights, you may fall to your death at any time…”

Ai Tianjue continued speaking at length, even somewhat repetitively.

Yet this was precisely the standard upheld by teachers within the Xuan Immortal Ark.

Li Fan bowed and took his leave, thinking to himself, “Teachers treat students with sincerity, and students repay with genuine respect. This is the true inheritance that has allowed the Immortal Ark to endure for thousands of years. Factions like the Celestial Pivot Institute and the Severed Immortal Tower are merely outer layers. The true core lies in these master disciple lineages.”

After leaving Ai Tianjue’s residence, Li Fan did not immediately depart from the Severed Immortal Tower.

Instead, he went to visit another elder.

Chi Gongdao.

Although Li Fan did not formally study under this Elder Chi, his repeated submission of unique insights regarding True Immortal seal script had earned Chi Gongdao’s appreciation.

Unlike Ai Tianjue’s somewhat traditional approach, Chi Gongdao was a radical within the Immortal Ark.

He advocated abandoning all foundational cultivation methods and devoting oneself entirely to True Immortal seal script.

It must be said that his research into True Immortal seal script was indeed beyond most others.

After Li Fan’s evaluation, among all the elders in the Severed Immortal Tower, Chi Gongdao had reconstructed the greatest number of True Immortal characters and achieved the highest level of accuracy.

Moreover, he possessed a secret technique that allowed him to precisely locate, within the boundless Sea of Relics, world extinction relics whose True Immortal power was on the verge of dissipating yet still usable.

It was said that the majority of dual True Immortal power relics within the Severed Immortal Tower had been discovered by him.

Thus, his status within both the Severed Immortal Tower and the entire Immortal Ark was exceptionally high.

Whoosh.

As Li Fan pushed open the door to the small tower, a gust of cold wind accompanied by faint whispers rushed out.

Already accustomed to this, Li Fan ignored it and walked straight forward, calmly sitting down before Chi Gongdao.

In front of him, a brush made of flesh and hair suddenly appeared.

Li Fan reached out to take it. Before his hand even fully approached, the hairs on the brush seemed to come alive, rapidly extending and tightly binding his right hand.

Fragments of incomplete True Immortal seal script characters appeared within his sea of consciousness, and his hand began to move along with them.

Drops of blood flowed from the tip of the brush, condensing like ink and leaving indelible marks in the air.

To be honest, when Li Fan first came here, he had almost exposed himself and nearly wrote out a complete True Immortal seal script character.

If he had not reacted in time, the Immortal Ark would likely have already been completely annihilated under the world destroying power of the True Immortal seal script.

The brush moved like a dragon and serpent, and red blood splattered.

Before long, a fragmented and twisted True Immortal character appeared in the air.

It was precisely one half of the character [Hunger].

"Starving, starving, starving, starving!"

A furious roar suddenly came from the brush in his hand. The strands of hair wrapped around it tightened further. Many of them even wriggled like worms, attempting to crawl along Li Fan’s hand into his body and devour his flesh and blood.

Li Fan narrowed his eyes. He did not activate his physical or spiritual power to expel them. Instead, while his flesh was being devoured, he carefully sensed the hunger contained within those strands of hair.

They were not insatiably greedy. The strands merely tasted lightly, then quickly withdrew. The brush slipped from his hand and flew back into the darkness.

Moments later, strange chewing sounds echoed out.

Mixed within were occasional cracking sounds of bones being crushed.

Chi Gongdao’s voice followed, "Not bad. Compared to last time, the flavor is a bit purer."

"Young Zhao, you are truly a genius. If that old man Ai had not refused, I would have taken you as my disciple no matter what."

Li Fan did not respond and instead said in a low voice, "Elder Chi, I feel that my comprehension of this character has reached a bottleneck. I would like to switch to a new one."

Chi Gongdao let out a strange laugh, "Heh heh, greedy. I like it."

Whoosh.

Seven brushes, also formed from flesh and hair, flew out of the darkness and stopped before Li Fan.

"Pick whichever one you want."

Li Fan closed his eyes and sensed the aura emanating from each brush.

"This one."

After a long while, he chose his target and reached toward the leftmost brush, the one with the faintest flesh aura.

Flesh churned, black hair attached itself.

Guiding Li Fan’s hand, it began to write in the void.

With wild and unrestrained strokes, a blood red True Immortal character slowly appeared.

Li Fan focused his mind to comprehend it, while the other six brushes had already disappeared at some unknown time.

"Solitude."

"The solitude of being the only self across eternity and heaven and earth."

Back when Li Fan’s Holy Embryo crossed the star sea, he had once encountered this True Immortal seal script character.

At that time, even the black sword, Heavenly Wonder, which had already fused with his Dao Foundation, showed signs of being forcibly separated.

Now, once again, Li Fan felt that same power from the blood red character before him.

However, within the surrounding space, there were faint restrictions suppressing the power emitted by Solitude and other manifested True Immortal seal script characters.

In Li Fan’s perception, time passed both slowly and rapidly.

After the [Solitude] character was fully written, he still felt unsatisfied.

This process of inferring the True Immortal seal script through the power it displayed, without directly seeing its true form, was truly addictive.

The brush wrapped around his hand had already returned to the darkness.

Chi Gongdao’s sinister laughter sounded again beside Li Fan’s ear, "Boy Zhao, want to experience it again? As long as you abandon the darkness and join me instead of Ai Tianjue, I will personally teach you all these True Immortal seal script characters that I have deduced…"

Li Fan’s expression did not change, "No need for your concern, senior. If I have a need, I will still exchange comprehension for it as before."

After speaking, he turned and left without waiting for a response.

The small building fell silent for a moment, then Chi Gongdao’s voice echoed again, "Such a firm will. I like it even more…"

"Heh heh heh heh…"

What Chi Gongdao did not know, despite coveting Li Fan, was that with just this single direct experience, Li Fan’s understanding of the Solitude character had already quietly surpassed his.

After all, Li Fan had the innate advantage of having personally seen true True Immortal Seal Script, and he had once directly suffered the aftereffects of the Solitude character. Surpassing his teacher in an instant was only natural.

"Let me first try to see whether I can continue restoring it on my own. If I fail, I will borrow the talents of those geniuses on the Immortal Ark."

"After all, the more True Immortal seal script power I grasp, the better."

Li Fan returned to his residence and began organizing the gains he had obtained from Ai Tianjue and Chi Gongdao.

At the same time, he waited for their next summons.

His life within the Xuan Immortal Ark was just this simple, unadorned, and monotonous.

…

Xuanhuang Realm.

The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators remained highly attentive to the light of departure from the realm.

Although the frequency had slightly decreased, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance still occasionally released images from within the Darkest Star Sea.

All kinds of dangers and calamities made the cultivators within the Xuanhuang Realm feel both shocked and excited.

“Just watch and enjoy it. Every time they encounter danger, they turn misfortune into safety. That is the protection of the Heavenly Sovereign. We may not have such luck.”

“No wonder the Immortal Alliance was unwilling to send people into the star sea before. It is simply too dangerous. We have not even seen the shadow of the Xuanshang Immortal Ark yet, and already many Dao Integration cultivators have fallen. In the end, how many can return safely?”

“The Immortal Ark is good, but it is not our homeland.”

…

Amid the discussions of the crowd, the Holy Emperor Li Ping had already discerned some clues.

After all, he had truly crossed the star river. The images released by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance appeared real.

But compared to a true long journey through the star sea, there were still many flaws.

“The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance is fabricating things?”

“It seems the true departing rainbow light has likely already met with misfortune.”

Li Ping said with slight regret.

At this moment, the Holy Dynasty had once again gathered enough Voidbright Flow Crystals. He intended to personally go beyond the Xuanhuang Realm, to comprehend the Dao again while also familiarizing himself with the battlefield environment where he would later confront the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor.

Within the unnoticed firmament, the Holy Emperor had already flown to the edge of the Xuanhuang Realm.

This time, Li Ping refused the request of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao to accompany him. After all, he would not travel far and would only move around the vicinity of the Xuanhuang Realm.

As layers of rainbow light separated, he began to break free from the attraction of the Immortal Ruins and fly into the dark void.

“Perhaps it is not necessary to rely on these Voidbright Flow Crystals.”

“Xuanhuang creations are manifestations of Xuanhuang laws. Their properties might be imitated through spiritual qi.”

Looking at the multicolored and illusory lights around him, Li Ping pondered.

The Xuanhuang Realm gradually turned into a tiny dot, barely visible.

Li Fan then turned to look toward the Immortal Ruins.

There, it was pitch black.

The ruins of the Immortal Realm passage devoured all attempts at observation.

Some vague images flashed through his mind. For some reason, Li Ping actually felt a faint sense of familiarity with the mysterious Immortal Ruins.

Although fleeting, it was still captured by the Holy Emperor.

“Immortal Ruins…”

Li Ping shook his head and suppressed the thought after a long while.

The most urgent matter now was to resolve the issue of the Xuanhuang Realm being possessed and having its order replaced.

As for how to escape the Immortal Ruins after accomplishing this goal…

Ever since he learned from Mo Rubin that the uniqueness of the You Race originated from the bloodline of the first Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, Li Ping had been trying to mass replicate this bloodline using Cat Treasure’s abilities.

So far, three abilities of Cat Treasure had been identified: item replication, lifeform simulation, and marrow cleansing.

Li Ping first made every effort to have Cat Treasure simulate a member of the You Race.

Then he infused the recorded lifeform data into ordinary humans through marrow cleansing.

By taking this indirect approach, he then replicated the flesh and blood of these modified humans.

Perhaps due to Cat Treasure acting as an intermediary and bypassing certain restrictions, these replicas actually possessed part of the You Race bloodline abilities.

Although their efficiency in generating source power essence through prayer was only about one fifth of that of normal You Race members, the advantage was that there were no limitations. With the Holy Dynasty’s powerful flesh manufacturing technology, as long as resources were sufficient, they could be produced in nearly unlimited quantities.

This temporarily solved the energy shortage problem of the Holy Dynasty and the Dark Sea.

Deep within the Dark Sea, the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation continued to operate, accumulating energy.

It was believed that within less than a hundred years, enough power would be gathered to break free from the Immortal Ruins.

Before that, Li Ping’s task was to resolve the issue of Xuanhuang’s “Orthodoxy.”

Returning to the present, Li Ping subconsciously glanced at his shoulder.

Cat Treasure was still lying there. However, it had turned its head away, not looking at Li Ping.

It seemed that replicating the bloodline of the first Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable was extremely taxing for it.

During this period, it had spent most of its time in deep sleep.

Cat Treasure had also become somewhat distant toward Li Ping.

Li Ping had a premonition that if their relationship continued to weaken, Cat Treasure’s might leave at any moment.

After all, there was no master servant bond between them.

It was only maintained by his use of Source Power Essence as an incentive.

He squeezed out a cluster of golden light and placed it on Cat Treasure’s head.

As he moved deeper into the void, Li Ping began to comprehend the laws of the star sea around him.

As for the lingering calamities within the star sea…

Cat Treasure’s occasionally raised tail pointed out a safe path forward for Li Ping.

With his prior experience in long distance voyages, the journey did not encounter any danger.

"If the final battle is set outside the Xuanhuang Realm, then the assistance of heaven and earth will be reduced by more than half."

"The chance of victory, aside from Cat Treasure’s many divine abilities, may also lie in borrowing the calamity forces that exist everywhere in the star sea."

Outside the void of the Great Qi small world, the relic of the First Origin Sect and the terrifying Obliterating Wind Calamity were sealed.

While maintaining the seal, Li Ping was also researching this calamity.

Compared to the various calamity forces within the Darkest Star Sea, the Obliterating Wind Calamity was a pure force that annihilated everything.

Li Ping suspected that even the calamities within the star sea would gradually decay into ruin under the blowing of the Obliterating Wind.

"In the end, these so called star sea calamities are merely methods of True Immortal seal script techniques."

"Although they are existences beyond the understanding of us mortals."

"Since the Obliterating Wind can erase them into nothingness, then in a certain sense, their power can also be turned to our own use."

"But I must find the proper method."

A flash of inspiration appeared in Li Ping’s mind. Ignoring Cat Treasure’s warning, he proactively flew toward a nearby dangerous region in the void.

Golden source power essence densely covered his body as protection.

Li Ping quietly sensed the mysterious changes occurring on the surface of the source power essence.

Under Cat Treasure’s foolish gaze, Li Ping suddenly felt the surroundings become dark again.

Unlike the previous darkness of the Darkest Star Sea, which came from the absence of light and lifeless silence.

This time, Li Ping felt a bone chilling darkness as his connection to the world was gradually stripped away, as if he were being separated from everything in the star sea.

Not only were his connections severed, even the link within his body to the Xuanhuang Realm, and even the threads connecting him to other mysterious unknown existences, were slowly fading.

The Faceless Holy Emperor, who had always cared deeply about the Xuanhuang Realm, suddenly felt an unexpected detachment in his heart.

He felt that the Xuanhuang Realm and all living beings within it were no longer so important to him.

The long held attachment was about to be completely released.

A slight movement from his shoulder instantly pulled Li Ping out of that state.

Only then did he realize that even under the calamity of a True Immortal seal script character, where all connections to the world were fading, Cat Treasure still remained on his shoulder the entire time, without the slightest sign of separation.

With source power essence protecting his body, Li Ping moved instantly and escaped the region covered by the calamity.

"This True Immortal seal script character seems especially effective against me."

"Solitude, or perhaps Isolation?"

Li Ping stared at that region and pondered.

He condensed another mass of golden light in his hand and placed it on Cat Treasure’s head.

Cat Treasure unceremoniously swallowed a mouthful, then lazily fell asleep again.

…

Sun family, underground secret chamber.

Li Fan’s divine sense clone sensed that his connection with the Holy Emperor clone had completely disappeared.

He could not help but feel a trace of regret.

"The final sensation transmitted, was it the power of a True Immortal seal script?"

"Solitude?"

"To think that by coincidence, he used it to completely break free from me."

However, after a moment, Li Fan became indifferent.

At the level of strength the Holy Emperor had reached, it was unrealistic to control him like a chess piece in real time.

Moreover, he had the assistance of that extremely mysterious creation, Cat Treasure.

If he still could not completely sever his connection with Li Fan’s true body, then Li Fan would begin to doubt whether the Holy Emperor could truly force out the full strength of Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor.

As for the Holy Emperor clone, or rather Li Ping’s safety, Li Fan was not worried at all.

Even the Holy Embryo did not perish within the “Solitude” character technique. The Holy Emperor Li Ping, who is stronger and has encountered many fortuitous opportunities, naturally has even less reason to be unable to escape.

“Since the overall path has already been determined, I will just watch his performance.”

“No matter what, the gains of this life are already more than sufficient.”

“In fact, so abundant that it is almost dazzling.”

While Li Fan was distracted in thought, a somewhat familiar voice suddenly sounded.

“Senior, when can we go out and take a look? I am truly feeling quite bored being cooped up here.”

Li Fan shifted his gaze, his eyes deep and unreadable.

It was originally Sun Luyao’s voice.

But now, whether in movement or expression, it had reached a level where it's hard to distinguish real from fake.

After Li Fan’s continuous attempts, especially thanks to the Holy Embryo’s gains within the Immortal Ark, he had finally created a fairly qualified simulated personality of Sun Luyao.

This Sun Luyao himself was not even aware that he was a fabricated existence.

His consciousness and memories had been restored to the point when Li Fan had removed the wind calamity from his body and promised to take him out, traveling while searching for other possible immortal artifacts.

“What is it, Senior?” Sun Luyao looked at Li Fan’s gaze, seemingly a little afraid.

“Heh.” Li Fan revealed a gentle smile.

“Nothing, I just thought of something pleasant.”

“Since you have said so, then we will go out today.”

Sun Luyao was overjoyed. “That is great!”

Using the same method as before, after creating a fabricated Sun Luyao and Boundless Mirror, Li Fan’s divine sense clone took their “true bodies” and left the underground secret chamber.

“Senior, where shall we go first?”

“Within the nearby range, I do not seem to sense any traces of possible immortal artifacts.” Sun Luyao asked after checking.

“To make some preparations,” Li Fan replied simply.

He flew rapidly, arriving at the entrance of a small world, then leaped into the spatial passage.

“Oh? This small world is full of plants?”

Sun Luyao looked at the scene before him and spoke with curiosity.

Like a tropical rainforest, towering and dense vegetation stretched upward, competing for sunlight.

From time to time, vines could be seen moving like pythons in the shadows. They would quietly wrap around other towering trees, their sharp wooden thorns piercing into them.

Before long, the trees would wither and collapse.

This would open up a large space above.

Within a few breaths, abundant sunlight would attract other trees, which would grow at a visible speed to fill the gap.

“Senior, this small world seems to still be in a relatively primitive stage of life. There should be no immortal artifacts we are looking for,” Sun Luyao said, though still absorbed in the sight, dutifully offering his suggestion.

“We are not looking for immortal artifacts. I will teach you a formation. Once you learn it, you will handle the formation work next,” Li Fan said calmly.

Hearing this, Sun Luyao’s spirit lifted. “Thank you, Senior. I will certainly not fail your expectations!”

“Watch carefully. This formation is called…”

“Primordial Spiritual Void.”

Li Fan rose into the sky above the small world.

Streams of light poured down, directly blocking out the sunlight above.

The already dim primitive forest world now descended into complete darkness.

In the vision of the Boundless Mirror spirit Sun Luyao, the light scattered by Li Fan consisted of extremely profound formation units.

Even with his foundation as an immortal artifact, analyzing them was extremely difficult.

As the formation gradually took shape, a feeling that was both familiar and terrifying rose uncontrollably in Sun Luyao’s heart.

“This is…”

Sun Luyao’s face turned pale. After a long while, he finally realized.

It was the same sensation he had felt each time he faced the obliterating wind calamity, the feeling of life hanging by a thread.

His intuition told him that if he remained here until the formation was completed, it would be the day of his great calamity.

The Boundless Mirror trembled slightly and quickly transformed into a beam of light, flying to Li Fan’s side.

Li Fan ignored him and continued perfecting the formation.

“A pity. First, the materials are insufficient. Second, this is only my divine sense acting, so the full power of the Spiritual Void formation cannot be unleashed.”

“However, it is sufficient for condensing some protective layers.”

More than ten days later, the Primordial Spiritual Void formation was completed.

As a beam of light capable of destroying heaven and earth descended, this small world completely vanished.

Meanwhile, Li Fan’s divine sense had already returned to the Xuanhuang Realm with the Boundless Mirror.

“Did you learn the formation just now?”

The simulated Sun Luyao did not respond for a long time.

He had just been affected by the Primordial Spiritual Void formation, and the structure that maintained the simulated personality’s 'true nature' had already been destroyed.

“Truly a useless piece of trash.” Li Fan snorted coldly.
