Chapter 1284: Great Qi Enlightens The Dao

However, considering that the Sun Luyao before him was in fact his own creation, calling him useless would be equivalent to insulting his own craftsmanship.

Thus, the words that had reached Li Fan’s lips were swallowed back down.

With another cold snort, his thoughts rapidly shifted, and the now defective “Sun Luyao” was destroyed.

A moment later, an entirely new fabricated personality was born once again.

“Senior, that formation just now…” The newly fabricated personality had absolutely no awareness that he had only just been created. His memories still remained frozen at the moment the Primordial Spiritual Void Formation destroyed the world, and his face was pale.

“That formation is truly far too profound. This junior has not yet learned it.” Sun Luyao spoke bitterly, terrified of angering Li Fan.

Li Fan sensed the crystal clear sphere condensed at the cost of an entire small world and revealed a kindly smile. “No need to worry. The Primordial Spiritual Void Formation is indeed somewhat complicated. I only need to demonstrate it a few more times.”

Those calm and ordinary words caused Sun Luyao’s heart to turn cold. Yet he did not dare object in the slightest and could only blankly follow Li Fan toward the next target small world.

The worlds Li Fan selected were all among the smallest of the Xuanhuang Realm’s subordinate small worlds that had not yet been discovered by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance. This was specifically to avoid drawing the Xuanhuang Realm closer to the Immortal Ruins and attracting outside attention.

However, Li Fan estimated that this behavior of digging away at the roots of the Xuanhuang Realm could not continue for too long.

Li Fan weighed the crystal clear sphere in his hand. “Another two or three of these will far surpass the protection provided by my 119th life’s Myriad Spirits-All Living Beings Refine the Soul. There should not be any problems.”

…

Great Qi Small World.

Daoist Hundred Flowers stood at the border of the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven, staring blankly into the void outside.

All this time, she had always completed the Holy Emperor’s assignments perfectly. As a result, the rewards of source power essence had never ceased, and recently they had even become abundant.

But source power essence was ultimately just that.

Before ever obtaining it, one felt it was incomparably precious and desired to taste it no matter what. Yet after truly becoming wealthy in it, it gradually began to feel dull and meaningless.

After all, it could not help one transcend mortal limits and ascend to the realm of a True Immortal. No matter how much one possessed, it was useless.

Daoist Hundred Flowers felt herself gradually becoming slack.

After achieving freedom in source power essence, she slowly lost both her goals and motivation. The thing she did most each day was care for the many Cave Heaven worlds, ensuring that spiritual energy circulated smoothly and vitality flourished.

The second thing was daydreaming.

Emptying her mind and thinking of nothing. Occasionally, fragmented scenes would flash through her thoughts.

Some were memories from after she awakened and experienced life within the Holy Dynasty Great Qi.

Others were scenes from before she had been captured by the Fishing Pond, together with those survivors from the various worlds.

“I wonder whether all those people are truly dead.” Hundred Flowers could not help thinking this.

Just as she was lost in thought, a ripple in the space ahead drew her attention.

After sensing that familiar aura, her tense nerves instantly relaxed again.

“Senior Hundred Flowers.”

The visitor was none other than the Holy Emperor’s eldest disciple, Sun Erlang.

“You came looking for another beating?” The moment Hundred Flowers saw Sun Erlang’s expression, she understood his purpose and could not help feeling somewhat helpless.

Sun Erlang frankly admitted it. “This junior returned to cultivate for a while and feels he has improved again, so I came to seek guidance from Senior once more.”

Hundred Flowers smiled. “I already told you not to listen to that Qiao Gong's braggart boasting so loudly, claiming his puppets can rival Longevity Immortal cultivators. In the end, they are merely piles of dead objects. How could they truly compare to cultivators like us?”

Before Sun Erlang could reply, the voice of Master Qiao Gong had already sounded.

“Whether they can or cannot is not decided through boasting. We will see the truth with our hands! Boy Sun, teach her a proper lesson!”

Sun Erlang cupped his fists. “Senior, please be careful… This time is truly different from before.”

Before his words had even fallen, Sun Erlang’s figure disappeared from Hundred Flowers’ divine sense perception.

A trace of seriousness flashed through Hundred Flowers’ eyes as she transformed into a streak of golden light and flew into the endless void opened by the Rift-Splitting Whale.

She faintly sensed that many presences were secretly following behind her.

“They should be puppets controlled by that boy. Yet even my divine sense cannot lock onto them?”

Daoist Hundred Flowers finally became somewhat interested.

A glazed golden flower appeared in her hand with a slight movement of thought.

Then, in an instant, it suddenly bloomed.

Petals drifted down one after another, yet the glazed flower itself showed no signs of damage. Before long, the surrounding void around Daoist Hundred Flowers was already enveloped by billions of golden flower petals.

Bang!

Bang!

The petals scattered through the air, continuously colliding with the hidden puppets following in secret.

One after another, puppets coated in dark golden paint gradually revealed their true forms.

There were five in total, and they had silently surrounded Hundred Flowers at the center.

Daoist Hundred Flowers teased, “Young Sun knows he cannot win, so a duel became a group beating?”

Sun Erlang’s responding voice came through, though it did not originate from any of the puppets.

“Senior misunderstands. These puppets are all controlled by me alone. So it still counts as fair…”

Within the void, five nearly identical voices echoed simultaneously alongside Sun Erlang’s words.

“Gold of Rifted Space!”

“Wood of Entanglement!”

“Water of Extinguishing Life!”

“Fire of Burning Intent!”

“Earth of Nothingness!”

Strange Five Elements powers emerged respectively from the five puppets. They did not rush to attack Hundred Flowers, but instead instantly formed into a formation.

The hundred flowers within the formation seemed to instantly leave the void and return to the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven.

However, this Five Elements Cave Heaven was not full of vibrant life. Instead, it was filled with a chilling aura of slaughter.

Every strand of Five Elements energy within the Cave Heaven resembled a sharp sword. Upon sensing Hundred Flowers as an outsider, they launched frenzied attacks.

The Gold of Rifted Space moved silently, its sharpness capable of tearing apart space itself.

The Wood of Entanglement searched through the void for targets. Once it latched onto something, it would never stop until death.

The Water of Extinguishing Life snuffed out all vitality. Even the glazed golden flowers released by Hundred Flowers rapidly withered after coming into contact with it.

...

The Five Elements generated one another, with the five forces endlessly transforming into each other without cease.

Trapped within the formation, Hundred Flowers seemed to have endured several days of siege already, yet the attacks showed no sign of weakening.

“This is a Five Elements Killing Formation.”

“The five puppets should be serving as the formation core. Rather than fighting directly, they transformed into formation eyes...”

While Hundred Flowers was pondering this, she failed to notice that an obsidian-gold puppet had silently appeared behind her.

Hidden within the violent Five Elements aura, it resembled a golden sword as it slashed down decisively.

The sound of metal striking metal echoed throughout the Five Elements Killing Formation. Hundred Flowers Daoist’s body instantly became transparent.

A glazed golden flower bloomed within her body.

Under the radiance of its light, even the sword embedded in her body gradually became glazed and transparent.

The power of the Gold of Rifted Space erupted violently, breaking free from the glazed corruption before vanishing once again and hiding within the chaotic Five Elements Killing Formation.

“Not bad.”

Hundred Flowers Daoist revealed her true appearance before Sun Erlang for the first time and gave a faint praise.

“If it were the former me, I would likely have been severely injured by that strike.”

“Unfortunately...”

Within Hundred Flowers Daoist’s transparent body, the glazed flower rapidly expanded.

Under the pure glazed radiance, the violent Five Elements power was completely assimilated into solid glazed crystals.

In merely a few breaths, the glazed flower swept through everything around it, engulfing the entire formation space.

Clang!

A slender finger extended out from the solid crystal.

It lightly tapped upon the condensed flower.

A crack appeared, then rapidly spread across the entire flower body.

Bang!

The flower exploded into countless fragments. The originally violent Five Elements Killing Formation completely turned into emptiness.

Hundred Flowers also returned to her original form and gazed around her surroundings.

However, what caused her expression to slightly change was that this technique, [Pure Life Glaze], which could annihilate an entire small world in an instant, seemingly had not broken the Five Elements Killing Formation at all.

Within the void, chaotic auras once again began to emerge.

After discerning them, Hundred Flowers immediately understood.

“So it is not a Five Elements Killing Formation, but a Yin-Yang Five Elements Grand Formation.”

The Yin and Yang energies circulated and intertwined. Within the chaos, the aura of the Five Elements emerged once more, endlessly regenerating.

Before long, the void that had only briefly calmed became lively once again.

Seeing this, Hundred Flowers could not help but slightly frown.

She could easily destroy the formation, yet she could not stop the process of Yin and Yang generating the Five Elements.

Even if she annihilated it again and again, the killing intent directed toward her within the void remained endless.

“After combining the powers of the Five Elements and Yin-Yang with formation techniques, although the destructive power has not increased much, it has indeed become far more troublesome.”

Although Hundred Flowers understood a little about formations, she could not sense any traces of a formation around her.

“Hahahaha! Hundred Flowers, you are out of options now, aren’t you? Hurry up and surrender obediently!” Master Qiao Gong’s arrogant voice echoed throughout the killing formation.

Hundred Flowers let out a cold snort, and dazzling golden light shone within her eyes.

“Boy Sun, be careful. We finally forced her to use this move. Let us see how our prepared countermeasure performs.”

After receiving the augmentation of source power essence, Hundred Flowers’ glazed radiance seemed to become even purer.

It was as if even space itself had crystallized. A glittering gemstone slowly formed around her.

The Yin-Yang energies that nurtured the Five Elements, as well as the structural framework maintaining the formation itself, no longer had any place to remain under the oppression of such pure power.

Light from the outside world shone inward. This killing formation was on the verge of being broken by Hundred Flowers.

“You think you are the only one with source power essence?!”

At that moment, Master Qiao Gong’s somewhat smug voice rang out once more.

A finger formed entirely from golden light suddenly appeared before Hundred Flowers without any warning, ignoring the already solidified glazed crystals.

The crystals shattered violently, turning into streams of radiant fragments. The golden finger was unstoppable as it ruthlessly pressed toward the center of her forehead.

Hundred Flowers’ expression changed slightly, and her body once again transformed into a pure glazed state.

Bathed in the same golden radiance, Hundred Flowers clashed against the golden finger.

To her astonishment, the source power essence golden finger that looked so terrifying was merely an empty shell.

It collapsed upon contact, transforming into countless golden threads that wrapped around her body from head to toe.

“Boy Sun, reel in the net!” Master Qiao Gong shouted excitedly.

The golden threads spread in an instant. Crossing horizontally and vertically, they caught the Daoist Hundred Flowers completely off guard and trapped her within the net.

The glazed flower tried to bloom with radiance, but upon colliding with the golden net, its light was erased into nothingness.

A tremendous force came from within the golden net. Hundred Flowers was dragged away in a miserable state, violently pulled forward at extreme speed.

“How presumptuous!”

This time, Hundred Flowers was truly enraged.

“All living beings are glass!”

Within her icy cold shout, the figure of Hundred Flowers, who had seemed already captured, suddenly vanished.

The glazed flower also underwent a transformation. Petals drifted down one after another, but this time, after falling, they completely disappeared without a trace. In an instant, its inner true form was revealed.

Within the shifting radiance, there was astonishingly an entire glazed world.

The glass world froze over, and countless living beings abruptly opened their eyes.

Hiss...

The enormous golden net wrapped around the world instantly developed countless tiny cracks.

The shocked and furious voice of Master Qiao Gong rang out: “Did you not say before that you escaped after abandoning your world?! I never expected that you actually refined the entire Wansheng Realm into a glazed state!”

“What a vicious woman!”

From within the glazed world came the voice of Hundred Flowers Daoist: “What do you understand! This was for survival!”

“Not just for myself, but for the entire Heavenly Lotus Sect!”

Amid Hundred Flowers’ furious shout, dazzling brilliance erupted from the glazed world, completely breaking free from the golden net restraining it.

“Boy Sun, retreat quickly!”

“Senior, please forgive us…”

She vaguely heard the somewhat battered voice of Master Qiao Gong, along with the helpless voice of Sun Erlang.

When she returned to the void, the two of them were already nowhere to be seen.

The glazed flower bloomed once more, concealing the glazed Wansheng Realm within its center. Hundred Flowers Daoist also returned to her original appearance.

She did not pursue them and instead returned to the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven.

“After finally fighting a battle, things are not quite so boring anymore. I wonder when we will truly go to war with the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance?”

“If we can truly escape the Immortal Ruins, or even the entire Darkest Star Sea, perhaps the Heavenly Lotus Sect may one day reappear beneath the heavens.” Hundred Flowers Daoist pondered silently.

Toward the Holy Emperor of Great Qi, she possessed a special kind of confidence.

Hundred Flowers casually glanced once more toward the void beyond.

There, at the place where the Holy Emperor had once gone, she faintly sensed an energy that caused the entire glazed Wansheng Realm to tremble slightly in fear.

“What a maniac…”

Within the Holy Dynasty Great Qi, the somewhat disheveled Qiao Gong cursed nonstop while looking rather distressed at the seven dark golden puppets before him.

“I should have realized it long ago. Anyone capable of surviving the world extinction catastrophe could never be some simple character. Seeing how submissive she acted before the Holy Emperor earlier, I actually got deceived by her…”

“Qiao Gong, Qiao Gong, you truly have become muddleheaded!”

Sun Erlang remained silent.

The strength suddenly displayed by Senior Hundred Flowers, who had always appeared gentle and amiable, was indeed somewhat terrifying.

However, the purpose of challenging her this time had also been achieved.

Sun Erlang looked toward the seven dark golden puppets in the field.

Through these puppet bodies, he had not only become more familiar with the power of the seven Spirit of Heaven and Earth within the puppet cores.

He had also vaguely gained a deeper mastery over source power essence.

“No! I refuse to believe it! I, the great Qiao Gong of the Heavenly Mechanism Realm, will not lose to a mere Wansheng Realm!” Beside him, Qiao Gong spoke fiercely and took something out from his robes.

“Boy Sun, install this into those puppets!” Qiao Gong said viciously.

“What is this?”

Sun Erlang looked curiously at the square black object in Qiao Gong’s hand.

“Hehehe, this is the ‘experience’ extracted from the Immortal Puppet Ancestor by our Heavenly Mechanism Realm back then. It cannot be replicated. Ever since the Heavenly Mechanism Realm was destroyed, every use means one less remaining. I was unwilling to use it before, but now…” Qiao Gong looked at it with reluctance before finally gritting his teeth.

“No matter what, I cannot lose to that woman!”

When Sun Erlang heard the words Immortal Puppet, his heart trembled slightly.

Just as he was about to receive it, he suddenly remembered something and hesitated. “Such a precious item should probably be left for Senior Tianyang? Perhaps it would be more useful to him…”

Qiao Gong waved his hand dismissively. “I already gave him a copy long ago. Why do you think you have not seen him for so long? He has been in secluded cultivation comprehending it and still has not emerged!”

“Enough nonsense. Do as I say! Hurry, or I might regret it in a moment!”

Hearing this, Sun Erlang no longer acted coyly.

His mind connected simultaneously with the seven dark golden puppets as he crushed the square black object in his hand.

Black liquid flowed out through the gaps between his fingers.

Like a living creature, it crawled upward along Sun Erlang’s arm until it reached his head. It resembled a hunting cobra, raising itself high before suddenly drilling directly into his eye sockets.

Out of trust toward Qiao Gong, Sun Erlang did not resist.

The instant the black liquid covered his vision, the environment he sensed completely changed.

A vast number of blurry images surged toward him like a tidal wave. Accompanying them were fragmented and discontinuous battle memories.

Or more accurately, memories of being beaten.

Mysterious and unfathomable spells continuously bombarded the Immortal Puppet’s body.

The Immortal Puppet could only rely on its own incomparably sturdy material to endure them head on, with very few opportunities to counterattack.

Yet even merely enduring the attacks caused mysterious and profound insights to arise within Sun Erlang’s heart.

After being beaten countless times, Sun Erlang seemed to gradually form a certain instinct.

Whenever an immortal technique attack appeared again within his mind, his body would instinctively generate a feeling of how to respond to that spell.

This sensation completely immersed Sun Erlang.

Unfortunately, just as he seemed about to truly comprehend something, all the scenes suddenly vanished. And the various insights from before also receded like a retreating tide, leaving behind no trace at all.

“Urgh…”

Veins bulged across Sun Erlang’s forehead. His fists clenched tightly as he gasped heavily.

His eyes turned bloodshot as he stared fixedly at Master Qiao Gong.

Qiao Gong seemed to have long been prepared for this and had already stayed far away. He coldly said, “Boy Sun, clear your head. Do not be deceived by illusion.”

“Those feelings of being on the verge of Dao comprehension, do they truly come from yourself, or from the Immortal Puppet?”

Qiao Gong’s words were like a bucket of ice water poured over his head, instantly waking Sun Erlang considerably.

Yet even so, it still took him nearly half a day to slowly suppress the thought in his heart. Because of the intense feeling of loss, he had almost tried to seize the Immortal Puppet experience from Qiao Gong and continue comprehending it himself.

“I am sorry, senior,” Sun Erlang said somewhat ashamed.

“It is fine. You need not blame yourself. Forget you, even the old fellows of our Heavenly Mechanism Realm could not resist this kind of temptation at all.” Qiao Gong licked his lips, seemingly savoring the taste of Dao comprehension.

“Now look again and see what is different from before,” Qiao Gong instructed.

Sun Erlang turned his attention back to the five dark golden puppets. A moment later, a trace of delight flashed in his eyes.

“Hm? Those memories of being beaten are appearing again…”

Sun Erlang closed his eyes and carefully sensed them.

Qiao Gong clapped his hands, and thousands of Holy Army puppets appeared one after another.

Relying on mechanical instinct, they simultaneously launched attacks toward the dark golden puppets controlled by Sun Erlang.

As if tempered through countless trials, every different spell technique and move was effortlessly avoided by Sun Erlang.

Even Sun Erlang himself was stunned by such results.

He could not even understand why those attacks clearly landed upon the dark golden puppets he controlled, yet ultimately caused no damage at all.

It was not because of the dark golden puppets’ powerful defensive abilities neutralizing the attacks.

Rather, through some incomparably mysterious method, all the Holy Army puppets’ attacks had truly been evaded.

“Do not lose focus. Maintain this instinctive feeling as much as possible!”

“The remnants of the Immortal Puppet’s experience will dissipate very quickly. As for how much you can ultimately retain, that depends on your own fortune!”

Master Qiao Gong’s words immediately snapped Sun Erlang back to his senses.

He cast aside all distracting thoughts and concentrated fully on memorizing the Immortal Puppet’s evasion instinct.

But after all, this was a divine ability belonging to an Immortal Puppet, not something mortal means could permanently preserve.

Even though Sun Erlang had already done his utmost, as time gradually passed, the number of times the dark golden puppets he controlled were struck inevitably increased.

After persisting for seven full days, the evasion probability finally stabilized at a fixed value.

“One third.”

“That is already a fairly good result.”

Qiao Gong comforted him.

Sun Erlang was clearly somewhat unwilling to accept it.

“You need not worry. As you continue comprehending it in the future, your evasion ability will still improve to a certain extent. But if you wish to reach the Immortal Puppet’s level, moving according to thought itself and evading so called divine abilities and spell attacks…”

“I fear you would have to break through the mortal limit.” Qiao Gong spoke truthfully.

Sun Erlang let out a long breath, and the regret in his heart slowly subsided.

“Do not underestimate this one third chance. In life and death combat, it often produces miraculous effects. Even if someone’s strength far surpasses yours, their attacks may still be unconsciously evaded by you.”

“More importantly, you can simultaneously control seven puppets. In actual battle, because the seven puppet bodies share se

nsory perception, the practical effect will be slightly higher than this value…”

Qiao Gong began summarizing and analyzing the gains from this experience with Sun Erlang.

“If you were to spar with Hundred Flowers again now, there would be a high probability that you could evade the Glazed Flower Golden Light of the Wansheng Realm. As long as the formation remains unbroken, she would merely be a turtle trapped in a jar…” Qiao Gong still seemed somewhat unconvinced by Hundred Flowers and spoke in a muffled tone.

While the two were conversing, they suddenly noticed the surrounding space faintly trembling.

“Hm?”

Sun Erlang and Qiao Gong were both startled at first, then simultaneously flew outside the testing grounds.

It was not only their location. The entire Holy Dynasty Great Qi had fallen into violent trembling.

In the sky above, a vortex faintly appeared.

Bolts of thunder roared continuously within it.

“This is…”

A trace of pleasant surprise flashed through Sun Erlang’s eyes.

He had experienced a similar scene before.

It was a phenomenon that occurred whenever the overall environment of the Holy Dynasty underwent ascension.

After the previous transformation, the concentration of spiritual qi within the Holy Dynasty had increased severalfold. Moreover, the number of outstanding talents born into the world had also clearly risen compared to the past.

The current cultivation environment of the Holy Dynasty was already no worse than that of an ordinary prefecture in the Xuanhuang Realm. If it ascended once again.

Would it not leave the Xuanhuang Realm far behind?

Not only the disciples of the Holy Emperor, but all the citizens of the Holy Dynasty also walked out from their homes at this moment, gazing excitedly toward the heavens.

As the most direct beneficiaries of the world’s ascension, the citizens of the Holy Dynasty, without any summons, all knelt upon the ground together and began devoutly chanting praises to the Holy Emperor in prayer.

If Li Ping had been present, he would have seen that the fortune of the Holy Dynasty, which had already been refined to the utmost limit, now actually showed signs of another breakthrough.

It was only that taking this next step was extremely difficult.

At present, it was merely the beginning.

Amid the chants of the Holy Dynasty’s citizens, dense purple qi, almost tangible in form, drifted out from all regions and was absorbed by the vortex in the sky.

The sounds of wind and thunder intensified. The peals of thunder were so fierce that even Sun Erlang faintly felt his soul trembling.

From above his head, he sensed waves of pressure growing increasingly heavier.

It caused him to lower his head slightly.

“Master has broken through again.”

A trace of realization arose in Sun Erlang’s heart.

From the expressions of Su Yuqing, Ou Shangtian, and the other disciples of the Holy Emperor, Sun Erlang could see that they shared the same thought as him.

The vortex in the heavens spun faster and faster. Streams of starlight continuously burst forth from within it, scattering toward every corner of the world.

Where vegetation was touched, it grew at a speed visible to the naked eye.

Where living beings came into contact with it, it was as though enlightenment had been poured directly into their minds, allowing them to instantly comprehend the Dao.

Several especially concentrated and vast streams of starlight shot out like ribbons, flying accurately toward Sun Erlang and the others.

This even included cultivators such as Qiao Gong and Hundred Flowers, who had been recruited by the Holy Emperor.

The moment the starlight entered his body, the scene before Sun Erlang’s eyes abruptly changed.

It was as if he had truly arrived in the endless void beyond the Xuanhuang Realm. Sun Erlang saw that within the dead silence and darkness, countless terrifying powers of calamity lurked and raged.

Sun Erlang also saw that even within this dreadful Darkest Star Sea of extinction, countless Star Sea Daos were still stubbornly reviving.

“Light hides beneath darkness...”

“Life is born from silence and death.”

Like a devout believer comprehending the Dao, Sun Erlang personally witnessed the vastness and resilience of the star sea, and could not help but shed tears.

The other cultivators within the Holy Dynasty were the same.

Waves of mysterious energy fluctuations burst forth from their bodies and surged toward the heavens.

Their shared enlightenment and comprehension caused the trembling of the Great Qi small world to intensify once more.

These fluctuations even spread beyond the world itself and diffused into the void.

The Five Elements Cave Heavens surrounding Great Qi, as well as the other small worlds that had been relocated here, were all affected and began resonating at the same frequency.

Like the rhythm of a heartbeat, it seemed as though something was being nurtured within this pulsing sound.

All living beings within the Great Qi small world seemed to sense something in their hearts as they raised their heads and gazed toward the vortex in the sky.

Under the gaze of countless eyes, a majestic figure passed through the wind, thunder, and lightning, through the purple qi and the hazy, mysterious starlight.

Slowly descending into the world.

“Welcome, Holy Emperor!”

Hundreds of millions of Great Qi citizens knelt and shouted in unison, their voices shaking mountains and seas.

However, the disciples of the Holy Emperor, as well as Hundred Flowers, Qiao Gong, Yin Shangren, and the others, discovered with some shock that the faceless Holy Emperor they were familiar with now had a face growing upon that previously blank visage.

After hesitating only briefly, the aura emanating from the Holy Emperor unquestionably confirmed his true identity.

The Holy Emperor stood above the nine heavens, overlooking all living beings below.

With a gentle wave of his hand, all the kneeling citizens rose to their feet.

Chapter 1285: The Immortal Ancestor At Fifty Years Old

The vortex in the sky was about to heal. The Holy Emperor stretched out his hand and grasped the final beam of starlight shooting forth from within.

Nebulae flowed and shimmered brilliantly. After being refined within the Holy Emperor’s palm, the starlight flowed downward like a gentle stream beneath him.

It transformed into a throne of starlight.

The Holy Emperor sat upright upon it, his voice like thunder as he slowly spoke:

“From obscure chaos and boundless primordial origin; yin and yang divided, the five elements circulated; all things emerged, created from the One…”

Every word and sentence was profoundly mysterious and incomprehensible.

Yet under the Holy Emperor’s recitation, all living beings fortunate enough to hear within this world faintly developed a sense of understanding.

The fleeting sensation of enlightenment brought by the starlight overhead once again became clear amidst the Holy Emperor’s grand Dao voice.

“The Dao follows heaven and earth, grasp it and become immortal; wander freely through the azure void, command creation itself; endure through countless tribulations, qi nurturing the eight desolations…”

Even those with mediocre talent and low cultivation seemed to gain enlightenment from the Holy Emperor’s voice.

The surrounding spiritual qi spontaneously poured into their bodies, presenting the scene of instant enlightenment upon the spot.

As for those with exceptional talent such as Sun Erlang and Ou Shangtian, their eyes shone brightly, and streams of purple qi even gathered around them.

Yin Shangren scratched his scalp. He felt as though the foundation of his Oneself Dao Foundation within his body could not wait to burst forth.

“So this is what they mean by one person attaining the Dao and even chickens and dogs ascend to heaven? No, this is clearly selflessly passing one’s own comprehension onto others regardless of closeness or distance. Hiss…”

The Holy Emperor’s transmission of the Dao lasted for three days and three nights.

The enlightened people listened as though intoxicated and entranced.

Even after the Holy Emperor’s image dispersed, they still remained immersed within it, completely unaware.

For the vast majority of them, the Holy Emperor’s teachings would require the remainder of their lives to fully digest.

At this moment, the Holy Emperor had already returned to the Holy Emperor Throne.

His six disciples stood in order below him.

“Congratulations to Master on attaining the Dao!” Sun Erlang bowed and said.

The remaining disciples followed suit.

“This is your master’s fortune, and also your fortune.”

“Three years.”

“I will give you three years to comprehend. Three years from today…”

The Holy Emperor’s gaze swept across the six disciples below.

“My Holy Dynasty Great Qi shall launch its campaign against the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and reclaim the Xuanhuang Realm!”

The six disciples all trembled upon hearing this.

They had long known that this battle would inevitably arrive. Yet none of them had expected the day to come so quickly.

However, at such a moment, no one dared question the decision of the great Holy Emperor.

They all lowered their heads and acknowledged the order.

“During these three years of preparation, certain methods can already be put into action ahead of time.”

The Holy Emperor’s voice echoed within everyone’s hearts.

…

Xuanhuang Realm, Tianquan Prefecture.

Sun Luyuan was currently speaking eloquently at a gathering when he suddenly sensed something. He quickly cut short his lengthy speech.

Then, while no one paid attention, he hurriedly departed from the cave residence.

“The Dark Needle Plan is finally about to be implemented? I have waited far too long for this day.” A sharp light flashed through Sun Luyuan’s eyes. He suppressed the excitement and slight fear for the future within his heart, concealed his aura, and headed toward the agreed meeting place.

The so called Dark Needle Plan was a sabotage operation targeting the Tianxuan Mirrors and teleportation formations of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance controlled the majority of the prefectures within the Xuanhuang Realm, yet could still command them as easily as moving one’s own limbs precisely because of the Tianxuan Mirrors and Teleportation Formations spread throughout every prefecture.

No matter which prefecture encountered trouble, reinforcements from other prefectures or even the Immortal Alliance headquarters could arrive swiftly.

Therefore, if one wished to oppose the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, disabling or interfering with this connection became the highest priority.

“Previously, that boy Ou Shangtian said he could influence or even destroy the Tianxuan Mirror clones in every prefecture. I wonder what method he actually intends to use. However, the deathsworn soldiers in every prefecture have long since been prepared.” As Sun Luyuan hurried onward, he continuously pondered.

He knew that once the bowstring was released there would be no turning back. Once they acted, he would completely become a traitor to the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance. If discovered, there would absolutely be no chance of survival.

Yet Sun Luyuan had already made up his mind.

Aside from the previous reasons that drove him toward betrayal, the even greater factor was Sun Luchang’s death not long ago.

When Sun Luchang had been selected to head beyond the Xuanhuang Realm, Sun Luyuan still retained a slight hope for his survival.

Only when the mass of essence blood left within the underground blood pool suddenly dried up did Sun Luyuan completely despair.

During these past days, he watched as the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance still occasionally released rainbow light messages regarding those who had departed the realm. Among them even appeared images of the already deceased Sun Luchang.

The anger within his heart accumulated further and further.

Sun Luyuan had been waiting for the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance to give him an explanation.

Even a perfunctory consolation would have sufficed.

But clearly, he had overestimated his own importance. The Dao Integration guardians of each prefecture and those so called high ministers of the Immortal Alliance truly were nothing more than expendable materials. They could be discarded at will.

“Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance…” At this point, Sun Luyuan had completely abandoned all hope in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

He had entirely defected to the Holy Dynasty Great Qi. “Setting everything else aside, the benefits I have obtained from the Holy Dynasty these past years far exceed what I gained from desperately serving the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.”

While thinking this, Sun Luyuan arrived at the agreed meeting place.

Beside the white mist barrier that towered between heaven and earth in Tianquan Prefecture.

Several years ago, because of the great upheaval of the Xuanhuang Realm, the white mist barrier here had broken apart midway and crashed heavily to the ground. Freed from restraint, the Essence Devouring White Mist spread wildly in all directions, mercilessly devouring every living being it engulfed.

Although the great upheaval later gradually subsided and the white mist barrier restored itself, this land of death never regained life.

This alone demonstrated the terrifying nature of the Essence Devouring White Mist.

“Who would have imagined that the Holy Dynasty actually possesses a method capable of almost completely isolating the influence of the Essence Devouring White Mist? Meeting in this place could not be safer!”

After carefully surveying his surroundings and ensuring no one had followed him, Sun Luyuan cautiously took out the Samantabhadra True Boat.

He flew into the vessel and guided it into the white mist barrier.

Maintaining a constant speed while continuously changing direction, he traveled for some time before finally seeing another Samantabhadra True Boat quietly suspended within the white mist.

A streak of black light flew out from it, slightly parting the mist as it arrived before Sun Luyuan.

Sun Luyuan caught it and discovered it was a storage ring made from black jade. When he looked up again, the previous Samantabhadra True Boat had already vanished without a trace.

“So cautious. They are unwilling to even show themselves.”

Inside the black jade storage ring were nearly a thousand square jade artifacts arranged neatly in rows, each engraved with mysterious characters.

Sun Luyuan took out one of the jade artifacts and carefully examined it while reading the usage method that had just been transmitted through the black light.

“As long as it is brought into a Tianxuan Mirror sub-mirror or a teleportation formation and then detonated with a spell technique?”

“It is that simple?” Sun Luyuan was somewhat shocked.

He immediately felt the urge to test it first. However, after carefully inspecting it for a while, he could only shake his head helplessly.

“A detonation time has already been set. It can only explode after three years. Before that time arrives, even the core formation inside has not been activated. It is merely an ordinary jade artifact…”

“No wonder I could not sense even the slightest spiritual energy fluctuation.”

Sun Luyuan put the jade artifact away again, his expression gloomy.

“Let those cultivators whom the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance regards as ants ring its death knell first.”

Just as the various regions of the Holy Dynasty began moving for the conquest planned three years later.

Li Fan had already used the Spiritual Void Grand Formation to annihilate four small worlds.

He collected enough material that he referred to as the “Essence of All Things.”

A pure aggregate of energy, emitting a dreamlike five colored viscous glow. To Li Fan, it felt somewhat similar to golden source power essence.

“Have you learned this formation yet?” Li Fan gazed into the distance while asking the Boundless Mirror.

Sun Luyao, whose artificial personality had been reforged several times, remained silent briefly before finally replying, “I have mostly learned it, Senior.”

Li Fan nodded in satisfaction. With a light tap of his finger, a ray of light entered Sun Luyao’s phantom figure.

“Then next, go to these locations and continue setting up formations there.”

“You only need to secretly establish the formations. There is no need to activate them.”

As he spoke, Li Fan flicked all the source power essence he had gathered during his recent return to the Sun family toward the Boundless Mirror.

Sun Luyao hurriedly stored away the golden light and enthusiastically thanked Li Fan.

Afterward, he transformed into a streak of light and headed toward the target small worlds.

If it had been the real Sun Luyao carrying out Li Fan’s task alone, he might have obeyed on the surface while secretly resisting. But now he was merely an artificial personality.

Even the joy he felt upon receiving the source power essence was fabricated, so naturally he would not disobey Li Fan’s commands.

“The formations arranged by the Boundless Mirror spirit are even weaker than mine. But destroying a world is still more than enough. After all, the worlds I selected for him are all weak small worlds without cultivators.”

“Although I probably will not appear again in this life, leaving behind some backup measures is only proper.”

His connection with the Holy Emperor had already been completely severed. Yet Li Fan could still faintly sense the enormous changes occurring within the Holy Emperor.

“Did he gain another enlightenment within the star sea?”

“Even though the clone’s original talent was merely ordinary, after receiving so many opportunities and fortunes, he has actually begun to resemble a true child of destiny…” A trace of mockery flashed across Li Fan’s face.

“What a pity. It is destined to be futile!”

Li Fan’s split divine sense transformed into a thin line and flew toward Guangyang Prefecture.

He intended to transfer the “Essence of All Things” gathered for protection into the hands of his main body.

In less than half a day, Li Fan had already found his target.

It was the Daoist Qianxun, cultivating in the mortal world while concealing his identity.

Li Fan’s split soul silently drifted into the body of a nearby Golden Core cultivator. That person’s body paused slightly before quickly returning to normal.

Changing direction, he arrived before the Daoist Qianxun.

“Old sir, shall we play a game of Go?”

The slovenly Daoist, who was scratching his feet without any regard for appearance, immediately raised his head.

…

After successfully obtaining the Derivation Attendee Jade Token from Daoist Qianxun, Li Fan first went to the Dao Discussion Tower in Guangyang Prefecture and used all his savings to rent a small courtyard.

Then, using the Dao Pill method, he completely seized possession of the cultivator’s body he had inhabited.

Li Fan raised his hand and examined this brand new body, slightly frowning.

“Compared to the environment of the Xuan Immortal Ark exposed within the Star Sea, this possession method seems less perfect within the Xuanhuang Realm.”

Li Fan moved around and felt slight disharmony.

“Possessing Zhao Xian was enough to deceive the Severed Immortal Tower.”

“But possessing this one…”

“Fu Yuansheng may not necessarily evade the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s inspection. It still requires further refinement.”

Li Fan controlled Fu Yuansheng’s body and arranged a circle of formations around the area.

Then he strode directly into the formation.

“Using the body as a vessel, refining it through formations…”

Li Fan murmured softly. Borrowing the power of the formation, he slowly polished away the disharmonious parts within the possessed body.

During this process, the experiences of the Holy Emperor’s cultivation in this life, the Holy Embryo’s experiences aboard the Xuan Immortal Ark, and the insights gained by his main body during secluded cultivation all surged into his mind simultaneously.

Li Fan integrated them all together.

His fingers moved repeatedly, modifying and perfecting the formation he had just established.

The abnormalities between body and soul gradually disappeared completely during this process.

“From today onward, I am Fu Yuansheng!” Li Fan’s split soul smiled faintly.

To verify it, Li Fan first entered the Tianxuan Mirror sub-mirror in Guangyang Province.

As expected, he deceived the Tianxuan Mirror’s inspection and successfully entered the Tianxuan Mirror space under Fu Yuansheng’s identity.

“Only two thousand contribution points…”

“How truly miserable.”

Li Fan shook his head and sighed, but made no changes.

He merely rested briefly as usual before leaving the Tianxuan Mirror.

Walking to the busiest district of Guangyang Heavenly City, he activated the Derivation Attendee Jade Token.

The suddenly erupting light instantly drew everyone’s attention.

“What is that?”

“That kind of jade token… wait, could it actually be that thing?!”

People quickly recognized the object in Li Fan’s hand. Cries of shock and disbelief rang out one after another.

Curious cultivators surrounded Li Fan so tightly that not even water could pass through. Li Fan also deliberately put on a pale faced appearance, as though he were struggling to endure the strain.

As the guiding cultivator arrived, the chaotic scene finally began to calm down.

“Silence!”

The pressure emanating from the guiding cultivator unmistakably revealed his Soul Transformation realm strength.

The surrounding crowd instantly fell silent as cicadas in winter. The guiding cultivator weighed the jade token in his hand, yet did not immediately bring Li Fan to the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters.

Sun Ang, who was actually Li Fan’s true body, sensed the already obtained “Essence of All Things.”

He excused himself by saying, “No. My mind simply feels unsettled…”

“Perhaps something has happened to my bloodline family.”

“The several hidden agents we planted within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance have also completed coordination. Once the time arrives, the Tianxuan Mirrors and teleportation formations in every prefecture of the alliance will all fail simultaneously.”

A simplified map of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s territory appeared before everyone.

“At that time, every prefecture will become an isolated island, unable to care for one another. Their strength has already been thoroughly investigated. Defeating them one by one will not be difficult.”

“The most critical point remains the four central prefectures and the headquarters of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.”

After scanning through the roster of cultivators stationed across the various prefectures, Sun Erlang focused his gaze upon the very center of the map.

After pondering for a moment, Sun Erlang spoke:

“When Master summoned me previously, he vaguely revealed that at the appropriate time, he will employ a heaven-defying method to directly seal off the four central prefectures and the headquarters of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance. We should not need to worry about reinforcements from the alliance headquarters. We only need to focus on ending the battles in each prefecture as quickly as possible.”

“In addition, the secret realms of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance hidden within the White Mist and across the various prefectures will all be sealed using formations before the war begins. Hidden Dragon Abyss, Phoenix Mist City, Vast Mountain, and Chizha Immortal City. Although the strength stationed in each place is not great individually, together they are still not to be underestimated. They must be defeated separately.”

The others all listened seriously to Sun Erlang’s explanation of the battle plan.

Only Ou Shangtian maintained a playful grin.

“I have personally experienced the formation standards of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance. They are simply not worth mentioning. Since Master personally created the sealing formations, trapping them for a year or even longer will be effortless!”

“Though… could there perhaps be a shortage of formation materials?” Ou Shangtian suddenly frowned in confusion.

Sun Erlang smiled slightly and took out a piece of Voidbright Motherstone, placing it before everyone.

Ou Shangtian swept his gaze across the supplies stored within the Motherstone and immediately shot to his feet in shock.

“So much? Did you rob the treasury of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance?”

Sun Erlang laughed heartily. “Master gave me a total of three. Each Motherstone is packed completely full. As far as I know, Senior Ou Daozi’s side has also been granted sufficient supplies. So you do not need to worry about strategic resources. Just prepare for the formation setup.”

When Ou Shangtian heard his father mentioned, his eyes lit up and he nodded repeatedly.

Sun Erlang then looked toward the duo Su Yuqing and Liuli, who had remained silent the entire time.

Ever since they had been sent by the Holy Emperor to guard the underground world of darkness, it was as though they had truly been tainted by that darkness and changed temperament, becoming much more taciturn.

“Junior Sister, how is the formation of the small world reinforcements progressing?” Sun Erlang asked aloud.

“Faster than expected. Rest assured, the Federation of All Worlds army will certainly arrive at the battlefield on time.” Su Yuqing replied softly, though her tone carried a firmness she had never possessed before.

During her process of enlightening the You Clan Race in the underground dark world, she had vaguely sensed a possible connection between the Heavenly Dao of small worlds and the living beings within them.

In addition, because of her experience in the Li Realm, where she had received the favor and possession of the Heavenly Dao itself, she was naturally far more capable than ordinary cultivators at gaining the affinity of the Heavenly Dao of small worlds.

Relying on this advantage, under the Holy Emperor’s orders, she traveled between different small worlds.

Using both gentle and forceful methods together, temptation and coercion side by side.

With an efficiency that could only be described as terrifying, she assembled a true “Federation of All Worlds.”

Although she held little expectation for the actual combat power this allied army would display when the time came, its sheer scale and momentum alone would certainly be enough to boost morale.

Most importantly, it eliminated the possibility of them causing trouble while the Holy Dynasty and the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance fought their decisive battle.

“By the way, where did Senior Sister Lin Ling go? Why have we not seen her lately?” Ou Shangtian suddenly asked curiously.

Sun Erlang answered vaguely: “She naturally has duties personally assigned by Master. I am not too clear on the details either. But rest assured, she definitely will not miss this grand feast.”

All the disciples once again looked toward the miniature map of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance in the center of the hall.

Their eyes were filled with impatience and anticipation.

Within the Holy Dynasty secret realm, in the experimental grounds or academy specially created for Yin Shangren.

Yin Shangren scratched his scalp and pushed the True Self Dao Foundation, which had emerged once again from the crack in his skull, back inside.

Somewhat uncertain, he said: “Is doing this a bit too rash?”

“With my Foundation Establishment method, it can indeed be considered a complete victory. But the Primordial Golden Core has only been deduced halfway. As for everything beyond that, it is entirely castles in the air and flowers reflected in the moonlight. At first glance it seems marvelous, but it collapses the moment it is tested. It simply cannot withstand scrutiny!”

Holy Emperor Li Ping was sitting at the wooden table, continuously flipping through illusory pages of text while making edits and revisions.

Around him, phenomena born from Dao comprehension appeared like a galaxy itself, twisting space and flickering in and out of existence.

Yin Shangren forcibly turned his gaze away from the astonishing sight.

Only after a long while, when the Holy Emperor had finished reviewing the entire illusory book and once again started revising it from the first page, did he finally respond:

“As the saying goes, when the false is treated as true, then the false also becomes true. As long as the cultivators of the world believe that this is a ‘New New Method’ capable of escaping the Immortal Ancestor cultivation system and cultivating independently…”

“Even if it only lasts for a few days, that will already be enough.”

“Furthermore, with how obscure the New New Method is, and how completely contrary it is to the Immortal Ancestor method, how long do you think it will take the cultivators of the Xuanhuang Realm to verify whether it is genuine or false?”

As he spoke, the Holy Emperor once again used his hand as a pen to revise the illusory book formed from the New New Method.

Yin Shangren did not answer, merely repeating the phrase: “When the false is treated as true, then the false also becomes true.”

After a long while, realization suddenly dawned upon him.

“I see now. Precisely because the world has never seen the New New Method before, once we publish it, and once the easiest part to verify, the Foundation Establishment method, proves genuine, then people will naturally assume for the time being that all the subsequent techniques are genuine as well.”

“And my repeated revisions are merely to improve the effectiveness of that deception.” The Holy Emperor smiled faintly in self mockery.

“But what is the point? In the end, it still cannot shake the foundation of Immortal Ancestor.” Yin Shangren scratched his scalp again.

“The Immortal Ancestor method and the New New Method are incompatible with one another. To cultivate it, one must switch allegiance and rebuild one’s Dao path from the beginning. Perhaps not even one in a thousand would choose to do so, but even so, one side’s gain is the other side’s loss.”

“And more importantly…”

As the Holy Emperor spoke, he completed yet another round of revisions to the illusory book.

This time, however, he made no further changes and instead closed the book.

Pressing both hands upon it, dazzling starlight surged across its surface.

In scarcely the span of a breath, the originally illusory book composed purely of light and shadow actually gained physical substance.

It became a real book that truly existed in the world.

Handing this copy of the “New New Method” to Yin Shangren, the Holy Emperor stood up and continued:

“And more importantly, if we publish the New New Method, and the Immortal Alliance proves incapable of stopping us…”

“Then Immortal Ancestor will definitely return from the distant starry sky.”

The Holy Emperor spoke in a deep voice.

“This is called attacking what the enemy must save.”

A glimmer flashed through Yin Shangren’s eyes as he slowly nodded.

“You… are you confident about facing Immortal Ancestor?”

After hesitating for a moment, Yin Shangren still asked the question.

The Holy Emperor paused briefly before answering calmly: “At most, it is merely staking everything on a final gamble.”
