Chapter 1287: Upheaval In The Star Sea Begins

“Risking everything...” Yin Shangren fell silent after receiving the answer.

“There is no need to worry. I have already made my plans. Regardless of victory or defeat, the orthodox Xuanhuang lineage will inevitably be reestablished. You and Xu Ke need only do what you wish to do,” Holy Emperor Li Ping said calmly.

“But...” Yin Shangren still hesitated after hearing this.

“The moment Immortal Ancestor appears will be the moment the Holy Dynasty army launches its full scale assault on the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters. You will take advantage of the chaos to infiltrate the Museum of Divine Treasures and bring out Mr. Bai’s skull. At this stage, victory and defeat are matters of the greater tide. Although both of you are not weak, you cannot influence the overall situation. Moreover, the Divine Treasures Pavilion is controlled by the Illusory True Sage lineage of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance. If you can tie them down, that too will be a great contribution.”

A gloomy glint flashed in Yin Shangren’s eyes. “They are merely the lingering souls of the strange beasts from Xuanhuang Realm’s past. If Emperor Yi were still here, I might fear them somewhat. But just Emperor Sanmo...”

“Nothing to fear!” Yin Shangren snorted coldly.

“The Illusory True Sage controls the miraculous artifact [Era]. Even the most mediocre being can produce miracles after hundreds of thousands or millions of simulations and deductions. Do not underestimate them,” Li Ping said seriously.

The Holy Emperor’s words still carried some weight in Yin Shangren’s heart.

He no longer argued, instead narrowing his eyes in thought.

As he thought, a rustling sound once again came from his scalp, like silkworms crawling. His scalp undulated, as though something might emerge at any moment from the crack atop his head.

Yin Shangren instantly became somewhat irritated, while Li Ping flashed to his side.

With a gentle stroke of his palm, under the penetration of tiny points of starlight, the disturbance gradually subsided.

“This is backlash from the True Self. Continuing to forcibly suppress it is not a good solution,” the Holy Emperor said at a glance, having seen through the issue.

Yin Shangren revealed a helpless expression. “I changed paths midway after all, rather than cultivating from the beginning. It was inevitable that various aftereffects would remain. Back then, I thought that as long as I consumed my original imperfect Dao Foundation and recultivated the Oneself Foundation Establishment, everything would be resolved. But recently, after listening to your teachings on the star sea, I gained further insight. Only then did I realize that the self I originally recognized as complete was not truly complete. My foundation has been shaken. It indeed requires further adjustment.”

“Do not worry. I will deal with it before the decisive battle arrives,” Yin Shangren assured him.

“As long as you know.”

The Holy Emperor’s lingering voice echoed, but his figure had already disappeared.

Yin Shangren looked around, only to discover in astonishment that the incomplete New New Method, which had previously materialized from illusion and been taken away by the Holy Emperor, had somehow reappeared on the long table where he had sat.

Knowing this was intentionally left behind for him by the Holy Emperor, Yin Shangren did not stand on ceremony and immediately picked it up to study.

“Marvelous...”

Even though it had merely been compiled to deceive the masses, this half volume of the New New Law still appeared profoundly mysterious in Yin Shangren’s eyes, nearly indistinguishable from a true divine technique.

He quickly became completely engrossed.

Holy Dynasty, Five Elements Great Cave Heaven, Fire Attribute Cave Heaven.

An endless sea of fire, with blazing flames like monstrous waves, erupted from time to time, shooting toward the heavens.

The scorching fire, like wild steeds, devoured everything within the cave heaven.

Yet in the deepest part of this infernal scene, a golden glazed flower bloomed brilliantly. No matter how the surrounding flames raged, the flower remained pristine and clear, utterly unaffected.

At the center of the glazed flower, the image of a world appeared faintly.

From time to time, a strand of golden light drifted out from the glazed world within the flower. When the surrounding flames came into contact with this golden light, they instantly flared explosively, burning even more fiercely.

If viewed from high above, one could see Hundred Flowers Daoist using the golden glaze as a guide to continuously sort and regulate this Fire Cave Heaven.

Compared to when it had first been captured here, not only the Fire Cave Heaven, but the scale of the entire Five Elements Great Cave Heaven had nearly expanded by a full circle. Daoist Hundred Flowers could be said to have rendered great service.

Holy Emperor Li Ping’s figure appeared beside the golden glaze.

The roaring flames instantly withered. They did not even dare approach, merely swaying in the distance as if currying favor.

“You have done well. The Five Elements Cave Heaven has been managed excellently.”

“The other cave heavens as well,” Li Ping said indifferently.

His gaze pierced through the canopy of the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven, reaching directly into the void beyond the world.

The Five Elements Great Cave Heaven, like a powerful navigator, carried the Holy Dynasty Great Qi swiftly through the void.

Around it, nearly a hundred large and small different small worlds were being carried along in tandem.

With Holy Dynasty Great Qi as the core, they faintly formed an formation, like a giant warship that inspired awe.

“It was merely my duty. Without the Holy Emperor’s reward of the Myriad Spirit Jade Nectar, I could not have achieved this,” Hundred Flowers came before Li Ping and bowed.

She followed Li Ping’s line of sight and looked outward.

After a brief silence, she could not help but sigh. “I can hardly believe that such a magnificent sight was created by me.”

“The vast majority of them are no smaller than my homeland.”

“I will need to trouble you once more. Return this Five Elements Great Cave Heaven to the main Xuanhuang world,” Li Ping’s voice sounded at just that moment.

Hundred Flowers was slightly stunned.

The Holy Emperor smiled and explained, “The time for evasion has passed. Now it is time for close combat. Let this be the vanguard of the first battle!”

As the Holy Emperor spoke these words, the surrounding flames seemed to receive some kind of encouragement and surged violently higher.

Daoist Hundred Flowers also noticed that within the blazing Fire Cave Heaven, aside from the flames themselves, a deeper shadow flowed within.

It was a terrifying existence capable of threatening her.

The Holy Emperor extended his palm. The shadow flowed rapidly to his hand, transforming into an adorable little insect with a tiger like head.

Though it looked plump and harmless, Hundred Flowers knew full well how terrifying this little thing was.

The Fire Cave Heaven they currently stood in, and even the entire Five Elements Great Cave Heaven, were merely manifestations of this black insect.

Rather than tending the cave heaven over these years, it would be more accurate to say that Hundred Flowers had been raising this insect called [Dao One].

“With Dao One helping you, dragging the cave heaven back will not be as difficult as it was on the journey here.”

“You need only return the Five Elements Cave Heaven to its proper place. Dao One will handle everything else,” the Holy Emperor instructed.

As Li Ping spoke, strands of starlight radiated from his palm.

Dao One seemed somewhat pleased, its plump body affectionately rubbing against Li Ping’s palm. It then greedily devoured the tiny points of starlight.

Its black body seemed to become even more solid.

“Go.”

Li Ping gently patted it. Though Dao One seemed somewhat reluctant, it obediently dispersed into shadow and returned to the surrounding Cave Heavens.

The surrounding fire instantly burned even more fiercely.

Hundred Flowers sensed even more clearly that the entire cave heaven had suddenly come alive. Being within it felt like being inside the belly of a giant beast.

The constantly rising sense of danger made her deeply uneasy.

Li Ping also noticed her abnormal state and brought her outside the Five Elements Cave Heaven into the void.

With a light tap of the Holy Emperor’s finger, the Five Elements Cave Heaven separated from Holy Dynasty Great Qi and the void fleet formation.

“There is no need to worry. Dao One will only faithfully carry out my orders.”

Since the Holy Emperor had said so, Hundred Flowers could only nod. Suppressing the fear in her heart, she transformed into golden light and flew toward the Five Elements Cave Heaven.

In an instant, the five ringed cave heaven seemed to be coated with a golden edge.

Boom boom!

After the initial rumbling, the movement of the cave heaven became absolutely silent.

Under the concealment of the Holy Emperor’s formation, even if one were beside the passing cave heaven, they might not notice this enormous moving entity at all.

Watching the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven as it returned to its homeland, Li Ping pondered inwardly.

"With Dao One in its current state, it is enough to silently alter the spiritual energy of the entire Xuanhuang Realm."

"Not only can it be used against the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, it can also take this opportunity to stimulate the Xuanhuang Realm itself and further awaken signs of revival."

Ever since his enlightenment at the center of the star sea last time, a burst of revival power had briefly erupted within the Xuanhuang Realm. However, it was ultimately rootless water. As time passed, the signs of revival gradually stagnated.

The newly sprouted tender bud on the Ruomu branch was beginning to wither and turn yellow once more.

After being transformed by the Dao One insect, the insectified Five Elements Great Cave Heaven was like a powerful medicine.

The spiritual energy of heaven and earth was an extremely important component of the Xuanhuang Realm. If it were invaded, it would inevitably provoke an intense instinctive reaction from the Xuanhuang Realm itself.

"The mission of the Dao One insect is not merely to create a battlefield environment suitable for the soldiers of Great Qi."

"Its most important purpose is to insectify and devour as much as possible the foreign cultivation worlds that have been stitched together over these thousands of years."

"Once the great war ends, the Dao One insect will die. Spiritual energy will return to its proper course, and the Dao One insect's corpse, namely those foreign worlds, will become nourishment for the Xuanhuang Realm."

"After enduring this insect calamity, the Xuanhuang Realm itself will become much stronger. Combined with the Xuanhuang Orthodoxy measures I previously arranged, no matter whether Immortal Ancestor or I emerge victorious, the Xuanhuang Realm will hold an absolute advantage in the future fusion of worlds."

Within the Holy Emperor's mind, he continuously deduced the scenes of the great battle that would soon arrive.

His gaze pierced through layer upon layer of spacetime barriers and saw the Daoist Hundred Flowers smoothly dragging the insectified Five Elements Cave Heaven back into position.

Amid the silent roar of heaven and earth, the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven, having returned to Tianling Prefecture, began to emit streams of abnormal spiritual energy outward.

The spiritual energy concentration of the Xuanhuang Realm would rise slightly within a short period.

Cultivators would find it difficult to detect the abnormalities in this newly born spiritual energy. Only when the Insectification Transformation was activated would they be caught off guard and lose their authority to draw upon the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.

Seeing the plan proceeding smoothly, Holy Emperor Li Ping finally withdrew his gaze.

With a single step, he returned to the Holy Dynasty Great Qi.

Deep within the Holy Emperor's throne.

The location of the core of the Heaven and Earth Myriad Spirits Grand Formation.

In addition, many formations such as the All Living Beings Refine the Soul Formation were layered upon one another. Even the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao consciousness, which was closely connected to the Holy Emperor, would have its connection severed here.

This ensured that all outside prying was completely cut off.

The Holy Emperor's disciple, Lin Ling, formerly the incarnation of the spirit wood from the Spiritwood Realm, had now revealed her true form.

However, what looked rather strange was that the tree was inverted, with the crown at the very bottom.

Its dense roots were instead at the very top.

Structures spread throughout the Holy Dynasty Great Qi, such as the Heroic Spirit Seats, Holy Physician Institute, Holy Academy, Holy Heart Hall, and Holy Supervisory Court, were all connected to the roots of the inverted spirit tree.

At the heart of the tree, every scene occurring within the Holy Dynasty Great Qi appeared simultaneously.

After each projection of light and shadow played once, it transformed into green light and was absorbed by the inverted spirit tree.

Holy Emperor Li Ping looked at the inverted spirit tree before him, and a trace of hesitation, exceedingly rare for him, flashed through his eyes.

"So called planning for defeat before planning for victory. Holy Emperor, this move can only be achieved by great wisdom."

Beside Li Ping, a yellow paper figure with a perpetually worried face was praising him without restraint.

It was none other than Daoist Yi Jue of the Du'e Sect.

He sat atop the Book of Du'e, his eyes fixed tightly on the inverted spirit tree ahead.

"Moreover, Your Majesty's plan is for the sake of the Xuanhuang Realm. It is not a retreat left for yourself, so it cannot be said to weaken your resolve and determination," Daoist Yi Jue continued.

The Holy Emperor remained silent.

He only occasionally cast streams of spell seals, causing the roots of the inverted spirit tree to sway.

At the heart of the tree, the speed at which the projections of Great Qi were absorbed seemed to increase even further.

Only after a long while did the Holy Emperor stop.

He suddenly spoke.

"In this decisive battle with the Immortal Alliance, your Du'e Sect need not take action."

"Proceed according to what I said before. Hide yourselves in secret and observe..."

"Whether there are other eyes watching."

The Holy Emperor's tone was difficult to interpret.

"The battle between the Holy Dynasty and the Immortal Alliance is an upheaval in the Xuanhuang Realm unseen in ten thousand years. If that force secretly monitoring the Xuanhuang Realm is still operating, it will inevitably observe this and then transmit the information. I do not require you to find the final destination of that information. You only need to determine whether such an event occurs."

The tightly furrowed brows of Daoist Yi Jue from the Du'e Sect finally relaxed.

He clapped in praise.

"Holy Emperor, this action aligns perfectly with the great Dao of my Du'e Sect. If Your Majesty is willing, I could even relinquish the position of Du'e Sect Master..."

Before Daoist Yi Jue could finish, the Holy Emperor interrupted him.

"Regardless of whether Immortal Ancestor or I win, you must report the result to the victor. As for after completing the task, you may do as you please."

Daoist Yi Jue showed no joy at the prospect of soon obtaining freedom. Instead, he looked somewhat stunned, his vaguely shaped little paper hand pointing at the inverted spirit tree.

"I am not going along?"

The Holy Emperor let out a light laugh.

"The only living being within this Tree of Primitive World is Lin Ling, who serves as its main body. Even I will not leave any retreat for myself upon it. And your Du'e Sect still wishes to go along?"

Daoist Yi Jue immediately wore a miserable expression.

"Holy Emperor, please reconsider. Relying only on that tree spirit who was born not long ago, what can possibly be accomplished? The star sea is vast. What if some disaster is encountered and it perishes halfway? Would this escape method not be abandoned midway..."

Li Ping waved a hand, cutting him off.

Staring at the inverted spirit tree, he corrected him.

"It is not an escape method, but information preservation."

Daoist Yi Jue sighed repeatedly.

"What difference is there?"

Li Ping narrowed his eyes and remained silent.

Within this Tree of Primitive World was not only all preserved image records of every event that had occurred since the founding of the Holy Dynasty.

Even the true spirits and memories of those who had fallen during this time, originally located within the Heroic Spirit Hall, would be transferred here when activated.

This was a contingency move the Holy Emperor had left for the entire Holy Dynasty, inspired by the Taiyan Sect's theory that information never perishes.

Or rather, the word proof would be more appropriate.

If Li Ping won, there was naturally no need to mention it. The Tree of Primitive World would never be activated.

But if Li Ping lost, then at the moment Great Qi was destroyed, the Tree of Primitive World would wrap up the true spirits of the Holy Dynasty's citizens and fly into the depths of the void.

If it were a physical entity, it would certainly be unable to escape Immortal Ancestor's obstruction.

But if it were only information, Immortal Ancestor might not care.

In addition, the Du'e Sect would create interference at that time.

It was not that the Holy Emperor had developed hesitation toward the decisive battle. After all, no place had been reserved on the Tree of Primitive World for any living being.

Rather, the Holy Emperor wanted to leave behind final proof of existence for the countless citizens who had followed and believed in him.

Li Ping knew that during the thousands of years in which the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had ruled half of Xuanhuang, the Holy Dynasty Great Qi was not the first to raise the banner of rebellion.

Five hundred years ago, there had already been an example of the united worlds rising in resistance.

But after they failed, all information regarding them was erased and sealed away by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

It was as though those losers had never existed at all.

Li Ping's actions were to prevent such a thing from happening again.

"Even if we lose, our existence will not be erased."

"If in some distant future, when the Tree of Primitive World returns to Xuanhuang, it can inspire later generations, that would be even better."

Many thoughts flashed through Li Ping's mind.

The stirring emotions were quickly calmed.

"Dharma Transmitting Immortal Ancestor."

Li Ping silently repeated that name once more in his heart.

In truth, with his current strength, he already had a thirty percent chance of remaining undefeated against the Immortal Ancestor. He might even defeat him.

After comprehending the Dao within the star sea, he had already understood where the current limit of this Darkest Star Sea lay.

Even though the Immortal Ancestor had dominated Xuanhuang for nearly ten thousand years, he certainly had not broken through the present limit of the star sea.

But what faintly unsettled Li Ping was the shadow standing behind the Immortal Ancestor.

The Heavenly Doctor.

Although Li Ping knew little about this figure, a vague intuition in his heart told him that this person absolutely could not be underestimated.

Anyone capable of conspiring alongside the Immortal Ancestor could not possibly be weak.

"The Immortal Ancestor, I can still handle. But if the Heavenly Doctor is added as well..."

Although the outlook was not optimistic, the Holy Emperor's plan to launch the final offensive three years later was not an impulsive decision.

Three years from now was an extremely special point in time.

The significance was not within the Xuanhuang Realm, but in the entire Darkest Star Sea.

From his connection with that vast true intent of the star sea's origin, he sensed that in three years, the star sea would once again erupt with the power of origin revival.

At that time, the revival power of the star sea would begin a large scale struggle against the calamity power lingering throughout the star sea.

Under the collision of these two immense forces, any cultivator in the star sea who had not reached the level of contending against either force would inevitably be affected.

This applied equally to cultivators who had comprehended the Dao through the star sea, as well as believers of calamity power.

The specific manifestation of this influence upon cultivators would be a severe reduction in their upper limit of strength.

Just as larger bodies in the ocean encounter more wind and waves.

The stronger one's cultivation, the deeper the influence of the star sea and calamity power within the Darkest Star Sea.

The Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor, these two beings standing at the peak of the star sea, would temporarily be forcibly dragged down.

Although the Holy Emperor's strength would likewise be reduced, on one hand, a large portion of his combat power came from the fortune of the Holy Dynasty. As long as the Holy Dynasty did not fall, the strength he could exert would remain at a relatively stable level.

On the other hand, he had a vague connection with the true intent of the star sea's primordial will. Protected by it, compared to other beings in the star sea, he only needed to face the impact of calamity power.

"Through my brief exchange with the Star Sea's Primordial Will, I confirmed that before me, no cultivator had ever come into contact with it. Although I do not know why the Immortal Ancestor and the others failed to discover the revival of the Star Sea's Primordial Will over these ten thousand years, it is undoubtedly fortunate for me."

"Not only does it reduce the gap between us to a certain extent, I can even borrow some of the power of this vast star sea."

"However, compared to the Xuanhuang Realm, which had no other choice, this star sea is currently undergoing vigorous rebirth, while my own power is far too insignificant. I have only one chance..."

The Holy Emperor stood before the inverted spirit tree, deducing the various possible scenarios of the great battle three years later.

No matter how Daoist Yi Jue of the Du'e Sect tried to persuade him, he remained unmoved.

"If I could borrow calamity power, perhaps my chances of victory would increase even further."

The Holy Emperor could not help but think this.

He would never have imagined that at the distant opposite end of the star sea, a group of beings attempting to master the star sea's calamity power had likewise perceived the coming upheaval three years later.

Xuan Immortal Ark, Severed Immortal Tower.

Zhao Xian, who was in secluded cultivation, namely the Holy Embryo Li Fan, was hurriedly summoned.

At the grand assembly of all core members of the Severed Immortal Tower, Ai Tianjue spoke and announced an event that might have a major impact on the Immortal Ark.

"The residual calamity power throughout the star sea is continuously strengthening, and it is expected to reach its peak within three years?"

"Under this influence, the True Immortal power attached to the Sea of Relics will also resonate. The usual fluctuations will intensify dramatically, making this our best opportunity to search for viable world extinction relics. Such an opportunity appears only once in a thousand years."

"If all goes well, we may gather enough relics in a single attempt to meet the next hundred years of demand."

After hearing Ai Tianjue's report, everyone immediately became excited.

Because of the scarcity of world extinction relics, the Severed Immortal Tower's research into True Immortal seal script had progressed extremely slowly.

Often, several cultivators had to share the same relic.

Only the true ruling figures and their disciples had the opportunity to exclusively use one each.

Nearly every cultivator in the Severed Immortal Tower believed their own aptitude was no worse than anyone else's. If each person could have sufficient relics for study, the difficulty of research would undoubtedly be greatly reduced.

"What I care more about is why this phenomenon is occurring."

Chi Gongdao's voice sounded.

He himself did not attend the meeting. The speaker was merely a brush woven from flesh and hair.

"The Immortal Ark has always kept extremely detailed records of fluctuations in calamity power. Such abnormal phenomena have never appeared before."

"And abnormalities either signify opportunity, or they represent..."

"Disaster!"

The flesh brush wrote an enormous character in the air.

A strange fluctuation emanated from the character. All the cultivators present involuntarily felt a chilling cold rise in their hearts, as if standing beside a bottomless abyss.

"Gongdao, stop fooling around."

A blue haired elder spoke in a deep voice.

With a single glance, the character was absorbed into his eyes.

The speaker was the second elder of the Severed Immortal Tower and host of this assembly, Gan Jingda.

After stopping Chi Gongdao's antics, Gan Jingda said gravely, "However, what you said is not without reason. In fact, several of us have already analyzed this privately."

"This disturbance is different from the previous rebounding star force riot. The root cause likely comes from the Star Sea itself."

As soon as these words were spoken, the entire hall fell silent.

The cultivators all contemplated the deeper implications of this statement.

None of them were fools. They clearly understood that the source of their current power came from the residual True Immortal power in the star sea.

But from the perspective of the entire star sea, that True Immortal power was a foreign object, an aberration.

Something that ought to be purged.

Judging from current trends, there was no possibility of mutual integration between the two.

Once the upheaval arrived, what would the outcome be?

If calamity power lost control, that would not necessarily be good news for the Xuan Immortal Ark, which already survived under extreme hardship, as if walking on thin ice. Even if more True Immortal power became available in the future, the dangers they faced would correspondingly increase.

This was the price of scheming for True Immortal power with a mortal body.

And if the Star Sea gained the upper hand, then the Xuan Immortal Ark's future would be even more bleak.

These remnants aligned with True Immortal power would suffer a drastic weakening once deprived of the weapon they had long relied upon.

Unless they were willing to change paths and return to the route of Dao comprehension cultivation.

But...

Having once tasted the ability to wield True Immortal power with a mere gesture, who could still willingly accept the slow, step by step path of ordinary cultivation?

Ai Tianjue coughed lightly, breaking the silence.

"Everything now is still only speculation. There is no substantial evidence."

"The Xuan Immortal Ark has endured countless disasters since ancient times. I believe we will safely survive this upheaval as well."

The assembled cultivators responded with applause.

"However, this upheaval concerns a matter of great importance. We have decided that beginning today, the Immortal Ark will enter a state of emergency war preparation."

"Prepare to enter wartime status at any moment."

Gan Jingda announced the purpose of the meeting.

Although no one voiced opposition, the heaviness on their faces was unmistakable.

At this moment, Li Fan suddenly spoke, drawing everyone's attention.

"If upheaval occurs, will the suction force in the Star Sea also be affected to some extent?"

"I once heard of the existence of the Xuanhuang Realm at the opposite end of the Star Sea. Compared to our Immortal Ark, that still intact cultivation world possesses vastly richer resources. As Li Fan spoke, everyone's eyes lit up.

Gan Jingda and Ai Tianjue exchanged glances, seemingly discussing something.

Then, under the expectant gazes of the crowd, they said:

"The Council of Elders will conduct a detailed evaluation of the feasibility of this matter."

"If it proves possible..."

"Our Immortal Ark may perhaps find a place to establish ourselves at the far end of the Star Sea."

Chapter 1288: Immortal Artifact Linking Two Worlds

The atmosphere of the meeting reached its peak with the announcement of Gan Jingda’s resolution.

“No wonder there have been no further records of it in the Xuanhuang Realm ever since.”

“In that case, I shall add more fuel to the fire!”

Within the boundless dark space.

Wu Ninglu.

“If you want to deal with him, you must strike at his weakness.”

Gradually, Wu Ninglu’s face also softened.

But only Li Fan could see that deep within her eyes, the blazing hatred remained, impossible to erase.

And outside this dark space.

In a place Wu Ninglu could not perceive.

“Originally, you could have done even better. Did you hesitate?” Li Fan reprimanded indifferently.

“Have you sensed the emotions of heaven and earth yet?” Li Fan asked again.

A trace of guilt flashed across Sun Tianci’s face.

“Not yet.”

“It does not matter. Heaven and earth’s hostility toward New Method cultivators will not be reversed in a single moment. Continue using sparring as a pretext to challenge Dao Integration cultivators across various regions. "There are still four immortal artifacts remaining, including the Great Sun Golden Bell. They are genuine immortal artifacts, truly passed down from ancient times to the present."

Having glimpsed the third part of the Grand Formation of the Primordial Mystic Spirit, and successfully reproduced part of its power, Li Fan understood very clearly just how powerful True Immortal level strength truly was. This was true for immortal formations, and equally true for immortal artifacts.

These were ultimate weapons capable of completely overturning the battlefield, and perhaps even the capital for his future exploration beyond the High Wall.

"Mr. Bai may have refrained from using the power of those immortal artifacts against the Immortal Ancestor because he was concerned for the safety of the Xuanhuang Realm. I do not care about that..."

"Of course, the prerequisite is obtaining the immortal artifacts' recognition."

"The immortal artifacts left behind by the Great Celestial Venerable should certainly have numerous restrictions."

...

Many thoughts flashed through Li Fan's mind before he once again looked at Sun Tianci, who had fallen into enlightenment from listening to Li Fan's teachings.

"Less than three years remain. It should be enough."

Sun Tianci's cultivation did not continue for long before being interrupted by a sudden disturbance.

On this day, a servant of the Sun family hurriedly came to report.

"The exit of the Sun family has been blocked? And they specifically named me for a challenge?"

Sun Tianci, awakened from his cultivation, looked somewhat dazed.

The Sun family servant replied with a mournful face, "Yes, Young Master. Those in the family who tried to force their way out were all beaten and thrown back by the other party."

"It has been going on for more than ten days. The family head has urgent matters and cannot spare the time. We truly had no other choice but to disturb your secluded cultivation."

Seeing the servant's utterly terrified expression, Sun Tianci could not help but comfort him, "It is fine. Take me there to have a look."

For Sun Tianci, enlightenment and cultivation were as simple as eating and drinking. Being interrupted once in a while meant nothing. He could simply continue next time. Naturally, there was nothing worth becoming angry over.

Upon arriving outside the Sun family cave dwelling, Sun Tianci saw the one blocking the entrance.

It was unexpectedly a child about the same age as him, appearing only five or six years old.

Dressed in purple robes, with pure eyes...

Or perhaps somewhat foolish and vacant.

"You... fight." The child pointed at Sun Tianci and spoke with concise simplicity.

Sun Tianci immediately shook his head. "No."

Hearing his request rejected, the child's eyes instantly narrowed.

Sun Tianci kindly reminded him, "You are only at the Nascent Soul realm. You are absolutely not my opponent. I will not bully the weak."

His words were spoken with complete sincerity, and the killing aura surging from the child opposite him gradually dissipated.

Whispers from the Sun family sounded in Sun Tianci’s ears.

“Tianci, do not be careless. We have investigated him. This little child is no ordinary person. He is obsessed with martial combat, and his strength is terrifying. Although he is only at the Nascent Soul realm, with a casual gesture he can defeat Soul Transformation cultivators...”

“Yes. His origins are mysterious, and the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance officials seem to completely ignore him. People call him the Martial Maniac Child.”

Sun Tianci nodded to his family, indicating that he understood.

At the same time, he looked at the Martial Maniac Child and said seriously, “At the Nascent Soul realm, you may be able to defeat Soul Transformation cultivators. But the difference between Soul Transformation and Dao Integration is like the gap between heaven and the abyss. You have no chance of winning.”

“I am afraid that if I strike too heavily, I may injure you.”

The Martial Maniac Child shook his head, disagreeing with Sun Tianci’s view.

“Victory and defeat in battle have nothing to do with realm.”

“Fight!”

“Not afraid of death!”

Seeing the blazing battle intent in the other child’s eyes, Sun Tianci could not help feeling somewhat helpless.

At the same time, he knew there was no avoiding this battle, so he could only bring him to the Sun family training arena.

Although the Sun family was a newly risen clan, and their cave dwelling looked ordinary from the outside, it was actually full of hidden wonders. The various functional structures within were in no way inferior to those ancient families of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance that had endured for thousands of years.

Take this training arena for example. It had been built atop the corpse of an ancient fallen Longevity Immortal that had been acquired at enormous expense. It could easily withstand attacks from Dao Integration cultivators.

Inside the training arena, Sun Tianci and the Martial Maniac Child, two children, stood facing each other with solemn expressions.

The onlookers were so tense they had reached their limit.

Sun Tianci was now unquestionably the most precious existence in the entire Sun family. Although his realm completely suppressed the opponent, if he suffered even the slightest injury, every Sun family member present who had failed to stop this match would face severe punishment.

“Please!”

The Martial Maniac Child gave a low shout. In the next moment, a silver spear tore through the sky and stopped directly before Sun Tianci’s face in a thrust.

“So fast!” Sun Tianci was somewhat surprised, but only to that extent.

An attack from a Nascent Soul cultivator could not even shake his defenses.

The spear dissolved like ice melting into water, vanishing on its own.

“Hm?” However, after neutralizing the attack, Sun Tianci felt a wave of astonishment.

In the moment he was distracted, the space before him rippled like water. Then the silver spear emerged once more like a flying fish leaping from the sea, thrusting directly toward Sun Tianci’s body.

“Martial!” the Martial Maniac Child shouted at the same time.

Silver light flowed along the spear. In an instant, seventeen additional weapons split off, surrounding Sun Tianci at the center.

Sabers, spears, swords, halberds, axes, hooked weapons, forks...

It was as if eighteen different cultivators were wielding them, each executing a different technique.

They all struck at once.

Boom!

Sun Tianci’s body was completely engulfed by the violent explosion of silver light.

“Young master!”

“Tianci!”

The Sun family members present cried out in alarm.

If the training arena had not remained sealed, they would likely have rushed in to rescue him immediately.

“There is no need to panic. This level of force cannot injure Tianci.” Sun Luyuan’s voice sounded, and everyone instantly relaxed in relief.

Having heard that the Sun family’s qilin child was engaged in battle, the late arriving Sun Luyuan fixed his gaze on the fight within the arena.

The Martial Maniac Child naturally understood that his attack would not succeed in a single move.

The moment the silver radiance engulfed Sun Tianci, he had already flashed forward and launched an unending barrage of attacks.

There were martial weapons used to wound, cultivator treasures taking manifested form, unexpected fists and kicks, and even the power of heavenly and earthly phenomena representing Dao Integration cultivators...

The training arena roared continuously and shook without cease. It looked dangerously unstable, as though the protective barriers might shatter at any moment.

Sun Luyuan’s expression turned grave as he cast spells to reinforce it.

Meanwhile, Sun Tianci, hailed as the greatest genius of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance in the past hundred years, could only defend passively, appearing utterly battered and miserable.

In truth, no one present could understand the shock in Sun Tianci’s heart at this moment.

Because he discovered that the mysterious technique his master had granted him, the one capable of dissolving cultivator attacks and returning them to heaven and earth, had completely lost its effect against this Martial Maniac Child.

“How can this be? Could it be because his realm is too low? A technique meant to deal with Dao Integration cultivators is instead useless against him?”

Since birth, he had cultivated continuously. Although he had experienced many battles within his master’s illusion realm and against Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Dao Integration cultivators, this was the first time his trump card had completely failed.

The young Sun Tianci could not help but feel some panic.

But he was extraordinary after all.

And although the Martial Maniac Child’s attacks were fierce, there was still ultimately a difference of two major realms between him and Sun Tianci.

As he endured the relentless beating, Sun Tianci gradually adapted to the attacks and slowly discovered some clues.

“No. The technique has not failed. Just like the previous Dao Integration cultivators, after the Martial Maniac Child’s attacks are executed and dissolved by me, his own aura still weakens briefly. But...”

“What he loses is quickly replenished from heaven and earth?!”

Realizing this, Sun Tianci was even more shaken.

One had to understand that this technique was not merely consuming spiritual energy. It stripped away a cultivator’s origin and Dao foundation, dispersing them back into the Xuanhuang world.

And correspondingly, the Martial Maniac Child’s performance in the training arena was equivalent to fighting him while continuously drawing origin power from the Xuanhuang world.

“How is this possible?”

“This completely violates the new cultivation method created by the Immortal Ancestor?!”

It was no wonder Sun Tianci was so shocked. The Martial Maniac Child’s actions were equivalent to constantly devouring the Xuanhuang Cave Heaven, the transformation of life, and the Spirit of Heaven and Earth...

Yet the Xuanhuang world seemed to show not even the slightest malice or retaliation.

Within Sun Tianci’s understanding, this was something absolutely impossible.

Because of the mystery he had uncovered, Sun Tianci lost focus for an instant, and the Martial Maniac Child seized the opportunity. A spell technique pierced through his defenses and struck him directly.

Sun Tianci spat out a mouthful of blood, and seriousness flashed in his eyes.

White flowing radiance like drifting light emerged around his body, instantly forcing back the Martial Maniac Child’s spell techniques.

It was Sun Tianci’s Spirit of Heaven and Earth, [White Silk].

But the White Silk at this moment, after Li Fan’s conditioning and Sun Tianci’s years of cultivation, was already fundamentally different from when it had first descended into the world.

“To actually force me to this extent…”

“Master was right. There are countless geniuses in this world. I am nothing special.”

Sun Tianci gradually calmed himself. Surrounded by white radiance, he dissolved each of Martial Maniac Child’s attacks one by one.

“Do not pursue the cause. Follow the method and strike.”

His master’s teachings flashed through Sun Tianci’s mind.

“If I cannot understand why this Martial Maniac Child can continuously draw upon the Xuanhuang Realm’s origin, then I will simply ignore it.”

“Strike at the root. Directly sever his connection to the Xuanhuang Realm.”

A flash of light passed through Sun Tianci’s eyes.

The illusory White Silk surged like a tornado, spiraling wildly as it wrapped around Sun Tianci’s body.

Within the vortex of white light, he rose into the air.

One hand pointed toward the heavens, the other toward Martial Maniac Child.

A low shout escaped his lips.

Martial Maniac Child’s previously seamless assault was forcibly interrupted for a brief moment.

Then he simply halted his offensive altogether, looking at Sun Tianci in the air with some surprise.

The two fingers were like a pair of scissors.

They temporarily severed his connection with heaven and earth.

An unprecedented feeling of weakness surged through his heart.

And in Sun Tianci’s eyes, the moment that connection was cut, Martial Maniac Child’s figure actually became somewhat blurry.

“This is…”

“The Spirit of Heaven and Earth, born into human form?”

A trace of realization vaguely flashed through Sun Tianci’s mind.

But the movement of his fingers did not pause.

Through his method of communicating with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, he had completely seized the Heavenly Dao’s perception within this area.

Temporarily excluding Martial Maniac Child from it.

It was destined not to last long.

“Suppress!”

High in the air, Sun Tianci viciously pressed down the finger pointing at Martial Maniac Child.

Endless White Silk light gathered into it like a surging river.

The enormous phantom of an index finger solidified, like a towering mountain reaching the heavens, crashing down from above.

The surrounding space around Martial Maniac Child was sealed by this overwhelming force. His body could not move.

As the Suppression Finger descended, violent roaring sounds mixed with the shrieking of space being crushed into cracks, resounded throughout the entire martial arena.

Sun Tianci’s face showed neither joy nor sorrow.

And Martial Maniac Child beneath the descending finger was likewise expressionless.

There was not the slightest fear in his eyes. Instead, he looked thoughtful.

Just as the Suppression Finger was about to descend upon him, he unexpectedly imitated Sun Tianci and struck a finger toward the sky in return.

The purple robe on his body transformed into vast purple qi, surging into that strike.

Compared to the Suppression Finger Sun Tianci had unleashed, its momentum appeared much smaller.

Yet it seemed far more condensed and sacred.

Martial Maniac Child’s expression held the joy of enlightenment, along with the solemnity of unleashing a supreme technique.

One purple, one white.

One rose from the earth, one descended from the heavens.

They collided violently near the ground.

Boom!

Blinding light instantly drowned everything.

“Not good!”

Sun Luyuan’s expression changed slightly. With decisive speed, he swept his great sleeve, carrying away the Sun family members watching the battle as he instantly retreated.

At the same time, he did not forget to activate the protective formations around the martial arena one after another.

The facts proved that Sun Luyuan’s choice was extremely wise.

The impact caused by the collision of the Suppression Fingers swallowed the entire martial arena whole.

Then it continued spreading outward.

The protective formations painstakingly arranged by the Sun family shattered one after another before this terrifying might, as fragile as paper.

The overwhelming force swept through until more than half of the Sun family cave abode was engulfed.

The Sun family’s two Dao Integration cultivators acted together, casting techniques to restrain it.

Looking at the Sun family cave abode left in utter ruin, Sun Luyuan’s face twitched.

Fortunately, Sun Tianci’s still vigorous aura brought some relief to his heart.

After the storm dispersed, he arrived at the location of the original martial arena, which had now become nothing but empty void.

Martial Maniac Child was nowhere to be seen.

The Sun family’s qilin child stood motionless, seemingly with his eyes closed in contemplation.

Strictly ordering others not to disturb him, Sun Luyuan personally stood guard for him.

Looking at the ruins left by the great battle all around, a sense of helplessness suddenly rose in Sun Luyuan’s heart.

“Both are Dao Integration, yet the difference is actually this vast.”

“What is even more terrifying is that Tianci is only five years old. In the future…”

A term he had never even dared to think of before suddenly surfaced in Sun Luyuan’s mind.

“How many years has it been since the Xuanhuang Realm last produced a Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereign?”

“With Tianci’s talent, it may not be impossible. It may not be impossible!”

“Especially with the great upheaval approaching soon. When winds and clouds gather, sages emerge in chaotic times…”

This cultivator who had already been in the Dao Integration realm for more than five hundred years found that at this moment, he could not control the slight trembling of his hands.

He could only tightly shut his eyes, fearful that others might glimpse the thoughts in his heart.

At this moment, within Sun Tianci’s consciousness, this Dao Integration child was trapped in unceasing self-reproach.

“I did not mean to kill him.”

“But once the spell was formed, he also counterattacked with the Suppression Character Art…”

“I truly could not control it.”

Sun Tianci was filled with remorse.

But Li Fan’s cold rebuke interrupted him.

“Idiot! How could that kind of existence possibly be killed so easily by you?”

“Do not worry. Even if your entire Sun family were wiped out, he still would not disappear.”

Li Fan’s vicious words did not matter to him. Upon hearing that Martial Maniac Child had not actually perished, Sun Tianci was somewhat delighted and emerged from his remorse.

“Master, who exactly is Martial Maniac Child?”

“Could he be a Spirit of Heaven and Earth, born in human form?” Sun Tianci asked curiously.

Li Fan let out a light snort.

“You at least have some discernment.”

In truth, Li Fan still had more he did not say.

“Zhang Qianmo’s reincarnation method truly does have some profundity.”

“His body carrying the Grand Aspiration to exterminate demons has fused into the fundamental laws of Xuanhuang.”

“And this body of Martial Maniac Child…”

In previous reincarnations, Li Fan had seen Martial Maniac Child before. But at the time, he had not possessed sufficient insight to perceive the mysteries behind him.

However, the many major gains of this life, his increasingly close connection with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, and several rounds of star sea Dao comprehension had given him enough ability to see through the true nature of Zhang Qianmo’s reincarnation body.

“Zhang Qianmo once made three Grand Aspiration. One was to exterminate all demons under heaven. One was to replace the Ten Great Immortal Sects. One was to collect all cultivation methods and share them with all cultivators under heaven.”

“To exterminate all demons can be called [Slaughter].”

“In the cultivation world, the strong are revered. Replacing the Ten Great Immortal Sects can be called [Martial].”

“To share cultivation methods so that all people under heaven can cultivate can be called [Civil].”

“In ancient times, sages attained the Dao and the world changed, ascending in broad daylight and leaving blessings for later generations. This was an ancient supreme method capable of attaining True Immortal Dao…”

A sharp gleam flashed in Li Fan’s eyes.

“Even though the chance of completing each aspiration is exceedingly slim, these reincarnation bodies are like my simulation, capable of infinitely magnifying the probability of success.”

“If the Immortal Dao still existed, Zhang Qianmo might truly have been able to complete the three grand aspirations through this method and achieve the True Immortal realm.”

“What a pity…”

Li Fan shook his head slightly.

“Time has passed, the immortal path has been severed, and the world stands on the brink of destruction. This method…”

“The fault does not lie in the technique. The Great Dao itself has changed.”

“A cultivation method that once could achieve True Immortal status can now, at best, only leap around within a single world.” Li Fan seemed to gain some insight.

“But compared to the cultivators of the same era who had long since turned to ash, Senior Brother Zhang’s method is stronger by an unknown amount. In fact, if the Xuanhuang Realm can truly survive disaster in the future, and if the Immortal Dao is reopened…”

“Zhang Qianmo might actually be able to ascend to the True Immortal realm.”

Li Fan could not help imagining the future.

“The process may be somewhat long. But if it can lead to True Immortal Dao attainment, then none of that matters.”

After pondering for a moment, Li Fan’s thoughts returned to the present.

“The Xuanhuang Realm becoming the final surviving place in the entire star sea has already made it difficult enough for Zhang Qianmo’s Grand Aspiration Ascension Method to reach its second step. If Emperor Yi had not voluntarily led the demon leaders away, this step alone would likely have taken him several thousand years.”

“And now, this second step…”

Li Fan had watched the battle between Zhang Qianmo’s reincarnation body and Sun Tianci from beginning to end.

Naturally, he had also seen Martial Maniac Child’s condition, as though a Spirit of Heaven And Earth had descended into mortal birth.

“This Grand Aspiration Ascension Method truly relies on the feedback power generated after the world’s elevation…”

“It lodges itself within the world, completely opposite to the current Heavenly Sovereign new method.”

“It can also be seen as a parasite. But the new method only knows how to devour and seize. This Grand Aspiration Ascension Method, however, benefits the world.”

“No wonder the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao is almost willing to support it unconditionally. After all, among all under heaven, those willing to stand on the side of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao are so few they can be counted on one hand.”

“It is a wondrous method. But without the prospect of ascension, it is ultimately not worth mentioning.”

“At the very least, it is far inferior to directly becoming the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.”

…

While Li Fan’s thoughts surged, Sun Tianci, having learned that Martial Maniac Child had not died and feeling relieved, began sorting through the gains from this battle.

This was the first time he had encountered someone of similar age who was evenly matched with him in actual combat. Inevitably, a trace of excitement arose in his heart.

“I did not expect the Suppression Character Art Master taught me to be this powerful.”

“I have only comprehended less than one third of it so far. If I fully unleashed it…”

Sun Tianci traced shapes through the void with his finger, immersing himself in that incomparably profound talismanic form.

This Suppression Character Art was naturally not a true True Immortal seal script character.

It was merely a residual character Li Fan had comprehended on his own through the Xuan Immortal Ark’s research.

Yet even such an imperfect existence was still an unimaginably terrifying divine ability to cultivators.

As the saying goes, stones from other mountains may be used to polish jade. Li Fan passed on the half-comprehended Suppression Character Art to Sun Tianci precisely to see what this Xuanhuang prodigy might be able to comprehend from it.

It would also serve as a reference for himself.

...

Although the details of Martial Maniac Child’s battle with Sun Tianci were ordered to be kept secret by Sun Luyuan.

The devastated state of the Sun family cave abode after the battle could not be concealed from the world.

Thus, the reputation of the Sun family’s qilin child grew even louder.

There were even quite a few battle-hungry Dao Integration cultivators who took the initiative to seek him out, requesting sparring matches.

Sun Tianci could not have wished for anything better, and accepted all challengers.

After continuous battles, his practical combat ability improved at an astonishing rate.

And after cumulatively shaving away a portion of the Spirit of Heaven and Earth within thirty Dao Integration cultivators, returning it to the Xuanhuang world.

The accumulated power exceeded that of one complete Dao Integration cultivator.

Quantitative change had finally accumulated into qualitative transformation.

On this day, Sun Tianci stood frozen in place, staring blankly at the sky.

He remained motionless, tears actually flowing from his eyes.

"Xuanhuang..."

He murmured softly, his expression filled with grief.

It was as if a gentle breeze had passed over his body, continuously circling around him.

An aura Li Fan was extremely familiar with silently descended upon Sun Tianci.

"So he has finally met the conditions?"

"After gaining the Holy Emperor as a supporter, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao’s standards have risen quite a bit."

"Back then, slaughtering a few New Law cultivators at random would have achieved roughly the same effect."

Li Fan, who was observing from the side, thought to himself.

"However, this is still not the time for him to undergo the Great Celestial Venerable’s trial."

Li Fan keenly noticed that the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao’s attention upon Sun Tianci differed from what it showed toward the Holy Emperor.

Perhaps because Li Fan was hidden within Sun Tianci’s sea of consciousness, while the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao showed closeness, it also displayed a trace of vigilance and suspicion.

This emotion was so faint that even Sun Tianci himself did not notice it, remaining immersed in the supreme joy of making contact with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

Only Li Fan, who had personally experienced the Heavenly Dao’s true intimacy through the Holy Emperor’s body, could detect the difference.

"It seems I still need to do more."

"Thinking carefully, perhaps only that matter would be the most efficient."

Li Fan did not feel anger at the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao’s reaction.

Instead, he had already begun considering countermeasures.

"If you wish to take, you must first give."

"I will let you taste some sweetness first."

Li Fan let out a cold snort inwardly as he waited for Sun Tianci to awaken from his enlightenment.

In the end, it was only three days later that Sun Tianci happily came to report the good news to Li Fan.

But Li Fan’s words left him somewhat stunned.

"Master, are we no longer going to spar with Dao Integration cultivators?"

"I feel it was quite effective."

"Too slow. Too slow. As your master, I could have my soul scattered at any moment. I cannot wait that long."

Li Fan coldly snorted and directly poured information into Sun Tianci’s mind.

"This..."

Sun Tianci could not help widening his eyes.

"Master, this is a grave crime in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance!"

"I myself may be fine, but if it implicates the family..."

After understanding his master’s plan, Sun Tianci could not help but hesitate.

Because his master actually wanted him to go to the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s [Eternal Immortal Wall] and release the power originally belonging to the Xuanhuang Realm from the cultivators who had been eternally suppressed there.
