Next

Chapter 1290: The Holy Emperor Suddenly Achieves Insight

“Master, does this [Eternal Immortal Wall] really exist within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance? It is simply too horrifying to believe,” Sun Tianci asked after a long while, still unable to accept it.

“The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s brutality goes far beyond just this.” Li Fan let out a cold laugh.

The first time Li Fan learned of the Eternal Immortal Wall was in the 114th life, when the Tianxuan Spirit Locking sealed all spirits and the Mysterious Net enveloped Xuanhuang.

At the time, he had assumed it was a unique product of that particular life’s Immortal Alliance.

But later, in the 119th life, he impersonated Sun Xingwang, Dharma King of the Xuantian Sect, and used the Three Disasters and Hundred Tribulations Divine Clarity Method to refine countless thought demon gods within tens of thousands of cultivators. The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s final method of dealing with those cultivators was precisely a technique similar to the Eternal Immortal Wall. From the information revealed after Mo Rubin possessed a Dharma-Transmitter, it became known that the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance indeed secretly preserved many cultivators in sealed storage, using them to maintain and guarantee the stability of the Xuanhuang Realm.

And there was more than one such location.

Li Fan transmitted a blurry scene to Sun Tianci, and the Sun family’s prodigy was instantly shocked by the cruel sight.

“Master, what should we do?”

Not long after, he recovered from the shock and asked in a resolute tone.

“Your execution speed of the Dark Nether Art is still too slow. Even if we successfully infiltrate the Immortal Wall, we will not have much time to act.”

“First, become faster.”

The Dark Nether Art was naturally the mysterious technique Li Fan had imparted, one that dissolved a cultivator’s cultivation and returned it to the Xuanhuang world.

Li Fan’s divine sense split from Sun Tianci’s sea of consciousness, manifesting into an illusory form.

The avatar raised his head toward the sky and slowly murmured, “Distort the Principles of Heaven and Earth…”

As he softly chanted, a scene that made Sun Tianci’s scalp go numb unfolded.

An invisible vortex instantly appeared above Li Fan’s head.

A deeply familiar aura, belonging to the Spirit of Heaven and Earth, seemed to be brewing within the vortex.

As he watched the blurry humanoid shape gradually extending an arm from within, Sun Tianci became increasingly certain of his suspicion.

“To summon the Spirit of Heaven and Earth with a single word? Master’s true identity is actually…”

Just as Sun Tianci stood stunned by the sight, Li Fan’s rebuke sounded by his ear.

“What are you standing there for? Do you intend to wait until the Spirit of Heaven and Earth fully descends?”

Sun Tianci instantly snapped back to his senses. He immediately directed a Dark Nether Art toward the blurry figure that was on the verge of manifesting.

As if the descent process had been obstructed, a gust of wind passed through, and the Spirit of Heaven and Earth that Li Fan had falsely summoned returned once more to heaven and earth.

During this process, Sun Tianci did not feel his connection with the Xuanhuang world deepen in any way. Clearly, this was because the Spirit of Heaven and Earth still belonged to Xuanhuang itself and had not been refined or occupied by a cultivator.

And because the “erroneous descent of the Spirit of Heaven and Earth” had been interrupted just before completion, the vigilance from the Xuanhuang world was negligible.

Li Fan narrowed his eyes in observation, then cast Distort the Principles of Heaven and Earth once more.

This time Sun Tianci reacted quickly. The blurry figure was sent back the moment it was about to take shape.

This repeated more than a hundred times. Only when it was about to attract the Xuanhuang world’s attention did Li Fan finally stop.

Sun Tianci let out a sigh of relief, his face pale as he wiped sweat from his forehead.

Clearly, continuously using the Dark Nether Art for such a long time to “decompose” more than a hundred Spirits of Heaven and Earth, even half-formed ones, was a heavy burden for him.

“Change locations. Continue,” Li Fan said coldly.

Ever since the day he defeated Martial Maniac Child and revealed his true combat strength, Sun Tianci was no longer restricted in his movements by the Sun family. This despite the fact that he was only a little over five years old in actual age.

Only Sun Luyuan repeatedly warned him that safety must come first. He had even bestowed many treasures for self-defense.

The special training lasted a total of fifteen days, with their footprints covering all corners of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance. Aside from travel, nearly all remaining time was spent dissolving Spirits of Heaven and Earth. Sun Tianci’s progress was astonishing.

With casual ease, he could now continuously return the falsely summoned half-descended Spirits of Heaven and Earth back to the world.

“Mm, that is about enough.” Li Fan nodded slightly as he observed Sun Tianci’s performance.

“What are you thinking about?” Li Fan asked when he noticed Sun Tianci seemed lost in thought.

“Uh, Master, ten days ago we came here before. The spiritual energy density seemed lower then than it is now?” Sun Tianci asked uncertainly.

Li Fan smiled. “The spiritual energy of the world rises and falls like tides. Is that not normal? How could it be like the cave dwelling where you grew up, forever fixed and unchanging?”

Sun Tianci nodded slightly upon hearing the explanation. But deep in his surveying gaze, a trace of doubt still flickered.

“This little fellow has remarkably sharp observation skills.”

Li Fan had naturally also noticed the abnormality in heaven and earth. He had even detected a familiar aura within the diffused spiritual energy.

“Dao One Insect. It seems this is the Holy Emperor clone’s method. The source should be the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven. Returning the cave heaven to the Xuanhuang Realm to create a battlefield environment suitable for Great Qi soldiers? Perhaps it can also use insect-transformed spiritual energy to launch a fatal strike…”

The Holy Emperor clone’s arrangements mostly originated from explorations made by the original body in previous lives. With only a little thought, Li Fan saw through the scheme.

But he did not expose it and merely pretended ignorance.

Returning to Sun Tianci’s sea of consciousness, they advanced toward one of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s Eternal Immortal Walls.

Tongyan Prefecture, inside a cave hidden among encircling mountains and broken cliffs.

“This place…”

Sun Tianci gazed from afar and sensed something extraordinary. “If Master had not pointed it out, even if I saw this cave before, I would have subconsciously ignored it. I would never have even thought of entering to investigate…”

“Hmph. This is the so-called blessed land where only those with destiny may enter. A peculiar creation of Xuanhuang. No formation concealment is needed, yet it naturally prevents most people from even noticing it. The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance has quite a few such hidden cave heavens. They have almost all been divided among the Dharma-Transmitters as their personal cave dwellings.” Li Fan recalled the hidden cave heaven where he met Mo Rubin after infiltrating the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters in the 119th life.

It was exactly the same as this place.

“Because of this natural characteristic, the stationed cultivators will certainly not be overly vigilant. But we must still proceed carefully…”

Li Fan’s divine sense clone laid down a series of formations around Sun Tianci, then the two flew together into the hollow cave.

After passing through a narrow descending tunnel, they arrived before a deep shaft only waist-wide for a single person.

It was pitch black, descending straight downward, bottomless.

“Do not probe with divine sense. It will trigger an alarm.”

Li Fan immediately saw through the mechanism behind this underground cavern.

He leapt into the deep shaft, rapidly flying downward.

It took the time of an incense stick, as if he had pierced through the Xuanhuang earth itself and arrived at the depths of the Nine Nether.

Only then did the cramped tunnel gradually widen.

After passing through a horizontal passage, a massive underground cavern, shaped like an inverted cone and buried in the deepest underground, suddenly appeared before Sun Tianci.

The cavern walls were densely covered with square openings.

Looking carefully, within each of those openings were amber colored crystal bodies.

And within every single one of those crystal bodies, without exception, a cultivator lay sleeping.

From time to time, Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance guards could be seen patrolling through the air. Sun Tianci did not dare spread out his divine sense to investigate, but from a rough estimate, this underground cavern alone held at least over one hundred thousand sealed cultivators.

Their complexions were rosy, and some even wore faint smiles on their faces.

They were utterly unaware that they had fallen into eternal sleep.

“According to Master, this is merely one part of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s Eternal Immortal Wall...” Sun Tianci felt a chill in his heart and unconsciously clenched his fists.

“Go. The rest depends on you.” Li Fan seemed to see the suppressed anger in Sun Tianci’s heart and spoke indifferently.

At the same time, he transmitted the method to break the sealing formation imprisoning these cultivators.

“Master, what do you think would happen if we awakened all the cultivators here?” Sun Tianci suddenly asked.

“I advise you to abandon that thought. Since the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance dares to do this so openly, they must naturally have prepared preventative measures. Believe me, the speed at which you awaken them will absolutely not match the speed at which the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance handles them. You should know that the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance possesses methods to extract and preserve a cultivator’s Dao Foundation...” Li Fan said coldly.

Sun Tianci’s gaze flickered, but in the end, he could only abandon the thought.

Avoiding the patrolling cultivators, he rapidly passed by these pitiful sleeping souls. A nearly imperceptible breeze followed in his wake, dissolving all of their Dao Foundations.

“Without their cultivation, even while sleeping, they will not live much longer... It is equivalent to me personally killing them...” Sun Tianci’s flying body trembled.

“Killing? Or saving? Look at their current state. Is this not worse than death? If they could consciously perceive everything around them, they would surely beg you to act and free them,” Li Fan spoke to comfort him.

After another round of persuasion, Sun Tianci’s hesitant movements once again became resolute.

Over more than five years, Li Fan had cultivated Sun Tianci according to his ideal image of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

This made him compassionate, but not foolishly naïve. Once he made a decision, he could become extraordinarily decisive.

The Xuanhuang heaven and earth power formed from dissolving the Dao Foundations of tens of thousands of cultivators was gathered by Li Fan into a single brilliant orb of light.

When the act of merciful release had reached one fifth completion, Li Fan spoke.

“That is enough. If we continue further, even I will not be able to conceal these intense energy fluctuations.”

Sun Tianci looked at those who remained, a trace of regret faintly appearing.

But he still obeyed his master’s orders and quietly flew toward the exit.

“Master, is there something wrong?” As he reached the very top of the massive cavern, Sun Tianci sensed that his master still seemed to be gazing at a certain spot below, and could not help asking.

“It is nothing. Just leave.”

After a brief silence, Li Fan finally replied.

Sun Tianci did not ask further and sped upward all the way. After leaving this horrifying underground prison, Sun Tianci took the orb of light containing the Dao Foundations of countless cultivators and gently crushed it.

Countless streams of light burst forth instantly.

In a daze, Sun Tianci seemed to see wondrous things of the world, the Xuanhuang Cave Heaven, and scenes of mountains and rivers shifting.

In the sky, wind and clouds changed color. A creaking sound like a giant millstone grinding echoed above the clouds.

And throughout the entire Xuanhuang Realm, a faint tremor spread in that instant.

Though the movement was minuscule, Sun Tianci still sensed it.

“The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance should already be sending people to investigate. Go!” Li Fan called out.

There was no need for a reminder. The moment Sun Tianci crushed the light orb, he had already fled far from the scene.

At this moment, he was immersed in the rapidly increasing favor of Xuanhuang heaven.

Meanwhile, after ensuring no one was tracking them, Li Fan once again recalled the scene he had just witnessed in that massive cavern.

Several faces flashed through his mind. Though he did not know their names, Li Fan was certain he had seen them before.

But not in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Rather...

In the territory of the Five Elders Association.

Within the Derivation Law Jade space, the Dao Deviation Stone in his true body’s sea of consciousness emitted a faint glow, bringing forth scenes he had once seen.

That was during the 119th life, when the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance used the Chosen Immortals to activate the power hidden within the Immortal Ancestor stone statue, restraining the five Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereigns before launching a fierce assault against the Five Elders Association.

After the Five Elders Association appeared to be driven into a desperate corner, their hidden methods were finally revealed.

Ancient sects that had already gone extinct reappeared in the world. Even cultivators from the Carefree Paradise emerged, fearlessly counterattacking with all kinds of strange artifacts.

Li Fan compared several faces that had appeared during that campaign with the sleeping cultivators he had just seen in the cavern.

They matched perfectly.

“Interesting.” Li Fan looked toward the location of the Five Elders Association’s Carefree Paradise.

“It seems there are not only Five Elders Association cultivators within that Paradise. The question is whether those sleeping cultivators appearing there was due to cooperation between the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Five Elders Association, or whether the Carefree Heavenly Sovereign captured them unilaterally.”

“If it is the latter, then this Heavenly Sovereign’s strength may be somewhat greater than I imagined.”

The infant like image of the Carefree Heavenly Sovereign surfaced in Li Fan’s mind.

He also recalled Dharma-Transmitter Zhou, whom he had encountered during the Dharma Transmission Council’s inspection in the 119th life.

She had transformed the surroundings into a modern city with neon drenched rainy night scenery, claiming she had seen it while vacationing in the Carefree Paradise and had reproduced it exactly.

“Cooperation between the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Carefree Paradise is not impossible.”

“The Carefree Paradise may not fully represent the Five Elders Association. Only when the Five Elders Association faces an absolute crisis do they take action.”

“Dreamland Paradise...”

A sudden question flashed through Li Fan’s mind.

“I wonder whether these cultivators, if they die in reality, can still continue to exist in the Paradise. And if the Xuanhuang Realm ceases to exist, can this Carefree Paradise still remain?”

As thoughts surged through his mind, Sun Tianci had also fully absorbed this round of gains.

With Li Fan, this wise mentor, planning every step, he could be considered the fastest person at accumulating Xuanhuang heaven’s favor.

He was even progressing much faster than the Holy Emperor clone had once done.

Unfortunately, perhaps because there was already a destined Holy Emperor who could communicate with Heavenly Dao consciousness at any time, even though Sun Tianci clearly felt the closeness of Xuanhuang heaven and earth, he still could not directly converse with Heavenly Dao.

He could only sense the omnipresent convenience.

Sun Tianci immediately cast a spell. With the constant blessing of heaven and earth, its power indeed increased greatly.

Yet he still felt deeply dejected.

“It does not matter. At this point, it is already enough.”

Li Fan’s voice sounded beside Sun Tianci’s ear.

He saw that this incomparably mysterious master, who had never once revealed his true appearance before him, had actually shown his real face at this moment.

Sun Tianci could not help but be slightly stunned.

Because he had never expected that his master would be so extraordinarily handsome.

Clad in white robes, with a peerlessly beautiful face that seemed to gather all the spiritual energy between heaven and earth, along with the occasional flashes of compassion for all living beings in his eyes...

For a moment, Sun Tianci was completely entranced.

“Come with me.”

Master and disciple arrived deep underground.

After creating a secret chamber, Li Fan instructed Sun Tianci to take out the four items he had prepared long ago.

A simple hemp garment.

A full stalk of rice.

A small yet exquisite miniature house model.

A lifelike miniature donkey cart.

Li Fan then placed the four items in the four corners respectively, before looking toward Sun Tianci.

With a benevolent expression, he said, “You may begin. Do not forget the stories I have told you ever since the day you were born.”

Sun Tianci seemed to realize something and replied in a deep voice, “I understand, Master. I will not betray your trust.”

Li Fan nodded with satisfaction, then transformed back into his previously blurred appearance and withdrew beyond the formation.

Sun Tianci took a deep breath and began.

Taking the first step, facing the direction of the donkey cart, he softly recited:

“Blessings upon Xuanhuang Immortal Venerable.”

The second step, turning toward the house that represented the dwelling place of ordinary people, he sincerely murmured:

“Blessings upon Xuanhuang Heavenly Lord.”

The third step, looking at the full stalk of rice, he held his breath and whispered:

“Blessings upon Xuanhuang Supreme Emperor.”

The fourth step, gazing at the hemp garment, he finally murmured:

“Blessings upon Xuanhuang Celestial Venerable.”

This was the ritual performed in reverse from the normal Fallen Immortal Realm entry process for ordinary people, allowing entry into the special illusion realm for inheriting the position of Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

The moment the ritual was completed, a consciousness from the highest heavens instantly descended and locked onto Sun Tianci.

Sun Tianci gently closed his eyes and sat cross legged in the center of the four ritual items, seemingly falling asleep.

The four objects representing clothing, food, shelter, and travel flickered with alternating light and shadow, as though they had fallen into the crack between illusion and reality.

...

“No matter how many times I witness the thoughts of a fallen True Immortal, it still feels so unbelievably inconceivable.”

Li Fan’s split consciousness silently thought to itself.

During the brief moment just now when he had transformed into Mister Bai’s appearance to deceive Sun Tianci, even though he was hidden beneath layer upon layer of underground formations, he still sensed Xuanhuang heaven and earth showing signs of reaction.

Fortunately, he was no longer the same as before. Before Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao could locate him, he had already transformed back. Otherwise, there might have been another repeat of the incident of Returning to [Truth] Yet Unwilling.

“Such a close connection. Even the Holy Emperor’s clone in this life cannot compare.”

“It must certainly be the effect of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable...”

“Now let us see whether this boy possesses such fortune.”

Li Fan stared at the meditating Sun Tianci and thought this.

The trial within the Fallen Immortal Realm for Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable passed almost at the same rate as real time.

Back then, even with full knowledge of all the correct answers and rapidly clearing it with the optimal solutions, it had still taken him nearly half a year.

As for Sun Tianci, Li Fan had not directly told him the correct method.

This was to avoid any possible anti-cheating mechanisms within the trial.

Instead, through the method of telling stories since childhood, he had planted the solutions deep within Sun Tianci’s subconscious.

With Sun Tianci’s talent, even if it took some effort, successfully breaking through the illusion trial should not be difficult.

“He should arrive just in time for the beginning of the war between the Holy Dynasty and the Immortal Alliance.”

As for whether Sun Tianci might lose control...

Li Fan looked at the remnant soul of Sun Tianci’s birth mother wrapped within the core of his clone.

After a period of conditioning, all traces of resentment had outwardly vanished. She now completely appeared to be a loving mother.

“They call it being born already integrated with the Dao, but in truth, he consumed his birth mother’s life. This is his greatest weakness.”

“Soon. Let me see just how mighty the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable of this era truly is.”

Under the continuously flickering light of the trial ritual, Li Fan’s split consciousness appeared and disappeared like a ghost.

...

Holy Dynasty Great Qi.

Lingzhou, Dujiang County, Xixi Village.

The grim atmosphere of the impending war had already drifted into this peaceful village.

The vast majority of the village’s young and middle-aged men had already joined the Holy Army, ready to depart for conquest at any moment.

Only the elderly, the weak, women, and children remained in each household, maintaining livelihoods while going daily to the Holy Heart Hall to pray for their family members and the great Holy Emperor.

A woman in her forties had just returned from the Holy Heart Hall when she saw a young man standing at her doorway.

For no apparent reason, a sense of closeness arose within her. Just as she was about to speak, her heart suddenly tightened.

As though possessed by some strange force, she swallowed back the words that had reached her lips.

“This...”

“Auntie, may I ask, have you seen me before?”

In the end, it was the young man who spoke first.

But what he said was rather strange.

The woman did not understand.

However, the woman gradually relaxed under the other party’s warm and approachable demeanor, slowly opening up in conversation.

“Young man, I understand what you mean now.”

“You came looking for relatives, did you not?”

“Now that I think about it, you really do resemble my younger brother-in-law somewhat. It is just that he suddenly ran away from home years ago, and we have never seen him again since.” A trace of tears flashed in the woman’s eyes as she spoke slowly.

The young man nodded.

“Other than that, is there anyone else in the family?” he asked.

“My husband died early. It was just the two of us relying on each other since childhood. Though I was his sister-in-law by title, I was really more like his mother,” the woman said with a somewhat self-mocking tone.

“But these past few years, I have come to accept it. What is that saying again? The dead are gone. I adopted two orphans afterward, a boy and a girl. They are both very well-behaved. The old Li family can be considered to have successors now.”

“It is just that recently, it seems the Holy Dynasty is about to go to war. Those two little ones both volunteered to join the army. Sigh... I wonder whether they will be able to return alive. Tell me, everything was perfectly fine, so why fight a war?” the woman muttered worriedly.

But she quickly realized her words had crossed a taboo and immediately fell silent.

Seeing that the young man’s expression did not seem to change, the woman finally let out a sigh of relief.

“Do not worry. They will return home safely,” the young man said kindly.

The woman smiled as well. “Then I will borrow your auspicious words. By the way, have you eaten? How about eating at my home?”

“Seeing that you were not conscripted into the army, you should not be a cultivator, so you still need to eat, right?”

“Ah, this is all my fault. Seeing you reminded me of that missing younger brother-in-law at home again...”

The woman hurriedly explained.

The young man nodded and readily agreed.

He quietly ate a meal at the woman’s home before bidding farewell and leaving.

For some unknown reason, although the woman had only watched from the side and had not eaten anything herself, she still felt as though she had enjoyed a full feast. Her entire body felt warm, as if she had endless strength.

When she looked into the mirror in the room afterward, she was startled to discover that the wrinkles on her face had vanished without her noticing.

Only then did the woman realize that she had encountered a benefactor.

Yet no matter how hard she racked her brain, she could not figure out this benefactor’s identity.

If not for the difference in appearance, she would almost have believed that her younger brother-in-law had returned.

“Fan’er... are you really dead?”

The woman stood dazed in the room, lost in thought.

After leaving Lingzhou, the young man went to several other places in Great Qi.

Including the foot of Jieli Mountain.

In the end, he ascended to the summit of Jieli Mountain and slowly sat down inside a thatched hut at the peak.

This young man was naturally the Holy Emperor of Great Qi.

Ever since comprehending the Dao in the star sea and growing a face of his own, a certain concern had always lingered in his heart.

But for some reason, he had never chosen to investigate deeply.

Until the moment when the decisive battle was about to arrive.

The appearances of all the people of Great Qi were within a single thought of his.

Based on his current appearance, finding possible bloodline connections was not difficult.

It was just that the origins seemed too mixed, not belonging to a single family.

To the point that the Holy Emperor even began to suspect he had made a mistake.

Yet when facing those who truly shared a bloodline connection, the instinctive ripple that arose in his heart allowed the Holy Emperor to finally confirm something.

Yet the truth still seemed deeply hidden within a fog, impossible to fully discern.

“Was it an ancestor, or that mysteriously vanished person?”

“The moment of disappearance happened to coincide exactly with the day my consciousness was born.”

“Possession? Awakening of consciousness?”

...

The Holy Emperor’s thoughts became unusually chaotic.

It was only the movement on his shoulder that startled him awake.

Cat Treasure had awakened from sleep and affectionately rubbed against the Holy Emperor’s cheek.

The Holy Emperor stepped out of the wooden hut and gazed at the sea of clouds in the distance.

Clouds rolled and shifted across the sky, while gentle breezes passed in waves.

The clouds transformed into different shapes, only to vanish in an instant.

The Holy Emperor’s mood gradually returned to calm.

“Whatever my origin may be, I am still myself.”

“Incarnation of the Heavenly Dao, Holy Emperor of Great Qi.”

“When truth is made false...”

“Falsehood also becomes truth.”

The Holy Emperor’s eyes were incomparably calm.

The aura around his body surged like the sea of clouds.

It merged with the Heavenly Dao of the Great Qi world.

“Meow~”

Cat Treasure cried out in satisfaction, then peacefully went back to sleep.

“My mission does not change because of my identity.”

The clothes on his body slowly changed from simple white robes into the Starlight Holy Robe.

His body also expanded from that of an ordinary human to a height of thirty-three chi.

Holy Emperor Li Ping stepped forward from the summit of Jieli Mountain, placing one foot into the empty void beyond the cliff.

The next moment, his figure vanished.

He had returned to the Holy Emperor’s throne.

The brief confusion had already passed. From now on, he would be completely and utterly the Holy Emperor of Great Qi.

What he bore upon his shoulders was not merely himself.

But also the lives of countless soldiers of Great Qi, as well as the future of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Just as the Holy Emperor was quietly pondering, his heart suddenly stirred.

Because he sensed an intention transmitted from the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

It carried both urgency and confusion.

Chapter 1291: Lingering Remnant Soul Hidden Within Residual Will

The intent transmitted by the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao was not entirely clear, but the Holy Emperor Li Ping had already roughly understood what it wanted to convey.

“The position of Great Celestial Venerable…”

“It may lose its connection with me?”

Li Ping frowned and could not help but fall into deep thought.

“For several thousand years, there has not been a new Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable appointed, yet it happens precisely at this moment… who could it be?” The Holy Emperor sensed the faint scent of conspiracy. At present, he could only monitor a small portion of the Xuanhuang Realm, while the vast majority remained blind spots. One face after another flashed rapidly through his mind, yet he could not identify any truly suspicious target.

“Though in theory, anyone capable of passing the Great Celestial Venerable trial should stand on my side and face the Immortal Ancestor together, but…”

While soothing the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, the Holy Emperor’s gaze turned resolute.

“It seems the plan must be moved forward.”

“As long as I can force out the Immortal Ancestor when the Star Sea anomaly arrives, that will be enough.”

A streak of starlight flew out from the Holy Emperor’s throne.

The long-prepared war machine of the Holy Dynasty Great Qi began operating at full speed.

Sun Erlang, who was conducting the final tests on the defensive capabilities of the Holy Army puppets, was somewhat surprised upon receiving the Holy Emperor’s decree. But when he looked at the endless puppet formations arranged across the testing grounds like a field of stars, he quickly became excited and eager.

“Raise an army for a thousand days, use it for a single moment. It is time for the decayed Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance to witness the elite forces of the great Holy Dynasty!”

Just as he was about to leave to handle the expedition preparations, Sun Erlang seemed to remember something and flashed to the deepest underground section of the testing grounds.

Surging earth vein power flowed there, dense enough to seem almost tangible. It appeared to be continuously hammered and compressed by some immense force. What had originally been earthy yellow had now become magma-like crimson. The earth veins roared like torrents, crashing repeatedly against a black stubborn stone at the center.

No matter how violently the earth vein power raged, the stubborn stone stood firm and unmoving. In fact, with every strike from the crimson earth veins, the luster on its surface only grew brighter.

Above the black stubborn stone, a beam of starlight descended from a constantly rotating vortex of starry sky, shining directly onto it.

Under the illumination of the starlight, the black stone seemed almost to breathe. With each inhalation and exhalation, tiny specks of starlight were drawn into it.

Master Qiao Gong floated in midair nearby, staring intently at the black stubborn stone within this strange phenomenon. He also seemed to be constantly calculating something, adjusting and controlling the ratio between the input earth vein power and starlight.

“Senior Qiao Gong, the great battle may begin earlier than expected. Senior Tianyang, he…”

Qiao Gong had apparently already received the decree as well. Without taking his eyes off Tianyang’s body, he said calmly, “Do not worry. When the time comes, I will definitely give the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance a tremendous surprise. Those bastards swallowed quite a bit of my source power in previous years…”

“Right. Since a great battle is coming, those from the Heavenly Spirit Sect can also be put to wasteful use.”

Qiao Gong slapped his forehead, then after reporting to the Holy Emperor with closed eyes, sent out another command transmission that drifted toward the puppets in Nine Mountains Prefecture.

A trace of pride flashed in his eyes, and his attention returned to Tianyang, who was undergoing dual tempering from the surging earth veins and the power of the star sea.

Qiao Gong could clearly sense the immense power being nurtured within that black stubborn stone.

His body trembled slightly, and madness flashed in his eyes.

“This puppet is the pinnacle of my refining skill. Even in the old Heavenly Mechanism Realm, absolutely no one could surpass it. Shangguan, watch carefully. The disciple you once ignored will completely surpass you…”

Ignoring Sun Erlang, who was still present, Qiao Gong muttered to himself while continuously casting spell seals onto Tianyang’s body.

Seeing this, Sun Erlang wisely withdrew in silence.

While the armies and citizens of Great Qi hurriedly prepared for war, two people within the Holy Dynasty were already completely at ease as they left the small world and returned to the Xuanhuang Realm.

They were Xu Ke and Yin Shangren.

Yin Shangren narrowed his eyes and looked up at the sky, seemingly somewhat unaccustomed to the sunlight of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Xu Ke, meanwhile, was determining direction.

Before the great battle began, they intended to infiltrate the Divine Treasure Museum Hall first.

“This Emperor Sanmo is rather interesting. Clearly one of the Three Beast Emperors, yet he joined a human cultivation sect. And when disaster struck, he immediately defected and joined the Newly New Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance…” Yin Shangren said with a cold sneer.

Xu Ke shook his head in explanation.

“Grandfather San is mysterious and unfathomable. No one knows what he is truly thinking. The fact that he did not leave the Xuanhuang Realm with Emperor Yi back then was already incomprehensible. Besides, his actions cannot really be considered betrayal of the Beast Taming Sect. After all, the entire Beast Taming Sect rose to prominence almost entirely because of the methods he brought. He bestowed favor upon the Beast Taming Sect, not the other way around.”

“As for joining the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, I think perhaps it was simply for survival.”

Yin Shangren sneered.

“I do not care about the rest. If I am taking Mr. Bai’s skull and he appears to stop me, I will not show mercy. As for you, you will not switch sides at the last moment, will you?”

Xu Ke replied seriously.

“Do not worry. I have already made arrangements in advance, sending Qing and Hong to the Lingxu Realm. With the imitation Beast Taming Wheel and the current cooperation of the Beast Taming Sect, it should be enough to lure Grandfather San away. Even if the plan fails…”

“I will not show mercy either.”

“Good.”

After receiving Xu Ke’s assurance, Yin Shangren smiled, his expression returning to normal.

Following their plan, the two moved stealthily until they arrived near the Heavenly City of Tianyu Prefecture in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

“This should be the place, the Heng family of Tianyu Prefecture.” Xu Ke observed the surroundings as he spoke.

“From my perspective, we could just pick any family with authority to enter the Museum of Divine Treasure Hall. Why come all the way here?” Yin Shangren rubbed his scalp impatiently.

“That was the original plan. But the Holy Emperor suddenly sent word that something seems to have changed within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance. Access control for entering and leaving alliance headquarters has suddenly become much stricter. As a result, there are not many cultivators left who still have access to the Divine Treasure Hall. Among them, the Heng family of Tianyu Prefecture is the most suitable target.”

“A prominent family, all due to their weaving techniques. Their strength is not especially great, and they keep a relatively low profile, with little public presence…” Xu Ke explained via voice transmission.

Yin Shangren’s gaze pierced through the Heng family’s defenses, revealing a cold smile.

“The easiest targets should be those two girls, correct? A mother and daughter pair, no less…”

“Correct. Heng Ruoshui and He Xinxin. We only need to capture them when they leave and assume their identities.”

“The Holy Emperor instructed that unless necessary, no one should be harmed,” Xu Ke added.

Yin Shangren replied, “Do not worry. Their tender flesh does not suit my appetite anyway. Though the two of us becoming women? Can we not choose different targets?”

Xu Ke laughed.

“You still care about this outer shell?”

Yin Shangren waved dismissively.

“That is true enough. No point wasting time. Quick victory. I am becoming rather impatient to see Mr. Bai’s skull.”

The Heng family mother and daughter did not make the two wait long.

One day later, He Xinxin slipped out to play and was silently captured by the pair.

Two days after that, Heng Ruoshui seemed to have received an invitation to a banquet and left her cave dwelling. She too was captured in an instant by the two.

Looking at the Heng family mother and daughter, bound together and unconscious, Yin Shangren stroked his chin.

"The technique bestowed by the Holy Emperor is truly useful. The Dao script compass within this little girl's body is somewhat extraordinary. It has the ability to seek fortune and avoid misfortune, as well as deduce and predict. It can be considered half of a Heavenly Wonder, perhaps reborn after the dissolution of an ancient immortal artifact..."

"However, with the secret technique [Sky Shrouding Hand] granted by the Holy Emperor, this little girl did not sense the coming danger at all."

Xu Ke smiled.

"Perhaps because neither of us harbors any intention to harm others. Quickly, let us begin."

They each extracted a drop of essence blood from the foreheads of the Heng family mother and daughter.

Xu Ke took his and pressed it into his glabella.

Yin Shangren was far cruder. A slit opened across his scalp, and his Oneself Dao Foundation swallowed it whole.

As flesh squirmed and churned, in the blink of an eye, Xu Ke and Yin Shangren had respectively transformed into Heng Ruoshui and He Xinxin.

Their appearances, auras, and even soul fluctuations were almost completely identical.

"The wondrous methods passed down by the Holy Dynasty are indeed extraordinary." Xu Ke's eyes showed astonishment.

Yin Shangren closed his eyes in contemplation.

"The self that follows the heart is the true self. Ever-changing and unpredictable, unfathomable to gods and ghosts..."

After hiding the mother and daughter, the disguised Xu Ke and Yin Shangren flew toward Tianyu Heavenly City.

For cultivators to apply to visit the Museum of Divine Treasures, they had to submit a request through the local Administration Hall to the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters.

Only after approval from the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters would a designated guiding cultivator arrive to escort them inside.

In Tianyu Prefecture, a face like Heng Ruoshui's was the best possible pass.

And bringing a younger family member to visit the Museum of Divine Treasures was the most natural thing imaginable.

The journey proceeded without obstruction, and the application was quickly sent to the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters.

The response efficiency of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters was not nearly so swift. Only after seven days did a final reply arrive.

The nobility of Tianyu Prefecture seemed utterly insignificant before the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's guiding cultivator.

The black-robed guiding cultivator wore an indifferent expression and casually explained a few matters requiring attention upon entering Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters.

He brought the two to Tiancheng of Tianshu Prefecture, located around the center of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, then opened a portal leading to the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters within a room deep inside the Administration Hall.

The moment they stepped into the ring of light, rolling illusions surged forth one after another.

Even with Yin Shangren and Xu Ke's current strength, they could not stop it.

But Xu Ke recovered in an instant, because the Heng Ruoshui he was impersonating had not come to Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters for the first time.

As for the He Xinxin impersonated by Yin Shangren, her body trembled slightly before she opened her eyes a moment later.

Following routine, the guiding cultivator explained the reason for the illusions appearing. Then he casually asked:

"What did you see?"

Yin Shangren answered according to the Holy Emperor's instructions:

"The Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor's manifestation, towering between heaven and earth, transmitting the Dao to all living beings."

The guiding cultivator nodded and asked no further questions.

While traveling along the path through the void toward the Museum of Divine Treasures, Yin Shangren and Xu Ke secretly communicated through voice transmission.

Yin Shangren said: "Interesting. I saw the scene of the Immortal Ancestor floating outside the Xuanhuang Realm. Looking down upon Xuanhuang from above. The Xuanhuang Realm was far smaller than it is now. It should be a scene from shortly after the Immortal Ancestor attained Longevity Immortal through Dao attainment."

"What did you see?" Master Yin asked.

Xu Ke immediately transmitted an image.

It seemed to be within chaotic void, with no way to determine the exact location.

Two figures stood facing each other, their appearances impossible to discern.

"Who are you?"

"I am you."

"You are me..." The voice sounded somewhat hesitant.

After a brief silence, the speaker slowly shook his head.

"No. I am not the same as you..."

The other voice laughed, carrying faint mockery.

"This is your destined mission. You cannot refuse. Better accept reality. Sooner or later, we will become one."

"I already said, I am Xuanyuan Tuo. Not..."

At the crucial moment, the image shattered abruptly.

Yin Shangren was stunned for a moment and glanced at Xu Ke.

Xu Ke looked somewhat helpless.

"That is all I saw as well. The crucial part afterward was indeed gone."

Yin Shangren replayed the sequence several times.

"Interesting. Once we return, this information must be reported to the Holy Emperor. He should know something."

As the two conversed, they soon arrived before the Museum of Divine Treasures.

Standing atop a floating continent, the entire structure was black, solemn, and majestic.

Its towering and narrow gates caused every visiting cultivator to instinctively feel reverence.

After another round of identity verification, the guiding cultivator led them inside the museum.

The first exhibit they were required to visit was the enormous sphere of light known as [Beautiful Era].

Within the sphere of light, it seemed as though countless worlds were being born and destroyed.

"This is [Era]," the guiding cultivator explained with practiced familiarity.

"Using a single Dao Deviation Stone as its core, it deduces and manifests scenes from every era in the history of the Xuanhuang Realm."

"In all of the deduced worlds, cultivators have a far lower chance of survival than they do now."

"So although it is called Era, in truth it exists to highlight the beauty of the present age."

...

Yin Shangren and Xu Ke both remained unconvinced, though neither showed it openly. They merely nodded silently.

“As is customary, the two of you may personally experience it.”

“Do not worry. A whole lifetime within an era passes in but an instant in reality. And under normal circumstances, you will not survive more than a few years in an era illusion.”

Under the operation of the black-robed guide cultivator, Yin Shangren and Xu Ke each sent out a strand of divine sense and entered separate era light spheres.

Not long afterward, the guide cultivator’s expression became somewhat strange.

Because the situation he had expected did not occur.

One of them entered the ancient immortal cultivation era, while the other was cast into an age of absolute chaotic slaughter.

Yet one of them had surprisingly good fortune. Not only did they step onto the immortal path from childhood, they repeatedly encountered fortunate opportunities. They cultivated smoothly all the way to Soul Transformation, became a core disciple of an immortal sect, and ultimately died of old age.

The other was even more absurd.

She forcibly carved out a bloody path through the chaotic age. She became a female devil whom everyone feared, even taking pleasure in devouring cultivators’ souls alive. Only after committing countless atrocities, when cultivators across the world could no longer endure it and united together, was she finally slain in a siege.

“The other eras seem quite good as well.” After awakening from the era illusion, the two spoke with lingering interest.

The guide cultivator froze for a moment, then checked their information once again.

Heng Ruoshui. He Xinxin.

“I never expected this young girl to be so vicious at such an age.”

He had just been about to persuade them to continue the era journey and serve as proof for the Beautiful Eras.

But the two had already impatiently walked onward through the eras.

The guide cultivator hesitated as if wanting to speak, but ultimately said nothing more.

Next, he led them through different sections such as Heroes of Many Talents, Seas Change into Mulberry Fields, and Contest of Ten Thousand Techniques.

Yin Shangren suddenly said, “Next, we would like to look around on our own. Is that possible?”

His tone clearly carried impatience.

The guide cultivator nodded. In any case, his task had already been completed, so he handed over a jade token.

After explaining some precautions, the guide cultivator vanished from before them.

Xu Ke and Yin Shangren exchanged a glance. With perfect tacit understanding, they continued browsing while slowly moving toward the central area of the Divine Treasury Hall.

After quite some time, they finally saw the skull resting quietly in the distance.

Xu Ke’s body trembled slightly. He took a deep breath, and only then did his emotions gradually calm.

Yin Shangren also exerted tremendous effort to avoid showing any abnormal reaction.

They walked before Mr. Bai’s skull and silently gazed at it.

“I am almost unable to resist making a move.”

“Wait a little longer. The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Holy Dynasty have not started fighting yet. More importantly, I can vaguely sense that Grandfather San is still in the museum. In any case, with the authority level of these two members of the Heng family, there is no time limit for the visit…”

Yin Shangren did not reply. He had already become immersed in observing Mr. Bai’s skull.

No one knew how much time passed before another figure arrived near the skull.

After gazing for a long time, he let out a soft sigh.

It immediately drew the attention of Xu Ke and Yin Shangren.

The newcomer was a middle-aged cultivator with a long beard. Like them, he looked at Mr. Bai’s skull with emotions he could barely suppress.

“So it is this fellow…” Yin Shangren let out a cold snort.

“You know him?” Xu Ke asked.

“Hmph. His name is Shangguan Shiquan. Back then, he competed with me for Mr. Bai’s rib bone. Speaking of which, one of Mr. Bai’s leg bones is still in his possession…” Yin Shangren said with hostility.

“Hmph. Once we recover the most important skull, the remaining parts must also be reclaimed one by one.” Xu Ke’s gaze also flashed with dangerous intent.

“Naturally.” Yin Shangren fully agreed.

“Grandpa, what is so interesting about this? I still want to see the ancient dharma artifact from earlier…” A somewhat childish voice came from the distance.

It was a little girl of three or four years old, who walked over to Shangguan Shiquan, tugging at him with a tearful expression.

“This person was one of the greatest cultivators in Xuanhuang Realm history,” Shangguan Shiquan said as he picked up the little girl and comforted her.

Hearing this, the little girl widened her eyes curiously and stared intently at the skull ahead.

Meanwhile, after hearing Shangguan Shiquan’s words, the attitudes of Yin Shangren and Xu Ke shifted slightly.

After a moment of silence, the little girl suddenly stretched out her finger in alarm and pointed at Mr. Bai’s skull.

“Grandpa, look quickly. There is someone there!”

Like a bolt of thunder, the words exploded in the hearts of the three present.

All three instantly locked their gaze onto the skull once more.

Yet it remained utterly still and silent. There was not the slightest trace of life anywhere.

Shangguan Shiquan rubbed the little girl’s head.

“Nannan, do not speak nonsense. Where is there any person?”

The little girl pouted, her face full of unhappiness.

“Nannan is not speaking nonsense. There really is someone. Inside the skull. Can you not see them?”

The little girl spoke with such seriousness that Shangguan Shiquan could not help but hesitate.

He carefully examined it once more.

Still, nothing was discovered.

Shangguan Shiquan secretly mocked himself. He had no idea how many times he had already come to inspect this skull. How could anyone possibly be hiding inside it?

Assuming it was merely childish nonsense, Shangguan Shiquan told the little girl not to make trouble.

But the little girl stubbornly insisted, continuing to shout without stopping.

Helpless, Shangguan Shiquan could only take the little girl away for the time being.

Near the skull, only Yin Shangren and Xu Ke remained once more.

Xu Ke spoke in a low voice, "What do you think?"

Clearly, he was referring to the little girl's earlier words.

"Impossible. I am absolutely certain that Mr. Bai truly perished completely. There is definitely no remnant consciousness of his left within this skull."

"Moreover, Emperor Sanmo is no ordinary figure. He would not fail to distinguish whether any remnant consciousness remained in the skull. If there truly were something there, how could he openly place it here for us to observe? Hmph. That would be the remnant consciousness of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable..." Only after a long silence did Yin Shangren answer with some decisiveness.

"But..." Xu Ke stared at Mr. Bai's skull, a trace of doubt flashing through his eyes.

"Before that little girl said it, I had not noticed anything. But after she mentioned it, I truly do feel as though something is hidden inside this skull."

"Not Mr. Bai's remnant consciousness, but something else..."

"When I was young, I liked playing hide and seek with my companions. Whenever Mr. Bai was around, we all liked hiding near him. It was as though he could contain the entire world. As long as you stayed close to him, it became very difficult for others to find you..." Xu Ke murmured.

His words caused even Yin Shangren to become uncertain.

"Right. That guide cultivator mentioned before that a remnant soul from a past era once escaped. Its whereabouts afterward became unknown..."

"Could it be?" Xu Ke suddenly said.

"The remnant soul of an era?" Yin Shangren narrowed his eyes and stared at Mr. Bai's skull.

"We have stayed here too long. Let us go somewhere else first."

Rather than answering, he said this instead.

After walking to the exhibition area called [Forms of All Living Beings], Yin Shangren finally spoke.

"Although Mr. Bai's remains appear no different from the bones of an ordinary mortal, they are, after all, the bones of a former Great Celestial Venerable. There must certainly be something extraordinary about them."

"It is just that this special quality is difficult to identify. I once stitched together and raised a mutated human-hand dog. It was disgusted by every kind of bone. Only the white rib bone in my collection held a special attraction for it..."

"It was as though that bone could save it from disaster." Yin Shangren seemed to recall something as he spoke thoughtfully.

Xu Ke's heart stirred. "If that is the case, perhaps Mr. Bai's skull truly does have some method of sheltering that remnant soul. It is just that we have not yet uncovered the truth."

"Hmph. We are separated by several layers of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's protections, so we cannot see clearly. Once we get the skull into our hands, naturally everything will become clear," Yin Shangren snorted coldly.

Xu Ke nodded in agreement, then suddenly said, "Come to think of it, even we failed to detect the remnant soul hidden within the skull. Yet that little girl noticed it..."

"That little one is no simple matter. What was her name again? Shangguan Nihong? Once we return, we must certainly report this matter to the Holy Emperor..."

If Li Fan had been present and heard their conversation, he would certainly have guessed that the force within Mr. Bai's skull protecting the remnant soul of the era was precisely the [Eternal Remnant Thought], which held a fatal attraction to [Truth].

This form of energy, currently unknown to the cultivators of the Xuanhuang Realm and usable only by [Truth], was the fundamental reason Li Fan had gone to such lengths to obtain Mr. Bai's skull.

However, because in this life the Holy Emperor had severed the connection with his true body within the star sea, even if Yin Shangren and Xu Ke conveyed their discovery to the Holy Emperor, Li Fan was destined to remain unaware.

While the two of them were touring the Museum of Divine Treasures, an unusual atmosphere had already begun gradually spreading throughout the territory of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Because Li Fan's divine sense clone and Sun Tianci had previously infiltrated the Great Earth Cavern and stolen the Dao Foundations from nearly one fifth of the sleeping cultivators, the upper ranks of the Immortal Alliance were utterly enraged.

Because the Heavenly Spirit Sect within Nine Mountains Prefecture had suddenly rebelled, working from both inside and outside, they joined forces with the Five Elders Association and seized control of Nine Mountains Prefecture in one stroke.

The fall of Nine Mountains Prefecture shook the entire Immortal Alliance. The Immortal Alliance declared a state of emergency war preparedness, and to prevent the Five Elders Association from expanding their gains, mobilized large numbers of cultivators to the border to establish defensive lines.

Cultivators from every prefecture were also forbidden from moving freely. For the vast majority of the time, they were only permitted to move within the Heavenly Cities of their respective prefectures.

The Immortal Alliance was discussing how to retake Nine Mountains Prefecture.

Meanwhile, in places beyond their sight, the armies of the Holy Dynasty Great Qi had already boarded the Samantabhadra True Boat, following along the White Mist Barrier and appearing within the various prefectures of the Immortal Alliance.

They were only waiting for the Holy Emperor's decree. Once it came, they would swarm downward and launch a total assault against the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

"Senior Brother, when do we make our move? I can barely hold myself back anymore."

Within the white mist, Ou Shangtian rubbed his hands together, his gaze piercing through the White Mist Barrier, visibly excited.

"Wait a little longer. Wait until the formations in the Central Four Prefectures are fully arranged," Sun Erlang said steadily.

"Speaking of which, Senior Qiao Gong's move of redirecting disaster and splitting the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's attention was truly brilliant. The Immortal Alliance has moved large numbers of troops to the border, which is undoubtedly excellent news for us," Wang Xuanba said slowly while playing with a strange beast resembling a white snake in his hand.

"Do not be careless. Master once said that the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance is far less simple than it appears. Those cultivators... are merely a smokescreen to deceive others."

"Do you think our Holy Dynasty alone possesses Sky Patrolling Arrows and Holy Army puppets, while the Immortal Alliance has none? True victory must be fought for with lives." Sun Erlang clearly possessed a sharp understanding of the battle situation and rebuked them.

At the headquarters of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

"Of course not. This came from my homeland."

Trying to leave the bounds of this starry sky.

Based upon Li Fan’s formation knowledge accumulated over a hundred reincarnations through continuous deductions with the Final Dissociation Disc, knowledge surpassing several generations of the Xuanhuang Realm, and further integrating the insights Li Fan, or rather the Final Dissociation Disc, gained after obtaining several Immortal-grade formations.

After being infused with these formation essences, the Holy Emperor, through his enlightenment within the star sea, pushed the formations to an even deeper level.

At this moment, within the Great Qi Holy Dynasty, inside the enormous moon hanging above the skies of the four Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance prefectures and occupying nearly half the heavens.

Facing the statue of the Holy Emperor, they knelt and prayed devoutly.

And beneath the Holy Emperor Throne in the Holy Capital.

The violet-gold fortune of the Holy Dynasty and the golden source power essence merged into one.

Forming faint violet-gold starlight that departed the Holy Dynasty’s territory, sustaining the operation of the grand formation trapping the four prefectures of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

This ultimate trapping formation, named the [Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation] by the Holy Emperor, was almost infinitely close to a true Immortal-grade formation. Li Ping believed that even if a Immortal Ancestor arrived personally, it would still take some time to break through.

As for the people currently inside the four prefectures of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance trying to break the formation.

They would first have to ask whether the Heavenly Mandate Holy Emperor agreed.

Li Ping sat upon the Holy Emperor Throne, his gaze crossing the boundary between the two worlds and falling upon the territory of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance in the Xuanhuang Realm.

The Holy Emperor Throne, or rather the entire Holy Capital, had become incomparably quiet with the great battle having begun.

Cat Treasure remained as always, lazily sleeping against Li Ping’s shoulder. It seemed that apart from source power essence, nothing in the world could stir its interest.

Aside from Cat Treasure, there was also a figure that appeared to be only eight or nine years old standing beside the Holy Emperor.

Staring intently at the Xuanhuang Realm below.

It was Tianyang.

At this moment, after his puppet body had received massive infusions of source power essence, along with the combat memories of the Immortal Puppet Ancestor, he had already undergone earthshaking changes compared to before. His appearance and body had returned to how they were in life.

He had even genuinely developed the aura of life.

His strength was unfathomably profound as he gazed at the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, waiting for his opponent to descend.

And below the Holy Emperor Throne, Daoist Yi Jue of the Du'e Sect had brought out every single paper figure from the entire sect.

The paper figures reconstructed the mountain gate of the Du'e Sect from those bygone years right on the spot.

At the center of the buildings, a passage leading to some unknown place seemed to have been opened.

Although Daoist Yi Jue himself had not entered it, his eyes bulged outward and extended infinitely, probing deep into the passage.

“Holy Emperor, rest assured. If there is the slightest disturbance in the Xuanhuang Realm, this old Daoist will definitely see it,” Daoist Yi Jue said with a cheerful smile.

Li Ping did not pay Yi Jue any attention.

In truth, more than half of his focus and attention was on the starry sky outside the Xuanhuang Realm.

There, he had already made layer upon layer of preparations.

Waiting for the Heavenly Doctor and the Immortal Ancestor to descend.

Outside the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Four Prefectures, beyond the Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation.

At the very moment the sky of the Xuanhuang Realm turned incomparably dim, when the Holy Dynasty Great Qi descended with subsidiary small worlds resembling stars, and all the attention of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators was drawn away.

A tremendous upheaval simultaneously erupted within the Heavenly Cities of every prefecture of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

The moment Sun Luyuan saw the bright moon appear in the sky, it was as if some switch in his mind had been flipped. Without any thought whatsoever, he directly issued orders to those deathsworn soldier he had prepared for many years.

These deathsworn soldier would use their own lives as the price to detonate the formation restrictions left within their bodies inside the prefectural teleportation formations and the Tianxuan Mirrors.

Sun Luyuan, who had long since entered Dao Integration and presided over a great cultivation family, actually experienced a momentary blankness in his mind after issuing this order.

His throat went dry, and his hands and feet turned ice cold.

Yet before the delayed fear could rise within him, he discovered with some astonishment that in some prefectures, before his deathsworn soldier even had the chance to act, the Tianxuan Mirrors and teleportation formations had already been destroyed by others first.

Sun Luyuan immediately understood.

"For something this important, it was impossible they would entrust it to me alone."

Amid the chaos, Sun Luyuan saw gigantic flying vessels radiating golden light appear abruptly, like divine soldiers descending from heaven.

Before the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators could even react, the Heavenly Cities had already been surrounded.

Strange-looking puppets flew out from the vessels, firing streams of black light.

The supposedly impregnable defensive formations of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Heavenly Cities instantly became precarious.

As if they could be broken at any moment.

"It seems the rank of the traitors within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance may be even higher than mine."

"Could it be that even Chief Lu has defected?"

Sun Luyuan narrowed his eyes as he watched, immediately feeling far more at ease.

"The promising younger members of the family have already been arranged by me to leave the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Four Prefectures in advance. As for those remaining, I already warned them beforehand. As long as they hide in their cave dwellings, they should not be caught in the disaster."

"It is just a pity about Lu'er. I could not transfer him out in advance."

"Tianci seems to be in seclusion. His strength surpasses even mine, so there should be no need to worry about him."

As Sun Luyuan thought, he saw the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance beginning to organize cultivators into coordinated resistance. He could not help but let out a cold snort.

"Now is the time for me to establish merit."

With extreme caution, he changed both his appearance and aura. Then, catching them off guard, Sun Luyuan launched an attack against the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance defensive formations from within. Coordinating with the Holy Dynasty soldiers outside the Heavenly City, they quickly secured victory.

As a talisman personally written by the Holy Emperor was affixed to the forehead of the statue of the Immortal Ancestor within the Heavenly City.

It represented the complete fall of that Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Heavenly City.

The first Heavenly City captured by the Holy Dynasty had appeared.

Nandu Prefecture.

Although this was partly because the prefecture's defender possessed only Soul Transformation cultivation and its defensive forces were exceptionally weak, the significance remained immense.

Very soon, through the Holy Emperor's great power and the Star Sea Net, all soldiers of the Holy Dynasty learned of this matter.

The morale of the Holy Dynasty forces was greatly boosted, and they intensified their offensive once again. The battle situation was even more favorable than imagined.

The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had enjoyed peace for too long, and most of the combat forces in various regions had already been transferred to the borders.

In addition, the defensive formations they relied upon most for counterattacks had all failed.

Thus, in the face of the Holy Dynasty's fierce assault, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance was almost entirely being beaten one-sidedly.

Sun Erlang looked at the territorial map of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance before him, its colors changing rapidly due to the constant reports of victory, yet there was not the slightest joy in his eyes.

Because he knew the current results only existed because the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had been caught completely off guard.

Once they reacted, the true bitter battle would begin.

"Liuguang Prefecture, a Dao Integration cultivator has appeared. Blue Ice Immortal Sage."

"Yueyang Prefecture has also encountered a Dao Integration enemy. No information exists on him. Repeating, the enemy's identity is unknown."

...

Watching the endless stream of battlefield reports and sensing the black-gold puppet in his mind, Sun Erlang pondered briefly and did not act rashly.

If they were only ordinary Dao Integration cultivators, the currently allocated military strength would be sufficient to deal with them.

He needed to wait until the true opponent revealed themselves before making his move.

Moreover...

Sun Erlang's gaze turned toward the area directly beneath the bright moon in the sky, where the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Four Prefectures were located.

The battles on the outskirts were merely appetizers.

The place that would truly determine victory or defeat was there.

The Dao Deviation Stone in his mind flashed with blue light as Sun Erlang carried out another deduction, striving to complete the outer battlefield with the fewest casualties possible.

"Master, I will not disappoint you."

Sun Erlang silently said in his heart.

The Holy Dynasty Great Qi advanced victoriously in battle after battle, but this momentum was soon interrupted by an unexpected event.

Luoyan Prefecture. After Luoyan Heavenly City was captured, most of the Holy Dynasty soldiers transferred to other battlefields.

Only a small portion remained behind to guard it.

But from beyond the Luoyan Prefecture wilderness, a large group of cultivators suddenly emerged.

They did not attempt to retake Luoyan Heavenly City, but instead launched a surprise attack and swiftly retreated.

If the Holy Dynasty army’s setback in Luoyan Prefecture could be considered merely an accident.

Then what happened in Tianling Prefecture was undeniable proof that the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance truly possessed some real foundations.

After expending considerable effort to capture Tianling City, the Holy Dynasty army discovered that it was actually an empty city.

The important cultivators within had already completed their evacuation.

Only some cultivators without backing remained, relying on mechanisms and artifacts to resist.

The Holy Dynasty soldiers quickly realized this might be a trap, but before they could retreat, the entire Tianling City exploded with a thunderous blast.

The gigantic floating city, together with nearly ten thousand cultivators from both sides, was instantly reduced to ashes.

In the sky, death phenomena erupted all at once.

Numerous strange visions mixed and twisted together.

Making them impossible to distinguish clearly.

Tianling Prefecture, within a hidden mountain valley.

“Thanks to Brother Sun’s warning, our Tianling Prefecture was able to turn disaster into fortune.” Tianling City Lord Song Mansheng stroked his beard and said with a smile.

Sun Liancheng’s gaze remained fixed on the massive fireball in the distant sky. “It was still thanks to the City Lord’s wisdom. If not for your decisiveness, even if I had made the suggestion, the effect in killing the enemy would never have been this great.”

The other cultivators in the valley all chimed in.

“Exactly. Based on the visual recordings we left in the city, at least over ten thousand bandits perished in that explosion.”

“Haha, Fellow Daoist saw wrongly. Clearly it was twenty thousand!”

“…Ah, yes, yes. I am getting old and confused. Twenty thousand, it really was twenty thousand. We have visual evidence to prove it!”

Everyone spoke with mutual understanding.

“Speaking of which, where exactly did this group come from? They attacked without any warning, and most importantly, they were even able to interfere with the teleportation formations and Tianxuan Mirror.” Sun Liancheng interrupted the celebration.

“They should not be from the Five Elders Association. I have fought cultivators from the Five Elders Association before. The aura I sensed from them was completely different.”

“Who cares where they came from? Once the Immortal Alliance central headquarters takes action, they will all die. They are only acting arrogantly for now!”

“Lord Song, should we take advantage of the chaos and go out to earn more merit?”

Someone among the valley cultivators suggested.

Song Mansheng pondered for a moment, did not make a decision, and instead looked toward Sun Liancheng beside him.

Sun Liancheng narrowed his eyes and remained silent for a long time.

After everyone had waited for quite a while, Sun Liancheng finally shook his head. “The situation is unclear. This subordinate cannot make a judgment.”

Song Mansheng nodded upon hearing this. “In that case, let us wait a little longer. With the situation unclear, it is unwise to act rashly.”

Naturally, everyone in the valley agreed.

But Song Mansheng and Sun Liancheng avoided the others and held a private conversation.

“Brother Sun, you were not telling the truth just now.” Song Mansheng said in a deep voice.

Sun Liancheng smiled bitterly. “I truly did not dare say it in front of everyone. Otherwise, I feared it would shake morale.”

Song Mansheng’s expression turned grave. “That serious?”

Sun Liancheng replied, “Yes. Lord, you also know that my ability to predict this bandit assault relied entirely on the sensing of our Sun family’s fortune. That day, while I was chatting with my nephew, I suddenly felt our family fortune like a candle in the wind, trembling on the verge of extinction…”

“In extreme panic, I spent considerable effort before finally determining that the cause did not come from the Immortal Alliance, but from outside. I originally thought it would be a Five Elders Association surprise attack, but I never expected it to be an unknown group of bandits.”

“During this period, our family’s future fortune has been constantly wavering. One moment it shows overwhelming wealth and prosperity, the next it becomes an ominous sign of total bloodline extinction. It is truly terrifying…” Sun Liancheng sighed.

Song Mansheng’s brows furrowed even tighter upon hearing this.

Sun Liancheng advised, “No matter what, with the merit from blowing up the city, when rewards are distributed in the future, your contribution certainly will not be overlooked. The merit is already completely sufficient, so why take further risks? I imagine reinforcements for the other side will arrive soon. Those bandits’ combat strength is not weak. Rather than taking risks, it is better to remain hidden in this valley.”

“With the natural grand formation concealing us, they should not be able to detect us…”

Song Mansheng was ultimately persuaded and suppressed the restless thoughts in his heart.

Only less than half a day later, Song Mansheng saw a large number of bandits swarming in.

Their faces were filled with fury as they carefully searched every corner of Tianling Prefecture.

Fortunately, fortune ultimately remained on their side, and they were not exposed.

Inside the valley, everyone was extremely nervous, frequently looking up at the sky and whispering among themselves.

None retained their previous relaxed composure.

“Uncle, something is wrong.”

It was precisely because of his almost miraculous premonitions that they had been able to set up the ambush, detonate the Heavenly City, and wipe out a large wave of bandits.

Within heaven and earth, as branches spread and descendants multiply, the family scatters and its fortune declines.

The Reversed Evolution of Heaven and Earth Record cultivated by Sun Qi could reverse this trend, causing the family fortune to become increasingly concentrated.

The price, however, was that the more prosperous the family became, the more all kinds of accumulated forces of decline would be concentrated upon the cultivator of this technique.

From the five rings, countless tentacles extended downward toward Tianling Prefecture below.

And one of them was flying directly toward the Sun family.

“Not good!” Sun Qi’s expression changed drastically as he hurriedly shouted.

Sun Liancheng had already acted a step ahead.

He no longer cared about the family at all.

Alone, he transformed into a streak of blood-red light and rapidly flew toward the white mist barrier not far away.

But this escape technique, powered by burning his soul, unexpectedly grew slower and slower at a speed visible to the naked eye. It was as if countless tiny tendrils existed in the air around him, dragging and obstructing him.

The blood-red light dispersed, and Sun Liancheng revealed his true form. It was as if he had even lost the ability to fly, as he heavily plummeted from the sky.

The black writhing tendrils in the sky quickly locked onto him. They violently pierced into Sun Liancheng's body.

Sun Liancheng panicked and tried to cast spells to resist, but the surrounding spiritual energy seemed to have frozen solid and would not obey his control at all.

Unable to resist in the slightest, the black tendrils quickly pierced straight through Sun Liancheng.

Amid the screams of the Sun family members, they too were each seized by the tendrils branching down from the sky.

The wailing lasted only for a short while before Sun Liancheng's body was assimilated into the same kind of black tendril.

There was not even any phenomenon of a cultivator's fall appearing in the sky.

It was as if Sun Liancheng had not died, but had merely transformed into that black tendril.

The Sun family members were captured one after another, while only Sun Qi felt an icy chill in his heart.

He did not dare move.

Yes, in the entire Sun family, only he, Sun Qi, escaped disaster. Because at the very instant those horrifying tendrils locked onto him, Sun Qi had vaguely sensed something in his heart.

Amid ten thousand paths to death, he found the one and only faintly shining chance of survival.

So he did not hesitate in the slightest and directly used the cultivation dispersal chapter of the Supreme Primordial True Scripture, dispersing all of his cultivation.

He also expelled every bit of spiritual qi stored within his body.

Without holding anything back, he thoroughly became an ordinary mortal.

A black tendril as thick as an arm slowly drifted past in front of Sun Qi.

As if it possessed intelligence, it circled around him once.

Only from such close proximity did Sun Qi finally see clearly that these black tendrils were actually formed from countless densely packed black insects.

He did not even dare breathe, his entire body rigid with tension.

Fortunately, after determining that Sun Qi was nothing more than an ordinary mortal with no cultivation, the black tendril spared him.

Carrying away the entire Sun family, who had already transformed into the same black flying insects, it howled away into the distance.

Sun Qi still maintained his original stiff posture, not daring to move.

Only after nearly half a day had passed did his whole body go limp, and he collapsed to the ground.

"What exactly are these things..."

Countless thoughts surged through his mind, and only after a long while did he recover some spirit.

Looking at the white mist barrier not far away, as well as the five circular rings in the sky that were gradually fading away.

Sun Qi gritted his teeth and began cultivating once more.

Not long after closing his eyes to cultivate, Sun Qi suddenly opened them again.

He sharply noticed that the spiritual energy between heaven and earth...

Was different from before.
