Chapter 1294: The Holy Emperor Awakens A Residual Thought

Sun Qi raised his hand, attempting to touch the sky.

Without deliberately trying to absorb anything, the surrounding spiritual energy impatiently surged into his body in a frenzy.

This feeling...

Sun Qi had not experienced it for a very long time.

It was as if the towering tree pressing down upon him had been pushed away. Sun Qi felt an unprecedented sense of ease.

"Hehehe..."

After standing in a daze for a moment, a savage expression gradually appeared in Sun Qi's eyes.

"So family, relatives, all of them really are burdens!"

"Reverse the evolution of heaven and earth, heaven and earth reversed in evolution. At the end of this path, there can only be one eternal sole existence!"

"I am the Sun family. The Sun family is me!"

"The prosperity of the entire family shall return to one person alone..."

Having lived the first half of his life beneath the shadow of the family, now through a strange twist of fate, all his relatives had died out. Yet Sun Qi did not feel much sorrow at all. Instead, he felt a pleasure he had never experienced in this lifetime.

He even vaguely sensed that as the rest of the Sun family's bloodline died, the overall fortune of the Sun family had not directly scattered or vanished.

Instead, it was slowly gathering toward him.

"Give me ten years, no, five years. Not only can I recover my former cultivation, I may even achieve the Dao Integration realm..."

The wonderful future foreseen by his intense intuition made Sun Qi's body tremble with excitement. It even made him want to laugh loudly.

But another silver white arrow whistling overhead instantly turned his face pale and made him shudder.

"Heavenly Sovereign above. Could it really be that cultivators from outside the Xuanhuang Realm have invaded..."

Sun Qi shrank his head, then looked toward the white mist barrier not far away. Gritting his teeth, he actively accelerated his absorption of spiritual energy.

"I cannot stay in Tianling Prefecture. I need to leave quickly..."

"What a pity those burdens were all dragged away by the tentacles. If I want to cross the white mist barrier, I can only rely on myself."

Having dispersed his cultivation and rebuilt it, Sun Qi's cultivation speed was astonishingly fast. In just the time it took for a stick of incense to burn, he had already returned to the peak of Qi Condensation.

More and more bandits flew across the skies overhead, making the urgency in Sun Qi's heart grow stronger.

"I can already control a flying artifact. I should first get somewhere safe."

"Crossing only one prefectural barrier will not reduce my lifespan by much."

"Only after returning to Foundation Establishment can I once again observe my future fortune. But I cannot wait any longer..."

Having made up his mind, a transparent sphere wrapped around him and flew directly into the white mist.

Just as Shanteng Prefecture came within reach, Sun Qi suddenly discovered with horror that there seemed to be some human figures faintly visible within the white mist ahead.

Alarmed, he immediately controlled his artifact to stop flying.

But it was already too late.

"Who goes there!"

A furious shout rang out, accompanied by multicolored spell attacks flying out from the white mist, all striking Sun Qi.

He did not even have time to let out a scream before he was instantly blasted into ashes.

"Target eliminated. Alert lifted!"

Cai Yongchen, squad leader of the Third Legion of Great Qi, who was carrying out garrison duty, checked the scene before reporting.

"Only Qi Condensation cultivation. Probably a Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivator fleeing in panic."

"Bad luck. I thought it would be a big fish."

"Quite an unlucky bastard, charging straight into our security perimeter..."

"Stop chatting. Sweep this entire area clean immediately!" Cai Yongchen coldly snorted, interrupting his subordinates' idle chatter.

He suddenly sneezed.

It was as if something from that Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivator who had been blasted to death without even a corpse remaining had entered his body.

Cai Yongchen's expression turned serious. After carefully examining himself, he found nothing abnormal.

But the professional discipline of a Great Qi legion squad leader prevented him from simply ignoring it.

Instead, he very seriously reported the cause of the matter and his personal sensations in detail through the Holy Emperor Star Sea Net.

Only after making the report did he relax and continue leading his subordinates in the cleanup operation.

...

Within Sun Erlang's sea of consciousness, reports of similar incidents surfaced without pause.

These even included Holy Army puppets expended on the battlefield, the number of Sky-Patrolling Arrows consumed, wounded and fallen Great Qi soldiers, as well as lists of Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance forces that had been captured alive or had surrendered.

There were also inventory reports from the Great Qi Holy Dynasty's rear territories, listing newly produced resources.

Massive sets of constantly shifting real time data flickered endlessly.

Based on this information, the Dao Deviation Stone glowing with faint blue light within Sun Erlang's sea of consciousness continuously adjusted its battlefield simulations accordingly.

Although resistance had emerged across the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance prefectures, the vast majority of the alliance's territory had already completely fallen under Holy Dynasty control.

The Immortal Ancestor statues in the Heavenly Cities had been suppressed by Holy Emperor talismans, and new suppression and connection formations were rapidly being established.

"The probability of Holy Dynasty victory on the outer battlefields continues to rise during the deductions."

"Once the situation stabilizes, we can focus on grinding down the truly difficult opponents."

"At present, thirty four Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Dao Integration cultivators have appeared on the outer battlefields. Those who should have appeared but still have not number around one hundred more..."

Thinking of that enormous number, Sun Erlang could not help but feel heavy hearted.

Although the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance possessed the great weapon known as the Sky-Patrolling Arrow, Dao Integration cultivators were not stationary targets who would simply stand there and let themselves be struck.

Great Qi soldiers would be needed to restrain them.

Casualties were inevitable.

"Fortunately, the previous Departing Realm Rainbow Light plan drew away a large number of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's veteran Dao Integration cultivators. Otherwise this war would be even harder."

Sun Erlang looked at the miniature map of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance before him.

Aside from the yellow and purple markings showing territorial contest between the two sides, there was also a unique gray color spreading indiscriminately across all regions.

Centered around Tianling Prefecture, it slowly diffused outward.

Any place occupied by gray was directly simulated by the Dao Deviation Stone as a decisive Holy Dynasty victory with battles resolved rapidly.

"Dao One Insects..."

A scene appeared before Sun Erlang's eyes.

A Dao Integration cultivator from Shanteng Prefecture being captured alive by a squad of Golden Core Great Qi soldiers wearing Holy Army armor.

The Spirit of Heaven and Earth sacrificed by this Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Dao Integration cultivator was Crimson Vine.

After Shanteng Heavenly City was captured by the Holy Dynasty, this Crimson Vine Immortal Sage arrived belatedly.

Countless vines like blazing flame wyrms erupted between heaven and earth, growing wildly and savagely. The vine branches carried overwhelming force, sweeping madly across the battlefield and knocking large numbers of Holy Dynasty soldiers out of the sky like swatting flies.

Crimson Vine rooted itself in midair and spread across the earth.

In the blink of an eye, it had already covered the entire Shanteng Prefecture. The once mountainous landscape had transformed into a dense primeval jungle of vines.

The forces of three Holy Dynasty legions were immediately dragged into bitter battle against the omnipresent crimson vines, each seemingly possessing its own intelligence.

Though protected by puppet armor, they still could not withstand being entangled, continuously scorched, and drained.

It truly seemed as if this Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Dao Integration cultivator would singlehandedly reverse the tide and reclaim Shanteng Prefecture.

However, the battle changed instantly after a shadow mysteriously descended and covered the skies.

The previously vigorous crimson vines suddenly became like frostbitten eggplants, their attacks weakening dramatically.

Even the color of their crimson flames dimmed for no apparent reason.

Meanwhile, the Holy Dynasty soldiers who had just been trapped in bitter exhausting combat...

After the gray force arrived, their fatigue vanished in an instant, and they became vigorous once more.

Their offensive even became fiercer than before.

Any casual attack they launched carried spiritual energy that could tear open breaches in the previously seemingly indestructible crimson vines.

And the wounds in the vines no longer healed as before.

Instead, they grew larger and larger during the fighting.

As if some invisible existence were continuously devouring them.

The Holy Dynasty's counteroffensive lasted only one hour.

The gigantic entity that had occupied an entire prefecture was ultimately reduced to only half the size of an adult human.

It was captured alive by Holy Dynasty soldiers and locked inside a specially made cage designed specifically for imprisoning Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Dao Integration cultivators.

This cage could sever the imprisoned cultivator's connection with the outside world, and also forced the power of the Spirit of Heaven and Earth within the Dao Integration cultivator into dormancy.

Once imprisoned, Dao Integration cultivators became like powerless mortals, completely unable to escape.

All the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Dao Integration cultivators who were captured were sent to the rear, to the Holy Dynasty Great Qi, for unified imprisonment.

As the Dao One Insects spread, the number of captured Dao Integration cultivators continued to rise.

The situation on the outer battlefield gradually stabilized, and only then did the pressure on Sun Erlang’s shoulders ease slightly.

He pressed his swollen forehead, but did not rest. Instead, he once again reorganized all the information gathered from the previous battlefield engagements.

To ensure no detail had been overlooked.

Very quickly, he noticed Cai Yongchen’s report.

Sun Erlang did not believe Cai Yongchen’s earlier sensation had merely been an illusion. After pondering for a moment, he ordered that Cai Yongchen be brought back from the battlefield.

After isolating him, a thorough inspection was carried out.

The result was the same. Nothing abnormal could be detected.

Yet Sun Erlang still felt that something was not quite right.

After some thought, he ultimately used the Star Sea Net to report the entire matter, along with his own inspection findings regarding Cai Yongchen, to the Holy Emperor.

Only a short while later, the Holy Emperor responded.

“The abnormality within his body should be wandering [Qi of Qiankun].”

“Qiankun refers to the Heaven and Earth itself.”

“Qi is the source of all things.”

“This is a blessing, not a disaster, so there is no need to worry. However, this wandering Qi of Qiankun originated from fallen cultivators. It may carry remnants of the former owner’s will, so it is not suitable for him to remain on the battlefield for now…”

After receiving his master’s guidance, Sun Erlang immediately understood.

At the same time, he marveled at the peculiarity of Cai Yongchen’s fortune. This Qi of Qiankun could barely be considered half of a Heavenly Wonder. Although what Cai Yongchen had absorbed was only a wandering fragment, it still possessed boundless effects, even directly integrating with his own Dao Foundation and bringing many wondrous benefits.

“You will return to Great Qi immediately and recuperate within the Holy Heart Hall. Only after you have completely absorbed this Qi of Qiankun may you return to the battlefield.”

After explaining the origins of the Qi of Qiankun Cai Yongchen, Sun Erlang issued his order.

Cai Yongchen revealed joy, though there was also some regret.

“I hope that by the time this subordinate returns, the war will already be over.”

Cai Yongchen bowed deeply, then turned and departed.

Sun Erlang issued a personnel transfer order to fill Cai Yongchen’s vacant position. Although it was only a minor incident, it also revealed the impact efficient communication could have on the overall war situation.

Eliminating every possible hidden danger.

One tiny increase in the chance of victory after another eventually locked in the winning outcome.

As the days passed, only a single-digit number of prefectures on the outer battlefield remained locked in fierce combat.

All the remaining territories had already been taken by the Holy Dynasty army.

Sun Erlang did not hastily issue an order for a total siege against the remaining Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance territories.

Instead, he ordered each legion to establish and construct stationed bases on the spot.

At the same time, in an orderly manner, all captured Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators and resources were transferred into Holy Dynasty Great Qi.

After all these years of war preparations, Great Qi had long since prepared sufficient facilities to accommodate and imprison them.

Sun Erlang once again turned his gaze toward the central four prefectures of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

“The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s true counterattack should be arriving soon.”

Sensing faint fluctuations coming from the sealed moonlight boundary, Sun Erlang made this judgment.

Tianquan Prefecture, moonlight boundary.

As Lu Xichan watched streams of rising green qi cover the moonlight, a trace of joy flashed through her eyes.

Although only eight days had passed in real time, within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters, countless deductions had already been carried out.

At last, they had found a slight possibility of breaking the formation. Since this formation had reached a level of profundity beyond comprehension, they simply abandoned the idea of “breaking the formation.”

Instead, they directly used “Spirit-Suppressing Qi” to corrode the formation units.

Spirit-Suppressing Qi could suppress all spiritual energy fluctuations.

Under its continuous billowing and rising presence, it indeed produced results.

The moonlight, originally like silver silk stretching across the sky, gradually transformed into something resembling a haze of green smoke.

It seemed that at any moment, the formation would be broken.

However…

The bright moon in the sky once again cast down its radiance.

Within moments, the damaged portions were completely restored.

Even though Lu Xichan had anticipated this and ordered everyone to resist with all their strength, they still could not prevent the moonlight from descending.

Looking at the formation restored to its original state, Lu Xichan’s face turned ashen.

“Chief…”

The formation masters under her command also turned pale, despair visible in their eyes.

“I will go request the Formation-Breaking Disc.”

Lu Xichan spoke in a deep voice, admitting the fact that her attempt to break the formation had failed.

Transforming into a streak of rainbow light, she vanished into the horizon.

After a little less than half a day, Lu Xichan returned.

Behind her followed a cultivator wearing a dark green Daoist robe, with a mark on the forehead resembling a mirror surface.

Their face could not be seen, and even their gender could not be distinguished.

If Li Fan were here, he would recognize at a glance that this was the distinctive attire of the Mirror Holder lineage of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

That Mirror Holder completely ignored all the formation-breaking cultivators present. He first raised his head to look at the silver moonlight enveloping the surrounding lands and gave a slight nod.

Then he slightly bowed toward a certain point in the void.

The mirror mark on his forehead emitted streams of radiance. A white jade circular disc appeared in the scene along with the shining light.

The white jade disc flew of its own accord, slowly approaching the moonlight pouring down from the sky.

The moonlight visibly twisted as it was absorbed by the white jade disc.

Within the projections of light emitted by the white jade disc, one could faintly make out countless diagrams of evolving formations.

The Mirror Holder observed for a moment, then slightly frowned.

Afterward, he released another white jade circular disc.

But the effect still seemed unsatisfactory, so he directly released all nine discs at once.

The nine discs revolved around one another, drawing the moonlight into the center.

The phantom projections of formation transformations instantly accelerated by countless times.

"What kind of formation-breaking disc is that? How can it be this powerful?"

"According to Chief Lu, it is a secondary body birthed by the Tianxuan Mirror, called the Dissociation Disc."

"Hiss. There is actually such a wondrous object in the world. If formations can be broken so easily, what use would there be for us formation masters?"

...

The formation masters present discussed through voice transmission.

Lu Xichan, meanwhile, stared tightly at the shifting patterns in the center of the Dissociation Discs, her brows still tightly furrowed.

"Venerable, it seems..."

That Mirror Holder nodded, his expression becoming even more solemn as he looked at the formation in the sky.

Then he paused for a moment, as if making up his mind.

He flew above the heads of everyone present, assumed a strange posture, then bowed deeply toward an empty point ahead.

With a light kowtow, the mark between his brows burst forth with light.

Then the phantom of an object quietly appeared.

The Mirror Holder kowtowed nineteen times in succession.

Nineteen illusory objects of different shapes appeared in the field.

Some were circular discs like the Dissociation Disc, though in different colors.

There was also a long white jade ruler, a cyan jade slip, and others.

The nineteen objects seemed to possess spirituality as they flew to the outer perimeter of the nine Dissociation Discs.

They began rotating rapidly.

The already somewhat indistinct projected images became even more blurred amidst the spinning.

As a result, their shapes began to change.

They astonishingly became extremely similar to the Dissociation Discs in the inner ring.

With the assistance of these external Dissociation Discs, the deduction images at the center of the ring accelerated once again.

So fast that it was nearly impossible to see clearly.

After observing for some time, the Mirror Holder said, "Three days will be enough to open a gap in this formation."

"We must seize the opportunity to completely resolve this trapping formation."

The Mirror Holder pointed at the bright moon overhead as he spoke.

Lu Xichan lowered her head and said, "I will report this to the Dharma-Transmitters."

The Mirror Holder said nothing further, focusing entirely on the Dissociation Discs and the nineteen phantom objects.

The observing formation masters, after witnessing this strange spectacle and remaining slightly dazed for a moment, gradually came back to their senses.

"How did nineteen more Dissociation Discs suddenly appear? The formation-breaking capability of a single Dissociation Disc is already terrifying. Nineteen stacked together..."

"I understand now. Mysterious Azure Mirror, Measuring Heart Ruler, Book of Heaven Earth... these are all Tianxuan secondary bodies!"

One statement stirred a thousand waves. Every formation master present was profoundly shaken.

"Nineteen. I only knew that the Tianxuan Mirror had secondary bodies. I never imagined there would be this many."

"No, no. So many years have passed, so nurturing nineteen can be understood. But I have never heard that they can transform into one another. Does that not mean every secondary body can unleash more than ten times its own power?"

Seemingly noticing the noisy discussions among her subordinates, Lu Xichan coldly swept her gaze over them, then transmitted her voice.

"Stop just staring. Discuss and study the portions of the formation that the Dissociation Discs have already broken."

"Surely you do not think everything will be fine just because the formation is broken? If we cannot make amends afterward, then I think our Formation Strategic Hall of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance will be completely replaced from top to bottom."

Her words caused cold sweat to break out on the formation masters, and their attention shifted from the Tianxuan secondary bodies back to the flashing formation phantoms.

...

Holy Emperor Throne.

The Holy Emperor's gaze pierced through the formation barrier and landed upon the twenty-eight Tianxuan secondary bodies, including the nine Dissociation Discs.

"The Tianxuan Mirror, self-pregnant with its own being, dividing itself and transforming into Dao..."

The Holy Emperor nodded thoughtfully and sincerely praised, "Even after falling into the mortal world, it has never given up on transcending once again."

"The Tianxuan Mirror truly deserves to be called a great artifact passed down in the Xuanhuang Realm since ancient times."

The Holy Emperor pressed down Cat Treasure, who had slightly lifted its head, curiosity gleaming in its eyes as though it might leap up the next moment.

Being stopped by the Holy Emperor, Cat Treasure was slightly dissatisfied.

It lightly bit the Holy Emperor's finger, but after a mass of golden source power essence blocked it, Cat Treasure finally gave up.

It once again lay resting on Li Ping's shoulder.

"Aiya, great Holy Emperor, those things below are all treasures."

Daoist Yi Jue, despite having both eyes extended deep into the vortex passage, still seemed able to clearly see everything happening in the Xuanhuang Realm below as he clicked his tongue in admiration.

"Each secondary body is equivalent to a Dao copied and separated from the Xuantian Treasure Mirror."

"Some of these Daos are not even possessed by the Tianxuan Mirror itself, but were instead detected by the Xuantian Treasure Mirror over the years while observing this world."

"If this old Daoist still had a human body, even if I had to risk my life, I would snatch one. Using it as a foundation, even if I attained immortality in the future, it would be of immense use."

Daoist Yi Jue kept boasting, seemingly trying to incite the Holy Emperor to seize them.

But Li Ping remained completely unmoved.

"I can comprehend the Dao of heaven and earth within the star sea myself. Why would I need to rely on external objects?"

"Besides, the Dao observed by the Tianxuan Mirror may not necessarily be true."

Li Ping chuckled softly, instantly rendering Daoist Yi Jue speechless.

"Great Holy Emperor, are you really just going to watch them break the formation? If you send people to harass them, even if you do not seize some Tianxuan secondary bodies, delaying their formation breaking would still be beneficial."

After a moment of silence, Daoist Yi Jue spoke again.

"Yi Jue, just do the task I assigned to you."

Li Ping glanced at Yi Jue indifferently.

Daoist Yi Jue let out a few awkward laughs and said nothing more.

"That old man was not this talkative before. It seems the mirror below is indeed of great use to him." At this moment, Tianyang, who had remained silent the entire time, suddenly spoke.

Some of the Du'e Sect paper figures below nodded slightly, not denying it.

However, as for exactly what use it had, Daoist Yi Jue refused to say a single word.

"You people of the Ten Sects are still as annoying as ever," Tianyang said softly.

It was as if an invisible wind swept through the Holy Emperor Throne Hall. The Du'e Sect paper figures were instantly blown about and swayed violently.

Even the reconstructed mountain gate of the Du'e Sect showed signs of being blown away.

Daoist Yi Jue waved his hand, and the paper figures curled together into a cluster, resisting the wind.

Tianyang let out a cold snort and shifted his gaze elsewhere.

Only then did the great wind gradually subside.

"It seems you have indeed improved considerably," the Holy Emperor said with some delight.

"After recovering my sanity, I gained a new understanding of my memories regarding Ancestor. Moreover, although my original body has already died, all these years of slumber within the earth veins allowed the puppet body’s experiences to become a form of wealth. Seas turn into mulberry fields, the years flow on, and all things in the world are no exception..." Tianyang’s small childlike body spoke words utterly mismatched with its appearance, filled with ancient weariness.

"Oh right... take a look at this."

After a moment, Tianyang took out a child's skeleton.

"Hm? Is this not your body from before you died?" The Holy Emperor recognized the skeleton’s origin at a glance.

"Yes..." Tianyang’s expression was strange.

"I can vaguely sense that there is an extremely peculiar force on it. It comes from the obsession I held before abandoning my body back then."

"It is different from all cultivation methods of the present..."

Hearing Tianyang’s words, the Holy Emperor also became much more serious.

At Tianyang’s signal, Li Ping took the skeleton and frowned as he carefully examined it.

After a long while, he shook his head slightly and spoke honestly: "I cannot sense the energy you mentioned."

Tianyang stroked his chin, then said thoughtfully, "Perhaps this will work."

A crimson gold color instantly spread across the surface of his skin.

Tianyang’s body then melted away, disappearing into the suddenly manifested crimson gold armor.

The crimson gold armor split into several pieces and flew one after another toward the Holy Emperor.

They equipped themselves onto his body in sequence.

Adjusting automatically according to the Holy Emperor’s physique.

Before long, a puppet battle armor that seemed custom made for the Holy Emperor had fully formed.

It wrapped his entire body, radiating a majestic and sacred aura.

Tianyang’s voice sounded in his mind.

"Do not resist."

"Please, witness my life..."

Boom!

"Tianyang, it is time to take your medicine!"

Countless scenes instantly appeared before Holy Emperor Li Ping’s eyes.

They were everything Tianyang had experienced during his lifetime.

But because Tianyang was transmitting them voluntarily, it felt as though Li Ping had truly become Tianyang himself and personally lived through that entire life.

His senior brother and master, who had transformed into Dao, each willingly went to the battlefield to die in order to protect him.

The utterly real scenes and emotions deeply moved even the Great Qi Holy Emperor.

"Tianyang’s Life Is Inferior To No One!"

The cry from Tianyang’s heart also shifted from illusion into reality, truly sounding beside Li Ping’s ears.

And thus...

The Great Qi Holy Emperor was finally able to synchronously sense that extremely peculiar strand of energy upon Tianyang’s remains.

It seemed utterly incompatible with everything in the world.

Like a plum blossom in winter snow, standing proudly alone.

Although it appeared quite weak, it had endured for thousands of years without fading with time.

Instead, it had only grown fresher with age.

"This is..."

Li Ping seemed to recall something, and his hand trembled slightly.

But some invisible existence severed that faint connection.

A sense of loss filled the Holy Emperor’s heart.

Yet his will was extraordinary, and he quickly suppressed this anomaly.

First, he used Cat Treasure to test it. After discovering that even Cat Treasure could not identify this peculiar energy, he turned to the Du'e Sect below.

The Du'e Sect paper figures seemed completely unaware.

They still remained huddled together.

"Yi Jue, do you know something?" Holy Emperor Li Ping was not certain, but he asked anyway.

At this moment, Daoist Yi Jue actually withdrew his bulging eyes from the passage.

The two eyeballs, trailing long strips of paper behind them, flew beside Tianyang’s remains.

They circled around several times in succession.

Judging from Daoist Yi Jue’s expression, he seemed to have truly recognized something.

"This old Daoist merely has a guess."

"It may not be correct."

The Holy Emperor waved his hand.

"Speak freely."

As if afraid someone might overhear, Daoist Yi Jue turned his eyeballs and glanced outside the Holy Emperor Throne.

Only then did he speak word by word.

"Regarding that Grand Mage of Tiandu, our Du'e Sect has had a speculation since ancient times."

"The Grand Mage has already perished. What transmited the immortal arts of the Ten Great Immortal Sects is merely a single residual thought preserved after his death."

"Upholding the Grand Mage’s lingering will of transmitting the Dao."

As soon as Daoist Yi Jue said this, the Du'e Sect paper figures huddled together even more tightly. It was as if some terrifying existence were about to approach.

"A lingering will to transmit the Dao is neither a living being nor energy."

"It is more like..."

The Holy Emperor pondered, then continued.

"A resonance with the Great Dao."

Daoist Yi Jue clapped in praise.

"The Holy Emperor truly possesses remarkable comprehension!"

"When immortals perish, their Dao remains vacant. The Dao of immortality exists everywhere. If anyone can approach even slightly close to its essence, it will create resonance with that Dao."

"Within Heavenly Capital, it is the Dao of Transmission."

"And upon this skeleton, it may be the Dao of Contention."

Chapter 1295: Shadow Of The Path To Immortal Ascension

“The Dao of Contention...” The Holy Emperor pondered deeply, sensing the surging energy within Tianyang’s remains.

After a long while, he let out a deep breath.

“A Dao may lead to Immortal Ascension, but it does not align with me.”

There was not much regret in the Holy Emperor’s tone as he withdrew from the Tianyang armor state.

Returning the remains, Li Ping instructed Tianyang, “Since the Dao of Contention is vacant, this resonant skeletal remnant is an absolutely rare treasure for you. Study it well. Although the Immortal Dao does not manifest in this era, since the resonance still exists, that means the Dao itself remains.”

“Given enough time, you may truly be able to achieve the realm of a True Immortal through this.”

Daoist Yi Jue of the Du'e Sect stared eagerly as Tianyang put away the skeletal remains, then stuffed his long eyeballs back into the passage once more.

“What a pity, what a pity...” Daoist Yi Jue sighed repeatedly.

“And what profound insight does the Du'e Sect Master have now?” Tianyang was clearly displeased by Yi Jue’s behavior.

Daoist Yi Jue shook his head and chuckled. “I merely lament that the Du'e Sect missed a great opportunity. As the saying goes, when one attains the Dao, even his chickens and dogs ascend to heaven. If the great Holy Emperor had comprehended the lingering intent, perhaps one day he truly could have attained the Great Dao. Then we might have benefited as well.”

“As for you...”

“Perhaps such a day may come. But our Du'e Sect likely will not live to see it.”

His words made no effort to conceal his pessimism regarding Tianyang’s chances of becoming an Immortal.

This time, however, Tianyang was not provoked by the Du'e Sect’s taunts. He merely sensed the faint unwillingness to admit defeat lingering within his skeletal remains, as though he had returned to the days when he still possessed a human body.

But perhaps because he had now become a puppet, even after trying for a long time, Tianyang could not rekindle the hot blood within his heart.

Even the eight words, “Tianyang’s life is inferior to no one,” sounded different than before when spoken aloud.

For a time, silence filled the Holy Emperor Hall.

But before long, activity below from the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance drew their attention.

Flashes of light appeared as a group of grim cultivators dressed in black emerged at the moonlight boundary of Tianquan Prefecture.

They first gave a slight salute toward the Mirror Holder in the sky, then with solemn expressions began preparing spells and techniques against the still unbroken Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation.

It seemed as though they would launch a full assault against the grand formation at the very next moment.

Various techniques were indeed unleashed, but the corresponding manifestations seemed as though time itself had been frozen, suspended in midair.

Purple spears like heavenly thunder, twisted spatial rifts, endless streams of yellow talismans.

All were activated, then gathered together.

Waiting only for a breach to be torn open in the Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation before erupting all at once.

The black-clothed cultivators of the Immortal Alliance took turns converting the power within their bodies into techniques, accumulating them.

Several hours passed, and batch after batch of black-clothed cultivators were replaced.

The accumulated attacks at the formation boundary had reached a truly terrifying level.

Even the Holy Emperor’s face showed a trace of gravity.

Without question, if this frozen sphere of gathered power exploded on the surface of the Xuanhuang Realm, it could easily reduce several prefectures to ruins.

“I will go.” Tianyang was just about to step forward and eliminate this hidden threat, but Li Ping stopped him.

“Wait a little longer. I have my own way of dealing with it,” Li Ping said gravely.

Tianyang nodded slightly and did not act rashly.

Another half day passed.

In total, more than a thousand full power attacks had been infused.

The condensed sphere of light had become even more dazzling than the bright moon in the sky.

Even that Mirror Holder seemed to feel a trace of apprehension.

The mark on his forehead released a small ancient bronze mirror, covering himself, the nine Dissociation Discs, and the shadows of the other secondary bodies within its protection.

Within the Dissociation Discs, the shifting projections produced by formation analysis rapidly transformed, finally producing results.

From time to time, a strand of multicolored thread flew out toward Lu Xichan nearby.

After Lu Xichan comprehended the contents of these threads, her body trembled slightly, revealing an expression of utter fascination.

She then transmitted her insights to the formation masters present, drawing repeated exclamations of amazement.

At this moment, when they looked at the Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation before them, their eyes no longer held the despair from before.

Under Lu Xichan’s leadership, the formation masters began breaking the formation.

The moonlight, originally as solid as silver silk, gradually became hazy under the influence of external forces.

The Holy Emperor sensed that these Immortal Alliance formation masters were like tiny insects continuously gnawing at the foundations of the Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation.

Certainly, Li Ping could further adjust the formation.

And he was confident that the combined deciphering speed of the twenty-eight Dissociation Discs could never surpass the speed at which he could alter the formation. If the Immortal Alliance had no additional special methods, he could rely on formations alone to trap them for an entire lifetime.

But...

His goal had never simply been to trap them.

The arrangements he had left outside the Xuanhuang Realm informed him that the star sea had begun to stir.

The struggle between the restorative force of the reviving star sea and the remnants of immortal power was about to officially begin.

The Holy Emperor, who had remained seated all this time, slowly rose.

With a single thought, his majestic figure was projected across the heavenly curtain of Xuanhuang.

As if in mutual coordination, the Great Qi Holy Dynasty, which resembled a bright moon, dimmed slightly, yielding the stage to the Holy Emperor of Great Qi.

The moment Li Ping’s image appeared, the soldiers battling across the various prefectures of the Immortal Alliance instantly became fevered with excitement and battle intent.

They shouted in unison, “Welcome, Holy Emperor!”

The mountain-shaking, sea-roaring cries echoed endlessly across the lands of Xuanhuang.

The captured and besieged cultivators of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance looked fearfully at the towering figure in the heavens, yet involuntarily thought of the many legends regarding the Immortal Alliance’s Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor.

“At this very moment, where exactly is the Immortal Ancestor?”

And those Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators who were still fighting like trapped beasts were all left stunned and absent-minded upon witnessing that figure filling their entire field of vision.

"Long ago, Immortal Ancestor attained the Dao, spread his teachings to all living beings, and created the glorious thousand-year great age of cultivation."

"But the Immortal Ancestor method acts against heaven itself. Heaven and earth are what nurture cultivators. To devour heaven and earth is like murdering one's father and slaughtering one's mother."

"It is not the righteous path."

...

The Holy Emperor's voice echoed throughout the Xuanhuang Realm.

Blessed by the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, it was transmitted with perfect clarity into the ears of every living being still alive.

At first, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators did not understand what this Holy Emperor of Great Qi intended to do.

But when they heard the words "It is not the righteous path," their expressions changed drastically.

The Mirror Holder guarding the Dissociation Disc wore a dark expression.

In the Central Four Prefectures, lights continuously flashed. Those were the high-ranking Immortal Alliance officials who had remained stationed at headquarters, finally enraged.

To slander the Immortal Ancestor Heavenly Sovereign was to slander the entire Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

It was to shake the legitimacy and very foundation of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's rule.

To the high ranks of the Immortal Alliance, the consequences of this matter were even more severe than losing all territory in the other prefectures.

After all, territory could be won back.

But once people's hearts changed...

"Break the formation. Break it immediately!"

Beside Lu Xichan's ear came Dharma-Transmitter Ren's furious roar.

The Immortal Alliance formation masters all fell silent like frightened cicadas and began working desperately.

Yet while attempting to break the formation, they could not help but secretly listen to that voice descending from the highest heavens.

Accompanied by the many sacred phenomena continuously appearing across the sky, it spread toward every corner of the Xuanhuang Realm.

"I too possess a method. Without borrowing the power of heaven and earth, one may still walk the immortal path."

"Namely, Foundation Establishment through Oneelf, Primordial Unity Golden Core, Corporeal Nascent Soul, Consciousness Soul Transformation..."

"Star Sea Dao Integration..."

"Dao Resonance Longevity..."

The Holy Emperor's words struck like thunder beneath a clear sky, resounding between heaven and earth throughout the Xuanhuang Realm.

They had already drawn the attention of every cultivator.

After all, just from the names alone, the Holy Emperor's method sounded far superior to the Immortal Ancestor method.

Combined with the auspicious signs of drifting multicolored clouds and flashing golden radiance throughout heaven and earth, cultivators became dazed.

The last time the Xuanhuang Realm had witnessed a supreme expert preaching the Dao was the Dharma Transmitting Immortal Sage thousands of years ago.

After the Immortal Ancestor method was validated by the world, the then Dao Integration realm Dharma Transmitting Immortal Sage became the Longevity Immortal realm Dharma Transmitting Heavenly Sovereign.

If this new method was truly viable, would that not mean the Xuanhuang Realm was about to produce another peerless existence capable of standing against Immortal Ancestor?

Surrendering to bandits of unknown origin might lead to future reckoning by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

But if one joined under this Holy Emperor instead...

A strange atmosphere began spreading among the Immortal Alliance cultivators.

The Holy Emperor's preaching continued.

"The first step upon the immortal path is Foundation Establishment through Oneself."

"Borrowing the wonders of heaven and earth can establish one's foundation. Why? Because wondrous objects of the world are manifestations of laws."

"Yet the most wondrous thing in existence is not an object, but spirit."

"Foundation Establishment through Oneself shall establish the countless principles of the world within oneself."

...

The originally profoundly mysterious method of Foundation Establishment through Oneself became simple and easy to understand as the Holy Emperor explained it calmly.

At this moment, even ordinary mortals in the Xuanhuang Realm who had never stepped onto the cultivation path could vaguely understand the general meaning.

There was no need to mention those Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators who had already successfully walked the Immortal Ancestor path once before.

The Holy Emperor's new method was essentially built upon the foundation of the Immortal Ancestor method, then shattered its shackles and underwent complete rebirth.

Naturally, the Immortal Alliance cultivators who practiced the Immortal Ancestor method found it extremely familiar.

Just by listening, thoughts such as "So that is how it is," "This is indeed feasible," and "Wonderful" arose in their hearts in agreement.

Some Immortal Alliance cultivators who had happened to reach the peak of Qi Condensation and were attempting to break through into Foundation Establishment, yet had been troubled by not finding a suitable Foundation Establishment wondrous object, suddenly came to enlightenment.

As if divinely inspired, they became wildly excited.

"Why waste all that effort searching for some wondrous object? The Holy Emperor is right. I myself am the wondrous object!"

"Foundation Establishment. Foundation Establishment!"

They immediately entered seclusion on the spot to comprehend it.

Although the Foundation Establishment through Oneself method was not easy to cultivate in practice, the Xuanhuang Realm had the greatest number of Qi Condensation cultivators.

With such an enormous base, even multiplying by the tiniest probability still resulted in thousands upon thousands.

Before the Holy Emperor had even finished explaining the middle section of the Primordial Unity Golden Core, new method cultivators using Foundation Establishment through Oneself had already begun appearing across the Xuanhuang lands.

Their breakthrough treatment was completely different from Immortal Ancestor cultivators.

After breaking through, heaven and earth spiritual energy surged into their bodies wildly and spontaneously, as if they truly were the destined protagonists of legend, favored by the Heavenly Dao.

There were even a few whose breakthroughs were accompanied by rays of heavenly radiance descending from the sky.

Within those rays were various heavenly treasures and earthly wonders, like gifts from heaven and earth themselves.

The difference in heaven and earth's attitude was so vast that other cultivators could not help but grow envious.

Cultivators at the Golden Core realm and above might still harbor some hesitation.

But Qi Condensation and Foundation Establishment cultivators had no burden whatsoever in dispersing their cultivation and starting over.

After all, even if this Holy Emperor's new method proved impossible to cultivate, as long as their Foundation Establishment wondrous object remained, they could start over at any time.

After dispersing their cultivation, they temporarily stored away their wondrous objects.

Then they focused entirely on cultivating the Foundation Establishment through Oneself method.

The number of Qi Condensation and Foundation Establishment cultivators in the Xuanhuang Realm far exceeded the combined total of cultivators in all other realms.

Even if only one out of ten among them chose the Holy Emperor's new method...

For the Dharma Transmitting Heavenly Sovereign and the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, it would be an unimaginably massive blow.

Aside from Dharma-Transmitter Ren, the other Dharma-Transmitters could no longer remain seated.

Because within Immortal Alliance headquarters, experiments had already proven the genuine feasibility of the Foundation Establishment through Oneself method.

If this Holy Emperor were allowed to continue preaching...

All the high-ranking Immortal Alliance cultivators shuddered involuntarily.

Immortal Alliance Nether Prison.

Within the deepest part of the space imprisoning several thousand vicious criminals.

A figure that seemed to be nothing but dry bones remained suspended in the void, limbs spread wide in the shape of a cross, nailed in place.

Looking closely, every single bone in the figure’s body seemed to be constantly scorched by blazing flames, struck by thunderbolts, gnawed upon by strange insects.

Pain beyond description, yet this figure seemed long accustomed to it, his expression calm.

Or rather, his face, nearly nothing more than a skull, could no longer display any expression at all.

At this moment, amid the suffering of his countless bodily torments, he slightly raised his head.

His pitch-black eye sockets pierced through layer upon layer of the Nether Prison’s space, gazing toward the heavens of the Xuanhuang Realm.

"With me as Foundation Establishment..."

"With me as Foundation Establishment..."

A black flame, like a long serpent, emerged from the void.

It flew directly toward him, piercing through his chest in an instant.

The black flame passed through his heart, yet some remained at the wound, burning the figure’s remaining flesh, withered bones.

Even his remnant soul.

Even with the figure’s endurance, he could not suppress a muffled groan.

"With me as Foundation Establishment, with me as Foundation Establishment..."

Yet he continued muttering without pause, faint starlight seeming to ignite within his black eye sockets.

For a very long time, aside from pain, no other sensation had appeared in his heart.

But now, he faintly saw a sliver of hope.

A chance to escape.

How long had he been imprisoned?

Within the sunless Nether Prison, he had nearly forgotten the concept of time.

But judging from the injuries his body had suffered, it should have been a full five hundred years.

After the misfortune of being captured and imprisoned here, he had abandoned all thoughts of escape.

After all, every bit of his power had already been drained dry by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Even if he somehow escaped this place by luck, he would still be unable to evade the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s pursuit, much less find the road back.

But now, through this voice reaching the deepest parts of the Nether Prison, perhaps he could truly leave this place.

"Every fragment of pain is built upon my body."

"All of it is felt by me."

"The source of pain is me."

"I establish my foundation..."

Specks of golden light began to flicker in response to the figure’s words.

These golden lights seemed to come from the few withered bones the figure still possessed.

They had remained hidden all this time, only being triggered now in this desperate final gamble.

Amid cracking sounds, the golden light became like flames, baking the withered bones.

The withered bones melted like candles, but after cooling and condensing, they formed a somewhat smaller body that had returned to a normal shape.

The surrounding restrictions sensed the figure’s abnormal movement.

Punishments were continuously triggered, striking down upon him.

But the figure had long since grown accustomed to it, even absorbing these punitive methods and transforming them into energy to temper his new body.

Under the golden radiance, the figure became smaller and smaller.

Until in the end, only the size of an adult’s palm remained.

Stepping out from his original withered skeleton.

"With me as Foundation Establishment, it actually returned me to the appearance I had when I first began cultivation."

"As expected of a supreme mysterious method."

"Even if I wasted more than five hundred years within the High Wall, if I can bring this method back, it will not be a loss."

The tiny figure transformed into a streak of golden light, flying directly out from the deepest part of the Nether Prison.

Ignoring every restriction along the way.

Even the prison guards of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s Nether Prison seemed completely unable to see this escaping golden light.

The golden little man arrived above the surface, gazing at the Holy Emperor’s image in the sky.

"As expected, desperate lands produce extraordinary talents. In just five hundred years, such a figure has appeared in this world once more..."

"Primordial Unity Golden Core."

The golden little man listened seriously for a long time, his brows tightly furrowed the entire while.

"Something is strange. Could it be that I have been imprisoned too long and become stupid?"

"Never mind. I will memorize it first. Once I get out, there will be plenty of people to study it."

...

Naturally, the Holy Emperor of Great Qi had no idea that he had quietly gained a listener from beyond the High Wall.

At this moment, his preaching had already reached the final stage, "Dao Resonance Longevity Immortal."

"Beyond Xuanhuang, above the Star Sea, there exists the great Dao leading to immortality."

"The True Immortals have fallen, the Great Dao stands empty."

"Tracing back the shadow of the Dao, resonating with the true intent of the Dao, one may glimpse the realm of Longevity..."

The Holy Emperor preached solemnly.

And these profoundly mysterious words caused even the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao itself to gain some comprehension.

All the winds of the world fell completely still.

Across the vast Xuanhuang Realm, apart from the Holy Dynasty’s preaching voice, no other sound remained.

Including the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators who had previously been desperately trying to break through the Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation.

At this moment, they all stood frozen, somewhat dazed as they listened to the Holy Emperor’s words.

The higher one’s realm and strength, the greater the shock within their hearts.

Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters, Museum of Divine Treasures.

Xu Ke and Yin Shangren had been waiting for the decisive battle between the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Holy Dynasty to erupt, so they could seize the opportunity to detonate the Golden Tree and take Mr. Bai’s skull.

But suddenly, they felt the ground beneath their feet begin to tremble.

From a slight vibration, it gradually became violent shaking.

"This is..." Xu Ke was slightly alarmed.

Because he sensed that it was not merely the Museum of Divine Treasures where they stood. The source of the shaking was this very space containing the museum itself.

The shaking became increasingly violent. The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters, originally dim like a starry sky, slowly began lighting up with countless specks of starlight.

"The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters is inside the Tianxuan Mirror. This situation, is the Tianxuan Mirror breaking through?" A trace of astonishment flashed across Yin Shangren’s face, uncertain whether this abnormal change would be fortune or disaster for them.

Within the Derivation Law Jade space.

Li Fan’s true body also noticed the faint trembling outside.

The three guarding Dao Integration cultivators instantly became somewhat nervous.

After all, such a scene had not appeared even once in several hundred years.

Zhang Xu and Hua Yueye stood protectively before the Derivation Law Jade, while Li Fan guarded the entrance to the space.

Fortunately, Elder Xu of the Guardian Hall soon sent word that everything was fine, allowing them to relax.

"If my guess is correct, it should be the clone Holy Emperor attacking," Li Fan thought to himself.

Just at this moment, he sensed that the little girl spirit of the Derivation Law Jade had already awakened from her deep sleep and was trying to contact him through simulated personality.

With a thought, he took over control of that fabricated personality.

“Wow, something huge happened outside!”

The little girl made an exaggerated expression.

“You were trapped in here and could not see it. What a pity!”

The Derivation Law Jade looked Li Fan up and down with eyes full of regret.

“You can see the outside world?” Li Fan stared at the little girl and asked suspiciously.

Derivation Law Jade snorted and placed both hands on her hips.

“Me? Of course not.”

“But someone told me about it. What, you are not convinced?”

“Well? As long as you beg this great auntie, I will tell you about the major event that happened outside!”

The little girl spoke in an extremely smug tone.

Seeing that Li Fan remained unmoved and was still thinking about something, she continued tempting him.

“You are already at the Dao Integration realm now, right? If you knew what happened outside, it would definitely help you tremendously. Even for me, after hearing it, my deduction speed increased by quite a lot...”

Derivation Law Jade said this with complete seriousness.

“The one secretly telling you about outside events... was the Tianxuan Mirror?” Li Fan suddenly asked.

The expression on the little girl’s face instantly froze, then she waved her hands.

“Hahaha, how could that be!”

Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

“The tremor outside just now...”

“The Tianxuan Mirror advancing in rank? How is that possible? In this life, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance did not carry out the Heaven Measuring and Earth Survey.”

“Even the Derivation Law Jade gained something.”

“Could it really have been caused by the Holy Emperor’s preaching on the Dao?”

Li Fan felt uncertain.

His two clones outside had indeed also witnessed the Holy Emperor preaching the Dao.

But he had long known that this was something the Holy Emperor had fabricated to strike at the foundation of the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor.

Aside from the Foundation Establishment Through Oneself chapter, everything else was merely castles in the air, fabricated nonsense that could not actually be cultivated.

So he had not paid much attention to it.

But now, judging from the reactions of the Derivation Law Jade and the Tianxuan Mirror, the cultivation method transmitted by the Holy Emperor...

Actually seemed to contain some real profundity.

Li Fan looked at the Derivation Law Jade, who was still acting smug and trying to make him beg, then coldly snorted inwardly and directly recited the contents of the Holy Emperor’s transmitted method.

The Derivation Law Jade immediately looked as though she had seen a ghost.

“Big Brother Tianxuan Mirror told you too?”

Li Fan let out a cold snort and did not answer.

The little girl, however, instantly became like a frostbitten eggplant, completely dejected.

“So boring!”

“I am going back to sleep!”

“Wait!” Li Fan stopped her.

The little girl immediately looked at Li Fan with a wary expression.

“It makes sense that this Holy Emperor’s new method would be useful to cultivators.”

“But it can enlighten even you, the Derivation Law Jade?” Li Fan’s face showed doubt.

Derivation Law Jade rolled her eyes at Li Fan.

“Did you not hear it? Beyond Xuanhuang, above the Star Sea, there is a Great Dao leading to immortality!”

“When a True Immortal falls, the Great Dao is left vacant!”

“Reverse the shadow of the Dao, resonate with the true intent of the Dao...”

Derivation Law Jade widened her eyes.

“Take me for example. The Derivation Law Jade is originally the manifested embodiment of the laws of the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“And the law of deduction within the Xuanhuang Realm is itself merely a projection of that Dao above the Star Sea, the Dao that can achieve immortality...”

“In other words, when it comes to resonating with the Great Dao, we naturally possess an innate advantage.”

Derivation Law Jade could not help but look rather proud.

“This is something you cultivators cannot even dream of matching!”

“If you want to resonate with the Great Dao, you first need to find traces of it, right? The Dao that leads to immortality is vague and elusive, vanishing in an instant. Even if you happen to glimpse it by chance, maintaining that connection continuously would be unimaginably difficult!”

Seeing Li Fan’s increasingly grave expression, the little girl became even more smug. Then, as if she suddenly remembered something, she revealed a wary expression.

“Do not even think about stealing mine, alright? To be honest, even if you could forcibly borrow my power to comprehend the Dao of Derivation, it would be useless.”

“Why?” Li Fan asked.

“That character I showed you before, do you still remember it? Thinking about it now, it was actually like a painting, depicting the path of Immortal Ascension for others to observe.”

“It was not the actual entity of the path of Immortal Ascension, only a painting. That is why even ordinary cultivators could perceive it.”

“But we are projections of the path of Immortal Ascension itself. You are not me, so how could you possibly ascend upward and see the Dao itself?”

Derivation Law Jade spoke word by word, very slowly.

It seemed that even expressing this meaning was quite difficult for her.

“The Great Dao is empty...”

“True Immortal seal script, Dao Inscription Immortal...”

Li Fan fell into thought.

All the scenes from the past related to immortal power surfaced in his mind, rapidly flowing past.

In the end, four words faintly emerged.

“Eternal Remnant Will?”

Li Fan felt somewhat uncertain inwardly.

“It isn’t a projection of the path to Immortal Ascension, but rather… a resonance of the Dao.”

“Dao Resonance Longevity. So that is how it is.”

“The Holy Emperor actually managed to discover the existence of Eternal Remnant Will?”

Tianyang’s figure flashed through Li Fan’s mind.

“Mm, perhaps that should be the case.”

After all, it was his own clone. Even though the connection had now been severed, Li Fan quickly pieced together the likely truth based on scattered clues.

“Interesting. It seems this Holy Emperor of Great Qi, after integrating the essence blood of Sun Erlang and Wang Xuanba, possesses even greater comprehension than I imagined.”

“Though my own comprehension was already extraordinary...”

Li Fan once again carefully studied this incomplete New Method text, which he had previously not valued much.

“If Eternal Remnant Will is a resonance of the Dao, then every time [Truth] senses Eternal Remnant Will, it becomes so hungry. Does that mean what [Truth] truly needs is the path of Immortal Ascension itself?”

“Something that can replenish [Truth]’s power...”

Li Fan’s thoughts raced.

...

Outside the Xuanhuang Realm, the Holy Dynasty’s Dao preaching was nearing its end.

Regardless of whether they belonged to the Holy Dynasty or not, all living beings who had listened to the lecture slightly lowered their heads, expressing astonishment toward the Holy Emperor.

After all, such a miraculous method was something they would never have had the opportunity to hear in their entire lives.

Yet now the Holy Emperor had selflessly shared it with them.

Quite a number of cultivators, overwhelmed with gratitude, wept bitterly and repeatedly kowtowed, becoming the Holy Emperor’s most loyal believers.

Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Four Prefectures, moonlight boundary.

The formation masters gradually recovered from the shock of the Holy Emperor’s preaching and secretly looked toward Lu Xichan.

“Continue breaking the formation.” Though she had received the other party’s favor, Lu Xichan, as the Chief of the Formation Strategic Hall, would absolutely never make a mistake on a matter of principle.

She issued the order coldly.

“No need.”

The voice of the Dharma-Transmitter coming from behind caused her to freeze on the spot.

“The Heavenly Sovereign has returned.”

Dharma-Transmitter Ren looked toward the sky, his eyes filled with fanatic devotion.
