Chapter 1296: Immortal Ancestor Battles The Holy Emperor

TL Note: I've corrected 混元金丹 from Primordial Golden Core to Primordial Unity Golden Core. The earlier translation missed part of the meaning contained in 混元, which is a Daoist concept referring to the primordial, undivided state of creation. "Primordial Unity" better captures the original term, so future chapters will use the updated translation for consistency.

“The Heavenly Sovereign has returned.”

Lu Xichan, along with all the formation masters present, froze slightly the moment they heard these words.

Then, unavoidably, intense fear surged into their hearts, and they lowered their heads.

Even their bodies could not stop trembling slightly.

This was the overwhelming oppressive force of the Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereign who had suppressed the Xuanhuang Realm for thousands of years and single-handedly created the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Following Dharma-Transmitter Ren’s words, across every prefecture of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, the Holy Emperor talismans affixed to the enormous Dharma-Transmitting stone statues suddenly began to flutter despite the absence of wind.

They continuously flapped, as though they might be blown away at any moment.

The stone statues suppressed beneath the talismans also seemed to come alive, emitting faint tremors.

The Holy Emperor talismans radiated violet-gold starlight, while the Dharma-Transmitting stone statues emitted white radiance.

The two forces continuously clashed.

Across the Xuanhuang Realm, heaven and earth changed color.

The Holy Emperor also seemed to sense something. While continuing his preaching, he casually raised his head to look toward the heavens.

Yet the Dao principles flowing from his mouth did not stop.

Only his speaking pace unconsciously quickened slightly.

Amid the strange phenomena shaking the Xuanhuang Realm, some Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators had already guessed what was happening.

Their faces turned pale, cold sweat poured from their foreheads. They no longer had any mind to listen to what the Holy Emperor was saying, their bodies trembling uncontrollably in fear.

Yet some cultivators had flickering eyes as they concentrated on listening to the Holy Emperor’s teachings, while inwardly praying that Immortal Ancestor would return just a little later.

“The transformations of past and present, the principles of the Great Dao.”

“The Dharma-Transmitting method has no place in Xuanhuang.”

“Now that I have attained the Dao, I shall attempt to change it…”

At last, the Holy Emperor’s preaching came to its conclusion.

The Holy Emperor’s gaze fully shifted away from the countless living beings below and toward that figure standing in the starry sky beyond the Xuanhuang Realm.

He gave a slight nod, then suddenly vanished into the heavens.

Without the Holy Emperor’s protection, all manner of strange phenomena abruptly descended upon the Xuanhuang Realm.

Rolling dark clouds emerged from nowhere. Layer upon layer, they slowly covered the bright moon formed by Holy Dynasty Great Qi.

Across the earth, birds and beasts that had previously come out to listen to the Holy Emperor’s preaching were startled into panicked flight, rushing back to their nests for shelter.

Even flowers, grasses, and trees were shattered and scattered by the increasingly violent winds.

Boom!

Bolt after bolt of thunder exploded within the dark clouds.

Then torrential rain crashed down upon the earth.

Wind, rain, and thunder roared together, and in an instant the entire Xuanhuang Realm resembled the end of the world.

Although Immortal Ancestor’s true body had not yet arrived, all living beings beneath heaven were already trembling beneath His shadow.

Those Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators whose hearts had wavered after hearing the Holy Emperor’s teachings felt as though a bucket of cold water had been poured over their heads, instantly cooling their feverish thoughts and restoring clarity.

“What was I thinking? That is Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor! The Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor who has suppressed the Xuanhuang Realm with a single hand for thousands of years! I actually imagined that the Holy... no, that these bandits could win?”

“The Holy Emperor... the Holy Emperor may be strong, but he is absolutely no match for Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor. Damn it, I need to forget this new path immediately.”

“Immortal Ancestor above, please forgive this lowly one’s momentary lapse into delusion…”

“Once Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor acts, everything will be restored!”

The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators were cowed by Immortal Ancestor’s’s might, their courage shattered.

The soldiers of the Holy Dynasty, due to the immense disparity in cultivation realms, also experienced a brief moment of fear.

But very quickly, their eyes became firm once more.

Some of them remembered the words the Holy Emperor had spoken before this campaign began.

And so someone shouted toward the heavens, “The Holy Dynasty will triumph, the Holy Emperor will triumph!”

At first, it was only scattered cries.

But very quickly it spread like wildfire.

Without anyone deliberately commanding them, every soldier of the Holy Dynasty seemed connected in spirit, shouting in perfect unison.

Their voices grew louder and louder, from shouting to roaring, from roaring to furious howling.

The voices of Great Qi’s soldiers surged like overwhelming tidal waves, spreading across the entire Xuanhuang Realm with the force of collapsing mountains and overturning seas.

As though responding to their call, the bright moon in the heavens erupted with violet-gold radiance.

It broke free from the endless dark clouds once more.

The chaotic storms shaking Xuanhuang actually began to show signs of gradually subsiding beneath these earth-shaking cries.

Dharma-Transmitter Ren listened to the distant voices and let out a cold sneer.

“Merely the death throes of the doomed.”

As if in response to his words, portals began appearing across the four central prefectures of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Massive flying vessel formations continuously emerged, and in mere moments filled the skies above the four prefectures.

At the prows of each vessel stood a Dharma-Transmitter.

The Dharma-Transmitters gazed upward and offered slight bows toward the Immortal Ancestor beyond the starry sky.

Lu Xichan secretly observed the scene, inwardly shocked.

“These must be the cultivation forces each Dharma-Transmitter has nurtured within their own small worlds. Since Heavenly Sovereign has appeared, naturally they no longer need to remain hidden.”

“Judging by the auras radiating from those flying vessels, there are even Dao Integration cultivators among them.”

“The hidden strength of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance is even greater than I imagined…”

As Lu Xichan pondered, a voice dripping with mockery suddenly came from above.

“You deployed the Dissociation Disc, along with nineteen Tianxuan secondary bodies, and after all this time you still have not broken a mere trapping formation.”

“Your Formation Strategic Hall truly grows worse with every generation. If Lu Xia knew, he would probably be so angry he would come back to life.”

Hearing her master’s name mentioned alongside such ridicule, anger surged within Lu Xichan’s heart.

But she also recognized the speaker as one of the Dharma-Transmitters, Dou.

So despite her anger, she did not dare reveal the slightest trace of it.

She only lowered her head and said, “This subordinate is incompetent.”

“Enough. Have your people step aside.”

Following Dharma-Transmitter Dou’s lazy command, a group of child attendants drifted down from the flying vessel above.

They first gave a slight salute to the Mirror Holder overseeing the Dissociation Disc. After receiving the formation analysis data gathered so far, they immediately began the process of breaking the formation.

There were thirty-six of these child attendants.

Their faces were utterly expressionless.

Even their eyes contained not the slightest emotional fluctuation.

One of them extended a hand into the light beam of the Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation.

Then, his body instantly began to turn illusory.

Starting from his hand and spreading through the rest of his body, he gradually became identical to the starlight of the formation.

Just as the child attendant testing the formation with his own body was about to be completely swallowed by the starlight, his figure suddenly vanished, transforming into a streak of light that flew before another child attendant.

This second child attendant likewise touched the formation with his hand, then tested it with his own body.

This process repeated continuously.

Until the thirty-sixth child attendant, just as he was about to completely transform into starlight...

His body trembled, shaking out the original thirty companions from within himself. He too returned to his normal appearance.

The thirty-six Dao children gathered together, whispering among themselves.

Then, as if they had reached a consensus, they all nodded in unison.

They split into two groups. One group began working on breaking the formation. The other once again repeated the process of testing the formation with their own bodies.

The Immortal Alliance formation masters observing from the side almost immediately sensed how extraordinary this group of Dao children was.

Judging by their speed of breaking the formation, the Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation would definitely be torn open within less than half a day at most.

As the Chief of the Formation Strategic Hall, Lu Xichan was even more shaken than anyone else.

As she looked at these thirty-six formation-breaking children, four words surfaced in her mind: Formation Spirit Sacred Physique.

This was an extremely special constitution, as if the body itself were naturally formed from formations. Not only did they possess an innate sensitivity and affinity toward all formations, but they could also merge body and formation as one, greatly increasing a formation's power.

Just as artifact spirits were to dharma treasures, they could transform into formation spirits, causing formations to undergo sublimation and transformation.

Formation Spirit Sacred Physique was something not seen even once in a hundred years.

Lu Xichan's master, Lu Xia, had spent his entire life hoping to find a cultivator with this constitution to inherit his legacy. Unfortunately, even until his death, he never achieved that wish, and in the end could only reluctantly pass all his lifelong knowledge to Lu Xichan.

Yet today, more than thirty of them had appeared at once.

Lu Xichan raised her head to look at the sky, at the figures standing atop the densely packed flying vessels floating overhead.

A chill rose in her heart.

"Just how many things have these Dharma-Transmitters been hiding?"

After Dharma-Transmitter Ren learned of the progress in breaking the formation, killing intent flashed through his eyes.

This time, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had been humiliated so badly that punishment from the Heavenly Sovereign was inevitable.

Since that was the case, before receiving punishment, he would first vent his fury brutally upon these troublemakers.

With a wave of his hand, the black-robed cultivators who had originally been gathering attacks, but had been forced to stop because of the Holy Emperor's preaching, resumed their actions.

Several cultivators wearing green Dao robes, holding horsetail whisks and talismans, quietly descended from the flying vessels above.

Waving their horsetail whisks and talismans, they molded the power accumulated within the light spheres into vicious-looking bodies resembling divine beings, filled with killing intent.

As these energy deities descended, the might radiating from them caused even Lu Xichan, a Dao Integration cultivator, to feel genuine fear.

The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's counterattack was ready to erupt.

Outside the Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation, the soldiers of the Holy Dynasty had already prepared for close combat against the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

The supreme battlefield commander, Sun Erlang, was methodically issuing orders through the Holy Emperor Star Network.

"Those below Nascent Soul are to remain at their positions and must not move recklessly. Continue supervising the construction progress of the suppression formations. Remember, completing the formation on time counts as a great merit."

"As for cultivators at the Nascent Soul stage and above, I am making the following deployment adjustments."

The brighter stars within the star sea were dispersed and reorganized under Sun Erlang's mental control.

"Do not clash head-on with the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance. Stretch the battle lines across every part of the alliance."

"We do not need to invade the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters. What we need is to wait for the Holy Emperor to return victorious from the star sea."

Sun Erlang spoke with absolute firmness.

The soldiers of Great Qi roared in acknowledgment.

After everyone's emotions had been fully stirred, Sun Erlang observed the scene inside the Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation and made final adjustments to military appointments.

At the same time, part of his remaining focus had already connected to the quietly standing dark-gold Holy Punishment Puppet.

"Finally, I can stretch my limbs a little."

Beneath Sun Erlang's calm gaze surged an incomparably blazing battle intent.

Three hours later.

The Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation, which had firmly sealed the four states of the Immortal Alliance for seven whole days, was finally torn open by a small gap.

In the very next instant, the powerful attacks filled with the fury of the Immortal Alliance cultivators poured out through that opening.

Manifested spell techniques, furious divine beings with glaring eyes, and countless treasures radiating light...

All erupted together in dazzling splendor.

The terrifying energy, enough to flatten several Immortal Alliance states into the ground, eagerly searched for targets to destroy.

Yet what awaited the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's long-accumulated counterstrike...

Was merely an ordinary black gate.

As the black gate opened, all of the violent attack methods were completely swallowed by it.

Like an abyssal beast opening its bloody maw.

Not even the slightest energy ripple was left behind for the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

After swallowing all the explosive energy that had accumulated, the black gate vanished silently once more, just as it had appeared.

Leaving only the somewhat stunned members of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance behind.

"The Dark Sea?" Dharma-Transmitter Ren's expression changed slightly. He had sensed a somewhat familiar aura from that gate.

And just as he had expected, the "massive" energies swallowed into the Dark Sea merely formed another accumulation cloud deep within it. Aside from that, they stirred no other waves.

"It seems the recent disturbance in the Dark Sea was also related to these thieves."

With new hatred added to old grudges, Dharma-Transmitter Ren's anger had reached its peak.

The thirty-six Dao children continued breaking the formation, intending to completely tear apart the Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation.

The cultivators under the other Dharma-Transmitters also streamed out through the opening in the formation, intending to sweep through and exterminate the rebels in each prefecture.

However, Dharma-Transmitter Ren's plan encountered a setback in the very first prefecture.

The entire prefecture was completely empty.

It seemed the rebels had fully withdrawn, and even the Heavenly City had been completely looted.

Not a single person remained behind.

"They ran?" Dharma-Transmitter Ren was somewhat uncertain.

Just as the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators stood there in confusion, swords drawn and looking around aimlessly, flashes of light lit up from every corner of the state.

They rapidly launched toward them.

The silver lights seemed to have received special enhancement, making them several times faster than before during flight.

They arrived in an instant.

"Hm? This is..."

"Sky-Patrolling Arrows?!"

Some of the Dharma-Transmitters recognized the objects right before their eyes.

Their expressions changed drastically.

The next moment...

Boom! Boom! Boom!

An endless series of violent explosions echoed across the heavens.

...

And at this moment, outside the Xuanhuang Realm, within the Darkest Star Sea.

That figure rapidly returning toward the Xuanhuang Realm encountered almost the same treatment.

Only, what exploded within the star sea was not mere Sky-Patrolling Arrows.

But rather the True Immortal residual power scattered everywhere throughout the star sea.

Holy Emperor Li Ping was not some rigid person who insisted on an upright and honorable duel against the Immortal Ancestor.

What he wanted was simply victory.

Using the great wind currently sweeping through the star sea, Li Ping utilized the star sea's revival power to alter the original positions of the lingering True Immortal power.

Afterward, it was concealed with formations, forming a trap in a certain sense.

This road home, the Immortal Ancestor had walked countless times.

He was familiar with it beyond familiarity itself.

Yet he had never expected that this time, he would actually suffer an ambush.

Like wind rising and waves surging, that figure became flickering and unstable under the influence of different remnants of True Immortal power, illusory and distorted.

He appeared somewhat battered.

The Holy Emperor gazed at the other party from afar. That appearance was exactly the same as the towering stone statues standing throughout the Xuanhuang Realm.

There was no doubt in revealing the other's identity.

High crown, long beard.

The Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor.

Yet even though this figure had suffered an ambush, the expression on his face remained exactly the same as the stone statues below, without the slightest change.

The Holy Emperor did not wait for the other party to recover from the sneak attack.

Behind him, the phantom of the Holy Dynasty instantly emerged, accompanied by swirling starlight.

"The Heavenly Mandate is with me..."

"The Great Dao is with me..."

"The future is with me!"

The fortune accumulated and stored by the Holy Dynasty for so long was instantly added onto his body.

The devout prayers of countless Great Qi citizens, soldiers, and the surviving You Clansmen race pierced through spacetime, sounding beside the Holy Emperor in unison like profound heavenly music.

Within the Darkest Star Sea, a fierce wind rose around the Holy Emperor.

Darkness retreated, starlight grew brighter.

At this moment, the Holy Emperor seemed to become the center of the entire Darkest Star Sea.

Infinite star domains, endless void, countless stars.

All revolved around the Holy Emperor at this moment.

Within the Xuanhuang Realm, all living beings felt something in their hearts.

They involuntarily raised their heads to look at the sky. Beyond the dark and gloomy heavens.

The dazzling silver swirling starlight illuminated the world like night being lit anew.

And at the center of the spiraling layers of stars, the solemn and majestic figure of the Holy Emperor could clearly be seen.

The starlight holy robe upon his body danced with the galaxy.

Radiant and brilliant, shining without end.

"Dao Extinguishes..."

"Dao is Born!"

Accompanied by calm yet vast Dao resonance, the Holy Emperor's figure vanished into the swirling starlight.

The brilliant silver radiance instantly unfurled.

Like a galactic river descending from the ninth heavens.

It crashed directly toward the high-crowned old man who had yet to steady himself.

At last, a trace of fluctuation appeared on the eternally unchanging face of the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor.

Within that infinite starlight, he seemed to see the ancient cultivation world, the incomparably prosperous grand cultivation era of this star sea.

Then he saw how, after reaching the height of prosperity, decline began, and faint discordant phenomena started appearing within the star sea.

Then it was as if he saw, with the collapse of the Immortal Dao, all kinds of terrifying calamities silently descending upon the star sea. One flourishing cultivation world after another was annihilated amid disaster.

The Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor's gaze wavered. Before his eyes, the brilliant star sea was growing dim.

Starlight entered his eyes, his body, his soul.

The Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor's high crown and garments began to decay.

His beard and hair began to fall away.

His upright and majestic figure became hunched.

Those remnants of True Immortal power that had not yet fully detached still continued entangling him.

The Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor appeared to be in imminent danger.

"Cough, cough..."

"What a move, Dao Extinguishes, Dao is Born."

Amid the howling winds of the star sea, the Immortal Ancestor finally spoke.

His voice was different from the benevolent voice of transmitted teachings remembered by the countless beings of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Perhaps due to the severe blow he had suffered, he sounded like a dying mortal, weak and feeble.

The Holy Emperor did not respond.

His figure did not even appear.

The annihilating impact of the starlight river was already nearing its end.

But the Holy Emperor's attack had not yet ended.

What had just occurred upon the Immortal Ancestor was merely Dao Extinguishes.

And what came next...

Was Dao is Born.

Pitch-black hair burst forth from the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor's scalp, growing wildly in the wind.

Dull explosive sounds came from every part of his body. At times, bulges of flesh and bone could be seen protruding.

Thump. Thump. Thump.

Powerful heartbeats accompanied the winds of the reviving star sea.

With every beat, a chunk of flesh violently exploded from the Immortal Ancestor's body.

When the new Dao is born, the old law must be slain.

This ancient being, the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor, who was incompatible with the revived star sea, was suffering an incomparably intense Dao backlash.

The heartbeat grew faster and faster. His bent body had long since become incomplete. Even the bones beneath the flesh no longer remained.

Like a shattered puzzle piece, he swayed endlessly amid violent explosions. His newly grown long hair circled once through the star sea before returning to its origin.

It viciously wrapped around his neck.

Tighter and tighter, like a sharp sword determined to sever his head.

Boom.

The heartbeat had reached its absolute limit. The Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor's chest exploded violently.

There was no blood mist.

Only pure, absolute nothingness.

Even energy no longer existed, a complete manifestation of Dao extinguish.

The extinguishing void began spreading outward from the hollow in his chest.

His already broken and battered body seemed about to be completely devoured by nothingness.

The winds of the star sea grew even more violent.

As though celebrating this victory.

However...

Just as the void of Dao extinguish was about to swallow the Immortal Ancestor's head.

This mysterious supreme being, who had suppressed the Xuanhuang Realm across several eras.

Suddenly had tiny points of starlight illuminate within his eyes.

Although the lower half of his head had already been partially consumed, a voice still rang out across the star sea.

It was precisely the exact same words shouted by the Holy Emperor.

"Dao Extinguishes..."

As the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor spoke, the star sea seemed to sink once more into silence and darkness.

The blowing winds gradually calmed.

The wildly growing hair slowly fell away.

Even the void consuming the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor was halted by some mysterious force, no longer spreading.

In merely an instant, all the destructive phenomena upon the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor had vanished.

It was as if an invisible barrier existed around him, blocking all forces that attempted to approach.

The wind still howled, and the starlight remained brilliant.

Yet it could not harm him in the slightest.

Even though he only had half of his head remaining.

"Dao Born."

Immortal Ancestor spoke calmly once more.

Black hair regrew, and his fleshly body was born and evolved from the void.

His high crown and robes were all restored to their original state in the blink of an eye.

In only a few moments, Dharma Transmitting Immortal Ancestor, who had originally been gravely wounded and on the verge of falling, had completely recovered!

What a terrifying sight this was.

"What a pity. It was just a little short."

The Holy Emperor's sigh suddenly rang out.

A streak of starlight swept past, and Li Ping's figure appeared once again.

He stared at Dharma Transmitting Immortal Ancestor. The regret in his eyes had already vanished, leaving only endless battle intent and unwavering conviction.

Immortal Ancestor also did not immediately launch a counterattack, but instead examined this attacker who had tried to kill him the moment they disagreed.

As if he had seen something extremely interesting, Immortal Ancestor was first momentarily stunned.

Then he said, "When did another Supreme realm cultivator appear in this starry sky?"

There was some wistfulness and some emotion in his tone.

"Supreme..."

The Holy Emperor carefully savored those two words.

Then he slightly shook his head.

"It is merely the current limit of the Star Sea."

"Not the limit of this Star Sea."

"So how can it be called Supreme?"

Dharma Transmitting Immortal Ancestor did not refute him.

Instead, he turned back to look toward the distant center of the Star Sea.

"Fellow Daoist, do you know the saying that as the water rises, the boat rises with it?"

"My Supreme, and your Supreme..."

"Are still somewhat different."

Immortal Ancestor spoke calmly.

There was no intention of boasting in his words, only the indifference of someone stating a simple fact.

The Holy Emperor listened to Immortal Ancestor's words and fell into thought.

He naturally understood what Immortal Ancestor meant.

The reason Dharma Transmitting Immortal Ancestor currently displayed this level of battle strength was because the limit of what the Star Sea could contain stopped here. But the power Dharma Transmitting Immortal Ancestor could truly control exceeded that limit.

It was only because of the current upper boundary that it could not be displayed.

As the Star Sea's limit was opened further, his strength would continue to grow stronger.

As for the Holy Emperor, although he had now also reached the Star Sea's limit, it was through the blessings of the Holy Dynasty's fortune, the Star Sea's favor, and many other factors.

Once the Star Sea's limit was opened, he would still need a period of further cultivation before he could catch up.

This was the gap between Immortal Ancestor and himself.

"After all, this is Dharma Transmitting Immortal Ancestor, who has existed for who knows how long."

The Holy Emperor did not feel much surprise in his heart.

Nor did he feel the slightest fear.

Even if his killing move had been blocked, even if there was a gap in strength between them.

Still...

The Holy Emperor's attack had only just begun.

Holy Emperor Li Ping extended his hand toward the front, sensing the winds rising in the Star Sea.

This time, it was not the wind of the Star Sea's revival.

But rather the chaotic winds that had gradually arisen from clashing against the residual power of a True Immortal.

The Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor also sensed Li Ping’s movement.

“Fellow Daoist, that move you just used, [Dao Extinguishes, Dao Born], was indeed extraordinary.”

“Seeing it stirred my emotions, and it has benefited me greatly.”

“I also have a move. Please offer your appraisal, Fellow Daoist.”

This time, the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor struck first.

“This technique is called…”

“Something in the Palm.”

The moment the words Something in the Palm echoed beside the Holy Emperor’s ears, a wave of unease surged in Li Ping’s heart.

Then the scene before his eyes changed at astonishing speed.

His body instantly began shrinking without limit.

The surrounding scenery rapidly magnified.

The elderly man in the high crown, who had originally been several sizes smaller than his three zhang three chi body, expanded at incredible speed.

By the time the Holy Emperor realized the change had occurred, the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor had already become like the colossal stone statue towering upon the surface of the Xuanhuang Realm.

It was not merely a change in size.

The Holy Emperor could even feel that his connection to the Holy Dynasty, to the Xuanhuang Realm, and even to the entire star sea, was continuously weakening as he shrank.

A faint premonition arose in the Holy Emperor’s heart. If this continued, those connections would very likely be severed completely.

And he would be forever lost within this miniature scene.

Yet while his thoughts raced, the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor’s attack had already arrived.

In merely the time it took to think, the full figure of the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor could no longer be seen.

Only the Immortal Ancestor palm, vast as mountains, immense as earth and heaven, came crashing down overhead.

The surrounding space was locked. Escape was impossible for the Holy Emperor.

Looking upward, even the palm lines of the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor had become like towering mountain ranges.

Facing the gigantic palm descending to suppress him, not the slightest fear appeared in the Holy Emperor’s eyes.

“The Xuanhuang Realm…”

“How could it possibly be something in your palm?”

A cold glint flashed through the Holy Emperor’s eyes.

“Let me show you…”

“The true power of Xuanhuang.”

“My body becomes…”

“Xuanhuang Heaven!”

His body was completely covered beneath the Immortal Ancestor giant palm.

And then…

Endless Xuanhuang radiance burst forth from beneath that giant palm.

At this moment, all living beings in the Xuanhuang Realm instantly felt the land beneath their feet shaking violently.

Even the dark clouds in the sky were scattered by the tremors.

Quite a few sharp-eyed cultivators even saw that it seemed as though certain lines within heaven and earth had vanished.

As creaking thunderous sounds rang out, it was as if the pillars of heaven had broken.

The sky of the Xuanhuang Realm sank downward slightly.

Chapter 1297: The Holy Legacy Shares A Common Hatred

It was not the imagination of the Xuanhuang cultivators.

The heavens had truly collapsed.

After a brief silence, a vast and mighty voice never before heard thundered across the world like an exploding bolt of lightning.

"Ahhh!"

It was as if their heads had been struck directly by a heavy club. Countless cultivators saw darkness before their eyes and nearly lost consciousness, almost fainting on the spot.

The buzzing in their ears did not fade even after a long while.

It was a tremor originating from the soul itself. Even sealing off the five senses was useless.

The cultivators who raised their heads to look at the sky all discovered, without exception, that the heavens seemed close enough to touch.

Moreover, the concentration of spiritual energy throughout the world had just undergone an extremely obvious decline.

The Xuanhuang winds and rains had also weakened significantly, as part of the world's power had been drawn away.

The overwhelming majority of cultivators in the world had no idea why such a terrifying phenomenon had occurred.

Only the few standing at the peak of the Xuanhuang Realm's power understood what these phenomena truly represented.

In a peculiar space.

Five statues whose faces could not be seen stood in a circle.

The statues lowered their heads, gazing at the center.

There, a glowing cloud mass representing the current Xuanhuang floated silently.

The many changes that had occurred in the Xuanhuang Realm since the beginning of the war were all displayed in meticulous detail within the cloud mass.

At this moment, as heaven collapsed and earth sank, the Xuanhuang cloud mass also slowly wriggled, shrinking by nearly an entire circle.

"Tsk tsk tsk, they really paid an enormous price this time."

A somewhat frivolous female voice suddenly rang out.

"And we are just going to watch? This is a once in a thousand years opportunity..."

One of the statues instantly came to life, revealing her original appearance. Her long hair flowed like silk, hanging smoothly to her waist.

A tight white robe wrapped around her voluptuous figure, yet for some reason exposed her fair thighs.

Her gaze was dreamy, slender fingers resting against her lips as she spoke to the other four statues.

"What else would we do? Help that mysterious Holy Emperor of unknown origins?" a cold voice came from the statue dressed in Daoist robes.

"I heard the Holy Emperor's transmitted new Dao and gained some insight. The Holy Emperor may be considered my teacher. If possible, I truly would like to help. Unfortunately..."

The scholar-like statue also came to life, raising his head toward the skies beyond Xuanhuang and sighing softly.

"The struggle over Xuanhuang orthodoxy means little to us. Immortal Ancestor harbors wolfish ambitions, and this Holy Emperor of unknown background is likely no good either. The Xuanhuang Realm, and even this star sea, are not places to remain long term. Everyone, our future hope still lies with Carefree. Maintaining stability with the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and preserving the stability of the Xuanhuang Realm while waiting for the final result is what we should do. Involving ourselves in this conflict is truly unwise."

One of the statues whose face had always remained obscured spoke in a deep voice.

"Besides... Immortal Ancestor cannot lose."

That statue added.

The gazes of the four statues all focused on Carefree Heavenly Sovereign, who still seemed asleep.

Senior Sister Zhao said somewhat wistfully, "Sigh, I had wanted to use this opportunity to tease the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance people. After all, they are all fresh new faces. Much more exciting."

The scholar, the Daoist, and the obscured statue all pretended not to hear.

"Binding oneself to heaven and earth truly has too many flaws. With the Xuanhuang Realm drawing out power to assist, I have become much weaker too."

Senior Sister Zhao covered her lips and yawned lazily.

"I am going back to recover. Call me if anything happens."

Before her words had even finished, Senior Sister Zhao's statue once again became still.

The scholar statue chuckled softly.

"Still could not resist going to join the excitement."

The Daoist statue said bluntly, "A thousand people, a thousand faces. Zhao Ruoxi has far more than ten thousand. Having some split personalities and being unable to control herself is normal. Let her go. It is not so easy for her to die even if she wants to."

After Senior Sister Zhao left, the obscured statue suddenly came to life.

It was revealed to be a middle aged cultivator with a square face and a solemn expression.

"The Carefree Paradise, after so many years of development, has already spread to the edges of the star sea and begun infiltrating the High Wall."

"Now is the most critical moment."

"This sudden outbreak of slaughter, regardless of the final result, is beneficial to us. At the very least, there will be many casualties. Afterward, it will provide another enormous replenishment of Carefree-power. Perhaps Carefree can use this opportunity to break through the High Wall's restraints in one stroke."

The square faced cultivator said in a deep voice.

"After all, the High Wall's suppression of a consciousness space like Carefree Paradise is far weaker than its suppression of physical force."

As the square faced cultivator spoke, a strange atmosphere began flowing through the space.

And Carefree, who carried the hopes of the five Heavenly Sovereigns for escape, still remained peacefully asleep.

Only his occasionally twitching brows hinted at possible intense inner fluctuations.

After a brief silence, the Daoist statue spoke.

"Beyond the High Wall... is not necessarily peaceful. The fact that the group who escaped back then wanted to flee back again proves this. Unfortunately, the High Wall is difficult to cross. This is true both inside and outside."

"Even if this plan ultimately succeeds, and we manage to escape beyond the High Wall using the dream power of Carefree Paradise, without the laws of the Xuanhuang Realm as our foundation, our strength will inevitably plummet. Dao Integration cultivation would likely make even taking a single step difficult beyond the High Wall."

The square faced cultivator said again in a deep voice, "Even if there is danger, what is lost would only be the dream body. It would not damage the true self fundamentally. But if beyond the High Wall truly is a paradise, then we can cultivate using the dream body from then onward. Gradually transferring the true self's power."

"When the dream body fully condenses into reality, and its strength surpasses the true self, we can switch places and successfully escape like a cicada shedding its shell."

The scholar statue nodded slightly as he listened.

"This truly is the most stable method we can think of at present. If Dharma Transmitting Heavenly Sovereign were not so terrifyingly powerful, and if he were not obsessively clinging to this little patch of the Xuanhuang Realm, we would not need to be so aggrieved."

The Daoist statue said, "In that case, let us each add another spark. The denser the Carefree power, the better. So long as the Xuanhuang Realm itself is not endangered, no matter how many die, it makes no difference."

...

Just as they were speaking, it seemed as if a great wind blew in from outside the Xuanhuang Realm.

The Xuanhuang light mass at the center of the five statues visibly shook slightly.

A trace of shock flashed through the eyes of the three Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereigns.

"That Immortal Ancestor is this overwhelmingly powerful, that can still be understood. After all, he has lived for so many years."

"But this Holy Emperor who suddenly appeared is also this terrifying? Even with the Xuanhuang Realm assisting him, it should not be to this extent."

The three Heavenly Sovereigns exchanged glances, uncertain and alarmed.

Meanwhile, Carefree Heavenly Sovereign slept even more soundly.

...

"Transform body into..."

"Xuanhuang Heaven!"

An overwhelmingly vast force suddenly surged into his body as the Holy Emperor roared.

Violet, gold, and Xuanhuang colors merged together.

The Holy Emperor's figure vanished beneath Immortal Ancestor's giant hand.

In its place was the scenery of endless Xuanhuang heaven and earth.

The Xuanhuang Realm, a single world.

Though it had stitched together and absorbed many other surviving cultivation worlds, its scale ultimately had limits.

Yet at this moment, the Xuanhuang heaven and earth being suppressed beneath Immortal Ancestor's giant hand stretched infinitely, with no end in sight.

The sky was high, the earth vast, and the scenery between heaven and earth continuously changed.

Seas turned into mulberry fields, stars shifted, constellations revolved.

As time passed, the distance between heaven and earth slowly increased.

It was as if an invisible giant stood between the earth and the heavens.

Endlessly lifting the sky upward.

"Xuanhuang transforms, heaven and earth are boundless."

"The Xuanhuang of antiquity, the Xuanhuang of the present, the Xuanhuang of the future."

"Gather."

The Holy Emperor’s voice echoed throughout the phantom image of the Xuanhuang Realm.

As heaven and earth expanded, it became increasingly resounding.

Past, present, future.

The Xuanhuang Realms across infinite spacetime merged into one at this moment.

Countless phantom images layered upon one another, as if they had been forcibly dragged out from the long river of time.

Forming an unprecedented eternal and vast spacetime.

The gigantic palm suppressing downward from Immortal Ancestor was held up by the endless heavenly canopy. It trembled violently, yet could advance no further.

The expansion of the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm had no end.

At a speed even faster than its earlier contraction, under the reverse pressure of immeasurable Xuanhuang radiance, Immortal Ancestor's giant palm instantly shrank back to the size of a normal human hand.

The distortion of scale and space returned to normal.

Immortal Ancestor withdrew his hand and looked at the circular black scar in the center of his palm, as though it had been scorched by intense flames. A trace of gravity flashed in his eyes.

Even though light and shadow flowed across his body, with Dao perishing and Dao being reborn, the black scar could not be healed.

Opposite Immortal Ancestor, the phantom image of the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm illuminated this dark and silent star sea.

As if there had truly come into existence an eternal supreme immortal domain, existing in the past, present, and forever.

Immortal Ancestor's gaze shifted away from the wound in his hand and moved toward the vast spectacle before him.

Mountains towered, fertile lands stretched for countless billions of miles. Strange spirits and wondrous landscapes were too numerous to count.

It resembled the legendary Immortal Realm.

Looking at the Xuanhuang Realm before him, Immortal Ancestor actually became slightly absent-minded.

A streak of starlight exploded in the sky of the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm.

Clad in a robe of starlight, wearing the Nine Heavens Jade Crown, stepping upon the long river of time.

The Holy Emperor slowly walked out from the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm.

As if stepping out from a painting into reality.

Illusion and reality twisted and intertwined at this moment, making truth and falsehood impossible to distinguish.

It even gave rise to an intensely contradictory sensation.

"This is..."

"The Law of Time?" Immortal Ancestor's voice carried both astonishment and disbelief.

But after only a moment, he slightly shook his head, rejecting his earlier speculation.

The black scar on his hand had not improved with the passage of time.

On the contrary, it was becoming increasingly severe, even showing signs of spreading to other parts of his body.

For his Supreme body, this was simply unimaginable.

Immortal Ancestor could vaguely sense that what was continuously devouring his palm was not a force related to time.

But rather...

An established fact.

No matter how time passed, no matter how the star sea lived or perished.

This wound would never change.

The Holy Emperor who had stepped out from the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm gave Immortal Ancestor no chance to breathe.

"Glorious holy spirits, wear my robe, become my spears and halberds."

As the Holy Emperor’s voice echoed, one phantom figure after another, likewise dressed in robes of starlight, walked out from the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm.

Their faces could not be seen, and even the techniques they used were entirely different from the Holy Emperor’s.

But without exception, all of them regarded Immortal Ancestor as their mortal enemy.

Without a word, they immediately launched into battle. Some fought with fists and feet, some with talismans, some with flying swords.

Their Dao arts and divine abilities were all phantom manifestations. They appeared ordinary and unremarkable, with no special destructive power.

Yet even without physically striking Immortal Ancestor, they still inflicted damage upon him.

Every wound was exactly the same as the black circular scar on his palm from before.

And before the vast, boundless Eternal Xuanhuang Realm, which seemed to still be continuously expanding, Immortal Ancestor's power also appeared to be suppressed.

Facing endless phantom incarnations that never knew exhaustion, Immortal Ancestor could only struggle to defend himself.

Even if he annihilated them in an instant, soon even greater numbers of phantom incarnations would fly out from the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm.

On the contrary, before dying, each of these incarnations would inevitably inflict at least a trace of injury upon Immortal Ancestor.

Even if it was only the slightest trace, each one was a fatal wound that could never heal.

Slowly, more and more black scars appeared across Immortal Ancestor's body.

Under the eerie reflection of the dreadful black aura, Immortal Ancestor's compassionate face became somewhat ferocious.

Yet even in such a dangerous situation, Immortal Ancestor still did not panic.

He was thinking, analyzing the true nature of the phantom Xuanhuang Realm before him.

The comprehension ability of Dharma Transmitting Heavenly Sovereign was beyond question.

The fact that he could create the heaven-defying cultivation path of "defying the principles of heaven and earth to attain longevity" was enough to demonstrate his world-shaking brilliance that illuminated the ages.

Moments earlier, after suffering the Holy Emperor’s Dao Extinguishes Dao Born attack, he had comprehended it almost instantly and used it in return, which also demonstrated the terrifying extent of his comprehension.

He had even gained some understanding of the residual power of True Immortals drifting through the star sea, and even of the essence of the High Wall itself.

But only...

This Eternal Xuanhuang Realm, existing between illusion and reality.

It left him utterly unable to grasp or understand.

As someone in the same Supreme realm, Immortal Ancestor naturally knew that the limits of this level of power made it fundamentally impossible to create such a vast Xuanhuang Realm out of nothing.

Otherwise, he would not have needed to painstakingly patch up worlds.

Yet before him, the oppressive pressure of the worldly phantom felt completely real.

The imprints of past cultivators from the Xuanhuang Realm felt completely real.

The wounds inflicted upon him also felt completely real.

What exactly was this...?

A sharp glint flashed through Immortal Ancestor’s deep eyes. He seemed on the verge of realizing the answer to the question.

But a streak of sword light sliced off his high crown.

And once again interrupted his train of thought.

Faced with the Holy Emperor’s relentless killing assaults, the condition of his body was no longer enough to support further observation and learning.

Immortal Ancestor’s felt a slight sense of regret.

He had a premonition that if he could comprehend this great divine ability of the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm, it might be of tremendous benefit, whether for the future revival of the Xuanhuang Realm, escaping the Immortal Ruins, or crossing the High Wall.

Unfortunately, the other party clearly had no intention of allowing him to have his way.

“Fellow Daoist, your talent is something rarely seen even across the past ten thousand years.”

“But if you wish to kill me...”

“You are still lacking somewhat.”

Immortal Ancestor’s expression became solemn.

A killing intent that had never appeared since the beginning of the battle surfaced in his eyes.

“To die beneath this move, Fellow Daoist may die without regret.”

Immortal Ancestor, his body covered in wounds, spoke indifferently.

Before the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm, a fissure suddenly appeared.

Boom!

A thick arm, seemingly formed from countless worlds, violently stretched out from the crack.

Bang! Bang!

Without the slightest hesitation, the world arm crashed directly into the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm.

The Star River Tunnel trembled violently.

The Eternal Xuanhuang Realm, after all, was not yet truly eternal.

But the world arm summoned by Immortal Ancestor contained real worlds.

They were merely fragments of worlds filled with deathly stillness and ruin.

Under the brutal bombardment of countless world fragments, the phantom of the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm became unstable, flickering in and out of existence.

As for the attacks from those illusory incarnations, against these already extinct worlds, they were utterly insignificant.

Even the residual True Immortal power remaining on those world fragments gradually transferred onto the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm through the collision between worlds.

Black calamities began appearing throughout the heavens and earth of the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm.

Boom!

Another arm formed entirely from world fragments appeared at another corner of the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm.

It charged directly toward the Holy Emperor standing within.

Wherever it passed, the illusory realm shattered violently.

Revealing the true dark void beneath.

“The corpses of worlds...”

The Holy Emperor looked at the overlapping vision of countless ruined worlds drawing ever closer in his sight.

Looking at the broken walls and ruins covering them, and the white bones occasionally exposed.

His mind could not help but recall the ancient catastrophe, when worlds were destroyed and cultivators turned into ash amid painful and despairing wails.

“So many...”

The Holy Emperor was moved inwardly.

As the world fragment arm that swept away everything was about to strike.

A trace of light appeared before him.

“Dust returns to dust, earth returns to earth.”

The light illuminated the Holy Emperor’s compassionate face as he softly chanted.

The moment those world fragments were touched by the light.

They actually evaporated into nothingness like melting snow.

That savage and violent sweeping arm not only failed to harm the Holy Emperor in the slightest.

It instead directly lost nearly a hundred world fragments.

The arm split open in the middle.

“Hm?!”

This time, Immortal Ancestor was genuinely shocked.

Looking at the damaged world arm, his mind stirred, and he hurriedly withdrew it.

He stared at the Holy Emperor protected within the radiance.

“This light is...”

Yet another incomprehensible thing had appeared before him.

Immortal Ancestor narrowed his eyes. He did not attack recklessly again, but instead began reconsidering the other party’s true identity.

The Holy Emperor also seized this chance to rest.

After all, having unleashed killing moves one after another, even with the Xuanhuang Realm providing remote support, the expenditure for him had been immense.

The Eternal Xuanhuang Realm was founded upon the principle he had comprehended, “When the false is taken as true, even falsehood becomes real,” layered with the countless outstanding heroes of the Xuanhuang Realm from past ages, as well as those who might possibly appear in the future through deduction, forming a vast world that was both illusory and real.

In the Holy Emperor’s deductions, if one’s strength were sufficient, it would be possible to summon this Eternal Xuanhuang Realm directly out of nothingness.

But clearly, his current self had not reached such a level.

Even those summoned holy spirits of the Xuanhuang Realm could not manifest real power.

Only the attacks they unleashed in an instant, or at the moment before death, those fleeting strikes capable of injuring Immortal Ancestor, were granted the attribute of “reality.”

Real damage.

Thus, Immortal Ancestor could not heal through ordinary means.

Perhaps only by transforming those “real” wounds back into nothingness could the scars disappear from his body.

Although it had indeed inflicted considerable harm upon Immortal Ancestor, the Holy Emperor was not faring well either.

The expenditure required to transform illusion into reality far exceeded the Holy Emperor’s imagination.

In such a short time, the support power coming from the Xuanhuang Realm had already been completely exhausted.

This was also the fundamental reason why, after suffering the assault from the world fragmented arms, the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm suddenly became so fragile.

The power support the Xuanhuang Realm could provide had already reached its limit.

What later helped the Holy Emperor overcome the crisis was another treasure from the Fishing Pond.

Like Cat Treasure, very little additional information had come with it when it was fished up. Its appearance was merely that of a bare white ring.

Yet this seemingly unremarkable object had caused Cat Treasure to feel annoyance and dislike.

After he carried it, Cat Treasure refused to follow him here.

However, Cat Treasure itself had no combat capability, so the Holy Emperor ultimately decided to bring along the white ring anyway.

It proved that the Holy Emperor’s decision was correct.

The white ring effectively saved his life.

Its true name was unknown, but under its radiance, any inanimate object would be decomposed into pure energy.

Living beings, however, were unaffected.

Objects carrying a cultivator’s divine sense would still be decomposed, but the cultivator’s divine sense itself would suffer no harm whatsoever.

At first glance, it seemed somewhat useless, but in reality, it was extraordinarily formidable.

The endless world-arms sweeping toward him were all instantly decomposed into energy the moment they touched the white light.

That energy replenished the Holy Emperor’s battle expenditure.

By this point, the battle had already fallen into a stalemate.

Although Immortal Ancestor’s foundation was far deeper than the Holy Emperor’s, the Holy Emperor had compensated for that disparity through numerous fortuitous encounters.

Both stood in the Supreme Realm, having reached the limit of the Star Sea. Deciding life and death between them so easily was no simple matter.

Otherwise, it would be too much of a desecration of the title Supreme.

“Could Fellow Daoist lend me the item in your hand for a look?”

“I merely wish to verify certain matters. After examining it, I will return it,” Immortal Ancestor said with utmost seriousness.

The Holy Emperor fell silent.

After a long while, he extended his hand and tossed the white ring over.

Immortal Ancestor nodded in acknowledgment, casually caught the white ring, and examined it carefully.

His brows gradually rose, then he let out a sigh.

“What a pity.”

Afterward, just as he had promised, he returned the white ring to the Holy Emperor completely intact.

And during this entire exchange, he did not take the opportunity to launch a sneak attack.

“If my guess is correct, this item should have come from beyond the High Wall.”

“Originally, I wondered whether it might be able to dissolve the High Wall. It seems I was overthinking...” Immortal Ancestor said with self-mockery.

Then Immortal Ancestor’s expression turned solemn as he looked at the Holy Emperor and, for the first time, asked:

“Just where does Fellow Daoist come from? Could you perhaps be from beyond the High Wall?”

It was no wonder Immortal Ancestor asked this.

After all, from his perspective, the sudden appearance of a Supreme Realm being like the Holy Emperor, possessing numerous divine abilities, was simply far too suspicious.

The Holy Emperor shook his head decisively, denying Immortal Ancestor’s speculation.

“I am the Heavenly Mandate Holy Emperor of Great Qi.”

“The incarnation of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.”

“I seek to support the great edifice before it collapses, to turn back the raging tide after its downfall, and to restore Xuanhuang’s rightful orthodoxy!” the Holy Emperor declared with a solemn expression.

Immortal Ancestor, however, sharply detected the scent of conspiracy within those words.

“The incarnation of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao...”

“If the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao possessed strength like yours, how could it have fallen to such a state?”

“Forgive this old man’s bluntness, but a mere Xuanhuang Realm could absolutely never nurture a figure such as yourself,” Immortal Ancestor said, his eyes flickering as he spoke with complete certainty.

Hearing this, the Holy Emperor could not help but fall silent.

“We two are fighting, but I fear there is some schemer plotting in the shadows.”

“Fellow Daoist, I hope you will think carefully and not fall into another person’s trap,” Immortal Ancestor said again.

“This person was able to cultivate someone like you, Fellow Daoist. Their strength is certainly not weak. Yet they have remained hidden behind the scenes the entire time…”

A fierce glint flashed in Immortal Ancestor’s eyes.

“Their scheme is enormous.”

“How about you and I join forces first and find this person, what do you think?” Immortal Ancestor suggested.

Hearing Immortal Ancestor’s words, the Holy Emperor truly began to think seriously.

Although his conviction to save the Xuanhuang Realm had never wavered, as his strength grew ever higher, he had also developed many doubts about the true origin of his own identity.

Especially after verifying that his bloodline originated from a mixture of three different lineages, the confusion in his heart had reached its peak at that time.

It was only that he had forcibly suppressed it all with his absolute conviction.

But at this moment, under the persuasion of the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor, those thoughts that had originally been extinguished reignited like dying embers flaring back to life.

Immortal Ancestor continued speaking.

“I truly understand your feelings, Fellow Daoist.”

“Look, if I had not spent all these years painstakingly patching and repairing the Xuanhuang Realm, then this final pure land within the Darkest Star Sea would probably have long since fallen into the Immortal Ruins.”

With a wave of his hand, countless images appeared before the Holy Emperor.

They showed scenes of Immortal Ancestor flying through the void, carrying world fragments that still retained a trace of life upon his back.

Even though he had long known what Immortal Ancestor had done for the Xuanhuang Realm, upon personally witnessing Immortal Ancestor’s solitary figure traveling through the cold starry sky with unwavering determination in his eyes, the Holy Emperor still felt a slight stirring in his heart.

“Although you and I have chosen different paths, in the end, both of us are doing this for that world.” Immortal Ancestor pointed toward the distant Xuanhuang Realm as he spoke.

“But the one behind the scenes may not be the same.” Immortal Ancestor’s tone became somewhat cold.

“If you and I fight, one of us will certainly be injured. It is even possible that while we are battling, that person behind the scenes may be carrying out some sinister act within the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“Can Fellow Daoist truly rest easy knowing that after your death, this person would still remain hidden within the Xuanhuang Realm?”

“As for me, I certainly would not be at ease.” The tone of the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor was filled with killing intent.

The Holy Emperor’s expression also darkened.

He felt that the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor’s words made some sense.

From the earlier act of borrowing the white ring for observation and then returning it exactly as it was, Immortal Ancestor had already demonstrated his character to him.

Meanwhile, the despicable nature of the one manipulating things behind the scenes had already become unmistakably clear.

There would always be time to decide victory or defeat with Immortal Ancestor later.

But if both he and Immortal Ancestor ended up gravely wounded...

Then that hidden mastermind might truly get exactly what they wanted.

Immortal Ancestor noticed the change in the Holy Emperor’s heart and gave a slight nod.

He then began asking the Holy Emperor about the full sequence of events.

“No memories whatsoever, suddenly descending into the world.”

“A faint connection, bloodline relation…”

As the Holy Emperor described everything, subtle changes appeared in Immortal Ancestor’s expression.

And the atmosphere between the two, almost without either noticing, gradually shifted from murderous tension to relative harmony.

“As for dragging out the one behind the scenes, it is both difficult and not difficult.”

“Since there is a bloodline connection, I possess a secret technique that can sense all those related by bloodline within a certain range. However, this person is deeply cunning and calculating. They have likely long since left the Xuanhuang Realm,” Immortal Ancestor said.
