Chapter 1298: Great Chaotic War In The Star Sea

“I also once followed the faint sense of connection, trying to track down this person. But every attempt ended in failure...” As the Holy Emperor spoke, he sensed the rising winds of the star sea.

The revival of the star sea, and its struggle against the residual True Immortal power, was a rather lengthy process.

Converted into the human scale of time, it would likely last for more than ten years.

Before this star sea storm reached its peak, he could resume battle with the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor at any moment.

Temporary cooperation did not mean eternal reconciliation.

The decision to halt the battle and first investigate the hidden mastermind was not only because the two were indeed evenly matched and incapable of determining victory or defeat, but also because there was an element of delaying for time.

The Holy Emperor’s gaze casually swept across the distant Xuanhuang Realm.

The gradually increasing number of cultivators following the path of "Foundation Establishment as Oneself" were weakening the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor’s foundation.

The Genesis Stone Tablet and Ruomu’s plan to establish Xuanhuang orthodoxy was also progressing at increasing speed, since the Holy Dynasty had taken over vast portions of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s former territory.

Before the star sea storm gradually strengthened and reached its peak, delay was beneficial to the Holy Emperor.

Since the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor had taken the initiative to propose the truce, the Holy Emperor naturally welcomed it.

Moreover, the treasure fishing operation with the Fishing Pond had not stopped for even a moment.

Perhaps during this time, another supreme treasure capable of reversing the battle situation might be caught.

As his thoughts raced, he used the Star Sea Net to issue instructions to his subordinates. While speaking with the Immortal Ancestor, the Holy Emperor forced out a drop of blood from between his brows.

Immortal Ancestor coughed lightly. First, he repaired the high crown that had been severed during the previous battle.

Then light surged, concealing the countless tiny wounds across his body.

Seeing this scene, the Holy Emperor became thoughtful.

“Could it be that the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor is delaying for time in order to comprehend the principle of ‘When False Becomes True, the False Is Also True’?”

Though he held this suspicion, the Holy Emperor was not worried that the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor could comprehend it within this short time.

Because the Holy Emperor had a vague intuitive sense that this method of "When False Becomes True, the False Is Also True" possessed its own unique nature.

It was not something that could be comprehended merely through heaven-defying talent.

While the Holy Emperor was pondering, the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor, having already returned to the appearance of the compassionate old man in the high crown, began casting one spell seal after another, enveloping the Holy Emperor’s blood suspended in midair.

The color of the light continuously shifted, finally settling on a pale yellow nearly identical to the appearance of the Xuanhuang world.

The Immortal Ancestor’s expression changed slightly upon seeing this.

Yet his hands did not stop, and he continued casting.

Within the pale yellow sphere, the blood seemed to come alive, struggling violently.

Then two protrusions emerged from it.

One pointed toward the Xuanhuang Realm.

The other...

Unexpectedly pointed beyond the star sea.

It was even spinning violently without pause.

As if the location it indicated was continuously changing position at extreme speed.

“How could this...” Seeing the increasingly grave expression of the Immortal Ancestor, the Holy Emperor also became serious. He had only just spoken when, before he could finish...

The surrounding space suddenly became violently chaotic.

Unlike the storm caused by the revival force of the star sea, it was more like something was about to burst forth from underground, as if drilling out from beneath the earth.

The Holy Emperor and the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor simultaneously flashed away, retreating to avoid it.

They watched as the rotating protrusion from the blood within the pale yellow sphere gradually came to a stop.

Quietly pointing ahead.

Moments later...

Faint ripples, almost imperceptible, spread from the space ahead.

As if a drop of water had just fallen.

Neither divine sense nor vision found the target, but both the Holy Emperor and the Immortal Ancestor knew that something had just arrived there.

The Immortal Ancestor narrowed his eyes, seemingly revealing a trace of reminiscence.

Yet after glancing at the Holy Emperor’s blood drop, confusion flashed in his eyes.

“Interesting. The true mastermind behind the scenes has actually taken the initiative to reveal itself...”

Within the pale yellow sphere, the Holy Emperor’s blood slowly burned away.

Yet the protrusion extending from it remained firmly pointed toward the void ahead.

“The Immortal Ark...” the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor murmured softly.

The Holy Emperor also narrowed his eyes.

Naturally, he was aware of the transmission sword light that had previously appeared outside the Xuanhuang Realm.

In an instant, countless thoughts arose.

“Could it be that the conspiracy behind everything truly involves this Immortal Ark?” The Holy Emperor’s heart tightened slightly.

“But...”

“The timing of this flying vessel’s appearance is far too coincidental.”

The Holy Emperor stared ahead without making the first move.

“The Xuan Immortal Ark is part of the remnants of the ancient Xuanshang Immortal Ark. It has long hidden beneath the High Wall, within the endless ruins...” The Immortal Ancestor briefly explained the background of the Xuan Immortal Ark before them.

The Holy Emperor looked at the magnificent scene at the edge of the star sea, beneath the High Wall, and momentarily lost focus.

He had briefly touched the true essence of the star sea’s origin, and thus understood the immeasurable vastness of this sea of stars.

Yet precisely because of this, it made the terrifying nature of the High Wall, which firmly sealed this entire star sea, even more apparent.

“You and I are battling, and they appear here at this exact moment...”

“Then let this old man see just how much the Xuan Immortal Ark has progressed over these years.”

A cold light flashed in the Immortal Ancestor’s eyes.

His body remained completely still. He merely cast a calm glance forward.

The space ahead, which had been rippling due to the Xuan Immortal Ark’s arrival, gradually became calm.

Then, as if frozen solid, the space slowly fell into absolute stillness.

Like the annihilation of the star sea at the end of the world, not a single fluctuation emerged from that dead zone.

“The Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor’s divine abilities are indeed extraordinary.”

Seeing this scene, the Holy Emperor’s pupils contracted slightly. His mind immediately began considering how he himself would deal with such a move.

The absolute freezing did not last.

Just before it could fully complete, a savage force suddenly erupted.

Shattering the frozen domain completely.

The image of the Xuan Immortal Ark flickered briefly into existence.

The power released by the Xuan Immortal Ark did far more than simply break the Immortal Ancestor’s frozen domain.

It also triggered resonance with the many remnants of immortal power lingering throughout this region of the star sea.

Like a hundred rivers converging, they came surging in with overwhelming force in an instant.

If the trap the Holy Emperor had previously laid by diverting the flow had been merely a stream of residual True Immortal power, then what had now been stirred was a vast, roaring river.

Because they were resisting the revival force of the star sea, those residual True Immortal powers were already far more active than usual.

At this moment, after being drawn in and sensing the aura of the Immortal Ancestor and the Holy Emperor, it was like a beast that had caught the scent of prey, pursuing them in an instant.

Both were forced to evade.

Although both had already reached the Star Sea limit known as Supreme.

Faced with the residual power of a True Immortal that could contend against the Star Sea itself, they were still deeply wary.

Especially since the two were hostile parties in a temporary cooperation. If one were seriously injured, they would undoubtedly fall into a disadvantage in the final battle to come.

After all, residual True Immortal power was unlike ordinary techniques. It was not so easily expelled.

Each relied on their own methods.

The Holy Emperor, through his connection with the Star Sea, could almost clearly perceive the waves of incoming residual True Immortal power. He evaded them with practiced familiarity.

When there were attacks he truly could not avoid, the starlight robe would flicker, and the source power essence generated from the endless prayers transmitted from the Holy Dynasty Great Qi would quickly expel the residual True Immortal power.

The Immortal Ancestor's methods, however, were rather peculiar.

He once again brought out that long arm composed of countless ruined worlds.

Like two sponges, they absorbed all of the blazing residual True Immortal power.

Boom.

Some of the ruined worlds were completely reduced to ash under the cleansing force of the residual True Immortal power.

However, other ruined worlds within the long arm quickly filled the gaps.

One truly could not know how many world fragments the Immortal Ancestor had gathered over all these years.

Seeing the Immortal Ancestor and the Holy Emperor resolve the crisis so easily, the Xuan Immortal Ark, having failed to divert disaster onto them, used another method.

A yellow earthen paper talisman slowly drifted down from the void.

It appeared unhurried.

But in reality, it was incomparably swift.

The Holy Emperor and the Immortal Ancestor had only just sensed the existence of this talisman one moment, and in the next instant, it had already landed upon them.

This was precisely the peculiar nature of this paper talisman.

When it first descended, there was clearly only a single talisman. But because there were two targets, it landed atop both of them simultaneously.

"True Immortal seal script..."

This thought flashed through both the Holy Emperor and the Immortal Ancestor's minds at the same time.

Very quickly, they felt the power contained within this True Immortal seal script character.

Buzz.

First, the Holy Emperor noticed that his connection to the Darkest Star Sea had been severed.

It was not that the True Immortal seal script had directly cut it off, but rather that the Star Sea origin had proactively severed the connection.

The Holy Emperor could even faintly sense the hostility transmitted from the Star Sea before the disconnection.

Originally, he could regard it as half a home ground, with the power of the Star Sea augmenting his every movement.

But now, it felt as though he were trapped in a swamp. Every action was met with immense resistance.

Even the Immortal Ancestor, whom he had previously regarded as a temporary ally, now radiated intense malice in the Holy Emperor's perception.

In the blink of an eye, everywhere he looked, there were enemies.

What made the Holy Emperor feel an even deeper chill was that the power support he drew from the Holy Dynasty was also slowly weakening. It would not become unusable immediately, but if this trend continued, it likely would not be long before the Holy Dynasty, like the Star Sea, transformed from support into hostility.

Never having encountered such a situation before, the Holy Emperor swept his gaze around as his thoughts raced.

"So this is the power of a True Immortal seal script character?"

"This is not the residual power commonly found throughout the Star Sea, but complete True Immortal power..."

The Holy Emperor tried to recall the pattern on the paper talisman he had just seen.

Yet he could not remember even the slightest trace of it.

While trying every possible means to deal with the increasingly hostile surrounding forces, the Holy Emperor looked toward the Immortal Ancestor in the distance.

Because of the growing hostility, the distance between them had unconsciously widened greatly compared to before.

The Immortal Ancestor's high crown emitted silver light like white jade.

Reflected upon it were the stone statues of the Immortal Ancestor standing throughout the Xuanhuang Realm.

One of those stone statues stepped out from the high crown.

With flickering light, it transformed into a physical form.

The moment the statue condensed, it was attacked by all surrounding forces. The power of the Star Sea, residual True Immortal power, and even the Immortal Ancestor himself...

The statue shattered explosively. When the violent explosion caused by the collision of multiple forces swept across and reached the Holy Emperor's position.

It actually changed targets and surged toward the Holy Emperor instead.

As if it had truly seen an irreconcilable mortal enemy.

The Holy Emperor solemnly neutralized the impact while continuing to observe the Immortal Ancestor's actions.

As another stone statue stepped out from the high crown and was blasted into dust by the combined forces.

The Holy Emperor sensed that the power of the True Immortal seal script character clinging to the Immortal Ancestor had weakened slightly.

"So this is using the stone statue, using false death, to reduce the hostility in one's place?"

The perceptive Holy Emperor quickly understood the Immortal Ancestor's intention.

With a thought, a blurry Holy Emperor phantom also stepped out from the starlight sacred robe.

As expected, the moment the phantom separated, it was violently attacked by all surrounding forces.

Including the Holy Emperor himself.

When the Holy Emperor struck his own separated phantom, he even felt a faint sense of satisfaction, as though vengeance had been completed.

Even though this illusion vanished quickly with the phantom's dissipation, it still deeply shocked him.

Both he and the Immortal Ancestor had already stood at the limit of the Star Sea.

Yet after being affected by the True Immortal seal script, they were virtually powerless to resist.

They could only slowly dissipate the effects of the True Immortal seal script through such a crude method.

There was simply no way to contend against it with power of the same level.

"Perhaps after manifesting the Eternal Xuanhuang Realm, with my comprehension of False Becomes True, I could contend against it."

"As for the other methods I currently possess..."

The Holy Emperor rapidly reviewed them in his mind, yet could not find a single one that could compare.

A rather absurd scene instantly appeared within the Star Sea.

Two Supreme experts were pinned in place by a single True Immortal seal script character.

And the Xuan Immortal Ark, which had been hiding in the shadows and observing for quite some time, finally made another move.

The somewhat disheveled Holy Emperor suddenly received a transmitted message by his ear.

"The Xuan Immortal Ark seeks only the resources needed to survive in the Star Sea."

"Perhaps we can cooperate."

The Holy Emperor could not help but feel astonished.

Seeing that the Holy Emperor had not responded for a long time, the Xuan Immortal Ark sent another message.

"We can help your Holy Dynasty deal with the Immortal Ancestor. But after the matter is settled, you must provide us with a place to reside."

"Rest assured. The entire Xuan Immortal Ark totals no more than one hundred thousand people. The Xuanhuang Realm is so vast, having one more group like us makes no difference at all."

The communication from the Xuan Immortal Ark was exceedingly sincere.

That only made the Holy Emperor even more suspicious.

If not for the earlier guidance from the Immortal Ancestor bloodline, pointing out that the mastermind behind everything might exist aboard that immortal ark, then the Holy Emperor might truly have been tempted.

But now...

The Holy Emperor pondered silently, trying to determine what exactly the Xuan Immortal Ark was plotting.

“Could it be that, seeing I have reached a cooperation with Immortal Ancestor, they have now appeared specifically to sow discord?”

Almost naturally, the Holy Emperor arrived at this conclusion.

The Holy Emperor remained silent for a long time.

As if sensing the Holy Emperor’s hostility, the Xuan Immortal Ark sent another message.

It caused the Holy Emperor’s heart to tremble violently.

“Immortal Ancestor is absolutely not trustworthy.”

“Many years ago, this person infiltrated our immortal ark and, under the pretense of observation, stole many of the ark’s hidden treasures.”

“Although he changed his appearance back then, he cannot deceive us...”

A flood of information arrived one after another.

The Holy Emperor fell silent once more.

“If you are interested, use this method to contact us.”

The chaos caused by the True Immortal seal script gradually subsided.

Seeing that the Holy Emperor still gave no reply, the Xuan Immortal Ark could only leave behind a secret technique.

Then its figure completely vanished.

As the disturbance settled, the hostility from the world also slowly faded.

The connection with the star sea was likewise being restored.

However, although the Holy Emperor and Immortal Ancestor had already pulled apart from each other, neither of them moved close again.

“Although they escaped, I can still use fellow Daoist’s bloodline to lock onto their position,” Immortal Ancestor said slowly as he looked at the Holy Emperor.

“This Xuan Immortal Ark is rather troublesome, coming and going without a trace. You cannot track its whereabouts?” the Holy Emperor asked instead of forcing out more blood.

Immortal Ancestor chuckled softly.

“This Xuan Immortal Ark has indeed made some progress over these years. Their research into True Immortal seal script has actually reached this level. Though in our eyes, it is merely a misguided path.”

“But I must admit...”

Immortal Ancestor looked toward the star sea.

“In this Darkest Star Sea, they truly are somewhat troublesome.”

“Small scale remnants of True Immortal residual power may not be frightening. But if they gather as they just did, then fellow Daoist must be careful.”

“If you are accidentally marked by it, removing it will require tremendous effort. It may even affect your future Dao path...”

Immortal Ancestor warned.

The Holy Emperor fell into thought as he looked at the surrounding True Immortal residual power which, though dispersed after the great commotion, had not vanished.

“Is there truly no way to completely eliminate these powers? Other than relying on the star sea’s own restorative force?” the Holy Emperor asked.

“Do you know why my progress in repairing the Xuanhuang Realm has been so slow?”

“Finding suitable materials is harder than searching for a needle in the ocean.”

“As for removing True Immortal residual power, unless one becomes a True Immortal...” Immortal Ancestor shook his head slightly.

The Holy Emperor fell silent.

“The time left for me is actually not much either.”

Immortal Ancestor suddenly said this.

The Holy Emperor was immediately stunned and instinctively looked toward him.

But Immortal Ancestor offered no explanation, instead changing the subject.

“Fellow Daoist, what are your plans now?”

“To continue pursuing the Xuan Immortal Ark and find the true mastermind...”

“Or fight me?”

“The Xuan Immortal Ark must have transmitted something to you just now.” Immortal Ancestor naturally saw the reason for the Holy Emperor’s changed attitude.

The Holy Emperor did not conceal it. He nodded and asked, “Have you ever been aboard the Xuan Immortal Ark?”

“Yes. And I took away some things that I needed,” Immortal Ancestor admitted frankly.

Hearing this, the Holy Emperor could not help but stare at Immortal Ancestor. This straightforwardness from the Exalted Heavenly Sovereign was somewhat beyond his expectations.

“Just as you wish to save Xuanhuang, I also have things I must uphold.”

Perhaps because he had not spoken with anyone for so long, Immortal Ancestor now spoke as though conversing with an old friend.

“To achieve that goal, one must be willing to use any means necessary.”

The Holy Emperor neither agreed nor disagreed.

Immortal Ancestor pointed toward the faintly glowing Xuanhuang Realm not far away, slightly above their angle.

“Have you ever visited the Immortal Ruins?”

“No.”

“There sits an Enlightened True Immortal. It is one of the culprits behind the calamity of this star sea. Have you ever considered that even if you defeat me, how would you lead the entire Xuanhuang Realm in escaping from the hands of that True Immortal?”

Immortal Ancestor asked.

“The time left for the Xuanhuang Realm is also not much.”

Immortal Ancestor let out a cold laugh.

The Holy Emperor merely remained silent once more.

“I have a way,” Immortal Ancestor declared proudly.

“For the sake of the name Xuanhuang, to ignore a future that may lead to total extinction. Can you truly live up to the word ‘Holy’ in your title?” Immortal Ancestor asked.

The Holy Emperor was not shaken by these words.

“If you can find a way to save the world, then naturally so can I.”

“But if I were to be persuaded by your words and simply give up, how could I face the billions of citizens of the Holy Dynasty?”

Immortal Ancestor sneered and no longer argued.

He merely sighed softly. “Fellow Daoist does not know what I have experienced over these years...”

A moment later, Immortal Ancestor became serious.

“I never intended to be your enemy. Nor do I fear you delaying for time.”

“If fellow Daoist wishes to fight, I will accompany you at any moment.”

“Everything depends on your decision.”

The Holy Emperor listened to Immortal Ancestor's words, pondered for a long while, and was just about to speak.

When ripples suddenly appeared once more in the surrounding space.

It was the Xuan Immortal Ark, returning after having departed.

This time, instead of immediately greeting them with True Immortal seal script characters, it first sneered mockingly.

“As expected of the renowned Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor. Your words truly sound better than a song. I only wonder when you intend to return the secret archives you stole from our Xuan Immortal Ark.”

“Oh, right. The reason the Xuanhuang Realm has been able to exist safely beneath the Immortal Ruins for so long is partly thanks to those secret archives of ours, is it not?”

The voice transmitted from the Xuan Immortal Ark was filled with hatred toward the Immortal Ancestor.

The Immortal Ancestor did not refute it.

Meanwhile, the Holy Emperor, listening to these words, began to consider what exactly the so-called secret archives stolen by the Immortal Ancestor were.

Thus, the two Supreme beings and the ancient Immortal Ark confronted one another in the void.

The contradiction between the Immortal Ancestor and the Holy Emperor lay in the conflict between the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor’s foundation and the survival of the Xuanhuang Realm. It was almost impossible to reconcile.

As for the Immortal Ark and the Immortal Ancestor, they were hereditary enemies. That enmity could not be resolved either.

Logically, it would be the wise move for the Holy Emperor and the Immortal Ark to join forces against the Immortal Ancestor.

However, that secret technique which had previously traced bloodline connections had pointed toward the Xuan Immortal Ark. This gave the Holy Emperor an inexplicable sense of unease, and so he had not made a decision.

It was not solely because of the Immortal Ancestor’s secret technique. The Holy Emperor himself had also sensed a somewhat familiar aura from that Immortal Ark.

If the Xuan Immortal Ark had come from beyond the High Wall, then why would it be connected to his own origins?

Everything was far too obscure and confusing. Furthermore, the words just spoken by the Immortal Ancestor forced the Holy Emperor, who had previously only wanted to defeat him, to consider far more.

“Elder Gan chose this location well. If you were any farther away, then even with the protection of True Immortal seal script power, preserving your Immortal Ark would be somewhat difficult.”

After a moment, the Immortal Ancestor recognized the owner of the voice aboard the Xuan Immortal Ark.

He spoke indifferently, a trace of cold light flashing in his eyes.

Yet he seemed wary of something and did not act rashly.

The Xuan Immortal Ark, however, ignored the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor and openly attempted to persuade the Holy Emperor to cooperate with them.

“Fellow Daoist need not worry about the safety of Xuanhuang. Within our Immortal Ark, we have already found a method to save the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“Please take a look…”

A large number of images were transmitted into the Holy Emperor’s mind.

Across the lands of the Xuanhuang Realm, countless towering obelisks stood erect, erupting upward with dazzling brilliance.

As a result, the Xuanhuang Realm was gradually pushed away from the Immortal Ruins.

The Holy Emperor even recognized the driving force behind those obelisks. It was precisely the Dark Sea hidden deep within the Xuanhuang Realm.

“This seems…”

“Feasible?”

The Holy Emperor performed a brief deduction, his heart shaking with indescribable shock.

“How does this Xuan Immortal Ark know of the existence of the Dark Sea?”

As if perceiving the Holy Emperor’s doubts, the Xuan Immortal Ark took the initiative to explain.

“Many years ago, our Xuan Immortal Ark came to the Xuanhuang Realm. We had many exchanges…”

However, these words did not dispel the Holy Emperor’s suspicions.

Instead, his vigilance only deepened.

Meanwhile, hearing the Xuan Immortal Ark persuading the Holy Emperor, the Immortal Ancestor had initially remained somewhat dismissive.

But when he saw the slight change in the Holy Emperor’s expression, he too became greatly astonished.

The way he looked at the Xuan Immortal Ark changed once more.

Too many events had occurred recently that he could not understand, matters beyond his control.

Such things had never happened in the past several thousand years.

But the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor believed that as long as he captured the Xuan Immortal Ark, all these questions would be resolved.

Although, considering the Xuanhuang Realm and that True Immortal who had attained enlightenment, this was not a suitable place to fight.

Still, the Immortal Ancestor did not believe the Xuan Immortal Ark could remain here forever.

His gaze turned toward the depths of the star sea.

There, an aura was rapidly approaching this place.

“Once it arrives, even if war breaks out here, it will not matter.”

Immortal Ancestor stared at the Holy Emperor and the Xuan Immortal Ark as they communicated, then slowly closed his eyes.

The situation in the field was exceedingly delicate.

At this very moment, a fluctuation coming from the Xuanhuang Realm drew the attention of all three forces present.

The Xuanhuang Realm, which had originally become somewhat weakened due to remotely supporting the Holy Emperor's power, now suddenly erupted with a vast surge of vitality.

Bang. Bang.

The sound was clearly audible, like the violent beating of a massive heart.

The Xuanhuang sphere of light continuously churned.

As though something were being gestated within it.

The Xuan Immortal Ark did not understand what was happening.

A trace of astonishment appeared on the Holy Emperor's face. He could sense that his connection with the Xuanhuang Realm was rapidly fading. Although the bond still remained, from this point onward, it would no longer be able to provide him with any assistance.

Immortal Ancestor's face first showed shock, along with a measure of disbelief. Then, as though he had sensed something, a brilliant light erupted in his eyes.

He completely ignored the other two present and flew straight toward the Xuanhuang Realm at extreme speed.

A moment later, the Xuan Immortal Ark also reacted.

Its tone was filled with horror, then overwhelming delight.

"Immortal spiritual qi. Such dense immortal spiritual qi, at that. This..."

"At the very least, there are two or three immortal artifacts. The Xuanhuang Realm truly is a treasure land."

The Xuan Immortal Ark immediately followed behind, transforming into a streak of light as it fled toward it.

Through the Star Sea Net, borrowing the perspectives of Great Qi's soldiers, the Holy Emperor had already sensed what was happening within the Xuanhuang Realm.

"The true Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable has descended."

There was no sense of disappointment from having fallen out of favor. In the Holy Emperor's heart, there was only intense unease.

It felt as though, from just now onward, the entire situation had completely spiraled out of control.

As if an invisible hand was secretly orchestrating everything.

Immortal Ancestor, the Holy Emperor himself, the Xuan Immortal Ark, and even the newly born Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable...

All of them seemed to be moving under its manipulation.

"What exactly..."

The Holy Emperor's heart grew incomparably heavy. In an instant, he had already arrived outside the Xuanhuang Realm.

At this moment, compared to the past, the Xuanhuang Realm had undergone an extremely obvious transformation.

It was as though some dormant mechanism that had remained silent for countless years had been activated. From every corner of the Xuanhuang Realm, certain strange auras began to spread outward.

Ancient, aged, yet gestating miraculous power.

"This..."

A trace of horror flashed through the Holy Emperor's eyes.

"Immortal spiritual qi?"

At the same time, he also saw Immortal Ancestor with a dark expression, as well as the Xuan Immortal Ark blocked in front of him.

Threads of immortal spiritual qi drifted outward from all across the Xuanhuang Realm.

It was impossible to determine their source.

But that sacred and ancient power...

For the living beings of Xuanhuang, it was absolutely not a good thing.

Bang. Bang. Bang.

Countless cultivators, upon coming into contact with even the slightest strands of immortal spiritual qi, wore expressions of intoxicated bliss.

Then, in the very next instant, they exploded into fragments.

How could mortal flesh possibly come into contact with the power of a True Immortal?

Chapter 1299: Immortal Descends, All Things Return To Void

Ever since the Immortal Path was severed, no one knew how many years it had been since immortal spiritual qi had appeared upon the lands of Xuanhuang.

Yet at this moment, these sacred wisps of aura, rising from the earth and climbing upward, seemed to bring no benefit at all to the Xuanhuang Realm.

Instead, they brought a horrifying disaster comparable to extinction.

The greed of cultivators was a hundred times more frenzied than when faced with the Spirit of Heaven and Earth. Even if they had to abandon everything around them, they would still chase after it and seize it. Anyone who dared stand in their way became an enemy worthy of death. Whether Great Qi soldiers or Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators, identity and status no longer mattered, nor did cultivation realm.

The battle between the Holy Dynasty Great Qi and the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance instantly transformed into chaotic slaughter among all cultivators the moment the immortal spiritual qi was released.

With every breath, thousands of cultivators perished.

Because of the unceasing strange phenomena appearing one after another, the sky became layered with thick stretches of bizarre clouds.

Not even the terrifying presence brought by the personal arrival of the Immortal Ancestor could disperse them.

In the entire Xuanhuang Realm, only two armies could barely remain lucid amid this apocalyptic scene.

One was the Great Qi Imperial Guard.

The other was the Qingxuan Army that guarded the Chizha Abyss.

Their common trait was that they had all cultivated the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra.

The Great Qi Imperial Guard had received direct transmission from the Holy Emperor.

The Qingxuan Army had been taught by the Holy Embryo before departing the Xuanhuang Realm.

As some of the few fortunate survivors, as they witnessed this tragedy unfolding in the Xuanhuang Realm, their faces turned pale and their bodies trembled. Though the Immortal Heart Mantra operated automatically to preserve their sanity, the instinctive fear in their hearts could not be erased.

It was not only cultivators.

Birds, beasts, grasses, flowers, even mountains, rivers, and the land itself, everything in the Xuanhuang Realm gradually lost control because of the appearance of immortal spiritual qi.

Beasts behaved like humans, risking life without hesitation in pursuit of immortal spiritual qi. Either they obtained it and exploded to death, or they died in savage struggle.

Plants could not actively pursue it, but some fortunate ones had immortal spiritual qi descend upon them from heaven without effort. Compared to other living beings in the world, although the overwhelming majority of plants also turned to dust in an instant after obtaining immortal spiritual qi, some still survived the cleansing of that vast power.

One might have thought this would create an immortal plant within the Xuanhuang Realm.

Yet before long, crazed cultivators followed the scent and arrived.

Although the transformed immortal plants completed their metamorphosis in a short time and gained defensive power, they still could not withstand the fearless assaults of cultivators. Before long, they were torn apart and devoured.

Then those lucky enough to seize and consume the immortal plants also had their flesh explode and their ashes scattered shortly afterward.

Only this time, thanks to the filtering effect of the immortal plants, they were able to enjoy the wondrous sensation of immortal spiritual qi for a little longer.

Then they perished amid intoxication and enlightenment.

If there was truly anything in the entire Xuanhuang heaven and earth that could genuinely benefit from the uncontrolled spread of immortal spiritual qi...

Then it was only the Xuanhuang world itself.

Like parched land finally nourished by rain descending from heaven.

The Xuanhuang Realm became enveloped in a dreamlike haze.

The earth roared, mountain ranges leapt, plains stretched outward. Transformations that would normally take millions of years now occurred in the blink of an eye.

The heavens, which had previously sunk somewhat while supporting the Holy Emperor of Great Qi, now slowly recovered their former posture and even became loftier.

The Xuanhuang Realm was visibly growing.

Amid strange rhythms, the white mist barriers that originally served as the borders between prefectures gradually dimmed under the immense pressure caused by the Xuanhuang Realm's spontaneous expansion.

Many barrier structures even directly dissipated with thunderous explosions, their power becoming nourishment and merging into the Xuanhuang world.

The strengthening effect brought by the Xuanhuang Realm's growth was astonishing.

Even the strange phenomena accumulating in the sky from the deaths of excessive numbers of cultivators were rapidly being digested.

...

Faced with this unprecedented transformation in Xuanhuang history, the three factions that arrived one after another from beyond the starry sky reacted differently.

The Holy Emperor was momentarily stunned amid the upheaval.

In his perception, the bond he had formed with the Xuanhuang world through all his previous actions became increasingly faint as the Xuanhuang world grew larger. It felt like a childhood close friend gradually becoming distant as both parties matured.

Though he felt a sense of loss, the Holy Emperor quickly recovered. Looking at the Great Qi soldiers still ceaselessly slaughtering one another across heaven and earth, he moved his thoughts and directly transmitted the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra to all of them.

Though among the maddened cultivators, very few could calm themselves enough to cultivate, saving even one was worthwhile.

The Immortal Ancestor, however, wore a complicated expression as he watched this upheaval.

No one knew what he was thinking.

But the only thing he did was keep a tight watch over the restless Xuan Immortal Ark beside him.

Voices came from aboard the Xuan Immortal Ark.

"What a waste, what a waste! Immortal spiritual qi is exceedingly rare even in the star sea! How can it be squandered by these mortals!"

"If this old man could obtain even a single strand, perhaps I could fully unleash the power of True Immortal seal script..."

"Immortal Ancestor! Step aside! Let our Xuan Immortal Ark gather some immortal spiritual qi, and all past grudges can be wiped clean!"

Gan Jingda barely managed to suppress the excitement in his heart as he spoke in a deep voice.

The Immortal Ancestor stood tall beneath his high crown, unmoving as a mountain.

"Your Xuan Immortal Ark..."

"Will stay right here and honestly watch."

"You are going nowhere."

Gan Jingda let out a cold snort, unable to suppress his anger.

"What arrogance! If you continue obstructing us, then do not blame our Xuan Immortal Ark for abandoning courtesy!"

"Though the Xuanhuang Realm may indeed be the last pure land in this stretch of star sea... compared to that, immortal spiritual qi is far more important!"

"Exactly! Jingda, stop wasting words with this old thing! That is immortal spiritual qi! If we can gain control of enough of it, perhaps we can use it to cross the High Wall! Why would we need to remain trapped in this Darkest Star Sea!"

Listening to the market-like clamor from the Xuan Immortal Ark, the Immortal Ancestor's expression remained unchanged, though a trace of mockery flashed through his eyes.

Hidden beneath the roaring of heaven and earth, faint footsteps quietly sounded behind the Xuan Immortal Ark.

Without warning, a shadow attached itself to the Xuan Immortal Ark.

An instant later...

The entire immortal ark vanished from existence.

As if it had never come to the Xuanhuang Realm at all.

The footsteps gradually faded into the distance, leaving behind only a faint deathly aura like frost.

Seeing this scene, the Holy Emperor's pupils contracted sharply.

"What was that?!"

The shadow came and went with incredible speed.

Not only had the Xuan Immortal Ark been caught completely off guard, even the Holy Emperor had failed to see clearly.

He could only vaguely sense the overwhelmingly dense death aura surrounding that figure, almost solid in form.

The Holy Emperor could not help but look toward the Immortal Ancestor.

Clearly, the Immortal Ancestor had long anticipated the appearance of that shadow. Perhaps the shadow's attack on the Xuan Immortal Ark had even been directed by him.

"I am not capable enough to make that thing obediently listen to me. I merely gave it a small hint."

"It is perfectly suited to dealing with those people aboard the Xuan Immortal Ark."

The Immortal Ancestor's gaze remained fixed on the transformation occurring in the Xuanhuang Realm.

He showed little concern for the mysterious shadow or the Xuan Immortal Ark.

Knowing that the Immortal Ancestor would not explain anything to him, the Holy Emperor did not press further, and instead looked down upon the world from the same perspective.

The drastic transformation of the Xuanhuang Realm was still continuing.

If the overall power of the Xuanhuang Realm before the spread of immortal spiritual qi had been "1".

Then in this short span of less than half a day, the overall power of the Xuanhuang Realm had already expanded to nearly "19".

This was not purely due to the mysterious nature of immortal spiritual qi itself, but rather because it acted as a catalyst, allowing the Xuanhuang Realm to truly absorb and fuse the origin power of those foreign worlds.

If before, it had merely been a crude stitching together of flesh.

Then what the Xuanhuang Realm was doing now was akin to a cultivator absorbing the spiritual qi within spirit stones and converting it into their own use.

The efficiency had increased by an unknown number of times.

And even...

The residual world power that had originally remained hidden deep within those foreign worlds, concealed and dormant, was now being uncovered by the Xuanhuang Realm under the stimulation of immortal spiritual qi.

Becoming nourishment for the Xuanhuang Realm.

"Hehehehe..."

"So that is how it is."

Sensing that presence outside the starry sky growing increasingly rapid, the Immortal Ancestor suddenly let out a relieved laugh.

The smile abruptly vanished.

The expression of the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor suddenly changed as he looked toward the Holy Emperor.

"Come, let us continue fighting!"

Expressionless, he instantly unleashed another move, Something In the Palm, striking toward the Holy Emperor.

Without the support of the Xuanhuang Realm's power, it was insufficient to activate Eternal Xuanhuang Realm. But having broken this move before, golden source power essence transformed into towering giant pillars that rose from the earth.

They firmly held back the descending giant palm of the Immortal Ancestor.

At the moment of collision, the Holy Emperor noticed that the Immortal Ancestor did not seem to be using his full strength.

The power of this Something In the Palm was completely incomparable to the one previously used in the starry sky.

And the Holy Emperor saw even more clearly that after trapping him, the Immortal Ancestor immediately attempted to leave.

It seemed he was urgently trying to find something, to stop the drastic transformation of the Xuanhuang Realm.

The Holy Emperor instantly understood something.

Though it was somewhat difficult to believe, he still erupted with full strength and broke free from the giant palm of the Immortal Ancestor.

"The Holy Heart endures forever."

"The Holy Favor endures eternally!"

The Holy Emperor chanted loudly, and in an instant, a beam of radiance shone down from the Great Qi small world.

This was the source power essence stored within the Holy Heart Halls throughout Great Qi.

It was one of the Holy Emperor's final trump cards.

Once exhausted, the combat strength he could wield would be greatly reduced. Yet at this moment, the Holy Emperor showed not the slightest hesitation.

Under the diffusion and stimulation of immortal spiritual qi, the fusion of worlds led by the Xuanhuang Realm was ongoing.

Events were developing in a direction favorable to the Xuanhuang Realm.

"As long as I can hold back the Immortal Ancestor..."

"My mission will be considered complete."

"Though the path has been somewhat winding."

The Holy Emperor thought this to himself, then once again engaged the Immortal Ancestor in battle.

Neither of them wished to destroy the Xuanhuang Realm, so both restrained their power.

And the Xuanhuang Realm, after its fusion and transformation, had greatly increased its tolerance for fluctuations.

For a time, the battle between the Immortal Ancestor and the Holy Emperor once again fell into a stalemate.

...

Xuanhuang land.

Countless cultivators were still slaughtering one another over the struggle for immortal spiritual qi.

Tongyan Prefecture.

For some unknown reason, the immortal spiritual qi gathered here seemed somewhat greater than in other prefectures.

Thus, the slaughter here was the fiercest.

Another intense struggle ended, once again, with a Soul Transformation cultivator turning into flying ash in complete satisfaction.

Because too many cultivators had already died, the competition was no longer as intense as before.

A rare lull appeared in the fighting.

Before the next cultivators arrived, a small golden figure quietly appeared.

Looking at that strand of immortal spiritual qi ahead, greed flashed in the golden figure's eyes.

But this greed seemed different from the meaning shown by the Xuanhuang Realm cultivators.

Just as the small figure was about to act, he suddenly sensed something and turned to look behind him.

He saw a dark-faced cultivator with a scruffy beard, looking somewhat wretched, attempting to approach.

He even held a net in his hand, apparently intending to capture both him and the immortal spiritual qi together.

Having been discovered, the dark-faced man quickly put away the net and burst into loud laughter.

"Courting death..." A trace of killing intent flashed through the golden figure's eyes.

The cultivation of this person before him was truly too weak. He could kill him with a single slap. Yet he actually dared to scheme against him...

Just as he was about to act, a sense of crisis suddenly arose in his heart.

He acted with absolute decisiveness, abandoning the immortal spiritual qi that was almost within his grasp, and instantly transformed into an escaping beam of light and fled.

Watching the small golden figure vanish from sight in the blink of an eye, Jiao Xiuyuan slapped his thigh fiercely in frustration.

"Damn it, I tracked him for so long, and he still got away!"

His expression shifted repeatedly, but in the end, Jiao Xiuyuan chose not to continue pursuing the small golden figure.

Instead, he solemnly looked toward the strand of immortal spiritual qi in the distance that was about to dissipate into heaven and earth.

Toward this peerless treasure of the star sea, there was some greed in Jiao Xiuyuan's eyes, but not much.

Far more than greed, there was an unprecedented solemnity.

He extended his palm, and from the center of it, a branch sprouted.

Very quickly, the sapling grew into a small tree, lush with green leaves swaying in the wind.

Carefully, he guided the strand of immortal spiritual qi into the tree's body, slowly absorbing it.

Jiao Xiuyuan closed his eyes and focused on comprehending it.

Not long afterward.

“It was indeed immortal spiritual qi, no mistake about it.” A sharp gleam flashed through Jiao Xiuyuan’s eyes, only to be replaced by deep confusion.

“So strange. With such an enormous amount of immortal spiritual qi, there are far too many things that could have been done with it.”

“And yet it was simply wasted like this?”

The more he thought about it, the more uneasy Jiao Xiuyuan became.

“And also…”

Jiao Xiuyuan raised his head and looked toward the sky.

In that brief instant just now, he seemed to have faintly sensed a familiar aura. Although it had already vanished now.

“Could it have been my imagination?”

“That makes no sense. If it really were that group, they should absolutely be frantically fighting over the immortal spiritual qi right now.”

Jiao Xiuyuan frowned deeply. After noticing someone approaching, he flashed away.

...

Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance headquarters was in complete chaos.

Not long ago, because the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor had returned to Xuanhuang, all Dharma-Transmitters, Mirror Holders, and even the Illusory Truth Sage lineage had temporarily departed to pay their respects to the Immortal Ancestor.

During this period, a world-shaking explosion occurred within the Museum of Divine Treasures.

Not only were many of the museum’s collections damaged, but even the entire Immortal Alliance headquarters suffered violent tremors.

The surviving Immortal Alliance cultivators had not even had time to investigate the cause of the accident.

They then discovered in horror that the Immortal Alliance headquarters had been cut off from the outside world.

With no understanding of what had happened, panic spread throughout the Immortal Alliance.

However, the chaos had not yet reached the Guardian Hall, within the space of the Derivation Law Jade.

The successive tremors caused all three Dao Integration cultivators stationed there to feel uneasy.

Especially “Sun Ang.”

His aura fluctuated, his face was flushed red, and beads of sweat continuously dripped from his forehead.

“Fellow Daoist Sun, are you alright?”

The three had worked together for quite a long time and had grown much closer.

Zhang Xu could not help but ask.

Although he also felt some unease, it was nowhere near as severe as Sun Ang’s state.

“Still too young after all,” Zhang Xu thought to himself.

“Something feels wrong.” Sun Ang, who was actually Li Fan’s true body, said with apparent nervousness.

“I just tried contacting Elder Xu, but there was no response.”

Hua Yuye comforted him. “Brother Sun need not think too much. Even if some unexpected change has occurred, nothing could possibly happen within Immortal Alliance headquarters.”

Zhang Xu also frowned and said, “Actually, my predecessor as guardian also experienced something similar. It was about five hundred years ago. The space shook endlessly like this, and contact with the outside world was lost. But in the end, everything turned out fine.”

“I hope so.” Li Fan wiped the cold sweat from his forehead as he spoke.

The space of the Derivation Law Jade once again fell into eerie silence.

The violent tremors that came from time to time struck at the hearts of the three.

Li Fan calmed his mind so deeply that he even ignored the calls of the Derivation Law Jade.

He was not nearly as shaken as he appeared on the surface.

On the contrary, Li Fan felt better than ever before.

“So this is immortal spiritual qi. So this is what immortal spiritual qi truly is…”

Within his sea of consciousness, the Final Dissociation Disc was erupting with a blinding radiance never seen before.

After finally witnessing the legendary immortal spiritual energy with his own eyes, the Final Dissociation Disc had at last completed the final missing piece needed to deduce an Immortal-grade formation.

In the past, although through various fortunate opportunities he had learned the formation diagrams of three Immortal-grade formations.

Without immortal spiritual qi, it had all been nothing more than castles in the air, empty theory on paper.

No matter how profound the formations were, they still remained within the limits of the mortal realm.

But now, the situation was completely different.

After understanding what kind of existence immortal spiritual qi truly was, the Final Dissociation Disc, with its data now supplemented, had truly begun advancing toward breaking the limits of mortality.

It had gained the genuine ability to deduce and deploy an Immortal formation.

Although it would still require guidance of immortal spiritual qi.

With the ancient world-protecting formation inherently present in the Xuanhuang Realm itself, along with the newly inherited authority of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

Li Fan’s plan to activate an Immortal formation had become possible.

The formation was named [Immortal Descent, All Things Return to the Void].

It had to be said that this life had seen many unexpected developments that caught Li Fan off guard.

Including, but not limited to, the Holy Emperor clone going out of control.

And the fact that he had actually formed a cooperation with the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor.

“Once strength reaches a certain level, controlling them like chess pieces becomes impossible.”

Fortunately, the many backup plans he had left behind had ultimately prevented the situation from spiraling completely out of control.

At least it had not reached the point where, after laying plans to such an extent in this life, he would be forced into a hasty use of [Truth].

The sudden arrival of the Xuan Immortal Ark was naturally due in great part to the contributions of Li Fan’s Holy Embryo clone.

The reason he had successfully persuaded the Xuan Immortal Ark to launch an expedition against Xuanhuang was not only because Li Fan had gathered ancient records from the Immortal Ark and proven that the Immortal Ruins might contain complete True Immortal seal script characters.

He had also secretly controlled cultivators to heavily damage the Immortal Ark’s divine tree.

Once the divine tree was damaged, the very foundation upon which it depended for survival was lost. Only then did everyone aboard the Xuan Immortal Ark unanimously decide to launch the expedition toward Xuanhuang ahead of schedule.

Although the Immortal Ark Council of Elders also suspected that someone had secretly manipulated events and pushed everything to this point.

The fact remained that the divine tree had been severely damaged. And the perpetrator had self-destructed and died, leaving no evidence behind.

If they wished to continue surviving within this Darkest Star Sea, coming to the Xuanhuang Realm was their only choice.

After arriving near the Xuanhuang Realm, out of caution, the Xuan Immortal Ark did not immediately launch an invasion.

Instead, they planned to first secretly probe the true state of the Xuanhuang Realm and quietly infiltrate part of their forces.

However, before their plan could be carried out, the violent energy fluctuations in the void attracted the attention of the Xuan Immortal Ark.

Naturally, this was the battle between the Immortal Ancestor and the Holy Emperor.

The power displayed by these two Supreme beings with every gesture made everyone aboard the Immortal Ark incomparably solemn.

But later, after discovering that the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor was the same thief who had stolen the Immortal Ark’s secret archives in the past, and that the existence of the Immortal Ark itself seemed to have already been noticed by him.

The Immortal Ark had no choice but to reveal itself.

During the confrontation with the two Supreme Beings, the Xuan Immortal Ark had consumed one nearly complete True Immortal seal script character.

The Holy Embryo guessed it was the character [Hate].

It had been personally written by Zhong Daogong, the Grand Elder of the Severed Immortal Tower, who had never appeared before the public and had devoted himself solely to researching residual True Immortal power.

The Grand Elder’s strength was unfathomable. For this expedition plan, he had produced a total of three nearly complete True Immortal seal script characters.

However, after the first [Hate] character failed to achieve particularly effective results, the people aboard the Immortal Ark became much more cautious.

They began considering alliances and cooperation.

But this was forcibly interrupted by the sudden fluctuations of immortal spiritual qi coming from the Xuanhuang Realm.

When they arrived at the Xuanhuang Realm and saw genuine immortal spiritual qi surging chaotically throughout the entire world, and sensed how the True Immortal characters spread throughout the entire Xuan Immortal Ark had been stimulated and suddenly come alive, the people of the Immortal Ark completely went mad.

Even Grand Elder Zhong Daogong appeared in person for the first time, his expression dazed as he stared at the immortal spiritual qi below.

“It is pure immortal spiritual qi.”

After observing for a moment, Zhong Daogong made his judgment.

“For ordinary cultivators, it is useless. But we can use it.”

“Guide the power of immortal spirit, infuse it according to the operational flow of the source power of the True Immortal seal script...”

Zhong Daogong muttered to himself, then gave his final conclusion.

“The power that can be unleashed would be enough to rival a True Immortal.”

“If we release the entire Immortal Ark’s reserves all at once...”

“We may not be unable to leap across the High Wall with this!”

Zhong Daogong’s words quickly unified the opinions of everyone aboard the Immortal Ark.

However, just as they intended to force the Immortal Ancestor to open a path, Zhong Daogong suddenly shouted, “Be careful!”

But it was already too late.

A moment ago, the Xuanhuang Realm had still been filled with wildly surging immortal spiritual qi.

The next moment, they found themselves in an unknown place.

Zhong Daogong reacted the fastest, casting a seal script character.

In an instant, the entire Immortal Ark fell into absolute silence. Everyone aboard was drenched in cold sweat as they stared at the scene outside the Immortal Ark.

It was as if they were inside a cauldron, with the Xuan Immortal Ark floating on the surface of the water.

Outside the cauldron, an unseen existence seemed to be stirring the water inside.

The water surface continuously rotated, and the Xuan Immortal Ark drifted unsteadily with it.

The people aboard the Immortal Ark could clearly feel that the surrounding temperature had dropped significantly.

“Everyone, what do we do now?”

After a long while, Elder Gan attempted to communicate through voice transmission.

However, this voice transmission seemed as if it could be heard by the invisible existence outside the cauldron.

Bang. Bang. Bang.

That figure leaned down and gazed below.

The temperature of the Immortal Ark plummeted sharply once more.

With just that single glance, one tenth of the lives aboard the Immortal Ark could not withstand it and died instantly.

But what horrified the people of the Immortal Ark even more was this.

Those who had died aboard the Immortal Ark all transformed into faint white lights, passed through the flying vessel, and flew toward the outside of the cauldron.

A small sphere condensed in the invisible existence’s hand.

Inside the sphere, those recently deceased Immortal Ark cultivators were lying peacefully.

The invisible existence put away the sphere, seemingly noticing that there were still living beings below.

It cast its gaze toward them once again.

This time, it even tried to extend a hand and fish the Immortal Ark out of the cauldron.

From top to bottom, everyone aboard the Immortal Ark felt as if they had fallen into an abyss of icy cold.

At the critical moment, Zhong Daogong once again unleashed a set of True Immortal seal script characters.

The movements of the invisible existence slowed.

Then, as if it had forgotten what had just happened, it gradually stopped trying to fish out the Immortal Ark.

It merely continued stirring the water in the cauldron.

It did not leave.

Having learned from the previous incident, no one aboard the Immortal Ark dared communicate through divine sense any longer.

Instead, they switched to the most primitive method of communication, using their hands as pens to gesture and write in the air.

"Elder Zhong, what exactly is that thing outside?"

"Its gaze seems capable of absorbing the vitality of living beings. That single glance just now caused massive casualties aboard the Immortal Ark."

"And it does not seem to distinguish based on cultivation level. It appears random..."

"The Xuanhuang Realm actually has such a terrifying existence?!"

...

Fear, accompanied by chaos, spread throughout the Immortal Ark.

Meanwhile, Li Fan gazed outside the Immortal Ark.

He had seen that invisible existence before this life, before leaving the Xuanhuang Realm.

It was precisely the mysterious existence he encountered while exploring the Life and Death Reversal Great Formation together with Shang Shaojun.

He had originally thought that all the small worlds within the reversal grand formation were merely one of the nine Yin-Yang Pearls.

Within each Yin-Yang Pearl were countless deceased cultivators preserved in ice.

"So the Immortal Ancestor can actually control this invisible existence..."

"It seems there truly is a connection between him and the Rebirth Heavenly Sovereign."

"This existence carries an ancient aura. It should have existed since the ancient Xuanhuang Realm."

Seeing this thing once more, Holy Embryo Li Fan's understanding was already different from before.

And Zhong Daogong's subsequent analysis confirmed his suspicions.

"This thing should not be a living being."

"In the records of the Immortal Ark, there may be a passage that corresponds to it."

Zhong Daogong's fingers moved rapidly through the air as he explained his speculation.

"In the ancient cultivation world, among those worlds that maintained close ties with the upper realm, aside from establishing the position of Great Celestial Venerable to handle communication with the Immortal Realm..."

"To prevent possible loss of control, they would occasionally also establish so-called [Watchers]."

"Watchers did not necessarily exist in every cultivation world, and they were not necessarily living beings or cultivators."

"But without question, they carried out missions bestowed upon them by the Immortal Realm."

"Missions completely different from those of the Great Celestial Venerable."

The auras of the people aboard the Immortal Ark became visibly unstable.

Creations of the Immortal Realm were clearly beyond what they could handle.

Precisely because they were highly proficient in wielding the power of True Immortal seal script characters, the people aboard the Immortal Ark understood more clearly than anyone just how terrifying the existence of an Immortal truly was.

And if even a Watcher had been assigned a mission by an Immortal, how could it possibly be weak?

An atmosphere of despair began spreading throughout the Xuan Immortal Ark.

Fortunately, the words Zhong Daogong wrote next rekindled their spirits.

...

“That was simply because the Xuanshang Immortal Ark was founded by a group of cultivators who had escaped from a cultivation world where Watchers existed.”

From his brief earlier exchange with Mo Rubin, Li Ping could tell that this Xuantian Sect Dharma King did not particularly care about any so-called Xuanhuang orthodoxy.

As long as the world beneath his feet remained intact, that was enough.

What he cared about more was finding that vanished Xuantian King and leaving this Darkest Star Sea.

So the Holy Emperor paid no attention to whether Mo Rubin responded or not, and inwardly shouted, “Dao One!”

The spiritual energy between heaven and earth instantly came alive.

Released through the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven, and with the Dao One insects that had already spread throughout the entire world during the Xuanhuang Realm’s previous savage growth, they now answered the Holy Emperor’s summons.

From death to life, they surged in a great torrent toward the Holy Emperor’s body.

Like an abyss swallowing the ocean, the Holy Emperor’s body gradually expanded as the insect-transformed spiritual energy continuously poured into him.

Ten zhang, one hundred zhang, one thousand zhang...

The Immortal Ancestor chains wrapped around his body instantly turned to ash.

In the blink of an eye, the Holy Emperor had become a truly colossal giant standing between heaven and earth.

Overlooking the lands of Xuanhuang.

Yet the infusion of insect-transformed spiritual energy still did not stop.

It was as if he truly intended to devour all the spiritual energy of the Xuanhuang Realm within a short span of time.

As his body continued to expand, the vast merged Xuanhuang Realm gradually appeared no larger than a single room in the Holy Emperor’s eyes.

Even the attacks of the Immortal Ancestor no longer seemed so impossible to resist.

The Holy Emperor now had enough spare energy to look beyond Xuanhuang and search for the Heavenly Doctor’s location.

“I will hold him back!”

At this moment, Tianyang’s voice suddenly rang out.

He stepped in front of the Immortal Ancestor and said to the Holy Emperor.

“Go without worry.”

“Even the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor will not be able to kill me in a short time.”

Tianyang was no longer in the form of a young child, but had transformed into a puppet of dark gold and crimson intertwined.

Roughly the size of an ordinary human.

“Take this!” The Holy Emperor handed the white ring to Tianyang, while he himself flew away from the Xuanhuang Realm, following the golden needles that were still continuously descending, searching for the Heavenly Doctor’s whereabouts.

He also attempted to intercept the golden light midway.

But the golden needles came from beyond the heavens, far too fast and far too dense.

There was simply no time to stop them.

Only by finding and eliminating the source of the golden needles could this be stopped.

Looking at Tianyang, who was already battling the Immortal Ancestor, and noticing no trace of Mo Rubin appearing.

The Holy Emperor could not afford to hesitate and once more charged into the starry sky.

After entering the void, the insect-transformed spiritual energy rapidly dissipated.

Had the Dao One insects not gained some benefit when the Xuanhuang Realm absorbed immortal spiritual qi and underwent ascension and sublimation earlier, their rate of death would likely have been even faster now.

The Holy Emperor understood that he had to find the Heavenly Doctor’s trace as quickly as possible.

Unfortunately...

This expert, who also seemed to be at the Supreme realm, apparently had no intention of appearing and fighting him directly.

He remained hidden the entire time.

And the Holy Emperor also discovered that these golden needles seemed as if they had been arranged long in advance.

They were not merely being launched from one location in the starry sky.

Rather, from every possible direction, countless golden needles appeared.

Falling into the Xuanhuang Realm with perfect precision.

The Holy Emperor only felt the frustration of possessing overwhelming martial prowess but having nowhere to use it.

In his mind, the image suddenly appeared of the obliterating immortal calamity sealed outside the Great Qi small world, along with the Great Mage’s skeletal remains.

He actually faintly developed the thought of breaking the seal and detonating them.

“Hm?”

Very quickly, the Holy Emperor was shocked by his own thoughts and forcibly suppressed them.

“How could I have such an idea?”

The thought flashed past, and the Holy Emperor could only continue searching for the Heavenly Doctor’s trace.

As the golden needles continued to fall, the Xuanhuang Realm gradually began returning to its original appearance.

Between heaven and earth, the White Mist Barrier rose once more, dividing the various prefectures.

The restless Xuanhuang Realm seemed to have been sealed by the golden needles, falling into slumber.

The helplessness in the Holy Emperor’s heart had already reached its peak.

He casually glanced once more at the Xuanhuang Realm below...

And suddenly his heart shook violently.

Because he abruptly discovered that the Xuanhuang Realm had not completely returned to its original state.

Rather...

That feeling of being within a formation had not faded at all.

Instead, as time passed, it became even stronger.
